words.tr: 短语. 一个恰当的例子；恰如其分的例证
words.ex: He never studies, and fails every test — a case in point.
words.ex_cn: 他从不学习，每次考试都挂科——这就是一个恰当的例子。
words.en: A case in point is a clear and appropriate example that supports or illustrates a point being made.

words.tr: 短语. 大量的；一片……的海洋（用于形容数量极多的事物）
words.ex: There is a sea of people at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会上人山人海。
words.en: A large amount or number of something.

words.tr: phrase. 多种的；各种各样的
words.ex: He eats a variety of fruits every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃各种各样的水果。
words.en: A number or range of things of the same general class that are different or distinct in character or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 沉溺于；放纵自己于（某种情感或行为）
words.ex: He abandon himself to sadness after the loss.
words.ex_cn: 他在失去之后沉溺于悲伤。
words.en: To give oneself over completely to a feeling, emotion, or influence.

words.tr: phrase. 最重要；首先
words.ex: Above all, be kind to others.
words.ex_cn: 最重要的是，对他人要善良。
words.en: Most importantly; especially.

words.tr: v. 符合；“accord”的现在分词；
words.ex: The results according to the data are surprising.
words.ex_cn: 根据数据，结果令人惊讶。
words.en: In a manner corresponding to something stated or understood.

words.tr: phrase. 是…的原因；解释；负责；（数量或比例上）占
words.ex: The rain can account for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 下雨是延误的原因。
words.en: If a particular thing accounts for a part or proportion of something, that part or proportion consists of that thing, or is used or produced by it.

words.tr: phrase. 适应
words.ex: He adapts to new rules quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快适应新规则。
words.en: If you adapt to a new situation or adapt yourself to it, you change your ideas or behaviour in order to deal with it successfully.

words.tr: phrase. 增加
words.ex: The new rules add to the cost.
words.ex_cn: 新规定增加了成本。
words.en: To increase or enhance something by adding more to it.

words.tr: phrase. 合计达
words.ex: The numbers add up to 100.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字加起来等于100。
words.en: If amounts add up to a particular total, they result in that total when they are put together.

words.tr: phrase. 适应； 调节
words.ex: He needs to adjust to the new school.
words.ex_cn: 他需要适应新学校。
words.en: If you adjust to a new situation or get used to it, you change your behaviour or ideas so that you can deal with it successfully.

words.tr: phrase. 尽管困难重重；在极不可能的情况下成功
words.ex: He won the race against all odds.
words.ex_cn: 他克服了所有困难赢得了比赛。
words.en: If something happens against all odds, it happens or succeeds although it seemed impossible or very unlikely.

words.tr: phrase. 尽管困难重重；在极不利的情况下仍取得成功
words.ex: He won the race against all the odds.
words.ex_cn: 他克服了所有困难赢得了比赛。
words.en: If something happens against all the odds, it happens or succeeds although it seemed impossible or very unlikely.

words.tr: phrase. 再三地；反复不止地
words.ex: He tried again and again to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他一遍又一遍地尝试解决这个问题。
words.en: Repeatedly; many times.

words.tr: phrase. 在 ... 前面
words.ex: He is ahead of his classmates in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上比同学领先。
words.en: In front of or before something in time or space.

words.tr: phrase. v. 旨在；针对；以…为目标
words.ex: This program aims at helping poor children.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目旨在帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: If you aim at something, you direct your efforts or actions towards achieving it.

words.tr: phrase. 几乎；差一点；除…外其余都
words.ex: He is all but finished with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎已经做完了作业。
words.en: All but means almost or nearly. It is used to indicate that something is very close to being the case but not completely so.

words.tr: phrase. 总的来说；整体而言
words.ex: All in all, the trip was fun and cheap.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，这次旅行又好玩又便宜。
words.en: When you say all in all, you are summarizing a situation or expressing a general opinion about it.

words.tr: phrase. 各种各样的；各种类型的
words.ex: He has all manner of books in his room.
words.ex_cn: 他的房间里有各种各样的书。
words.en: used to indicate a wide variety of something

words.tr: phrase. 尽管如此；仍然；还是
words.ex: He didn't study, but all the same, he passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他没有学习，但尽管如此，他还是通过了考试。
words.en: Despite that; nevertheless.

words.tr: phrase. 一路上；一直；完全
words.ex: He walked all the way to school.
words.ex_cn: 他一路走到学校。
words.en: From the beginning to the end; completely.

words.tr: phrase. 考虑到；体谅；允许有；留出
words.ex: The plan allows for extra time if needed.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划为需要时留出了额外的时间。
words.en: To make provision or plans for something; to take into consideration.

words.tr: phrase. 容许有……的可能；允许考虑某种情况
words.ex: This situation does not allow of any delay.
words.ex_cn: 这种情况不容许任何拖延。
words.en: To permit or make possible.

words.tr: phrase. 与...在一起；沿着；除此之外，还…
words.ex: He bought apples along with oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他买了苹果，还买了橙子。
words.en: in addition to someone or something else; together with someone or something else

words.tr: phrase. 等等
words.ex: He bought apples, bananas, and so forth.
words.ex_cn: 他买了苹果、香蕉等等。
words.en: Used at the end of a list to indicate that there are other items that could be mentioned.

words.tr: phrase. 决不；一点也不
words.ex: He is anything but lazy.
words.ex_cn: 他绝不是懒惰的。
words.en: You use anything but in expressions such as anything but quiet and anything but happy to emphasize that something is not the case.

words.tr: phrase. 远离；除...之外
words.ex: He lives apart from the city noise.
words.ex_cn: 他住在远离城市喧嚣的地方。
words.en: You use apart from when you are making an exception to a general statement.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吁；有吸引力；使感兴趣
words.ex: The teacher appealed to the students to be quiet.
words.ex_cn: 老师呼吁学生们保持安静。
words.en: To make a serious or urgent request to the public for help or money; to attract or interest someone.

words.tr: phrase. 赞成；满意
words.ex: My parents approve of my new job.
words.ex_cn: 我父母赞成我的新工作。
words.en: To have a favorable opinion of someone or something; to agree with or support a decision, action, or suggestion.

words.tr:
adj. 近似的；大约的；
v. 接近；
words.ex: The approximate cost is $50.
words.ex_cn: 费用大约是50美元。
words.en: An approximate number, time, or position is close to the correct number, time, or position, but is not exact.

words.tr: phrase. 起于；由…引起
words.ex: The problem arises from a simple mistake.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题源于一个简单的错误。
words.en: If a situation or problem arises from a particular event or activity, it is caused by it.

words.tr: 短语. 在拐角附近；即将到来；就在眼前
words.ex: The store is around the corner.
words.ex_cn: 商店就在拐角处。
words.en: If you say that something is around the corner, you mean that it is very near or will happen very soon.

words.tr: phrase. 事实上
words.ex: I thought he was late, but as a matter of fact, he is early.
words.ex_cn: 我以为他迟到了，但事实上，他来早了。
words.en: You use as a matter of fact to introduce a statement that gives more details about what has just been said, or an explanation of it, or something that contrasts with it.

words.tr: phrase. 整体来看；总体上
words.ex: The class, as a whole, did well on the test.
words.ex_cn: 整个班级在考试中表现不错。
words.en: Considering all parts or elements together; as a single unit.

words.tr: phrase. 远到；至于；直到；就…而言
words.ex: The river flows as far as the next town.
words.ex_cn: 这条河一直流到下一个城镇。
words.en: used to indicate the extent or degree of something

words.tr: 短语，就……而言；关于……
words.ex: As far as I am concerned, homework is important.
words.ex_cn: 就我而言，作业很重要。
words.en: Used to indicate the perspective or opinion of the speaker regarding a particular subject.

words.tr: phrase. 如下
words.ex: The steps are as follows.
words.ex_cn: 步骤如下。
words.en: used to introduce a list of items or points

words.tr: phrase. 关于；至于
words.ex: As for homework, I finished it yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 至于作业，我昨天就完成了。
words.en: used to start talking about someone or something

words.tr: 短语. 和……一样好；几乎等于，实际上就是
words.ex: He is as good as his brother at math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上和他哥哥一样好。
words.en: almost, practically

words.tr: phrase. 好像...似的； 仿佛...一样
words.ex: He talks as if he knows everything.
words.ex_cn: 他说话的样子好像什么都知道。
words.en: used to describe how someone or something appears or behaves, suggesting that the appearance or behavior is not real or true

words.tr: phrase. 关于；就……而言
words.ex: As regards homework, I finish it every day.
words.ex_cn: 关于作业，我每天都完成。
words.en: You use 'as regards' to indicate the subject that is being talked or written about.

words.tr: v. 分配；指派；
words.ex: The teacher will assign homework today.
words.ex_cn: 老师今天会布置作业。
words.en: To give someone a particular job or task; to allocate a resource or responsibility to a particular person or purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 至于； 关于；按着；根据
words.ex: I don't know as to when he will come.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道他什么时候来。
words.en: Used to indicate what something is about or concerns.

words.tr: phrase. 也；同样；又；还
words.ex: He likes coffee, and he likes tea as well.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，也喜欢茶。
words.en: In addition to something else; also.

words.tr: phrase. 也；又
words.ex: He can play the guitar as well as sing.
words.ex_cn: 他既能弹吉他也能唱歌。
words.en: In addition to; and also; equally with.

words.tr: phrase. 不包括；除…以外
words.ex: Aside from John, everyone went to the party.
words.ex_cn: 不包括约翰，大家都去参加派对了。
words.en: You use aside from when you are making an exception to a general statement.

words.tr: phrase. 联系；与…交往
words.ex: I associate with him because we share the same hobbies.
words.ex_cn: 我跟他联系是因为我们有相同的爱好。
words.en: to spend time with someone, especially someone that other people disapprove of

words.tr: phrase. 困惑；不知所措；亏本地
words.ex: He was at a loss when the teacher asked him a question.
words.ex_cn: 当老师问他问题时，他不知所措。
words.en: If you say that you are at a loss, you mean that you do not know what to do in a particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 连续地；一口气地（指时间或动作不间断）
words.ex: He slept for five hours at a stretch.
words.ex_cn: 他一口气睡了五个钟头。
words.en: If you do something at a stretch, you do it continuously, without stopping.

words.tr: phrase. 不惜任何代价；无论如何
words.ex: He will finish the project at all costs.
words.ex_cn: 他一定会不惜一切代价完成这个项目。
words.en: If you say that something must be done at all costs, you are emphasizing that it must be done, even if this requires a lot of effort or causes a lot of problems.

words.tr: phrase. 无论如何；总之；不管怎样
words.ex: At all events, he will come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 无论如何，他都会来参加派对。
words.en: In any case; whatever happens.

words.tr: phrase. 一直；随时；每时每刻
words.ex: He wears a helmet at all times when riding a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他骑自行车时一直戴着头盔。
words.en: If something happens or is done at all times, it happens or is done all the time or always.

words.tr: phrase. 乍看之下；一见就
words.ex: At first sight, the puzzle looks easy.
words.ex_cn: 乍一看，这个拼图很简单。
words.en: If you say that something seems to have a particular quality at first sight, you mean that it seems to have that quality when you first see it or first think about it, but that it may not really have that quality.

words.tr: phrase. 内心里；本质上
words.ex: He is at heart a kind man.
words.ex_cn: 他本质上是个善良的人。
words.en: If you say that someone has a particular quality at heart, you mean that it is a basic and important part of their character, even though they may not always show it.

words.tr: phrase. 不时；相隔一定距离（或时间）
words.ex: He checks the machine at intervals.
words.ex_cn: 他每隔一段时间检查一下机器。
words.en: If something happens at intervals, it happens occasionally or periodically, with breaks in between.

words.tr: phrase. 一般的；普遍；未被捕；详尽
words.ex: The issue is important at large.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题在一般情况下很重要。
words.en: If someone dangerous is at large, they are not in prison or have not been caught. It also means discussing something in a general way without considering details.

words.tr: phrase. 有空；悠闲地；从容地
words.ex: He reads books at leisure on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他在周末闲暇时读书。
words.en: If you do something at leisure, you do it in a relaxed way or at the time that you want, rather than in a hurried or forced way.

words.tr: phrase. 从不；在任何时候都不
words.ex: At no time did he lie to his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他从未对父母撒过谎。
words.en: If you say that at no time did a particular thing happen, you are emphasizing that it never happened.

words.tr: phrase. 曾经；同时；一度
words.ex: At one time, he played soccer every day.
words.ex_cn: 曾经，他每天踢足球。
words.en: If something was the case at one time, it was the case during a particular period in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 胡乱地； 随便地
words.ex: He picked a number at random.
words.ex_cn: 他随机选了一个数字。
words.en: If you choose people or things at random, you do not use any particular method, so they all have an equal chance of being chosen.

words.tr: phrase. 以…为代价
words.ex: He succeeded at the cost of his health.
words.ex_cn: 他成功了，但以牺牲健康为代价。
words.en: If something is achieved at the cost of something else, it is achieved by losing the other thing or by causing it to be lost.

words.tr: phrase. 在损害...的情况下
words.ex: He succeeded at the expense of his health.
words.ex_cn: 他成功了，但牺牲了自己的健康。
words.en: If something is done at the expense of someone or something else, it is done in a way that harms them or is unfair to them.

words.tr: 短语. 最迟；最晚
words.ex: You must finish the homework at the latest by Friday.
words.ex_cn: 你最晚必须在周五前完成作业。
words.en: By the specified time, but not later.

words.tr: phrase. 当时；此刻；现在
words.ex: He was busy at the moment.
words.ex_cn: 当时他很忙。
words.en: At the moment is used to indicate that something is happening now.

words.tr: 短语. 准备就绪的；随时待命的
words.ex: The firefighters are at the ready for any emergency.
words.ex_cn: 消防员随时准备应对任何紧急情况。
words.en: In a state of readiness or preparedness.

words.tr: phrase. 冒...之危险
words.ex: I will speak up at the risk of offending someone.
words.ex_cn: 我愿意冒犯人的风险也要说出来。
words.en: If you do something at the risk of something unpleasant happening, you do it even though you know that the unpleasant thing might happen as a result.

words.tr: phrase. 照这样的速度；照这样下去
words.ex: At this rate, we will finish the work tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 照这样下去，我们明天就能完成工作。
words.en: If you say that something is happening at a particular rate, you mean that it is continuing or developing at that speed.

words.tr: phrase. 有时；不时
words.ex: He is late at times.
words.ex_cn: 他有时会迟到。
words.en: on some occasions; occasionally

words.tr: phrase. 专心；注意；照顾
words.ex: Please attend to your homework now.
words.ex_cn: 现在请专心做你的作业。
words.en: To deal with or take care of something; to give attention to someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 把……归因于；认为……是由于
words.ex: He attributes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归功于努力工作。
words.en: If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 让步；退缩；放弃原先的立场或要求
words.ex: He won't back down even when he's wrong.
words.ex_cn: 即使他错了，他也不会退让。
words.en: To withdraw from a commitment or position, often in the face of opposition or after a confrontation.

words.tr: phrase. 不履行；食言；后退
words.ex: He decided to back out of the deal.
words.ex_cn: 他决定退出这笔交易。
words.en: If someone backs out of an agreement or a deal, they decide not to continue with it.

words.tr: phrase. 支持；倒退；备份
words.ex: My friend always backs up my ideas in meetings.
words.ex_cn: 我的朋友总是在会议上支持我的想法。
words.en: To support someone or something; to make a copy of computer data to protect against loss.

words.tr: phrase. 预料到；考虑到；把…作为条件谈判
words.ex: He didn't bargain for so much work.
words.ex_cn: 他没料到会有这么多工作。
words.en: If you do not bargain for something, you do not expect it to happen and so you are not prepared for it.

words.tr: phrase. 在……上讨价还价；就……达成协议
words.ex: They bargained on the price of the old car.
words.ex_cn: 他们在那辆旧车的价格上讨价还价。
words.en: To rely on or expect something to happen, often used in the context of making plans or predictions.

words.tr: v. 以…为基础；“base”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 基地 (或总部) 在…的；办公地点在…的（不用于名词前）；
words.ex: The movie is based on a true story.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影以一个真实故事为基础。
words.en: If one thing is based on another, the first thing is developed from or uses the second thing as its main idea or starting point.

words.tr: phrase. 习惯于做某事
words.ex_cn: 他习惯早起。
words.en: If you are accustomed to something, you are used to it and it is not strange or new to you.

words.tr: phrase. 被指派去做某事；被分配任务去做
words.ex: He is assigned to do the homework tonight.
words.ex_cn: 他被安排今晚做作业。
words.en: To be given a particular task or responsibility.

words.tr: 短语动词. 放松；别紧张；安心
words.ex_cn: 当他和朋友聊天时，他感到很放松。
words.en: To feel relaxed and comfortable in a situation.

words.tr: 短语动词. 有过错；应承担责任
words.ex: He is at fault for the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他应为这起事故负责。
words.en: To be responsible for a mistake or wrongdoing.

words.tr: 短语. 可以自由做某事；不受限制；有自由
words.ex: You are at liberty to leave now.
words.ex_cn: 你现在可以自由离开了。
words.en: If someone is at liberty to do something, they have been given permission to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 意见不一致；有矛盾；处于对立状态
words.ex: They are at odds about where to go for vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们对于去哪里度假意见不一。
words.en: To be in disagreement or conflict with someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 与……不一致；与……有分歧；与……争吵
words.ex: He is at odds with his brother over money.
words.ex_cn: 他因为钱的问题和他弟弟意见不合。
words.en: To be in disagreement or conflict with someone or something.

words.tr: 短语. 任某人处理；供某人支配
words.ex: The car is at your disposal during your stay.
words.ex_cn: 在你逗留期间，这辆车任你使用。
words.en: If you have something at your disposal, you are able to use it whenever you want, and for whatever purpose you want.

words.tr: phrase. 感到困惑或不知所措；茫然
words.ex: He is at sea without a map.
words.ex_cn: 他没有地图，迷失在海上。
words.en: If you are at sea, you are confused and do not know what to do in a particular situation.

words.tr: 短语. 处于危险中；面临风险
words.ex: His job is at stake if he is late again.
words.ex_cn: 如果他再迟到，他的工作就保不住了。
words.en: If something is at stake, it is being risked and might be lost or damaged if you are not successful.

words.tr: phrase. 完全受…支配；任由…摆布
words.ex: He is at the mercy of the weather during his hike.
words.ex_cn: 他在徒步时受天气摆布。
words.en: To be in a situation where someone or something has complete control over you.

words.tr: phrase. 更好；境况更佳；过得更舒服
words.ex: You will be better off without that job.
words.ex_cn: 没有那份工作，你会过得更好。
words.en: To be in a more advantageous or satisfactory situation.

words.tr: phrase. 难以置信地；不可思议地
words.ex: The movie's ending was beyond belief.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的结局难以置信。
words.en: If something is beyond belief, it is so extreme or unlikely that it is hard to believe.

words.tr: phrase. 无与伦比的；无可比拟的
words.ex: Her beauty is beyond compare.
words.ex_cn: 她的美无与伦比。
words.en: If you describe something as beyond compare, you mean that it is extremely good or great and that nothing else is quite like it.

words.tr: phrase. 无与伦比的；无可比拟的
words.ex_cn: 她的歌唱无与伦比。
words.en: To be unrivalled or unparalleled in quality or excellence.

words.tr: phrase. 与生俱来
words.ex: He was born with a talent for music.
words.ex_cn: 他生来就有音乐天赋。
words.en: To have a particular quality or ability from birth.

words.tr: phrase. 全神贯注于；热衷于；与……密切相关
words.ex: He is bound up in his work and has no time for friends.
words.ex_cn: 他全身心投入工作，没有时间陪朋友。
words.en: If you are bound up in something, you are very busy with it or very interested in it, so that you hardly think about anything else.

words.tr: phrase. 能够
words.ex: He is capable of solving hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能解决困难的数学问题。
words.en: To have the ability, power, or skill to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 与…相反；违反…；违背…
words.ex: His opinion is contrary to mine.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点与我的相反。
words.en: To be in opposition or contrast to something.

words.tr: phrase. 依靠；依赖
words.ex: He is dependent on his parents for money.
words.ex_cn: 他靠父母给钱生活。
words.en: rely on something or someone for support or existence

words.tr: phrase. 依赖于……的；取决于……的
words.ex: The plant is dependent upon sunlight to grow.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物依赖阳光生长。
words.en: Reliant on or determined by something else.

words.tr: phrase. 致力于…
words.ex: He is devoted to helping poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他致力于帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: To be devoted to something means to give all your time, effort, or love to it.

words.tr: phrase. 有...的资格；有权
words.ex: He is entitled to free healthcare.
words.ex_cn: 他有权享受免费医疗。
words.en: If you are entitled to something, you have the right to have it or do it.

words.tr: phrase. 相等；胜任
words.ex: Two plus two is equal to four.
words.ex_cn: 二加二等于四。
words.en: If one thing is equal to another, they are the same in size, number, standard, or value.

words.tr: phrase. 与某人完全相同的；与某人一模一样的
words.ex: He is identical to his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他和他弟弟一模一样。
words.en: To be exactly the same as someone else in every detail.

words.tr: phrase. 与某人完全相同；与某人一模一样
words.ex: He is identical with his brother in looks.
words.ex_cn: 他在外貌上和他哥哥一模一样。
words.en: To be exactly the same as someone else in all aspects.

words.tr: phrase. 与……完全相同的；与……一模一样的
words.ex: This shirt is identical to mine.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫和我的一模一样。
words.en: Exactly the same as; not different in any way.

words.tr: phrase. 与某物完全相同；与某物一模一样
words.ex_cn: 这个数字和那个数字完全相同。
words.en: To be exactly the same as something else.

words.tr: 短语. 负责；主管；掌管
words.ex: He is in charge of the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 他负责这个教室。
words.en: To have the responsibility for or control over something or someone.

words.tr: 短语动词. 有需求的；受欢迎的；被广泛需要的
words.ex: Good teachers are in demand.
words.ex_cn: 好老师很受欢迎。
words.en: If someone or something is in demand, they are very popular and many people want to have them or use them.

words.tr: phrase. 有争议
words.ex: The land is in dispute between two families.
words.ex_cn: 这块土地在两个家庭之间存在争议。
words.en: If something is in dispute, people are arguing about it or discussing it because they disagree about it.

words.tr: phrase. 有疑问；有怀疑
words.ex: He is in doubt about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个答案感到不确定。
words.en: To be uncertain or unsure about something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 正在全面进行中；处于高潮阶段
words.ex: The festival is in full swing this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这个节日本周末正在热烈进行中。
words.en: If an event is in full swing, it is at its busiest or liveliest time.

words.tr: 短语动词. 处于反对地位；持反对意见
words.ex: He is in opposition to the new law.
words.ex_cn: 他反对这项新法律。
words.en: To be in a position of disagreement or resistance against someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 反对；与……持相反意见
words.ex: He is in opposition to the new rule.
words.ex_cn: 他反对这个新规定。
words.en: To be against or resist something or someone.

words.tr: 短语动词. 处于良好状态；身体健康
words.ex: He runs every day to be in shape.
words.ex_cn: 他每天跑步以保持健康。
words.en: To be in good physical condition, especially as a result of exercise and proper nutrition.

words.tr: phrase. 身体状况良好
words.ex: He runs every day to be in good shape.
words.ex_cn: 他每天跑步以保持良好的体形。
words.en: To be in a good physical condition or to be well-prepared for something.

words.tr: 短语. 在视线内；看得见；即将出现
words.ex: The boat is in sight now.
words.ex_cn: 船现在看得见了。
words.en: To be visible or within the range of vision.

words.tr: 短语动词. 在空中；悬而未决；流传着（指想法、情绪等）
words.ex_cn: 空气中弥漫着兴奋的感觉。
words.en: If something is in the air, you feel that it is happening or about to happen.

words.tr: 短语动词. 悬而未决；结果不确定
words.ex: The fate of the project is in the balance as the investors decide whether to continue funding.
words.ex_cn: 项目的命运悬而未决，因为投资者正在决定是否继续提供资金。
words.en: If something is in the balance, it is uncertain whether it will succeed or fail, or whether it will happen or not.

words.tr: 短语动词. 处于未定状态；结果不确定
words.ex: His job hangs in the balance after the company's decision.
words.ex_cn: 公司做出决定后，他的工作悬而未决。
words.en: If something hangs in the balance, it is uncertain whether it will happen or continue.

words.tr: 短语动词. 掌握权力；处于控制地位
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上骑马，骑在马鞍上。
words.en: To be in a position of control or authority.

words.tr: 短语. 正在被使用；处于使用状态
words.ex: This machine is in use now.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器现在正在使用中。
words.en: If something is in use, it is being used.

words.tr: phrase. 挡道；妨碍；碍事
words.ex: Please move your bike; it's in the way.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的自行车挪开；它挡路了。
words.en: To be in a position that blocks someone or something; to prevent someone from doing something or something from happening by being in a particular place or condition.

words.tr: phrase. 阻碍某人；妨碍某人
words.ex: The box is in my way.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子挡着我了。
words.en: To be an obstacle or hindrance to someone's progress or movement.

words.tr: phrase. v. 做错了；理亏；有过失
words.ex: He is in the wrong because he broke the rule.
words.ex_cn: 他错了，因为他违反了规则。
words.en: If someone is in the wrong, they have made a mistake or done something that they should not have done.

words.tr: phrase. 对……不可或缺的；必需的；必不可少的
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必不可少的。
words.en: To be absolutely necessary or essential for something.

words.tr: phrase. 对……必不可少的；不可或缺的
words.ex: Water is indispensable for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必不可少的。
words.en: To be absolutely essential or crucial for a particular purpose or person.

words.tr: phrase. 无罪的，清白的；没有…的，不含…的
words.ex: He is innocent of the crime.
words.ex_cn: 他没有犯这个罪。
words.en: To be free from guilt or sin; not guilty of a crime or offense.

words.tr: phrase. 热衷于；喜爱；对…极感兴趣
words.ex: He is keen on playing football.
words.ex_cn: 他非常热衷于踢足球。
words.en: If you are keen on something, you like it a lot and are very enthusiastic about it.

words.tr: phrase. 热衷于；对……非常感兴趣
words.ex_cn: 她对摄影非常热衷，大部分空闲时间都在拍照。
words.en: To be very interested in or enthusiastic about something.

words.tr: phrase. 对…负有法律责任的；应承担…的
words.ex: He is liable for the damages caused by his negligence.
words.ex_cn: 他对因他的疏忽造成的损失负有责任。
words.en: To be legally responsible or obligated to pay for something, often a debt or damage.

words.tr: phrase. 有…倾向的；易于…的
words.ex: He is liable to make mistakes when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 当他累了的时候，容易出错。
words.en: If someone or something is liable to something, they are likely to experience it or do it.

words.tr: phrase. 沉迷于；着迷于
words.ex: He is obsessed with video games.
words.ex_cn: 他沉迷于电子游戏。
words.en: To be completely preoccupied with a particular thought or feeling, often to an unhealthy degree.

words.tr: phrase. 不备; 不警惕
words.ex: The thief caught him off guard.
words.ex_cn: 小偷让他毫无防备。
words.en: If someone is caught off guard, they are not ready or prepared for something that happens, especially something that they should have expected.

words.tr: phrase. 放松警惕的；失去戒备的
words.ex_cn: 他因突如其来的问题而措手不及。
words.en: To be unprepared or not vigilant against possible danger or difficulty.

words.tr: 短语动词. 正在节食；在控制饮食以减肥
words.ex: He is on a diet to lose weight.
words.ex_cn: 他正在节食以减重。
words.en: To follow a special course of food to which one restricts oneself, either to lose weight or for medical reasons.

words.tr: phrase. 保持警惕；提防；戒备
words.ex: Be on guard when you walk alone at night.
words.ex_cn: 晚上独自走路时要小心。
words.en: To be on guard means to be vigilant and ready to defend against danger or surprise.

words.tr: phrase. 保持警惕；提防；戒备
words.ex: Always be on your guard when dealing with strangers.
words.ex_cn: 在与陌生人打交道时，要始终保持警惕。
words.en: To be cautious and alert to possible danger or difficulty.

words.tr: 短语动词. 在出售；特价销售
words.ex: The shoes are on sale this week.
words.ex_cn: 这周鞋子在打折。
words.en: To be available for purchase at a reduced price.

words.tr: phrase. 正在增加；在增长中
words.ex: The number of tourists is on the increase.
words.ex_cn: 游客的数量在增加。
words.en: If something is on the increase, it is happening more often or becoming greater in number or amount.

words.tr: 短语动词. 专心工作；在岗位上认真履职；正在执行任务
words.ex: She is always on the job, ensuring everything runs smoothly.
words.ex_cn: 她总是在工作，确保一切顺利运行。
words.en: To be actively engaged in one's work or duties.

words.tr: phrase. 即将做某事；正要开始做某事
words.ex: He is on the point of leaving when the phone rings.
words.ex_cn: 他正要离开，这时电话响了。
words.en: To be about to do something; to be on the verge of doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 失去作用；无法工作；暂时不能活动
words.ex: The machine has been out of action for weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器已经停止运转好几个星期了。
words.en: If a machine or system is out of action, it is not working or is not able to be used.

words.tr: 短语动词. 上气不接下气；喘不过气来
words.ex: He ran fast and was out of breath.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，喘不过气来。
words.en: To be breathing very quickly and with difficulty, usually after physical exertion.

words.tr: 短语动词. 身体状况不佳；健康状态不好
words.ex: He is out of condition because he stopped exercising.
words.ex_cn: 他因为停止锻炼而体能下降。
words.en: If someone is out of condition, they are not physically fit.

words.tr: phrase. 失去控制的；无法管理的
words.ex: The fire was out of control.
words.ex_cn: 火势失去了控制。
words.en: To no longer be manageable or governable; to be in a state where one cannot be directed or restrained.

words.tr: phrase. 过时的；不再流行的；已废弃的
words.ex: This phone is out of date.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机过时了。
words.en: If something is out of date, it is old-fashioned and no longer useful or relevant.

words.tr: phrase. 不再印刷的；绝版的（指书籍等出版物已停止印刷，无法再购买到新本）
words.ex: This book will be out of print soon.
words.ex_cn: v. 这本书很快就要绝版了。
words.en: If a book is out of print, it is no longer being published and copies are no longer available from the publisher.

words.tr: phrase. 不在视线内；看不见；消失
words.ex: The ship was out of sight before we could take a photo.
words.ex_cn: 我们还没来得及拍照，船就已经看不见了。
words.en: To be not visible; to be unable to be seen.

words.tr: phrase. 缺货的；无存货的
words.ex: The latest model of the smartphone is out of stock in most stores.
words.ex_cn: v. 最新型号的智能手机在大多数商店都缺货了。
words.en: If a product is out of stock, it is not available for purchase because all the available items have been sold.

words.tr: phrase. 失去联系；不了解情况；与外界脱节
words.ex: He has been out of touch with his family for years.
words.ex_cn: v. 他已经多年没有和家人联系了。
words.en: If you are out of touch with someone, you have not been in contact with them recently and do not know what is happening in their life. If you are out of touch with a subject or situation, you do not have recent knowledge about it.

words.tr: phrase. 失业的；没有工作的
words.ex: After the factory closed, he was out of work for several months.
words.ex_cn: 工厂关闭后，他失业了好几个月。
words.en: To be without a job; unemployed.

words.tr: phrase. 喜欢；偏爱
words.ex: She is partial to chocolates.
words.ex_cn: 她偏爱巧克力。
words.en: To like someone or something more than someone or something else, in a way that is unfair.

words.tr: phrase. 与…有关
words.ex: This problem is related to math.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题与数学有关。
words.en: To be connected or associated with something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 与…有关；相对于…；与…有关系
words.ex: His success is relative to his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他的成功与他的努力有关。
words.en: To be connected or have a relationship with something in terms of its nature, quality, or quantity.

words.tr: phrase. 害怕某物或某种情况；对……感到恐惧
words.ex: She is scared of spiders.
words.ex_cn: 她害怕蜘蛛。
words.en: To feel fear or anxiety about someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 厌恶；厌倦
words.ex: I am sick of cold rain every day.
words.ex_cn: 我厌倦了每天下冷雨。
words.en: To be tired of or bored with something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 优越于；胜过；不屈服于
words.ex: This phone is superior to that one.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机比那部更好。
words.en: To be better or higher in quality, rank, or status than someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 对...表示同情的；体谅的；支持的
words.ex_cn: 他对穷人有同情心。
words.en: To show understanding and support for someone's feelings or situation.

words.tr: 短语动词. 处于控制之中；被有效管理
words.ex: The fire was finally under control after several hours of firefighting.
words.ex_cn: 经过几个小时的灭火，火势终于得到了控制。
words.en: To be in a state where one's actions, emotions, or a situation are managed or restrained by someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 在进行中
words.ex: The project is under way.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目正在进行中。
words.en: If an activity is under way, it has already started.

words.tr: adj. 最新的；最近的；新式的
words.ex: He keeps his knowledge up-to-date by reading news every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天读新闻来保持知识的更新。
words.en: Someone or something that is up-to-date has the most recent information or uses the newest methods or equipment.

words.tr: phrase. 最新的；紧跟时事的；即时更新的
words.ex: He keeps up to the minute news on his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他用手机获取最新的新闻。
words.en: Including the very latest information.

words.tr: phrase. 拐弯抹角；不直截了当地谈正题
words.ex: He keeps beating around the bush instead of telling the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他一直绕圈子，而不说真话。
words.en: To avoid talking about what is important or to delay talking about something difficult or unpleasant.

words.tr: phrase. v. 拐弯抹角；旁敲侧击；不直截了当
words.ex: He always beats about the bush when asked about his plans.
words.ex_cn: 每当被问及他的计划时，他总是拐弯抹角。
words.en: To avoid talking about what is important or to speak indirectly about a topic.

words.tr: phrase. 击败；打倒；压低（价格）；使减弱
words.ex: The team beat down their rivals in the final match.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍在决赛中击败了对手。
words.en: 1. To defeat someone in a fight, competition, or argument. 2. If the sun beats down, it shines very brightly and makes the weather very hot.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 殴打；痛打；损坏
words.ex: They beat up the man in the park last night.
words.ex_cn: 他们昨晚在公园里打了那个男人。
words.en: To beat someone up means to hit them repeatedly, especially in a violent way.

words.tr: phrase. 会怎样；发生什么情况（通常用于疑问句，表示对某人或某物未来的关切）
words.ex: I wonder what will become of him after he leaves school.
words.ex_cn: 我不禁想知道他离开学校后会怎么样。
words.en: If you wonder what has become of someone or something, you wonder where they are and what has happened to them.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 借口拒绝；找借口退出（某项义务或承诺）
words.ex: He begged off the meeting because he felt sick.
words.ex_cn: 他因为感觉不舒服而推掉了会议。
words.en: To politely refuse to do something that you have been invited to do or have agreed to do, usually because you have a good reason.

words.tr: 短语. 在幕后；在后台；秘密地；不为公众所知的情况下
words.ex: He works behind the scenes to make the show successful.
words.ex_cn: 他在幕后工作，以使这个节目成功。
words.en: In a position or situation that is not seen by the public; secretly or privately.

words.tr: phrase. 相信；信任
words.ex: I believe in working hard to achieve my dreams.
words.ex_cn: 我相信努力工作能实现我的梦想。
words.en: To feel certain that something exists or is true, or to have confidence in a person or thing.

words.tr: phrase. v. 极力迁就；竭尽全力帮助（某人）
words.ex: He will bend over backwards to help his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他会竭尽全力帮助他的朋友。
words.en: To make a great effort to achieve something or to help someone.

words.tr: phrase. 无法估量地；极其；非常
words.ex: Her kindness is beyond measure.
words.ex_cn: 她的善良无法衡量。
words.en: To a very great extent or degree; extremely.

words.tr: phrase. v. 发射升空；（火箭、航天器等）起飞
words.ex: The rocket will blast off at 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 火箭将在下午3点发射。
words.en: When a spacecraft blasts off, it leaves the ground at the start of its journey.

words.tr: phrase. 使充气；爆炸；发怒；夸大
words.ex: He blew up the balloon with his mouth.
words.ex_cn: 他用嘴把气球吹鼓了。
words.en: If someone blows something up or if it blows up, it is destroyed by an explosion.

words.tr: phrase. 夸耀；自夸；吹嘘（某事物）
words.ex: He likes to boast of his new toy car.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢炫耀他的新玩具车。
words.en: If someone boasts about something that they have done or that they own, they talk about it very proudly, in a way that other people may find irritating or offensive.

words.tr: phrase. 吹嘘；自夸（关于某事）
words.ex: He boasts about his new car.
words.ex_cn: 他吹嘘自己的新车。
words.en: If someone boasts about something that they have done or that they own, they talk about it very proudly, often in a way that other people find annoying.

words.tr: phrase. 归结为；最终意味着；简化为
words.ex: The problem boils down to a lack of time.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题归结为缺乏时间。
words.en: If you say that a situation or problem boils down to a particular thing or can be boiled down to a particular thing, you mean that this is the most important or the most basic aspect of it.

words.tr: phrase. 扩展业务；向新的方向发展；开拓新领域
words.ex: He wants to branch out into music.
words.ex_cn: 他想涉足音乐领域。
words.en: To expand or extend one's interests or activities into new areas.

words.tr: phrase. 停止运转；出故障；分解；感情失控
words.ex: The machine broke down yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器昨天坏了。
words.en: If a machine or vehicle breaks down, it stops working. If a discussion, relationship, or system breaks down, it fails because of a problem or disagreement.

words.tr: phrase. 闯入；打断；突然…
words.ex: The thief tried to break into the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 小偷试图在夜里闯入房子。
words.en: To enter a building or car using force, in order to steal something; to suddenly start doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 中断；突然停止；断绝（关系）；休息一会
words.ex: He broke off the conversation when the phone rang.
words.ex_cn: 电话响时，他中断了对话。
words.en: To suddenly stop doing something, especially speaking.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人心碎；令某人极度悲伤
words.ex: His lies broke her heart.
words.ex_cn: 他的谎言让她心碎。
words.en: To cause someone to feel extreme sadness or grief.

words.tr: phrase. 突发；爆发；越狱
words.ex: The fire broke out in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 火在厨房里突然烧了起来。
words.en: If something such as war, fighting, or disease breaks out, it begins suddenly.

words.tr: phrase. 打破僵局；缓解紧张气氛；使初次见面的人放松
words.ex: He told a joke to break the ice at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上讲了个笑话来打破僵局。
words.en: To do or say something to relieve tension or get conversation going in a strained situation or when strangers meet.

words.tr: phrase. 突围；突破
words.ex: He broke through the wall with his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用手打破了墙壁。
words.en: To break through means to make a way through a barrier or to achieve success in spite of difficulties.

words.tr: phrase. 打碎；分裂；解体；结束；期终放假
words.ex: He broke up the ice with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子把冰打碎了。
words.en: To end a relationship or to disintegrate into pieces.

words.tr: phrase. 带来；引起
words.ex: Hard work can bring about success.
words.ex_cn: 努力工作可以带来成功。
words.en: To cause something to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 使信服；使复苏
words.ex: He brought his friend around to the new idea slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地让朋友接受了这个新想法。
words.en: To persuade someone to agree with you or to do what you want; to cause someone to regain consciousness; to cause someone to change their opinion or decision.

words.tr: phrase. 说服；使觉醒
words.ex: He brought round his friend to agree with him.
words.ex_cn: 他说服了他的朋友同意他的观点。
words.en: To cause someone to become conscious again after being unconscious; to persuade someone to agree with a particular opinion or to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 提出；产生；生出；使显现
words.ex: He brought forth a new idea in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个新想法。
words.en: To bring forth means to produce or cause something to happen or exist.

words.tr: phrase. 提出；提前；把…带上前来
words.ex: He will bring forward a new idea at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他将在会议上提出一个新想法。
words.en: To bring forward means to move an event or date to an earlier time, or to introduce a topic or proposal for discussion.

words.tr: 使生效；实施；启用（指使计划、法律、措施等开始生效）
words.ex: The government will bring into effect the new law next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府将于下个月实施新法律。
words.en: To cause something to happen or to be put into operation.

words.tr: phrase. 使生效；实施；执行（计划、政策等）
words.ex: The government will carry into effect the new law next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将实施新法律。
words.en: To put into operation or implement something.

words.tr: phrase. 实施；使生效；付诸实行
words.ex: The new rules will be put into effect next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 新规则将于下周一实施。
words.en: To cause something to start to apply or operate.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 成功完成（困难的事情）；使（计划、交易等）成功
words.ex: He brought off the magic show with great skill.
words.ex_cn: 他以高超的技巧完成了这场魔术表演。
words.en: To successfully achieve something difficult.

words.tr: phrase. 使表现出；说出；呈出；出版
words.ex: The new lighting really brings out the colors in the painting.
words.ex_cn: 新灯光让画中的颜色更加突出。
words.en: To cause something to be seen or known; to publish something.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 使……渡过难关；帮助……康复；成功救治
words.ex: The doctor worked hard to bring the patient through the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 医生努力让病人顺利度过手术。
words.en: To help someone survive a difficult period or to recover from an illness.

words.tr: phrase. 将某人绳之以法；使违法者受到法律制裁
words.ex: The police want to bring the thief to justice.
words.ex_cn: 警察想把小偷绳之以法。
words.en: To ensure that someone is tried in a court of law for a crime they are accused of.

words.tr: 使某人屈服；使某人陷入绝境；使某人跪下
words.ex: The drought brought the farmer to his knees.
words.ex_cn: 干旱使这位农民陷入绝境。
words.en: To cause someone to submit or surrender.

words.tr: phrase. 拓宽视野；开阔眼界
words.ex: Traveling abroad can broaden one's horizon.
words.ex_cn: 出国旅行可以拓宽一个人的视野。
words.en: To expand one's understanding or experience, especially by encountering new ideas, cultures, or perspectives.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 漠视；拒绝考虑；置之不理
words.ex: He tried to brush aside the problem, but it came back later.
words.ex_cn: 他试图忽视这个问题，但它后来又出现了。
words.en: To refuse to consider something seriously because you think it is not important.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 漠视；拒绝；摆脱（某人或某事）
words.ex: He tried to brush off the criticism with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用微笑来应付批评。
words.en: To remove something by brushing or to dismiss someone or something rudely.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 复习；温习；提高（技能）
words.ex: I will brush up on my English before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 我将在考试前复习一下英语。
words.en: To improve your knowledge of something already learned but partly forgotten.

words.tr: phrase. 建立于；以…为基础；指望
words.ex: He built on his old ideas to make a new plan.
words.ex_cn: 他基于旧的想法制定了一个新计划。
words.en: To develop or increase something from a particular starting point or base.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 在……基础上发展；以……为起点进行建设或改进
words.ex: He built upon his earlier work to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他基于之前的工作解决了这个问题。
words.en: To develop or improve something by using or adding to something that already exists.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；逐步增长；加强
words.ex: He builds up his strength by running every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天跑步来增强体力。
words.en: To increase or develop something gradually; to accumulate or amass something over time.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 碰撞；偶然遇到
words.ex: Be careful not to bump against the table.
words.ex_cn: 小心别撞到桌子。
words.en: To come into contact with something or someone in a way that is usually not intended or expected.

words.tr: phrase. 包起来；裹紧（衣物）；收拾整理
words.ex: He bundled up before going out in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿得很暖和。
words.en: To dress warmly, especially by wearing multiple layers of clothing, or to wrap something tightly in cloth or paper.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （使建筑物等）烧毁；烧成平地
words.ex: The old house burned down in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 那座老房子在火灾中被烧毁了。
words.en: If a building burns down or if someone burns it down, it is completely destroyed by fire.

words.tr: phrase. 烧掉；烧坏；熄灭
words.ex: The candle burned out after five hours.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛燃烧了五个小时后熄灭了。
words.en: If someone burns out, they become exhausted or lose their enthusiasm because they have been working too hard or for too long.

words.tr: phrase. 烧起来；烧光；消耗
words.ex: The dry grass burned up quickly in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 干草在阳光下迅速烧了起来。
words.en: If something burns up or if fire burns it up, it is completely destroyed by fire or heat.

words.tr: phrase. 闯入；突然发作
words.ex: The thieves burst into the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 小偷在夜里闯入了房子。
words.en: If you burst into a particular kind of activity, you suddenly start doing it.

words.tr:
conj. 但是；然而；
prep. 除…以外；
adv. 只能；仅仅；
words.ex: I like apples, but I don't like oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果，但是我不喜欢橙子。
words.en: used to introduce a phrase or clause contrasting with what has already been mentioned

words.tr: phrase. 但是那时；不过话说回来
words.ex: I wanted to go out, but then it started raining.
words.ex_cn: 我想出去，但那时开始下雨了。
words.en: Used to introduce a statement that contrasts with or seems to contradict something that has been said previously.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 插嘴；干涉；打扰
words.ex: He always butts in when others are talking.
words.ex_cn: 他总是在别人说话时插嘴。
words.en: To interrupt a conversation or activity, especially in a rude or intrusive manner.

words.tr: phrase. 贿赂；收买；用钱打发
words.ex: He tried to buy off the witness with money.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用钱收买证人。
words.en: To pay someone to stop them from causing trouble or to get them to do something for you, often something dishonest.

words.tr: phrase. 买下…的全部股份；买断
words.ex: He decided to buy out his partner's share.
words.ex_cn: 他决定买下合伙人的一半股份。
words.en: To buy out means to purchase all of a company's shares or assets, often to take control of it.

words.tr: phrase. 偶然地；意外地
words.ex: He broke the vase by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心打碎了花瓶。
words.en: If something happens by accident, it happens without being planned or intended.

words.tr: phrase. 尽一切办法；务必；一定
words.ex: You can borrow my book by all means.
words.ex_cn: 你当然可以借我的书。
words.en: used to give permission or to say that you are willing to allow something to happen

words.tr: phrase. 不久以后；逐渐地；迟早
words.ex: By and by, the rain stopped and the sun came out.
words.ex_cn: 渐渐地，雨停了，太阳出来了。
words.en: After some time; eventually.

words.tr: phrase. 大体上；总的来说
words.ex: By and large, he is a good student.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，他是个好学生。
words.en: You use 'by and large' to indicate that a statement is mostly but not completely true.

words.tr: 短语. 万一；碰巧；或许（用于疑问句中，表示不确定的可能性）
words.ex: Do you have a pen by any chance?
words.ex_cn: 你碰巧有笔吗？
words.en: used to ask whether something is true or possible, especially when you do not expect the answer to be yes

words.tr: phrase. 碰巧；偶然；意外地
words.ex: I met my old friend by chance at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 我在超市碰巧遇到了我的老朋友。
words.en: If something happens by chance, it happens without being planned or intended.

words.tr: phrase. 比较起来
words.ex: He is slow, by comparison, his brother is fast.
words.ex_cn: 相比之下，他很慢，他弟弟很快。
words.en: When you say that something is true by comparison, you mean that it is true when compared to something else.

words.tr: phrase. 相比
words.ex: He runs fast, in comparison to his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，与他哥哥相比。
words.en: When you make a comparison, you consider two or more things and discover the differences between them.

words.tr: phrase. 默认地；自动地（指在没有其他选择或干预的情况下自然发生的状态或结果）
words.ex: The program opens by default in safe mode.
words.ex_cn: 该程序默认以安全模式打开。
words.en: If something happens by default, it happens only because something else which might have prevented it or changed it has not happened.

words.tr: phrase. …得多；尤其；更；到目前为止
words.ex: This is by far the best movie I have seen.
words.ex_cn: 这绝对是我看过的最好的电影。
words.en: By far is used to emphasize that something is the best, worst, biggest, etc., of its kind.

words.tr: phrase. 独自地；单独地；自动地
words.ex: The book fell by itself from the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书自己从架子上掉了下来。
words.en: without assistance or support; independently.

words.tr: phrase. 迅速地；飞快地；大步地（用于形容进展或增长非常迅速）
words.ex: His English is improving by leaps and bounds.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语正在飞速进步。
words.en: If something increases or improves by leaps and bounds, it does so very quickly and to a great extent.

words.tr: phrase. 突飞猛进地；飞跃式地；迅速地
words.ex: Her English skills are improving in leaps and bounds.
words.ex_cn: 她的英语水平正在飞速提高。
words.en: To develop, progress, or improve very rapidly and significantly.

words.tr: phrase. 绝不
words.ex: He is by no means lazy.
words.ex_cn: 他绝对不懒。
words.en: You use 'by no means' to emphasize that something is not true or is definitely not the case.

words.tr: phrase. 按照规矩；一丝不苟地；循规蹈矩地
words.ex: He follows the rules by the book.
words.ex_cn: 他严格按照规则办事。
words.en: If you do something by the book, you do it exactly as the rules say it should be done.

words.tr: phrase. 轮流地；时而……时而……
words.ex: He laughs and cries by turns.
words.ex_cn: 他一会儿笑，一会儿哭。
words.en: If people do something by turns, they do it one after the other in a repeated order.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吁；号召；要求；接（人）
words.ex: The situation calls for immediate action.
words.ex_cn: 这种情况需要立即采取行动。
words.en: If you call for something, you demand that it should happen.

words.tr: phrase. 叫（某人）进来；召来；来访
words.ex: He called in a doctor for his sick son.
words.ex_cn: 他为生病的儿子请了一位医生。
words.en: To request someone's presence or participation, especially by telephone.

words.tr: phrase. 取消；转移；叫走；依次叫名
words.ex: They decided to call off the meeting because of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为风暴决定取消会议。
words.en: To cancel or abandon something that was planned.

words.tr: phrase. 拜访；要求；呼吁；号召
words.ex: I will call on my grandma this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这个周末我将去拜访我的奶奶。
words.en: To visit someone; to formally ask or request someone to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 拜访；要求；呼吁；号召
words.ex: I will call upon my grandmother this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这个周末我会去拜访我的祖母。
words.en: To call upon someone is to ask them to do something or to use something that they can offer.

words.tr: phrase. 结转；转下期；转冲（下年度应税损益）；发扬
words.ex: The company will carry forward the loss to next year.
words.ex_cn: 公司会将亏损结转到下一年。
words.en: To transfer an amount from one accounting period to the next; to continue or extend something.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 成功地处理或应对（困难或尴尬的情况）；夺走；使显得有魅力
words.ex: He carried off the awkward silence with a joke.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个笑话成功应对了尴尬的沉默。
words.en: To succeed in doing or achieving something, especially something difficult.

words.tr: phrase. 继续；坚持；进行；开展
words.ex: He will carry on working after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后会继续工作。
words.en: If you carry on, you continue doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 执行；进行；履行
words.ex: They will carry out the experiment tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将进行这个实验。
words.en: To perform or complete a task, duty, or project.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 坚持到底；完成；帮助某人渡过难关
words.ex: He worked hard to carry through his plan.
words.ex_cn: 他努力实施他的计划。
words.en: To complete something or to continue doing something until it is finished, especially something difficult.

words.tr: phrase. 有影响力；有分量；被重视
words.ex: His opinion carries weight because he is very experienced.
words.ex_cn: 他的意见有分量，因为他经验非常丰富。
words.en: To have influence or importance.

words.tr: phrase. 一次性付清现金；用现金当场支付
words.ex: He paid cash down for the car.
words.ex_cn: 他用现金一次性付清了车款。
words.en: If you pay cash down for something, you pay for it immediately and in cash, rather than paying for it later or using a different method of payment.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 利用…获利；从…中赚取利益
words.ex: He tried to cash in on the new trend.
words.ex_cn: 他试图利用这个新趋势赚钱。
words.en: To take advantage of an opportunity in order to make money or gain something.

words.tr: phrase. v. 到处寻找；苦苦思索以找到
words.ex: He cast about for a solution to the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他四处寻找解决问题的办法。
words.en: To search or look for something in a determined way.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 抛弃；丢弃；抛弃某人或某物；不再考虑
words.ex: He cast aside his old shoes and bought new ones.
words.ex_cn: 他扔掉了旧鞋，买了新鞋。
words.en: To get rid of someone or something because you no longer want or need them.

words.tr: phrase. 抛弃；浪费
words.ex: He cast away his old shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他扔掉了他的旧鞋子。
words.en: To throw something away or to abandon someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 抛弃；丢弃；摆脱
words.ex: He cast off the old coat.
words.ex_cn: 他脱下了那件旧外套。
words.en: To get rid of something or someone that is no longer wanted or needed; to untie a boat from the place where it is moored.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 驱逐；赶出；排斥
words.ex: The village cast out the thief for stealing food.
words.ex_cn: 村庄把小偷驱逐出去了，因为他偷了食物。
words.en: To force someone to leave a place, especially a social group.

words.tr: phrase. 瞥见
words.ex: I catch a glimpse of the bird in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 我瞥见了树上的鸟。
words.en: To see someone or something for a very short time.

words.tr: phrase. 引人注目；吸引某人的目光
words.ex: The red ball catches my eye.
words.ex_cn: 这个红球吸引了我的注意。
words.en: If something catches your eye, you notice it or are attracted to it because it is interesting or unusual.

words.tr: phrase. 看见；瞥见
words.ex: I caught sight of a bird flying over the tree.
words.ex_cn: 我看见一只鸟飞过树顶。
words.en: If you catch sight of someone or something, you see them suddenly or briefly.

words.tr: phrase. 付账后离开；核实
words.ex: We checked out of the hotel after paying the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我们付完账后离开了酒店。
words.en: To check out means to leave a hotel after paying your bill, or to examine something or someone in order to be certain that everything is correct, safe, or satisfactory.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 检查；核查；（尤指为发现疾病或问题而）进行健康检查
words.ex: The doctor will check up on you tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 医生明天会给你做检查。
words.en: To examine something or someone in order to discover if there are any problems or to find out more information.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 检查；查看；核实（某人或某事的情况）
words.ex: The nurse will check up on the patient every hour.
words.ex_cn: 护士每小时会检查一下病人。
words.en: To investigate or verify the condition or behavior of someone or something.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 仔细考虑；反复思考（某事）
words.ex: I need to chew on this idea before I decide.
words.ex_cn: 我在做决定之前需要仔细考虑这个想法。
words.en: To think carefully and for a long time about something.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细考虑；详细讨论
words.ex: He chewed over the problem for hours.
words.ex_cn: 他思考了这个问题好几个小时。
words.en: To think about something carefully for a long time, especially before making a decision.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 清理；清除；收拾
words.ex: He will clear away the toys from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他会把地上的玩具清理掉。
words.en: To remove items or obstacles from a place so that it is tidy or unobstructed.

words.tr: phrase. 清除；摆脱；走开；消散
words.ex: Clear off the table before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 晚饭前把桌子收拾干净。
words.en: To leave a place quickly or to remove something completely.

words.tr: phrase. 清除；把…清出；（使）离开
words.ex: He will clear out the old boxes from the garage.
words.ex_cn: 他会把旧箱子从车库清理出去。
words.en: To remove items from a place to make it clean and empty.

words.tr: phrase. 在附近；靠近
words.ex: The park is close by my house.
words.ex_cn: 公园离我家很近。
words.en: If something is close by, it is near to you.

words.tr: phrase. v. 关闭；停业；终止运营
words.ex: The shop will close down next week.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店将在下周关门。
words.en: If a business or organization closes down or if someone closes it down, it stops operating permanently.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （使）闭合，关闭；（使）愈合；靠近拍摄
words.ex: He closed up the shop at 9 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 他在晚上9点关了店。
words.en: To shut something completely or to stop operating, especially for a business or a wound healing.

words.tr: phrase. 发生；造成
words.ex: How did this mistake come about?
words.ex_cn: 这个错误是怎么发生的？
words.en: If you ask how something came about, you want to know how it happened or started.

words.tr: phrase. 偶遇；偶然发现；使产生…印象
words.ex: I came across an old photo while cleaning my room.
words.ex_cn: 我在打扫房间时发现了一张旧照片。
words.en: If you come across something or someone, you find them or meet them by chance.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；跟随；进步；（催促）赶快
words.ex: I didn't see him, but he came along later.
words.ex_cn: 我没看到他，但他后来出现了。
words.en: To appear or arrive, often unexpectedly; to make progress or improve.

words.tr: phrase. v. （观点或态度）改变，回心转意；顺便来访，顺道拜访；苏醒，恢复知觉
words.ex: At first he refused, but later he came around and agreed to help.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始拒绝了，但后来回心转意，同意帮忙。
words.en: To change one's opinion or decision; to regain consciousness; to visit someone casually.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （观点或态度）转变，改变主意；（身体或情绪上）恢复；顺便来访，过来
words.ex: He didn't want to help at first, but he came round after we talked.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始不想帮忙，但经过交谈后改变了主意。
words.en: To regain consciousness; to change one's opinion or position; to visit someone casually.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 向…扑来；攻击；指责；接近（某事物）
words.ex: The dog came at me with barking.
words.ex_cn: 那只狗冲我扑过来，边叫边冲。
words.en: To move towards someone or something in a threatening way; to reach or achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 可归结为；屈尊做某事
words.ex: It will come down to who works harder.
words.ex_cn: 这将取决于谁更努力。
words.en: If a problem, decision, or question comes down to a particular thing, that thing is the most important factor involved.

words.tr: 短语动词. 开始生效；实施；起作用
words.ex: The new law will come into effect next month.
words.ex_cn: 新法律将在下个月生效。
words.en: If a law or agreement comes into effect, it starts to be used or to have an effect.

words.tr: 短语动词. 开始生效；正式实施
words.ex: The new rule will go into effect next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 新规则将于下周一生效。
words.en: To become active or start to be used.

words.tr: phrase. 加油；快点；拜托；来吧；开始
words.ex: Come on, you can finish this race!
words.ex_cn: 加油，你能跑完这场比赛的！
words.en: Used to encourage someone to do something or to hurry up, or to express disbelief or skepticism.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；出来；出版
words.ex: The sun comes out after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨停后太阳出来了。
words.en: If something comes out, it becomes known, especially after it has been kept secret or it has been unknown.

words.tr: phrase. 到达；显现；实现；成功地完成；（健康）恢复；渡过
words.ex: The package will come through tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 包裹明天会到达。
words.en: To successfully deal with a difficult situation or to do what is needed or expected.

words.tr: phrase. 苏醒；到达；总计；突然想起
words.ex: He came to after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后他醒了过来。
words.en: If someone comes to, they regain consciousness after being unconscious. It can also mean to reach a particular state or condition, or to be involved in something.

words.tr: phrase. 打起来；发生肢体冲突
words.ex: The two boys came to blows over a toy.
words.ex_cn: 两个男孩因为一个玩具打了起来。
words.en: If two or more people come to blows, they start fighting.

words.tr: phrase. 涌现； 惹人注意
words.ex: During the crisis, brave leaders come to the fore.
words.ex_cn: 在危机中，勇敢的领导者会脱颖而出。
words.en: If someone or something comes to the fore, they become important or noticeable.

words.tr: phrase. 实现；成真
words.ex: Her dream will come true next year.
words.ex_cn: 她的梦想明年将会实现。
words.en: If a dream, hope, or prediction comes true, it actually happens.

words.tr: phrase. 发生；上来；提到
words.ex: A problem came up during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议期间发生了一个问题。
words.en: To arise or occur, especially unexpectedly or as a subject of discussion.

words.tr: phrase. 达到；符合
words.ex: The temperature came up to 30 degrees yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天温度升到了30度。
words.en: To reach a particular standard or level; to be as good as expected.

words.tr: phrase. 赶上；提出；想出
words.ex: He ran fast to come up with the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: If you come up with a plan, idea, or solution, you think of it and suggest it.

words.tr: phrase. 使自己致力于；承诺做某事；投入于
words.ex: He commit himself to exercise every day.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺自己每天锻炼。
words.en: To dedicate oneself to a particular task or purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 承诺做某事；致力于；投入
words.ex: He wants to commit to learning English every day.
words.ex_cn: 他想承诺每天学习英语。
words.en: To pledge or dedicate oneself to a certain course of action or belief.

words.tr: phrase. 把……比作……；与……相比较（通常用于不同类事物之间的比喻或类比）
words.ex: He compared her smile to the sun.
words.ex_cn: 他把她的微笑比作太阳。
words.en: If you compare something to something else, you say that they are similar in some way.

words.tr: phrase. 与…竞争
words.ex: He competes with his brother for the best grades.
words.ex_cn: 他和弟弟竞争最好的成绩。
words.en: If one company or country competes with another, it tries to get people to buy its goods or services rather than those of the other company or country.

words.tr: phrase. 对...的关心；对...表示忧虑
words.ex: Parents have concern about their child's safety.
words.ex_cn: 父母对孩子的安全感到担心。
words.en: If you concern about something, you feel worried about it.

words.tr: phrase. 关注；涉及；关心；与…有关
words.ex: Parents are often concerned with their children's education.
words.ex_cn: 父母通常关注孩子的教育。
words.en: to be about or relate to a particular subject or issue

words.tr: v. 祝贺；恭喜
words.ex: I congratulate you on your success.
words.ex_cn: 我祝贺你取得成功。
words.en: If you congratulate someone, you express pleasure for something good that has happened to them, or you praise them for something they have achieved.

words.tr: phrase. 向某人祝贺某事；因某事向某人道贺
words.ex: We congratulate you upon your success.
words.ex_cn: 我们祝贺你的成功。
words.en: to express to someone your pleasure at their success or good fortune

words.tr: phrase. 同意；准许；答应（做某事）
words.ex: He did not consent to the medical treatment.
words.ex_cn: 他没有同意这个医疗治疗。
words.en: If you consent to something, you agree to do it or to allow it to be done.

words.tr: phrase. 存在于…中；在内
words.ex: Happiness consists in simple moments.
words.ex_cn: 幸福在于简单的时刻。
words.en: If you say that something consists in a particular thing, you mean that the thing mentioned is the main or essential feature of it.

words.tr: phrase. 由...组成
words.ex: The team consists of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something consists of particular things or people, it is made up of them.

words.tr: phrase. 因……而极度消耗；被……强烈占据（情感或精力），如 'consume with anger' 表示被愤怒吞噬
words.ex: The fire consumed with the old house.
words.ex_cn: 大火将那座老房子彻底烧毁。
words.en: To completely fill or overwhelm someone with a strong emotion or feeling.

words.tr: phrase. 贡献；促成；导致；有助于
words.ex: Volunteers contribute to the clean-up of the park.
words.ex_cn: 志愿者们为公园的清洁做出了贡献。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.tr: phrase. 冷却下来；平静下来；使冷静
words.ex: The car needs time to cool down after driving.
words.ex_cn: 汽车行驶后需要时间冷却下来。
words.en: To become less hot, or to make something become less hot; to become calm after being angry.

words.tr: phrase. v. 冷静下来；使冷却；（使）平息怒气
words.ex: He needs to cool off after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争吵后需要冷静一下。
words.en: To become less hot, or to make something less hot; to become calmer or less excited.

words.tr: phrase. 应付；处理
words.ex: He tries to cope with stress by walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天散步来应对压力。
words.en: To deal effectively with something difficult.

words.tr: phrase. 与···相应；符合
words.ex: The number 5 corresponds to the letter E.
words.ex_cn: 数字5对应字母E。
words.en: If one thing corresponds to another, there is a close similarity or connection between them, often because one is a cause or a result of the other.

words.tr: phrase. 与…通信； 与…相一致
words.ex: I correspond with my friend by email every week.
words.ex_cn: 我每周通过电子邮件和朋友通信。
words.en: If one thing corresponds with another, there is a close similarity or connection between them.

words.tr: phrase. （音乐开始前打拍子）开始计数；把…包括在内
words.ex: The teacher will count in before the choir sings.
words.ex_cn: 合唱团唱歌前，老师会先打拍子计数。
words.en: To include someone in a plan or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 依靠；指望
words.ex: I can count on my brother to help me.
words.ex_cn: 我可以依靠我哥哥帮我。
words.en: If you count on someone or something, you rely on them to support you or help you.

words.tr: phrase. v. 依靠；指望；信赖
words.ex: You can count upon me to help you.
words.ex_cn: 你可以指望我帮你。
words.en: To rely on someone or something to do what you expect or need.

words.tr: phrase. v. 不把…考虑在内；排除；点数后排除
words.ex: Don't count out the weather when planning the picnic.
words.ex_cn: 计划野餐时，别把天气因素排除在外。
words.en: If you count out a sum of money, you count the notes or coins as you put them in a pile one by one.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 把…加起来；逐一数出
words.ex: He is counting up the coins in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他正在数他口袋里的硬币。
words.en: To add up numbers or amounts in order to find the total.

words.tr: phrase. v. 替…掩护；为…顶班；为…打掩护
words.ex: He will cover for her when she is sick.
words.ex_cn: 当她生病时，他会替她顶班。
words.en: To do someone else's job or duties temporarily, especially because they are not available to do it themselves.

words.tr: phrase. 严厉打击；镇压
words.ex: The government will crack down on illegal activities.
words.ex_cn: 政府将严厉打击非法活动。
words.en: To take strong action to stop or punish someone or something that is considered wrong or illegal.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （因压力或情绪失控）崩溃，大笑；吹捧，夸赞
words.ex: He will crack up if he hears that funny story.
words.ex_cn: 如果他听到那个有趣的故事，他会笑得前仰后合。
words.en: If someone cracks up, they suddenly start laughing. If someone cracks up, they become mentally ill because they cannot deal with their problems or the pressure they are under.

words.tr: 短语. 归功于；应记于……名下
words.ex: We give credit to him for solving the problem.
words.ex_cn: 我们把这个问题的解决归功于他。
words.en: To acknowledge someone as the source of something good or to attribute a quality or achievement to someone.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 勾掉；划掉（清单上的项目）
words.ex: He crosses off one task from the list every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天从清单上划掉一项任务。
words.en: To remove something from a list or to indicate that something has been dealt with by drawing a line through it.

words.tr: phrase. 划掉；删除（文字或项目）
words.ex: He crosses out the wrong answer and writes the correct one.
words.ex_cn: 他划掉错误的答案，写上正确的答案。
words.en: To draw a line through something written to indicate that it is incorrect or should be disregarded.

words.tr: phrase. 极需；迫切需要
words.ex: The children cry out for clean water.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们极需干净的水。
words.en: If you say that something cries out for a particular thing or action, you mean that it needs that thing or action very much.

words.tr: phrase. 抄近路通过；越（界）；影响，涉及（不同群体）；违背
words.ex: The path cuts across the field.
words.ex_cn: 这条路穿过田野。
words.en: If an issue or problem cuts across different groups of people, it affects or matters to all those groups.

words.tr: phrase. 削减；急忙返回
words.ex: He wants to cut back on sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他想减少糖的摄入。
words.en: To reduce the amount, size, cost, etc. of something.

words.tr: phrase. 走捷径；偷工减料；为省事或省钱而降低标准
words.ex: He cut corners to finish the project faster.
words.ex_cn: 他为了更快完成项目而走捷径。
words.en: To do something in the easiest, cheapest, or quickest way, often by ignoring rules or omitting something important.

words.tr: phrase. 砍倒；削减；杀死
words.ex: They cut down the old tree in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 他们把院子里那棵老树砍倒了。
words.en: To reduce the amount, size, or number of something, or to do less of something.

words.tr: phrase. 插嘴；打断；超车抢档
words.ex: He cut in while I was talking.
words.ex_cn: 我正在说话时，他插嘴了。
words.en: To interrupt someone who is speaking, or to move into a line of traffic by driving in front of someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 切断；使隔绝；剪下
words.ex: He cut off the power during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他在风暴期间切断了电源。
words.en: To stop the supply of something, or to stop something from continuing.

words.tr: phrase. 切掉；裁剪出；停止
words.ex: He cut out sugar from his diet.
words.ex_cn: 他从饮食中戒掉了糖。
words.en: To remove something by cutting it or to stop doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 抑制；减弱；平息（情绪、活动等）
words.ex: He tried to damp down the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他试图平息这场争论。
words.en: To damp down something means to reduce its intensity or strength, often in order to prevent it from becoming too great or causing problems.

words.tr: phrase. 处理；应付
words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能处理困难的问题。
words.en: To deal with something means to take action in order to achieve something or in order to solve a problem.

words.tr: phrase. 在内心深处；本质上；实际上
words.ex: Deep down, he knows he made a mistake.
words.ex_cn: 在内心深处，他知道他犯了错误。
words.en: If you know something deep down, you know it although you may not admit it to yourself.

words.tr: phrase. 剥夺，使丧失（某物）
words.ex: The storm deprived him of his power.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴使他失去了电力。
words.en: To take something away from someone or something; to prevent someone from having something.

words.tr: phrase. 由…起源；来自
words.ex: This word derives from Latin.
words.ex_cn: 这个词源自拉丁语。
words.en: To obtain something from a specified source.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 突然造访；大批涌入；袭击（某地）
words.ex: The tourists descend upon the small village every summer.
words.ex_cn: 每年夏天游客们都蜂拥而至这个小村庄。
words.en: To arrive or come down on something or someone suddenly and in large numbers, often causing surprise or overwhelm.

words.tr: phrase. 献身于； 把...专用于；致力于…
words.ex: He devotes to helping poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他献身于帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: To give all or a large part of one's time or resources to (a person, activity, or cause).

words.tr: phrase. 逐渐消失；变弱
words.ex: The sound of the bell died away slowly.
words.ex_cn: 铃声渐渐消失了。
words.en: If a sound dies away, it gradually becomes weaker or quieter and then stops completely.

words.tr: phrase. 渐渐消失；平息；变弱
words.ex: The wind will die down in the evening.
words.ex_cn: 风在晚上会逐渐减弱。
words.en: If something dies down, it becomes much less noticeable or active.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 挖出；发掘；找出（信息、证据等）
words.ex: He digs up old toys from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他从花园里挖出旧玩具。
words.en: To remove something from the ground by digging; to discover something by searching.

words.tr: phrase. 浏览；动用（花费）；伸进
words.ex: I dipped into the book to find a funny story.
words.ex_cn: 我翻了翻这本书，想找一个有趣的故事。
words.en: To dip into something means to read or look at parts of it in a casual way, or to use some of a supply of money.

words.tr: phrase. 不同意；不适合
words.ex: I disagree with him about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 我不同意他对这部电影的看法。
words.en: To have or express a different opinion from someone else; to not agree with someone or something.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 分发；提供；给予（通常指大量或随意地）
words.ex: He likes to dish out advice to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢向朋友提建议。
words.en: To distribute or give out something, often in a casual or generous manner.

words.tr: phrase. 使自己与众不同；表现突出；出人头地
words.ex: He worked hard to distinguish himself at school.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，想在学校里脱颖而出。
words.en: To distinguish oneself means to do something very well or to be recognized for one's achievements, thereby making oneself stand out from others.

words.tr: phrase. 消除；终止；废除；杀死；干掉
words.ex: They want to do away with the old rules.
words.ex_cn: 他们想废除旧规则。
words.en: To do away with something means to get rid of it or to stop using it.

words.tr: phrase. 充分体现…的价值；公正地对待；如实评价
words.ex: This painting does justice to the beauty of nature.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画充分展现了自然的美。
words.en: To treat or represent someone or something in a way that is fair and shows their true qualities.

words.tr: phrase. 尽全力
words.ex: He did his best in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中尽了最大努力。
words.en: To try as hard as one can to achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 尽力而为；竭尽全力
words.ex: I will try my best to finish the homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 我会尽力按时完成作业。
words.en: To make the greatest possible effort to achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 尽最大努力；竭尽全力
words.ex: He did his utmost to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他尽了最大努力帮助他的朋友。
words.en: To try as hard as one can to achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 对...有益
words.ex: Eating vegetables does you good.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜对你有好处。
words.en: To be beneficial or advantageous to someone.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 扣好；整理好；修缮；包装
words.ex: She will do up her dress for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她会把裙子整理好去参加派对。
words.en: To fasten, close, or tidy something, or to repair or renovate it.

words.tr: phrase. 没有...也行；无需
words.ex: We can do without sugar in our coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我们咖啡里可以不加糖。
words.en: To manage or survive without something that one would like to have.

words.tr: 短语动词. 起作用；奏效；解决问题
words.ex: A simple fix can do the trick.
words.ex_cn: 一个简单的解决办法就能奏效。
words.en: If something does the trick, it achieves what you wanted.

words.tr: phrase. 打倒；把…拿下；患…病
words.ex: The crowd shouted 'down with corruption!'
words.ex_cn: 人群高喊‘打倒腐败！’
words.en: Used to express a wish or a call for the overthrow or end of something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 收（债务）；引诱；（天色）接近黄昏；紧缩（开支）；（车）到站；用...绘画；吸入（气体）；缩短；拉回（网）
words.ex: The bank will draw in the loan next month.
words.ex_cn: 银行下个月将收回贷款。
words.en: To attract or entice someone or something into a place or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 草拟；停住；逼近；追上；整队
words.ex: He will draw up a plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会起草一个计划。
words.en: To prepare and write something such as a document or plan, or to bring a vehicle to a stop.

words.tr: phrase. 梦见；渴望
words.ex: He dreamt of flying like a bird.
words.ex_cn: 他梦见自己像鸟一样飞翔。
words.en: To think about something that you would like to happen or achieve.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 凭空想出；虚构；杜撰（想法、计划或故事等）
words.ex: He can dream up funny stories in a minute.
words.ex_cn: 他一分钟就能编出有趣的故事。
words.en: To invent or imagine something, especially something that is not practical or likely to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 装扮；穿上盛装；乔装打扮
words.ex: The children dress up as pirates for Halloween.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在万圣节打扮成海盗。
words.en: To wear formal or special clothes for a particular occasion or to make something or someone look more attractive by adding decorations or details.

words.tr: phrase. v. 充分吸收（信息、景色等）；尽情欣赏
words.ex: They sit by the lake to drink in the beautiful view.
words.ex_cn: 他们坐在湖边欣赏美丽的风景。
words.en: To absorb or take in something, especially with great attention or enjoyment.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 顺便访问；顺道拜访
words.ex: I will drop by your house after work.
words.ex_cn: 我下班后会去你家拜访。
words.en: To visit someone casually and usually without having arranged it before.

words.tr: phrase. 顺便走访
words.ex: I might drop in at your house this evening.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚可能会顺便去你家。
words.en: To visit someone informally and often without notice.

words.tr: phrase. 减少；落下；睡着；让...下车
words.ex: The number of students dropped off last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年学生人数减少了。
words.en: If the level, amount, or value of something drops off, it becomes less.

words.tr: phrase. 不参与；退出
words.ex: He decided to drop out of the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他决定不参加比赛。
words.en: If someone drops out of a school or a course, they leave it before they have finished it.

words.tr: phrase. 招徕；竭力争取；征集
words.ex: They tried to drum up support for the new project.
words.ex_cn: 他们试图为新项目争取支持。
words.en: To drum up means to try to make people interested in something or to try to get support or business for something.

words.tr: phrase. 干涸；枯竭
words.ex: The river may dry up in the summer.
words.ex_cn: 这条河在夏天可能会干涸。
words.en: If something dries up or if something dries it up, it loses all its moisture and becomes completely dry.

words.tr: phrase. 由于；应归于
words.ex: He was late due to traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: If an event is due to something, it happens or exists as a direct result of that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 在早期
words.ex: He started to learn English early on.
words.ex_cn: 他很早就开始学英语了。
words.en: At an early stage of a period of time or process.

words.tr: phrase. 不是…就是…；…或…；要么…要么…
words.ex: You can either stay or go.
words.ex_cn: 你要么留下，要么离开。
words.en: Used before the first of two (or occasionally more) alternatives that are being specified (the other being introduced by ‘or’).

words.tr: phrase. v. 从…中出现；从…中浮现；从…中摆脱出来
words.ex: The sun emerges from the clouds.
words.ex_cn: 太阳从云层中出现。
words.en: to come out of a dark, confined, or hidden place

words.tr: phrase. 着重于；对…的强调
words.ex: The teacher puts emphasis on reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调每天都要阅读。
words.en: Special importance, value, or prominence given to something.

words.tr: phrase. 结果为；以…为结束
words.ex: The story ends in a happy surprise.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事结果是一个快乐的惊喜。
words.en: To have a particular result or conclusion.

words.tr: phrase. 结束；告终；意外到达
words.ex: He didn't plan to stay, but he ended up sleeping there.
words.ex_cn: 他本没打算留下，但最后在那里睡了。
words.en: If you end up in a particular place or situation, you are in that place or situation after a series of events, even though you did not originally intend to be.

words.tr: phrase. 从事于；参加
words.ex: He engages in sports after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后参加体育运动。
words.en: To participate or become involved in an activity.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 调查，查究（某事）；询问并深入了解
words.ex: They want to enquire into the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他们想调查这个问题。
words.en: To ask about something in order to get more information.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；包括；参与；成为...一部分
words.ex: He will enter into the room after knocking.
words.ex_cn: 他敲门后会进入房间。
words.en: To begin or become involved in an activity, agreement, or condition.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 开始从事；着手进行；进入（某种状态或阶段）
words.ex: He decided to enter on a new career after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他毕业后决定开始从事一份新职业。
words.en: To begin or start something, especially a task or project.

words.tr: phrase. 开始从事；着手进行；进入（新阶段、职位、状态等）
words.ex: He will enter upon his new job next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他将于下周一开始新工作。
words.en: To begin or start something, especially a new phase or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 即使在……的同时；正当……之时
words.ex: He smiled even as he cried.
words.ex_cn: 他一边哭一边笑。
words.en: Used to indicate that something happens at the same time as something else.

words.tr: phrase. 即使
words.ex: I will go for a walk even if it rains.
words.ex_cn: 即使下雨，我也会去散步。
words.en: You use 'even if' to say that something is true or happens although something else might prevent it.

words.tr: phrase. 尽管
words.ex: He went out even though it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 尽管在下雨，他还是出去了。
words.en: You use even though to introduce a clause which gives the reason for something, but which makes the reason seem less important or significant.

words.tr: phrase. 非常，极其（用于强调程度）
words.ex: He is ever so happy today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天非常开心。
words.en: used to emphasize the degree of something, meaning 'very' or 'extremely'

words.tr: phrase. 每一点；完全
words.ex: Every bit of information helps.
words.ex_cn: 每一点信息都有帮助。
words.en: To the same degree; equally.

words.tr: phrase. 完全地，彻底地（用于强调某人或某物充分具备某种特质）
words.ex: He is every inch a leader.
words.ex_cn: 他完全是一个领导者。
words.en: Completely or thoroughly, in every way.

words.tr: phrase. 每隔；所有其他
words.ex: He goes to the gym every other day.
words.ex_cn: 他每隔一天去一次健身房。
words.en: You use every other to indicate that an action or event happens regularly, with a fixed period of time between each one and the next.

words.tr: phrase. 除…之外；若不是
words.ex: Everyone came to the party except for Tom.
words.ex_cn: 除了汤姆，大家都来参加派对了。
words.en: You use except for to introduce the only thing or person that prevents a statement from being completely true.

words.tr: phrase. 尽力；努力；使自己付出努力
words.ex: He exerts himself to finish the job on time.
words.ex_cn: 他努力按时完成工作。
words.en: To exert oneself means to make a physical or mental effort.

words.tr: phrase. v. 通过解释来消除（问题、疑虑、责任等）；为…辩解，使显得不重要
words.ex: He tried to explain away his mistake with a funny story.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用一个有趣的故事来开脱自己的错误。
words.en: To explain away something means to try to make it seem less important or less bad by giving reasons for it.

words.tr: phrase. 使暴露于……；使接触……；使面临……
words.ex: Parents should expose children to books early.
words.ex_cn: 父母应该让孩子从小接触书籍。
words.en: To make something vulnerable or subject to something else, often negative.

words.tr: phrase. 面对面地
words.ex: They talked face to face instead of on the phone.
words.ex_cn: 他们面对面交谈，而不是打电话。
words.en: If you meet or talk to someone face to face, you meet or talk to them directly, rather than by telephone, email, or online.

words.tr: phrase. 勇敢地面对
words.ex: He must face up to his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的错误。
words.en: If you face up to a difficult situation, you accept it and deal with it honestly and bravely.

words.tr: phrase. 求助于；退到；转而依靠
words.ex: He will fall back on his savings if he loses his job.
words.ex_cn: 如果他失业了，他会依靠自己的储蓄。
words.en: To rely on something or someone for help or support, especially when other options have failed.

words.tr: phrase. 落后；拖欠
words.ex: He fell behind in math because he missed classes.
words.ex_cn: 他因为缺课而数学落下了。
words.en: To fail to keep up with others; to lag behind.

words.tr: phrase. 落入（圈套）；上当；倾心
words.ex: He fell for the scam and lost his money.
words.ex_cn: 他落入了骗局，失去了钱。
words.en: To be deceived by someone or something; to develop a romantic or strong liking for someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 吵架；失和；掉落；离队
words.ex: They fell out over a small argument.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为一个小争执吵翻了。
words.en: If people fall out, they have an argument and are no longer friendly.

words.tr: phrase. v. （计划、安排等）失败，落空，未能实现
words.ex: Their plan to go on vacation will fall through if they don't save enough money.
words.ex_cn: 如果他们没有存够钱，他们的度假计划就会落空。
words.en: If an agreement, plan, or deal falls through, it fails to happen or be completed.

words.tr: phrase. 开始；着手
words.ex: The temperature fell to zero last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚温度降到了零度。
words.en: If someone falls to doing something, they start doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 远离；一点也不
words.ex: The village is far from the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄远离城市。
words.en: If you say that something is far from a particular thing or far from being the case, you are emphasizing that it is not that particular thing or not at all the case, especially when people expect or assume that it is.

words.tr: phrase. 想要；感觉像；觉得
words.ex: I feel like eating pizza tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚想吃披萨。
words.en: To have a desire or inclination for something; to have a sensation or impression of being a certain way.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 抵挡；避开；击退（攻击、批评、威胁等）
words.ex: He used a stick to fend off the dog.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根棍子赶走了那只狗。
words.en: To fend off means to defend oneself against something or someone, or to keep them away.

words.tr: phrase. 算出；弄明白；解决；想出
words.ex: I can't figure out the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我算不出答案。
