words.en: To understand or solve something by thinking about it.

words.tr: phrase. 填（写）； 填满；替代
words.ex: Please fill in the blanks with the correct words.
words.ex_cn: 请用正确的单词填空。
words.en: If you fill in a form or other document requesting information, you write information in the spaces on it.

words.tr: phrase. 填写；长胖；变大
words.ex: Please fill out this form before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在离开前填写这张表格。
words.en: To complete a form or document by providing the required information.

words.tr: 短语动词. 符合要求；胜任；满足需要
words.ex: This small room can fill the bill for a home office.
words.ex_cn: 这个小房间可以当作家庭办公室使用。
words.en: To be exactly what is needed in a particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 挑剔；找岔子
words.ex: He always tries to find fault with his classmates' work.
words.ex_cn: 他总是试图挑他同学作业的毛病。
words.en: To criticize someone or something, often unfairly and too much.

words.tr: phrase. v. 试图引出（信息、反应等）；故意试探；钓（信息）
words.ex: He is fishing for compliments at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他正在派对上寻求赞美。
words.en: To seek or try to obtain something, often in a roundabout way or by hinting.

words.tr: phrase. 相适应；相融合
words.ex: He tries to fit in with his new classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力融入新同学中。
words.en: If you fit in with a group of people, you are accepted by them because you are similar to them or because your behaviour is acceptable to them.

words.tr: phrase. 与……相适应；与……协调；融入
words.ex: He tried to fit in with the new group.
words.ex_cn: 他试图融入新团体。
words.en: To be accepted by or to belong to a particular group or to be in harmony with something.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 决定；选定；专注于
words.ex: I finally fixed on a color for my room.
words.ex_cn: 我最终决定了房间的颜色。
words.en: If you fix on a particular thing, you decide that it is the one you want or will have.

words.tr: phrase. 修理；安排； 为（某人）提供
words.ex: He will fix up his bike tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要修理他的自行车。
words.en: To repair, arrange, or organize something.

words.tr: phrase. 集中（精力；注意力等）于
words.ex: He focuses on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上专心做作业。
words.en: to direct your attention or effort towards something specific

words.tr: phrase. 坚持到底；贯彻执行；完成（计划或行动）
words.ex: He didn't follow through on his promise.
words.ex_cn: 他没有兑现自己的承诺。
words.en: To continue an action or task to its conclusion.

words.tr:
n. 后续工作；后续事物
adj. 后续的；接着的
words.ex: He made a follow-up call to check on his patient.
words.ex_cn: 他打了一个随访电话来检查病人的状况。
words.en: An action or thing that serves to increase the effectiveness of a previous one, especially a second letter, phone call, or visit.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 闲荡；胡闹；不认真对待
words.ex: The boys are fooling around in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 那些男孩在教室里瞎闹。
words.en: To spend time doing things that are not useful or serious.

words.tr: phrase. 尽管；对于所有
words.ex: He went out for all it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 尽管在下雨，他还是出去了。
words.en: Despite; used to introduce a fact that makes the main statement in your sentence very surprising

words.tr: phrase. 唯恐；以免；担心
words.ex: He left early for fear of missing the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早早离开，怕赶不上公交车。
words.en: If you do something for fear of something else, you do it to avoid that other thing happening.

words.tr: phrase. 以免；惟恐
words.ex: He left early for fear that he would miss the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早早离开，生怕赶不上公交车。
words.en: used to introduce the reason for an action, especially when the action is taken to avoid a particular situation or outcome

words.tr: phrase. 永久地
words.ex: He left the city for good.
words.ex_cn: 他永久离开了这座城市。
words.en: If something changes or disappears for good, it never changes back or comes back as it was before.

words.tr: phrase. 出售；待售
words.ex: The bike is for sale.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车待售。
words.en: If something is for sale, it is being offered to people to buy.

words.tr: phrase. 简称；缩写
words.ex: He calls her Lily for short.
words.ex_cn: 他简短地叫她莉莉。
words.en: used to indicate that a shorter form of a name or word is being used

words.tr: phrase. 肯定地；毫无疑问地
words.ex: He will come for sure.
words.ex_cn: 他肯定会来。
words.en: without any doubt; certainly

words.tr: phrase. 暂时；目前；眼下
words.ex: I am busy for the moment.
words.ex_cn: 我目前很忙。
words.en: For the moment means for the present time, temporarily.

words.tr: phrase. 为了…
words.ex: He studied hard for the sake of his family.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习是为了家人。
words.en: If you do something for the sake of something, you do it for that purpose or in order to achieve that result.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人摆脱（负担、困境、责任等）；解除某人的（义务、痛苦等）
words.ex_cn: 新法律将使某人免于重税。
words.en: To release someone from a constraint, obligation, or difficulty.

words.tr:
adj. 免费的；自由的；
adv. 免费地；自由地；
v. 释放；
words.ex: The museum offers free entry on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆在周日免费入场。
words.en: If someone is free, they are able to do what they want to do, or go where they want to go, without being controlled or restricted.

words.tr: phrase. 有时；不时
words.ex: He visits his grandparents from time to time.
words.ex_cn: 他时不时去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: If you do something from time to time, you do it occasionally but not regularly.

words.tr: phrase. 逐渐取得进展；获得优势；变得流行或被接受
words.ex: The new idea is gaining ground among young people.
words.ex_cn: 这个新想法正在年轻人中逐渐流行起来。
words.en: To make progress or become more popular or accepted.

words.tr: phrase. 追上，逐渐接近（某人或某物）；在距离上缩短与……的差距
words.ex: The runner is gaining on the leader in the race.
words.ex_cn: 跑步者在比赛中正逐渐追上领先者。
words.en: To get closer to someone or something that you are chasing, or to increase your advantage over someone or something.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 联合起来对付某人；群起而攻之
words.ex: They gang up on the new student.
words.ex_cn: 他们一起欺负新学生。
words.en: If people gang up on someone, they unite against them for a particular reason, for example in a fight or argument.

words.tr: phrase. v. 联合起来对付某人；群起而攻之
words.ex: The kids ganged up on the new student because of his accent.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们因为新同学的口音而联合起来对付他。
words.en: If people gang up on someone, they unite against them for a particular reason, for example in a fight or argument.

words.tr: 短语动词. 联合起来反对某人；群起而攻之
words.ex: The students ganged up against the new teacher.
words.ex_cn: 学生们联合起来反对新老师。
words.en: To join forces to oppose or criticize someone collectively.

words.tr: v. 产生；发（热、电）；
words.ex: The wind generates electricity.
words.ex_cn: 风产生电力。
words.en: To generate something means to cause it to begin and develop.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （消息等）传开；（人）走动，外出活动
words.ex: The news about the party got about quickly.
words.ex_cn: 关于派对的消息很快传开了。
words.en: To move around or travel, especially within a community or area.

words.tr: phrase. 被理解；讲清楚
words.ex: He tried to get across his idea simply.
words.ex_cn: 他试图简单地表达他的想法。
words.en: To succeed in communicating an idea or piece of information to someone, especially when this is difficult or complicated.

words.tr: phrase. v. 取得成功；进步；超越他人
words.ex: He works hard to get ahead in his job.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以在工作中取得进步。
words.en: To make progress or become successful in one's career or life.

words.tr: phrase. 相处
words.ex: They get along well with each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们相处得很好。
words.en: If people get along, they like each other and are friendly to each other.

words.tr: phrase. v. 逃离；摆脱；离开
words.ex: He wants to get away from the noisy city.
words.ex_cn: 他想逃离喧闹的城市。
words.en: To escape from a place or a situation.

words.tr: phrase. 避免；绕开；说服；顺利应付
words.ex: He tried to get around the rules by using a loophole.
words.ex_cn: 他试图利用一个漏洞来规避规则。
words.en: To find a way to deal with or avoid a problem; to move or travel from place to place; to become known by many people.

words.tr: phrase. v. 度过难关；勉强应付；勉强维持生活
words.ex: He gets by with little money.
words.ex_cn: 他靠很少的钱维持生活。
words.en: To manage to live or do a particular thing using the money, knowledge, equipment, etc. that you have.

words.tr: phrase. 下来；吞下；弯下；写下
words.ex: He got down from the chair slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地从椅子上下来。
words.en: To move from a higher to a lower position; to write something down; to cause someone to feel sad or depressed.

words.tr: phrase. 抓住；掌握；得到；找到某人
words.ex: He tried to get hold of the rope.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抓住那根绳子。
words.en: To obtain something or to contact someone.

words.tr: phrase. 碍事；挡道
words.ex: Don't get in the way when others are working.
words.ex_cn: 当别人工作时，不要挡道。
words.en: If something or someone gets in the way, they prevent you from doing something or make it more difficult for you to do it.

words.tr: 短语动词. 深入了解；获得对……的洞察力
words.ex: He read the book to get insight into ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 他读了这本书以了解古代历史。
words.en: To gain a deep and accurate understanding of something.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；陷入；染上（坏习惯）
words.ex: He wants to get into a good university.
words.ex_cn: 他想进入一所好大学。
words.en: To enter or become involved in a particular activity, situation, or state.

words.tr: 短语动词. 毫无进展；一事无成
words.ex: If you don't study, you will get nowhere.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不学习，你将一事无成。
words.en: To make no progress or achieve nothing despite efforts.

words.tr: phrase. 下车；离开
words.ex: He gets off the bus at the school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校下车。
words.en: To leave a place, especially in order to start a journey; to remove something, especially clothing.

words.tr: phrase. 让某人感到烦躁；使某人恼火
words.ex: The loud music next door gets on my nerves.
words.ex_cn: 隔壁的吵闹音乐让我很烦。
words.en: To irritate or annoy someone.

words.tr: phrase. 出去；离开
words.ex: He told the dog to get out.
words.ex_cn: 他让狗出去。
words.en: To leave or escape from a place or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 克服；恢复；原谅
words.ex: He got over his cold last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周康复了。
words.en: To recover from something, such as an illness or a shock; to overcome a problem or difficulty.

words.tr: phrase. v. 比…抢先一步；先于…采取行动；占得先机
words.ex: By arriving early, we managed to get the jump on the other customers.
words.ex_cn: 通过早到，我们成功抢在了其他顾客之前。
words.en: To take action before someone else in order to gain an advantage.

words.tr: phrase. 通过；（电话）打通；度过；做完；用完
words.ex: He got through the exam with help from his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他在朋友的帮助下通过了考试。
words.en: To succeed in reaching a place or a stage in a process, or to make someone understand or accept something.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 归还；回馈；恢复
words.ex: He will give back the book tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会把书还回去。
words.en: If you give something back, you return it to the person who gave it to you or to the person who owns it.

words.tr: phrase. 分娩；产生
words.ex: She will give birth to a baby next month.
words.ex_cn: 她下个月要生孩子。
words.en: To bring a baby or young animal into the world by birth.

words.tr: phrase. 发出（蒸汽、光等）
words.ex: The lamp gives off a warm light.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯发出温暖的光。
words.en: If something gives off or gives out a gas, heat, or a smell, it produces it and sends it out into the air.

words.tr: phrase. 分发；发出；发表；用尽
words.ex: He gives out books to the students.
words.ex_cn: 他把书分发给学生们。
words.en: To distribute or hand out something; to emit or produce something such as a sound or smell; to announce or make something known publicly.

words.tr: phrase. 引起；导致
words.ex: Poor hygiene can give rise to infections.
words.ex_cn: 不良的卫生习惯可能导致感染。
words.en: To cause something to happen or exist.

words.tr: phrase. 放弃
words.ex: He gave up smoking last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年戒烟了。
words.en: If you give up something, you stop doing it or having it.

words.tr: phrase. 让路；让步
words.ex: The old rules give way to new ones.
words.ex_cn: 旧规则让位于新规则。
words.en: If something gives way to something else, it is replaced by it.

words.tr: phrase. v. 摆脱，甩掉（某人）；偷偷溜走
words.ex: He gave the guard the slip and ran away.
words.ex_cn: 他甩掉了守卫，逃跑了。
words.en: To escape from someone or something that is following or chasing you.

words.tr: phrase. 着手干；进行；（经常）表现得
words.ex: He goes about his work quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他安静地做自己的工作。
words.en: If you go about a task or problem in a particular way, you start dealing with it in that way.

words.tr: phrase. 追逐；追求
words.ex: He goes after his dreams every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天追求自己的梦想。
words.en: To pursue or chase someone or something, often with the intention of catching or achieving them.

words.tr: phrase. 反对；违反；不利于
words.ex: If you go against the rules, you might get in trouble.
words.ex_cn: 如果你违反规定，可能会惹上麻烦。
words.en: To oppose or act in contradiction to something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 一起去；赞同；附和
words.ex: I will go along with you to the park.
words.ex_cn: 我会和你一起去公园。
words.en: To agree with or support someone or something; to accompany someone.

words.tr: phrase. 到处走动；流传；供应
words.ex: The children go round the park every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们每天下午到处在公园里走动。
words.en: To move from place to place or to be sufficient for everyone.

words.tr: 参观; 转动; 走访; 相处
words.ex: We went around the old town last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们参观了老城区。
words.en: If you go around to someone's house, you visit them. If a story or piece of information goes around, it is told or passed on to a lot of people. If there is enough of something to go around, there is enough for everyone to have some.

words.tr: phrase. v. 违背（承诺、协议等）；食言
words.ex: He promised to help, but he went back on his word.
words.ex_cn: 他答应帮忙，但他食言了。
words.en: If you go back on a promise, agreement, or statement, you do not do what you promised or agreed to do, or you say something which is the opposite of what you said earlier.

words.tr: phrase. （时间）过去；逝去；走过
words.ex: Time goes by quickly when you are happy.
words.ex_cn: 当你开心时，时间过得很快。
words.en: If you say that time goes by, you mean that it passes.

words.tr: phrase. 下沉；坠落；下降；被接受；传下去；被咽下
words.ex: The sun goes down in the evening.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在傍晚落下。
words.en: To move from a higher to a lower place or position; to decrease in size, amount, or intensity; to be accepted or believed; to happen or take place.

words.tr: phrase. 参加；爱好；从事；赞成
words.ex: He goes in for football every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都参加足球。
words.en: To participate in or be involved with something; to have a liking for something.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；加入；探究
words.ex: He goes into the room quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他悄悄地进入房间。
words.en: To enter a place, to start doing something as a job or activity, to investigate or examine something, or to discuss something in detail.

words.tr: phrase. 详述；逐一细说
words.ex: He will go into detail about the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会详细说明这个计划。
words.en: To explain something thoroughly and with attention to particulars.

words.tr: 短语动词. 详细说明；深入细节
words.ex: I don't want to go into details, but the project was a success.
words.ex_cn: 我不想详细说明，但项目是成功的。
words.en: To discuss or describe something in detail.

words.tr: phrase. 不再使用；废弃；被淘汰
words.ex: Old phones go out of use when new ones come.
words.ex_cn: 当新手机出现时，旧手机就不再使用了。
words.en: To become no longer used or needed, especially because something better has replaced it.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细检查；复习；重做；转向；受欢迎
words.ex: I will go over my homework tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚会复习我的家庭作业。
words.en: To examine or review something carefully; to cross over something.

words.tr: 短语动词. （拳击中）打满规定回合；（消息、传闻等）传播开来，流传
words.ex: The rumor about the teacher goes the rounds at school.
words.ex_cn: 关于那位老师的谣言在学校里传开了。
words.en: To spread or circulate among a group of people.

words.tr: 短语动词. 经历一系列的过程或事件；依次访问多个地方或参与多个阶段
words.ex: The rumor will go the rounds of the school soon.
words.ex_cn: 这个谣言很快就会在学校里传开。
words.en: To be passed from person to person, or to visit a series of places in turn.

words.tr: phrase. 经历；仔细检查；完成；通过；穿过
words.ex: He went through a hard time last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年经历了一段艰难的时光。
words.en: To experience something, often something difficult or unpleasant, or to examine or discuss something in detail.

words.tr: phrase. 出错； 发生故障；误入歧途
words.ex: Things can go wrong if you don't follow the instructions.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不按照说明做，事情可能会出错。
words.en: If a situation or event goes wrong, it does not happen in the way you intended or expected, and often has a bad result.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 试图抓住；匆忙抓取
words.ex: He grabs at the ball during the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中扑向球。
words.en: To make a sudden attempt to seize something; to take advantage of something eagerly.

words.tr: phrase. v. 艰苦地完成；勉强写出；费力地生产
words.ex: He grinds out math problems every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上苦算数学题。
words.en: To produce something in a mechanical or unenthusiastic way, especially something that requires a lot of effort or is of low quality.

words.tr: phrase. 生长；喜欢上
words.ex: I didn't like the song at first, but it grew on me.
words.ex_cn: 我一开始不喜欢这首歌，但后来渐渐喜欢上了。
words.en: If someone or something grows on you, you gradually start to like them or it more.

words.tr: phrase. 戒除；抛弃；由…产生
words.ex: He grew out of biting his nails when he became a teenager.
words.ex_cn: 他当了青少年后就戒掉了咬指甲的习惯。
words.en: If you grow out of a habit or a type of behaviour, you stop doing it or having it because you are older and more mature.

words.tr: phrase. v. 防止；提防；防范
words.ex: Wear a helmet to guard against head injuries.
words.ex_cn: 戴上头盔以防止头部受伤。
words.en: To guard against something means to take precautions to prevent it from happening.

words.tr: phrase. 把...传下来；宣布
words.ex: My grandmother will hand down her old watch to me.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖母会把她的旧表传给我。
words.en: To pass something from one generation to the next or to officially give a decision or judgment.

words.tr: phrase. 手拉手地；紧密地；同时发生地
words.ex: They walk hand in hand in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们手拉手在公园里散步。
words.en: If two people are hand in hand, they are holding each other's hand. If two things go hand in hand, they are closely connected and one thing causes the other.

words.tr: phrase. 交出； 交付
words.ex: He will hand over the keys tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会交出钥匙。
words.en: To give something to someone else, especially because you have been ordered to do so or because it is necessary.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 闲逛；徘徊；无所事事地待着
words.ex: They like to hang about after school.
words.ex_cn: 他们喜欢放学后闲逛。
words.en: To spend time somewhere without any real purpose or activity.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 闲逛；逗留；在附近徘徊
words.ex: He hangs around the park after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后在公园闲逛。
words.en: To spend time somewhere without any particular purpose or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 不挂断；稍等 ；紧紧抓住
words.ex: Hang on, I will be there soon.
words.ex_cn: 等一下，我马上就到。
words.en: To hold onto something tightly; to wait for a short time.

words.tr: phrase. 闲逛；常去某处；挂出
words.ex: They hang out at the park after school.
words.ex_cn: 他们放学后在公园闲逛。
words.en: To spend time idly or casually, often with others.

words.tr: phrase. 挂断；拖延；把...挂起来
words.ex: He hung up the phone after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 争吵后，他挂断了电话。
words.en: To end a telephone conversation by breaking the connection; to suspend something from above so that it is supported only from above.

words.tr: phrase. 发生在...人身上；碰巧
words.ex: What will happen to the dog if we go on vacation?
words.ex_cn: 如果我们去度假，那只狗会怎么样？
words.en: If something happens to someone or something, it occurs or takes place, often by chance.

words.tr: phrase. 由于…而获得名声、声誉
words.ex: He has a reputation for being kind.
words.ex_cn: 他以善良著称。
words.en: To be known or famous for something, typically something good.

words.tr: phrase. 不应该做某事；无权做某事（通常用于表示某人做某事是不恰当或不合适的）
words.ex: You have no business speaking to me like that.
words.ex_cn: 你不应该那样跟我说话。
words.en: If you say that someone has no business to do something, you mean that they have no right to do it.

words.tr: phrase. v. 自取所需；随意享用（食物或饮料）
words.ex: Please help yourself to some cookies on the table.
words.ex_cn: 请随便吃些桌上的饼干。
words.en: To serve oneself with food or drink without waiting to be served by someone else.

words.tr: phrase. v. 自取所需；随便享用（食物或饮料）
words.ex: Please help yourself to some cookies on the table.
words.ex_cn: 请随意吃一些桌上的饼干。
words.en: To take something for oneself without asking for permission, often used when offering something to someone.

words.tr: phrase. 帮助解决困难
words.ex: He helps out at the store after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后在商店帮忙。
words.en: To assist someone in doing something or in a difficult situation.

words.tr: phrase. 偶然发现
words.ex: I hit on a great cafe while walking in the park.
words.ex_cn: 我在公园散步时偶然发现了一家很棒的咖啡馆。
words.en: To suddenly have a good idea or to flirt with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 偶尔发现；偶然想到；碰巧选择
words.ex: He hit upon a simple solution after thinking for hours.
words.ex_cn: 他想了几个小时后想出了一个简单的解决方案。
words.en: If you hit upon an idea or a solution, you think of it suddenly or by chance.

words.tr: phrase. 阻止；抑制；使退缩；隐瞒
words.ex: He tried to hold back his tears.
words.ex_cn: 他试图忍住眼泪。
words.en: To hold back means to prevent someone or something from moving forward or making progress, or to keep something secret or not express your feelings.

words.tr: phrase. v. 抑制，压制；保住（工作）；按住，使固定
words.ex: Try to hold down your anger.
words.ex_cn: 试着抑制你的愤怒。
words.en: To keep something at a low level or to maintain a position or job despite difficulties.

words.tr: phrase. v. 推迟；阻挡；抑制；保持距离
words.ex: Please hold off until tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 请等到明天再做。
words.en: To delay doing something, or to prevent something from happening or someone from doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 抓紧不放；继续；不挂断；坚持
words.ex: Hold on the rope tightly!
words.ex_cn: 紧紧抓住绳子！
words.en: To continue to do something or to wait for a short time.

words.tr: phrase. v. 坚持自己的立场；不输给他人；能自立
words.ex: In the debate, she held her own against older students.
words.ex_cn: 在辩论中，她面对年长的学生也毫不示弱。
words.en: To maintain one's position or condition without being overwhelmed or defeated.

words.tr: phrase. 伸出；提供；坚持；抵抗；寄予（希望）
words.ex: He held out his hand to help her up.
words.ex_cn: 他伸出手帮她起来。
words.en: If you hold out your hand or something you have in your hand, you move your hand away from your body, usually to offer something to someone else.

words.tr: phrase. v. 延期；延长（会议、假期等）；继续保留
words.ex: They decided to hold over the meeting until next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定将会议推迟到下周。
words.en: To postpone or delay something; to continue to use, show, or do something.

words.tr: phrase. 举起；支撑；继续下去；推举；阻挡；拦截；持械抢劫
words.ex: He held up his hand to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他举起了手来提问。
words.en: To hold something up means to keep it in a high position so that it does not fall or to support it. It can also mean to delay or stop the progress of something or someone, or to rob someone using violence or the threat of violence.

words.tr: phrase. v. 赞同，支持（某观点或做法）；通常用于否定句或疑问句，如 I don't hold with that（我不同意那种做法）
words.ex: I don't hold with the idea of working on weekends.
words.ex_cn: v. 我不同意周末工作的想法。
words.en: To agree with or support an idea, principle, or person.

words.tr: phrase. 用钩钩住；和…有联系；安装
words.ex: They decided to hook up the printer to the computer.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定把打印机连接到电脑上。
words.en: To connect or link something to a power supply, a network, or another device; to form a relationship or partnership with someone, especially in a casual or non-serious way.

words.tr: phrase. 抱着渺茫的希望；在几乎没有希望的情况下仍然抱有希望
words.ex: He hopes against hope that his lost dog will come home.
words.ex_cn: 他抱着一丝希望，盼着走丢的狗能回家。
words.en: To continue to hope for something even though it seems unlikely to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 虚度；消磨（时间）；无所事事地度过
words.ex: He likes to idle away the time with a book.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢用一本书消磨时间。
words.en: If you idle away a period of time, you spend it doing very little or doing nothing important.

words.tr: phrase. 要是…就好了
words.ex: If only I had more time, I would finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 要是我有更多时间，我就能完成作业了。
words.en: used to express a wish that something had happened differently or that something would happen

words.tr: phrase. 把…硬加给；利用；欺骗；勉强（某人）做事
words.ex: They should not impose on others without asking first.
words.ex_cn: 他们不应该在没有询问的情况下强加于人。
words.en: To impose on someone means to ask them to do something that may be inconvenient or troublesome for them.

words.tr: phrase. 征收；强加于；利用；占便宜
words.ex: The government will impose upon the new tax on luxury goods.
words.ex_cn: 政府将对奢侈品征收新税。
words.en: To place or set (something) on or over something else; to establish or apply as compulsory; to take unfair advantage of someone.

words.tr: v. 改善；改进；提高；
words.ex: He works hard to improve his English.
words.ex_cn: 他努力改善自己的英语。
words.en: To make something better, or to become better.

words.tr: phrase. 改进；在…基础上加以改良；对…做出更好的版本
words.ex: Scientists are constantly trying to improve upon existing technologies.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们不断尝试改进现有技术。
words.en: To make something better than it was before.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种意义上
words.ex: In a sense, he is right.
words.ex_cn: 在某种意义上，他是对的。
words.en: You say in a sense to indicate that a statement is true in one way, but not in others.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种程度
words.ex: In a way, he is right about the problem.
words.ex_cn: 在某种程度上，他对这个问题的看法是正确的。
words.en: To some extent; from a certain point of view.

words.tr: phrase. 总之；一句话
words.ex: He is lazy, in a word.
words.ex_cn: 总之，他很懒。
words.en: used to give a summary or to introduce a conclusion

words.tr: phrase. 另外；也
words.ex: He likes apples. In addition, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果。另外，他喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use in addition when you want to mention another item connected with the subject you are discussing.

words.tr: phrase. 除…之外
words.ex: In addition to apples, he buys oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还买橘子。
words.en: Besides; as well as.

words.tr: phrase. 提前；预先
words.ex: Please pay in advance.
words.ex_cn: 请提前付款。
words.en: Before a particular time, or before doing a particular thing.

words.tr: phrase. 无论如何；总之
words.ex: In any case, we should proceed with the plan.
words.ex_cn: 无论如何，我们应该继续执行这个计划。
words.en: used to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous statement; whatever the situation is or will be.

words.tr: phrase. 简单地说；简而言之；简单扼要地
words.ex: In brief, he likes soccer.
words.ex_cn: 简而言之，他喜欢足球。
words.en: In a few words; concisely.

words.tr: phrase. 万一；以防
words.ex: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
words.ex_cn: 带把伞，以防下雨。
words.en: used to describe a situation where you do something in order to be prepared for a possible future event

words.tr: phrase. 假使；如果；万一；以防
words.ex: Keep a flashlight in case of power outage.
words.ex_cn: 以防停电，准备一个手电筒。
words.en: used to describe what should be done if a particular situation, especially a bad one, occurs

words.tr: phrase. 符合（某人）一贯性格的；与角色相符的；合乎身份的
words.ex: He stayed in character during the whole play.
words.ex_cn: 他在整场演出中都符合他一贯的性格。
words.en: consistent with someone's usual behavior or personality; appropriate to a particular role.

words.tr: phrase. /prep. 负责；主管；掌管
words.ex: He is in charge of the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 他负责管理教室。
words.en: Having the responsibility for something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 负责；主管
words.ex: He is in charge of the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 他负责这个教室。
words.en: Having control over or responsibility for someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 冷酷地；蓄意地；残忍地
words.ex: The murderer killed the innocent in cold blood.
words.ex_cn: 凶手冷酷地杀害了无辜的人。
words.en: If someone kills in cold blood, they kill in a way that seems especially cruel because it seems to show no emotion.

words.tr: phrase. 共有
words.ex: They have nothing in common.
words.ex_cn: 他们没有什么共同点。
words.en: If two or more people have something in common, they share the same interests or experiences.

words.tr: phrase. 与…比较起来
words.ex: He runs fast, in comparison with his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，与他哥哥相比。
words.en: Used to say that something is being considered in relation to something else, especially to show how they are different or similar.

words.tr: phrase. 与...协力；和...一起
words.ex: He uses a calculator in conjunction with paper.
words.ex_cn: 他用计算器和纸一起计算。
words.en: Together with; in combination or coordination with.

words.tr: phrase. 与...有关；连同
words.ex: He called me in connection with the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他因会议的事给我打了电话。
words.en: If something happens in connection with something else, it is related to it in some way.

words.tr: phrase. 因此；结果
words.ex: He forgot his homework, in consequence, he got a bad grade.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了做作业，结果得了低分。
words.en: As a result; therefore.

words.tr: phrase. 由于；因为；鉴于……的结果
words.ex: He was late in consequence of the heavy rain.
words.ex_cn: 由于大雨，他迟到了。
words.en: As a result of; because of.

words.tr: phrase. 考虑到；鉴于；作为…的报酬；由于
words.ex: He got the job in consideration of his experience.
words.ex_cn: 由于他的经验，他得到了这份工作。
words.en: Used to introduce a reason or cause for something; because of.

words.tr: phrase. 相比之下；对比而言
words.ex: He likes coffee. By contrast, she prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡。相比之下，她更喜欢茶。
words.en: used when you are comparing two things or people and saying that the second one is very different from the first

words.tr: phrase. 相比之下；相反
words.ex: He likes cats. In contrast, she prefers dogs.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢猫。相比之下，她更喜欢狗。
words.en: used when you are comparing two things or people and saying that the second one is very different from the first

words.tr: phrase. 与……相比；与……形成对比
words.ex: By contrast to his brother, he is very quiet.
words.ex_cn: 与他哥哥相比，他非常安静。
words.en: in comparison with something else, especially something that is very different from it

words.tr: phrase. 相比之下；和...形成对照
words.ex: He likes coffee, in contrast to his sister who likes tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，而他的妹妹喜欢茶。
words.en: used when you are comparing two things or people and saying that the second one is very different from the first

words.tr: phrase. 与……相比；与……形成对比
words.ex: By contrast with her sister, she is very tall.
words.ex_cn: 与她的妹妹相比，她非常高。
words.en: Used when you are comparing two things or people and saying that they are completely different from each other.

words.tr: phrase. 与…形成对比；与…截然不同；相比之下
words.ex: In contrast with his brother, he is very quiet.
words.ex_cn: 与他的兄弟相比，他非常安静。
words.en: used when you are comparing two things or people and saying that the second one is very different from the first

words.tr: phrase. 处于控制之中；掌握局势；能控制局面
words.ex: He is in control of the car.
words.ex_cn: 他掌控着这辆车。
words.en: Having the power to influence or direct people's behavior or the course of events.

words.tr: phrase. 掌控；控制；管理；支配
words.ex: She is in control of the situation.
words.ex_cn: 她控制着局面。
words.en: Having the power to influence or direct people's behavior or the course of events.

words.tr: adj. 深入的；彻底的
words.ex: He did an in-depth study of the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题进行了深入的研究。
words.en: If you do something in depth, you do it very thoroughly and consider all the details.

words.tr: phrase. 详细地
words.ex: He explained the plan in detail.
words.ex_cn: 他详细地解释了这个计划。
words.en: Including all the facts or aspects of a situation.

words.tr: phrase. 认真地；诚挚地；正正经经
words.ex: He started working in earnest after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他毕业后认真开始工作。
words.en: If you do something in earnest, you do it with serious and sincere intentions.

words.tr: phrase. 有效；实际上
words.ex: The new rule is in effect from Monday.
words.ex_cn: 新规定从周一开始生效。
words.en: If a law or rule is in effect, it is operating or being applied.

words.tr: phrase. 显而易见的；明显的；作为证据的；在场且引人注目的
words.ex: His talent is in evidence during the performance.
words.ex_cn: 他在表演中显而易见地展现了才华。
words.en: If someone or something is in evidence, they are present and can be clearly seen.

words.tr: phrase. 超过；较...为多
words.ex: He has in excess of ten books on science.
words.ex_cn: 他有十本以上的科学书籍。
words.en: If something is in excess of a particular amount, it is more than that amount.

words.tr: phrase. 赞同；支持；有利于
words.ex: He is in favor of eating vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他赞成吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you are in favor of something, you support it or agree with it.

words.tr: phrase. 赞成；支持
words.ex: He is in favour of eating more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他赞成多吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you are in favour of something, you support it or agree with it.

words.tr: phrase. 有效的；在实施中的；大批的；大规模的
words.ex: The new law is still in force.
words.ex_cn: 新法律仍然有效。
words.en: If something such as a law, rule, or system is in force, it is operating or being used.

words.tr: phrase. 充足；以全文；全部地
words.ex: He paid the bill in full.
words.ex_cn: 他全额支付了账单。
words.en: If something is done or happens in full, it is done or happens completely.

words.tr: phrase. 通常；大体上；一般而言
words.ex: In general, he likes to eat fruit.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，他喜欢吃水果。
words.en: Usually; in most cases.

words.tr: phrase. 分成两半；一半
words.ex: She cut the apple in half.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果切成两半。
words.en: Into two equal parts.

words.tr: phrase. 和睦；协调
words.ex: The birds sing in harmony with the wind.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿与风一起和谐地歌唱。
words.en: In a way that is pleasing because all the parts seem to fit together well.

words.tr: phrase. 与...协调一致；与...和谐
words.ex: The painting is in harmony with the room's colors.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画与房间的颜色相协调。
words.en: If one thing is in harmony with another, the first thing suits the second or they seem right together.

words.tr: phrase. 匆忙地；急忙地；草率地
words.ex: He wrote the letter in haste.
words.ex_cn: 他匆忙写了这封信。
words.en: Done quickly, often without careful thought.

words.tr: phrase. 实质上；本身
words.ex: The idea is interesting in itself, but it needs further development.
words.ex_cn: 这个想法本身很有趣，但还需要进一步发展。
words.en: considered without other related ideas or situations

words.tr: phrase. 以实物（而非金钱）；以同样方式；回以同类事物
words.ex: She repaid his help in kind by offering her assistance when he needed it.
words.ex_cn: 她以同样的方式回报了他的帮助，在他需要时提供了帮助。
words.en: If you do something in kind, you do the same thing to someone that they have just done to you.

words.tr: phrase. 符合；一致；与…成一直线
words.ex: His decision is in line with the company's rules.
words.ex_cn: 他的决定符合公司的规定。
words.en: In agreement or conformity with something.

words.tr: phrase. 绝不；在任何情况下都不
words.ex: In no case should you give up your dreams.
words.ex_cn: 你绝不应该放弃你的梦想。
words.en: Under no circumstances; never.

words.tr: phrase. 立刻；马上
words.ex: He finished his homework in no time.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就完成了作业。
words.en: Very quickly or soon.

words.tr: phrase. 绝不；一点也不；无论如何都不
words.ex: In no way should you feel responsible for what happened.
words.ex_cn: 你绝不应该对所发生的事情感到负责。
words.en: not at all; definitely not

words.tr: phrase. phr. 为向某人致敬；为庆祝某人；为表彰某人
words.ex: They had a party in her honor.
words.ex_cn: 他们为她举办了一个派对。
words.en: To show respect or commemorate someone.

words.tr: phrase. 某人在场时
words.ex: He feels nervous in his teacher's presence.
words.ex_cn: 他在老师面前感到紧张。
words.en: When someone is in one's presence, they are in the same place as that person and are aware of them.

words.tr: phrase. 换句话说
words.ex: I'm tired; in other words, I need to rest.
words.ex_cn: 我累了；换句话说，我需要休息。
words.en: Used to introduce a different way of saying the same thing, often to make it clearer or more understandable.

words.tr: phrase. 尤其；特别
words.ex: I like fruits, in particular apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Especially; more than other things or people.

words.tr: phrase. 代替
words.ex: He used honey in place of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他用蜂蜜代替了糖。
words.en: Instead of someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 秘密地；私下
words.ex: He talks to his dog in private.
words.ex_cn: 他私下跟他的狗说话。
words.en: If you do something in private, you do it without other people being present, often because it is something that you want to keep secret.

words.tr: phrase. 与...成比例
words.ex: The cost is in proportion to the size of the room.
words.ex_cn: 费用与房间的大小成正比。
words.en: If one thing changes or is done in proportion to another, it changes or is done according to how much the other thing changes or is done.

words.tr: phrase. 实际上；事实上
words.ex: He looks happy, but in reality, he is sad.
words.ex_cn: 他看起来很开心，但事实上，他很难过。
words.en: used to emphasize what is actually the case, as opposed to what people might think

words.tr: phrase. 关于；涉及；与…相比
words.ex: He explained the rule in relation to the example.
words.ex_cn: 他结合例子解释了这个规则。
words.en: Concerning or in connection with something.

words.tr: phrase. 作为报答
words.ex: I helped him, and he gave me a gift in return.
words.ex_cn: 我帮了他，他送了我一份礼物作为回报。
words.en: If you do something in return for what someone else has done for you, you do it because they did that thing for you.

words.tr: phrase.  成为废墟地；破败不堪
words.ex: The old castle is in ruins.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的城堡已成废墟。
words.en: In a state of severe decay or destruction, often due to neglect or disaster.

words.tr: phrase. 寻找
words.ex: He is in search of a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他正在寻找一份新工作。
words.en: If you are in search of something, you are looking for it.

words.tr: phrase. 秘密地；暗地里；私下地
words.ex: They were meeting in secret to discuss their plans.
words.ex_cn: 他们秘密会面讨论他们的计划。
words.en: Done, made, or conducted without the knowledge of others.

words.tr: phrase. 简而言之；总之
words.ex: In short, he likes pizza.
words.ex_cn: 简而言之，他喜欢披萨。
words.en: used to introduce a summary of something that has just been said or to give a brief statement of the main points.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种程度上，就某种程度而言
words.ex: He will help you insofar as he can.
words.ex_cn: 他能帮多少就帮多少。
words.en: to the extent or degree that

words.tr: phrase. 不顾；不管；尽管
words.ex: He went to school in spite of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: You use in spite of to introduce a fact which makes the rest of the statement you are making seem surprising.

words.tr: phrase. 贮藏着；准备着；保存着
words.ex: There is a surprise in store for you.
words.ex_cn: 为你准备了一个惊喜。
words.en: If something is in store for you, it is going to happen to you in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 总的来说
words.ex: In summary, he likes apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 总之，他喜欢苹果和橙子。
words.en: used to introduce a short statement of the main points of something.

words.tr: phrase. 就...而言；在...方面；根据
words.ex: In terms of cost, this phone is cheaper.
words.ex_cn: 从成本来看，这部手机更便宜。
words.en: used to indicate what aspect of a subject you are talking about

words.tr: phrase. 如果...发生
words.ex: In the event of rain, the picnic will be moved to the gym.
words.ex_cn: 如果下雨，野餐将移到体育馆。
words.en: if something happens

words.tr: phrase. 如果；倘若；万一
words.ex: In the event that it rains, we will stay home.
words.ex_cn: 如果下雨，我们就待在家里。
words.en: If something happens; in case something happens.

words.tr: phrase. 面对
words.ex: He stayed calm in the face of danger.
words.ex_cn: 他在危险面前保持冷静。
words.en: If you do something in the face of a particular situation, you do it despite the difficulties or problems that the situation causes.

words.tr: phrase. 首先；起初；作为第一步
words.ex: In the first instance, let's consider the basic requirements.
words.ex_cn: 首先，让我们考虑基本要求。
words.en: You say in the first instance to mention something that is the first step in a series of actions.

words.tr: phrase. 有…的习惯；习惯于
words.ex: She is in the habit of drinking a cup of coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 她习惯于每天早上喝一杯咖啡。
words.en: Being accustomed to doing something regularly or routinely.

words.tr: phrase. 由…掌握；在…控制中；交由…处理
words.ex: The project is in the hands of a skilled team.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目在一支熟练的团队手中。
words.en: Under the control or responsibility of someone.

words.tr: phrase. 为了某人的利益；出于对某人的考虑
words.ex_cn: 为了公众的安全，这条路将被关闭进行维修。
words.en: For the benefit or advantage of someone.

words.tr: phrase. 为了…的利益；出于对…的考虑
words.ex: He stayed late in the interest of completing the project.
words.ex_cn: 为了完成项目，他待到了很晚。
words.en: For the benefit or advantage of something.

words.tr: phrase. 为了某人的利益；出于对某人的考虑；代表某人的利益
words.uk: ɪn ðə ˈɪntrəsts əv ɛs ˈbiː
words.us: ɪn ðə ˈɪntrəsts əv ɛs ˈbiː
words.ex: He spoke up in the interests of his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他为了朋友的利益而发声。
words.en: If you do something in the interests of a particular result or situation, you do it in order to achieve that result or maintain that situation.

words.tr: phrase. 为了某事的利益；出于对某事的考虑
words.ex: We must act in the interests of public safety.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须为了公众安全采取行动。
words.en: If you do something in the interests of a particular result or situation, you do it in order to achieve that result or maintain that situation.

words.tr: phrase. 根据；鉴于
words.ex: He changed his plan in light of the new weather forecast.
words.ex_cn: 根据新的天气预报，他改变了计划。
words.en: Used to introduce a fact or situation that is the reason for a particular action or decision.

words.tr: phrase. 根据；鉴于
words.ex: He changed his mind in the light of new facts.
words.ex_cn: 根据新事实，他改变了主意。
words.en: If you do or decide something in the light of something else, you do it or decide it after considering that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 从长远来看；最后
words.ex: In the long run, eating healthy saves money on doctor visits.
words.ex_cn: 从长远来看，健康饮食可以节省看医生的费用。
words.en: Over an extended period of time; in the future, especially in the distant future.

words.tr: phrase. 在…附近；大约；接近（某数量或数值）
words.ex: The park is in the neighbourhood of the school.
words.ex_cn: 公园在学校附近。
words.en: In the vicinity of; approximately.

words.tr: phrase. 负债；亏损；赤字
words.ex: He is in the red because he spent too much money.
words.ex_cn: 他因为花太多钱而亏钱了。
words.en: If someone is in the red, they owe money or have spent more than they have earned.

words.tr: phrase. 处于同样困境；同舟共济；境遇相同
words.ex: We're all in the same boat, so let's help each other out.
words.ex_cn: 我们都在同一条船上，所以让我们互相帮助吧。
words.en: In the same situation, especially an unpleasant one.

words.tr: phrase. 尾随；紧跟
words.ex: In the wake of the storm, the city was left in ruins.
words.ex_cn: 风暴过后，城市变成了一片废墟。
words.en: Following immediately after, often as a result of.

words.tr: phrase. 合调的；和谐的；一致的；协调的
words.ex: The guitar is in tune.
words.ex_cn: 这把吉他调音准确。
words.en: If someone is in tune with something, they understand it well or are in agreement with it.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 与…协调一致；与…合拍；与…同步；与…和谐
words.ex: She is always in tune with the latest fashion trends.
words.ex_cn: 她总是能很好地理解最新的时尚潮流。
words.en: In agreement or harmony with.

words.tr: phrase. 依次；轮流；结果；反过来
words.ex: The students spoke in turn to answer the teacher's question.
words.ex_cn: 学生们依次回答老师的问题。
words.en: You use in turn to refer to actions or events that are in a sequence one after the other, especially because one causes the other.

words.tr: phrase. 白费地； 徒劳地
words.ex: He cried in vain for help.
words.ex_cn: 他呼救却无济于事。
words.en: If you do something in vain, you do not succeed in achieving what you intend.

words.tr: phrase. 鉴于；考虑到；由于
words.ex: He stayed home in view of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 由于下雨，他待在家里。
words.en: You use 'in view of' when you are taking into consideration a particular fact or situation that is important in relation to what you are saying or doing.

words.tr: phrase. 告知某人某事
words.ex: Please inform the staff of the meeting time.
words.ex_cn: 请通知员工会议时间。
words.en: To tell someone about particular facts or information.

words.tr: phrase. 通知某人某事；向某人告知某事
words.ex: Please inform me about the meeting time.
words.ex_cn: 请通知我会议时间。
words.en: To tell someone about something; to give information.

words.tr: phrase. 询问；打听；咨询
words.ex: She decided to inquire about the availability of flights to Paris.
words.ex_cn: 她决定查询飞往巴黎的航班情况。
words.en: To ask for information about something.

words.tr: phrase. 调查，审查：收集或搜集关于某事的信息。
words.ex: The police will inquire into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方将调查这起事故。
words.en: To inquire into something means to investigate or examine it thoroughly in order to find out the facts about it.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持；坚决要求
words.ex: He insists on walking to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持每天步行上学。
words.en: If you insist on something, you demand it and refuse to accept any alternative.

words.tr: phrase. v. 坚持；坚决要求；执意要
words.ex: He insists upon finishing his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持要在吃晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: To demand something forcefully, not accepting refusal.

words.tr: phrase. 代替；而不是
words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: In place of someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 使成一体；融入
words.ex: It is important to integrate into the community when you move to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 当你搬到一个新城市时，融入社区很重要。
words.en: To integrate into something means to become part of a group or system, or to make someone or something become part of a group or system.

words.tr: v. （使）融入；
words.ex: He tried to integrate into the new school community.
words.ex_cn: 他试图融入新的学校群体。
words.en: If someone integrates into a social group, or is integrated into it, they behave in such a way that they become part of the group or are accepted into it.

words.tr: phrase. 干涉某人；妨碍某人；干扰某人
words.ex: Don't interfere with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 不要干涉我的作业。
words.en: To involve yourself in a situation when your involvement is not wanted or is not helpful.

words.tr: phrase. 在…上投资
words.ex: He wants to invest in a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他想投资一家小企业。
words.en: To put money, effort, time, etc. into something to make a profit or achieve a result.

words.tr: phrase. 使与…隔离
words.ex: He isolates from his friends when he feels sad.
words.ex_cn: 当他感到难过时，他会与朋友疏远。
words.en: To separate something or someone from other things or people with which they are connected or involved.

words.tr: phrase. 插队
words.ex: He tried to jump the queue, but others shouted at him.
words.ex_cn: 他想插队，但其他人对他大声喊叫。
words.en: To move ahead of others in a line or sequence without waiting for one's turn.

words.tr: 插队：违反排队规则，跳过其他人直接加入队伍。
words.ex: It's rude to jump a queue in front of others.
words.ex_cn: 在别人面前插队是不礼貌的。
words.en: To jump a queue means to unfairly move ahead of others who have been waiting longer in a line.

words.tr: phrase. 几乎；正是；大约；马上
words.ex: I have just about finished my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我差不多快写完作业了。
words.en: Almost; very nearly.

words.tr: phrase. 照看；密切注视
words.ex: Please keep an eye on the baby while I cook.
words.ex_cn: 我做饭时，请照看一下宝宝。
words.en: To watch or look after someone or something carefully.

words.tr: phrase. 控制；镇压；缩减
words.ex: Please keep down the noise.
words.ex_cn: 请把噪音压低。
words.en: To prevent something from increasing, spreading, or becoming too noticeable.

words.tr: phrase. 阻止；妨碍；抑制
words.ex: He tried to keep from crying.
words.ex_cn: 他努力忍住不哭。
words.en: To prevent someone from doing something or to not do something oneself.

words.tr: phrase. 与…保持联系
words.ex: I keep in touch with my friend by texting.
words.ex_cn: 我通过发短信和朋友保持联系。
words.en: To maintain communication or contact with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 祈求好运；交叉手指以求好运；祝愿一切顺利
words.ex: I'm keeping my fingers crossed for good weather tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我祈求明天天气好。
words.en: To hope that something will happen in the way that you want it to.

words.tr: phrase. 跟上；与…并驾齐驱；保持同步
words.ex: She needs to keep pace with the fast-moving market.
words.ex_cn: 她需要跟上快速变化的市场。
words.en: To move or progress at the same speed as someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 并驾齐驱
words.ex: He works hard to keep pace with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以跟上同学的步伐。
words.en: To move or progress at the same rate as someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持；继续；跟上
words.ex: He tries to keep up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力跟上他的同学。
words.en: To continue to do something; to maintain something at a high level; to stay level or equal with someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 随意放置；闲置；被漫不经心地放在某处；随意踢来踢去
words.ex: We kicked about some ideas for the project.
words.ex_cn: 我们讨论了一些项目的主意。
words.en: To move or be moved around or about, especially in a casual or aimless manner; to discuss or consider something informally.

words.tr: phrase. 随意讨论；非正式地商量；把…踢来踢去；粗暴对待；漂泊
words.ex: We kicked around the idea for a while before deciding.
words.ex_cn: 我们讨论了一会儿这个想法，然后才决定。
words.en: To discuss informally or consider casually; to treat roughly or harshly; to move or travel aimlessly.

words.tr: phrase. 中线开球；出发；开始；脱鞋
words.ex: The referee will kick off the match at 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 裁判将在下午3点中线开球。
words.en: To start something, especially a game, event, or process.

words.tr: phrase. v. 驱逐；开除；赶走；踢出去
words.ex: They kick out the man who was making noise.
words.ex_cn: 他们把制造噪音的男人赶了出去。
words.en: To force someone to leave a place or group.

words.tr: phrase. 踢起；扬起；激起
words.ex: The boy kicked up dust while running.
words.ex_cn: 男孩跑步时踢起了灰尘。
words.en: To cause something to rise or increase, especially dust, a fuss, or prices.

words.tr: phrase. 有点儿
words.ex: I kind of like pizza.
words.ex_cn: 我有点喜欢披萨。
words.en: To some extent; somewhat.

words.tr: phrase. 漫游；漂泊；闲逛；随意地击打或碰撞
words.ex: We just knock about the house on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我们周末只是在家里闲逛。
words.en: To travel or move around without a specific purpose or direction, often in a casual or aimless manner.

words.tr: phrase. 闲逛；漫游；随意打发时间；虐待；殴打
words.ex: He likes to knock around the city on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末在城市里漫游。
words.en: To travel or move around without a specific purpose or destination; to discuss or consider something informally.

words.tr: phrase. 击倒；拆卸；拍板成交；获得（收入）；降低（价格）；减（量）
words.ex: The strong wind can knock down the small tree.
words.ex_cn: 强风能把小树吹倒。
words.en: To knock someone or something down means to cause them to fall to the ground by hitting them, often with a vehicle or by physical force.

words.tr: phrase. 减除；偷；收工；杀死
words.ex: They knocked off $10 from the total price.
words.ex_cn: 他们从总价中减除了10美元。
words.en: To stop working; to reduce the price of something; to kill someone; to copy something, especially in a way that is not legal.

words.tr: phrase. 击倒；破坏
words.ex: He knocked out the other player in the boxing match.
words.ex_cn: 他在拳击比赛中击倒了另一名选手。
words.en: To knock someone out means to cause them to become unconscious or to defeat them in a competition.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 对...极其熟悉；对...了如指掌
words.ex: He knows the map of the city backward.
words.ex_cn: 他对城市的地图了如指掌。
words.en: If you know something backward, you know it very well and can understand or do it easily.

words.tr: phrase. 了如指掌：对某事物非常熟悉，知道得非常详细。
words.ex: He knows the map of the city backwards.
words.ex_cn: 他对城市的地图了如指掌。
words.en: To know something so well that you can understand or perform it easily and without hesitation.

words.tr: phrase. 知道不该做某事；更明智；更懂事
words.ex: She should know better than to trust him.
words.ex_cn: 她应该更明白事理，不会愚蠢到相信他。
words.en: To have more knowledge or understanding about something, especially to understand why something is not a good idea.

words.tr: phrase. 明事理而不至于；懂得不该做某事；有足够的判断力不去做
words.ex: You should know better than to trust everything you read on the internet.
words.ex_cn: 你应该明白不能相信网上读到的一切。
words.en: To be wise or experienced enough not to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 稍后；后来；之后
words.ex: He was tired, but he will study later on.
words.ex_cn: 他很累，但他稍后会学习。
words.en: At a time in the future; after the time you are talking about.

words.tr: phrase. v. 突然开始；投入；猛烈地开始进行；着手
words.ex: He launched into a speech without warning.
words.ex_cn: 他突然开始发表演讲。
words.en: If you launch into something, you start doing it or talking about it with a lot of energy or enthusiasm.

words.tr:
v. 发射；发起；启动；
n. 发射；投掷；启动；
words.ex: They will launch a rocket tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将发射一枚火箭。
words.en: To launch something means to send it into the air, space, or water, especially with a lot of force or effort, or to start an activity, event, or project.

words.tr: phrase. 把……放在一边；搁置；储蓄；抛弃
words.ex: He lay aside his book and stood up.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在一边，站了起来。
words.en: To put something to one side, especially for a short time, in order to do something else.

words.tr: phrase. 放下；放弃；规定
words.ex: The soldiers were ordered to lay down their arms.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们被命令放下武器。
words.en: To lay something down means to put it down, often in a careful or deliberate way. It can also mean to establish something, such as rules or guidelines.

words.tr: phrase. 非常强调；着重于；高度重视
words.ex: The teacher lays great emphasis on reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师非常强调每天阅读。
words.en: To place significant importance or stress on something.

words.tr: phrase. 暂时解雇；停止
words.ex: The company will lay off 50 workers next month.
words.ex_cn: 公司下个月将裁员50人。
words.en: To terminate the employment of a worker or workers, especially temporarily, because there is not enough work for them to do.

words.tr: phrase. 中途停留；过夜；延期；推迟
words.ex: We had a lay over in Tokyo for six hours.
words.ex_cn: 我们在东京停留了六个小时。
words.en: To lay over means to stop somewhere for a short time before continuing a journey, or to cover something with a layer of material.

words.tr: phrase. 了解；学习；获悉
words.ex: We learn about animals in science class.
words.ex_cn: 我们在科学课上了解动物。
words.en: To gain knowledge or information about a particular subject or topic.

words.tr: phrase. 最不；尤其不；特别是……也不（用于强调某人或某事最不应被提及或发生）
words.ex: She likes everyone in the class, but least of all the new student.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢班上的每个人，但最不喜欢新来的学生。
words.en: Used to emphasize that a particular person or thing is the one that is least likely to be affected by something or to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 不管；不理会；更不用说
words.ex: Leave him alone; he wants to be quiet.
words.ex_cn: 别管他，他想安静一下。
words.en: To not disturb or bother someone; to allow someone to be by themselves.

words.tr: phrase. 听任某人自行其是；让某人独自处理；不干涉某人
words.ex: If you leave him to his own devices, he will find a way to fix the problem.
words.ex_cn: 如果你让他自己想办法，他会找到解决问题的方法。
words.en: To allow someone to do something in their own way, without interference.

words.tr: phrase. v. 停止；中断；不再穿（衣服）
words.ex: It's time to leave off talking and start working.
words.ex_cn: 是时候停止谈话开始工作了。
words.en: To stop doing something, especially something that you have been doing for a long time.

words.tr: phrase. 省去； 遗漏； 不考虑
words.ex: Don't leave out the sugar in the recipe.
words.ex_cn: 别在食谱里漏掉糖。
words.en: To not include someone or something in an activity or discussion.

words.tr: phrase. 更不用说；何况
words.ex: He can't even walk, let alone run.
words.ex_cn: 他连走都走不了，更别说跑了。
words.en: Used to emphasize the improbability of a contrasting example.

words.tr: phrase. 放开；松手；释放；放弃
words.ex: You need to let go of the past and move forward.
words.ex_cn: 你需要放下过去，继续前进。
words.en: To release or stop holding something or someone.

words.tr:
n. 幻灯片；滑梯；
v. （使）滑动；下滑；
words.ex: He showed a slide of his vacation photos.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了一张他度假照片的幻灯片。
words.en: To move smoothly along a surface while maintaining continuous contact with it; to pass or move quietly or smoothly; a structure with a smooth sloping surface for children to slide down; a decline from a higher to a lower level or status.

words.tr: phrase. 趋于平稳；停止上升或下降；使变得平坦
words.ex: The plane will level off at 30,000 feet.
words.ex_cn: 飞机将在30,000英尺的高度平飞。
words.en: To stop increasing or decreasing and remain steady; to become flat or level.

words.tr: phrase. 睡懒觉；在于；位于
words.ex: He lies in bed on Sunday mornings.
words.ex_cn: 他在周日早上睡懒觉。
words.en: To be the main or most important part of something; to stay in bed longer than usual in the morning.

words.tr: phrase. 登录
words.ex: He logs in to his email every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上登录邮箱。
words.en: To enter a computer system or website by typing your username and password.

words.tr: phrase. 登出；注销；退出（计算机系统或在线账户）
words.ex: Remember to log out before you leave the computer.
words.ex_cn: 离开电脑前记得注销。
words.en: To log out means to terminate a session on a computer, website, or application, especially to prevent unauthorized access to your account.

words.tr: phrase. 渴望；向往；期盼
words.ex: He longs for his hometown.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望他的家乡。
words.en: To have a strong wish or desire for something.

words.tr: phrase. 回头看；回顾；倒退
words.ex: He looks back on his childhood with happiness.
words.ex_cn: 他满怀幸福地回忆自己的童年。
words.en: To look back means to think about something that happened in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 展望；期待
words.ex: I look forward to the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我期待着周末。
words.en: If you look forward to something that is going to happen, you want it to happen because you think you will enjoy it.

words.tr: phrase. 察看；检查；翻阅；原谅；从...上面看
words.ex: He will look over his homework before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡觉前会检查一下作业。
words.en: To examine or inspect something quickly or casually.

words.tr: phrase. 与…失去联系；与…失去接触
words.ex: He lost contact with his friend after they moved to different cities.
words.ex_cn: 他们搬到不同的城市后，他和朋友失去了联系。
words.en: To no longer communicate with someone or be in touch with them.

words.tr: phrase. 灰心；泄气；失去勇气
words.ex: Don't lose heart, you can try again.
words.ex_cn: 别灰心，你可以再试一次。
words.en: To become discouraged or disheartened.

words.tr: phrase. 发脾气；发怒
words.ex: He loses his temper when he hears loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 他听到吵闹声时就会发脾气。
words.en: To lose one's temper means to suddenly become very angry.

words.tr: phrase. 主修；专攻
words.ex: He wants to major in biology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学主修生物学。
words.en: To specialize in a particular subject or field of study at a college or university.

words.tr: phrase. 要紧；区别对待；有影响；起（重要）作用
words.ex: Volunteering can make a difference in your community.
words.ex_cn: 志愿服务能为你的社区带来改变。
words.en: If something makes a difference, it affects someone or something positively, especially in a noticeable or important way.

words.tr: phrase. 愚弄；使出丑；把…当傻瓜
words.ex: He likes to make a fool of his friends at parties.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在派对上捉弄他的朋友。
words.en: To make someone appear foolish or to deceive someone in a way that makes them seem silly.

words.tr: phrase. 把…当回事；小题大做；过分强调
words.ex: He makes a thing of forgetting his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他总把忘带钥匙当回事。
words.en: To treat something as more important or significant than it really is, often causing unnecessary attention or fuss.

words.tr: phrase. 小题大做；把…当回事；对…大惊小怪
words.ex: Don't make a thing out of small mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 不要把小错误当成大事。
words.en: To make a situation more complicated or serious than it needs to be.

words.tr: phrase. 把……列为头等大事；使成为最优先考虑的事项
words.ex: When planning your day, make sure to make a top priority of your most important tasks.
words.ex_cn: 在规划你的一天时，确保把最重要的事情列为优先事项。
words.en: To treat something as the most important thing to be done.

words.tr: phrase. 惩罚某人以儆效尤；拿某人开刀以警示他人
words.ex: The teacher decided to make an example of the student who cheated.
words.ex_cn: 老师决定惩罚那个作弊的学生，以儆效尤。
words.en: To punish someone publicly as a warning to others.

words.tr: phrase. 走向；促进；有助于
words.ex: He made for the door when he heard the alarm.
words.ex_cn: 他听到警报后走向了门。
words.en: If something makes for a particular situation, it causes that situation to exist or develop.

words.tr: phrase. 创造历史；做出载入史册的壮举
words.ex: They will make history with their big idea.
words.ex_cn: 他们将用他们的大创意创造历史。
words.en: To do something so important that it will be recorded in history.

words.tr: phrase. 对…直言不讳；毫不掩饰；对…毫不迟疑
words.ex: He makes no bones about his dislike for lazy people.
words.ex_cn: 他对讨厌懒惰的人直言不讳。
words.en: If you make no bones about something, you are open and honest about it and do not try to hide your feelings.

words.tr: phrase. 离开；逃走
words.ex: He made off after stealing the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他偷了自行车后就离开了。
words.en: To leave quickly, especially in order to escape or avoid something; to steal something and leave quickly.

words.w: make one's hair stand on end
words.tr: phrase. 使某人毛骨悚然；使人极度惊恐
words.uk: meɪk wʌnz hɛə stænd ɒn end
words.us: meɪk wʌnz hɛr stænd ɒn end
words.ex: The ghost story made my hair stand on end.
words.ex_cn: 那个鬼故事吓得我毛骨悚然。
words.en: To cause someone to feel extremely frightened or horrified.

words.tr: phrase. 理解；辨认出；书写；进展；设法应付；亲热
words.ex: I can't make out the words in this small print.
words.ex_cn: 我看不清这些小字。
words.en: to manage to see, hear, or understand someone or something with difficulty

words.tr: phrase. 讲得通； 有意义； 言之有理
words.ex: This plan makes sense.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划有道理。
words.en: To be reasonable or understandable.

words.tr: phrase. 确保；确定；核实；查明
words.ex: Make sure you lock the door before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前确保锁好门。
words.en: To make certain that something is done or happens.

words.tr: phrase. 充分利用；尽力而为；在不利条件下尽量做好
words.ex: He made the best of his small room by adding shelves.
words.ex_cn: 他通过加装架子，充分利用了自己狭小的房间。
words.en: To use or deal with something in a way that gets the most positive results from it, especially in a difficult situation.

words.tr: phrase. 达到标准；成功；合格
words.ex: He studied hard to make the grade in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，以便在数学课上达到标准。
words.en: To reach the required standard; to succeed.

words.tr: phrase. 编造；组成；弥补；化妆；和好
words.ex: He made up a story to explain his delay.
words.ex_cn: 他编了一个故事来解释他的迟到。
words.en: To make up means to form something by combining or assembling parts, to invent a story or excuse, to apply cosmetics, or to reconcile after a disagreement.

words.tr: phrase. 弥补；补偿
words.ex: He worked extra hours to make up for the lost time.
words.ex_cn: 他加班工作来弥补失去的时间。
words.en: To compensate for something that is lacking or has been lost.

words.tr: phrase. 使用
words.ex: He makes use of old books to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他利用旧书来省钱。
words.en: To use something or someone in order to achieve a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 许多（后接单数可数名词，表示复数意义）；一个又一个的
words.ex: Many a student fails this test.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生都未能通过这次考试。
words.en: Used to indicate a large number of something, followed by a singular noun.

words.tr: phrase. 详细规划；制定；筹划；在地图上标出路线
words.ex: He will map out the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会规划出这个计划。
words.en: To plan or arrange something in detail.

words.tr: phrase. 弄乱；搞砸；犯错；使陷入困境
words.ex: He might mess up the plan if he doesn't listen.
words.ex_cn: 如果他不听，他可能会把计划搞砸。
words.en: To make a mistake or do something badly.

words.tr: phrase. 招惹；干涉；摆弄；与…搞不正当关系
words.ex: Don't mess with me, or you'll regret it.
words.ex_cn: 不要干涉我，否则你会后悔的。
words.en: To interfere with or handle something in a careless or harmful way.

words.tr: phrase. 不妨；倒不如；还是…为好
words.ex: Since we're already here, we might as well stay for the show.
words.ex_cn: 既然我们已经在这里了，不妨留下来看表演。
words.en: Used to suggest that something should be done or accepted because there is no good reason not to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 管好你自己的事；少管闲事
words.ex: When asked about his personal life, he simply said, 'Mind your own business.'
words.ex_cn: 当被问及他的私生活时，他只是说：‘别管闲事。’
words.en: Used to tell someone in a somewhat rude way that they should not try to find out about things that are private or do not concern them.

words.tr: phrase. 混合；混淆
words.ex: Don't mix up the red and blue paints.
words.ex_cn: 别把红色和蓝色的颜料弄混了。
words.en: To confuse or mistake one thing for another.

words.tr: phrase. 与…混合；与…交往；与…混在一起
words.ex: He mixes water with juice.
words.ex_cn: 他把水和果汁混合在一起。
words.en: To combine or be combined with something else; to associate or be associated with others.

words.tr: phrase. 往往；多半
words.ex: More often than not, he walks to school.
words.ex_cn: 大多数情况下，他走路去上学。
words.en: If you say that something happens more often than not, you mean that it happens more than half the time.

words.tr: phrase. 四处走动；来回移动；到处活动
words.ex: The cat likes to move around the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫喜欢在晚上在家里四处走动。
words.en: To move around means to travel from one place to another or to change the position of something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 离开；启程；（车辆等）驶离
words.ex: The bus will move off in five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 公交车将在五分钟后开走。
words.en: To start moving or to leave a place.

words.tr: phrase. 继续前进；转变话题
words.ex: He decided to move on after the breakup.
words.ex_cn: 分手后，他决定继续前行。
words.en: To continue with your life after you have dealt with a bad experience.

words.tr: phrase. 搬出；迁走
words.ex: He will move out next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周要搬出去。
words.en: To leave a place where you have been living and go to live somewhere else.

words.tr: phrase. 尽管；虽然；即使
words.ex: Much as I admire her courage, I think she is reckless.
words.ex_cn: 尽管我佩服她的勇气，我认为她太鲁莽了。
words.en: Although; even though.

words.tr: phrase. 既不……也不……；两者都不
words.ex: Neither Tom nor Anna likes coffee.
words.ex_cn: 汤姆和安娜都不喜欢咖啡。
words.en: Used before the first of two (or occasionally more) alternatives that are being specified to indicate that they are each untrue or do not happen.

words.tr: phrase. 无疑地
words.ex: He will pass the test, no doubt.
words.ex_cn: 他肯定会通过考试。
words.en: You use no doubt to indicate that you are making a judgment or statement that you think is probably true, although you are not certain.

words.tr: phrase. 无论；不管
words.ex: No matter how tired I am, I finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 无论我多么累，我都会完成作业。
words.en: used to say that something is not important or does not affect the situation

words.tr: phrase. 不是别人而正是……；恰恰是
words.ex: The guest of honor is none other than the famous scientist.
words.ex_cn: 贵宾不是别人，正是那位著名的科学家。
words.en: used to emphasize the surprising identity of a person or thing

words.tr: phrase. 一点也不；丝毫不
words.ex: He was not in the least worried about the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他一点也不担心考试。
words.en: Not at all; not in any way or degree.

words.tr: phrase.  更不必说；不必提及
words.ex: He can run fast, not to mention jump high.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，更不用说跳得高了。
words.en: Used to introduce an additional point which reinforces the point being made.

words.tr: phrase. 直到……才；在……之前不
words.ex: He did not leave until his mother came back.
words.ex_cn: 直到他妈妈回来，他才离开。
words.en: used to emphasize that something does not happen before a certain point in time

words.tr: phrase. 既然
words.ex: Now that it is sunny, we can go outside.
words.ex_cn: 既然天晴了，我们可以出去了。
words.en: Used to introduce a reason or explanation, often implying that the situation has changed.

words.tr: phrase. 远非；远不及；完全不；差得远
words.ex: The movie was nowhere near as good as the book.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影远不及书好。
words.en: not nearly; not at all

words.tr: phrase. 反对某人；对某人提出异议
words.ex_cn: 她强烈反对他，因为他行为粗鲁。
words.en: To express disapproval or opposition to a person.

words.tr: phrase. 反对
words.ex: I object to the plan because it is too expensive.
words.ex_cn: 我反对这个计划，因为它太贵了。
words.en: To express disapproval or opposition to an idea or action.

words.tr: phrase. 想起；想到
words.ex: It did not occur to him to call for help.
words.ex_cn: 他没想到要打电话求助。
words.en: If a thought or idea occurs to you, it comes into your mind.

words.tr: phrase. 零碎杂物；零散物品；杂七杂八的东西
words.ex: She had a box full of odds and ends from her travels.
words.ex_cn: 她有一个装满旅行中零碎物品的盒子。
words.en: Miscellaneous items or remnants.

words.tr: phrase. 同一类的；差强人意的；徒有其名的
words.ex: They served coffee of a kind, but it was barely drinkable.
words.ex_cn: 他们端上了某种咖啡，但几乎无法入口。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as one of a kind, you mean that there is nobody or nothing else like them.

words.tr: phrase. 近来；最近
words.ex: He has been late for work of late.
words.ex_cn: 最近他上班总是迟到。
words.en: recently; in the recent past

words.tr: phrase. 必然地
words.ex: He left early, of necessity, to catch the train.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不早点离开，以便赶上火车。
words.en: If you say that something is of necessity the case, you mean that it must be the case and cannot be different.

words.tr: phrase. 不重要的；无价值的
words.ex: His opinion is of no account in this matter.
words.ex_cn: 他的意见在这件事上不重要。
words.en: If you say that something is of no account or of little account, you mean that it is very unimportant and not worth considering.

words.tr: phrase. 失去平衡的；不稳定的；措手不及的；心理失衡的
words.ex: He was caught off balance by the sudden gust of wind.
words.ex_cn: 突如其来的大风让他失去了平衡。
words.en: Not in a steady or stable position; unprepared for something unexpected.

words.tr: phrase. 由于
words.ex: He was late on account of the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为公交车。
words.en: Because of something; due to something.

words.tr: phrase. 在极小的空间内；瞬间急转；突然停止
words.ex: The car stopped on a dime.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在极小的空间内停了下来。
words.en: If a vehicle stops on a dime, it stops very suddenly and in a very short distance.

words.tr: phrase. 供试用的；包退包换的（指商品可先试用，不满意可退货）
words.ex: We sent the goods on approval.
words.ex_cn: 我们寄送了试用的商品。
words.en: If goods are supplied on approval, they are supplied to a customer who can decide whether to buy them or return them.

words.tr: phrase. 平均
words.ex: On average, children sleep 10 hours a night.
words.ex_cn: 平均而言，儿童每天睡10个小时。
words.en: If you say that something is true on average, you mean that it is generally the case.

words.tr: phrase. 平均；一般地说
words.ex: On the average, they work 40 hours per week.
words.ex_cn: 平均而言，他们每周工作40小时。
words.en: When you say 'on the average', you are referring to the mean value or the typical case in a set of data or a group of people.

words.tr: phrase. 代表；作为代言人
words.ex: He spoke on behalf of his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他代表他的妹妹发言。
words.en: If you do something on behalf of someone, you do it as their representative or in their interest.

words.tr: phrase. 在船（车或飞机）上
words.ex: The captain asked the crew to get on board.
words.ex_cn: 船长让船员们上船。
words.en: On board means to be on a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle.

words.tr: phrase. 出差；业务方面
words.ex: He is traveling on business.
words.ex_cn: 他出差。
words.en: If someone is on business, they are away from their usual place of work because they are doing something connected with their job.

words.tr: phrase. 在校内
words.ex: He lives on campus near the library.
words.ex_cn: 他住在校园里，靠近图书馆。
words.en: On campus refers to being within the area of land that a college or university occupies, including its buildings and grounds.

words.tr: phrase. 接受的条件是…
words.ex: He agreed to go on condition that he could bring his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他同意去，条件是他可以带他的狗。
words.en: Only if a particular requirement is met.

words.tr: phrase. 以…为条件；若是…
words.ex: You can go out on condition that you come home before 10 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 你可以出去，条件是你必须在晚上10点前回家。
words.en: used to say that one thing will happen only if another thing happens

words.tr: phrase. /adj. 一经要求；按需；即需即供的；随时可得的
words.ex: The service is available on demand.
words.ex_cn: 该服务可根据需求随时提供。
words.en: If something is available on demand, it is available when you ask for it, rather than at a fixed time.

words.tr: phrase. 连续地；不断地；竖着地；直立着
words.ex: He watched TV on end.
words.ex_cn: 他连续看电视。
words.en: If something happens for hours, days, weeks, or years on end, it happens continuously and without stopping for that amount of time.

words.tr: phrase. 以…为理由；基于…的原因
words.ex: He was denied entry on grounds of safety.
words.ex_cn: 他以安全为由被拒绝进入。
words.en: for the reason of; because of

words.tr: phrase. 以……为理由；基于……的原因；根据
words.ex: He was expelled from school on the grounds of misconduct.
words.ex_cn: 他因行为不端被学校开除。
words.en: Because of a particular reason or reasons.

words.tr: phrase. 借调的；租借的；暂借的
words.ex: The book is on loan from the library.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是从图书馆借来的。
words.en: If something is on loan, it has been lent to someone and has not yet been returned.

words.tr: phrase. 有时；间或
words.ex: He visits his grandparents on occasion.
words.ex_cn: 他偶尔去看望祖父母。
words.en: Sometimes but not often.

words.tr: phrase. 偶尔；有时；间或
words.ex: On occasions, I walk to work instead of driving.
words.ex_cn: 偶尔，我会走路去上班而不是开车。
words.en: At times; now and then.

words.tr: phrase. 为...的利益；代表
words.ex: He spoke at the meeting on my behalf.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上代表我发言。
words.en: If you do something on someone's behalf, you do it for that person as their representative.

words.tr: phrase. 独自地；独立地
words.ex: He solved the problem on his own.
words.ex_cn: 他自己解决了这个问题。
words.en: If you do something on your own, you do it without any help from other people.

words.tr: phrase. 准点；按时
words.ex: The train arrived on schedule.
words.ex_cn: 火车准时到达。
words.en: If something happens on schedule, it happens at the time that was planned.

words.tr: phrase. 与此相反；正相反
words.ex: He says he likes quiet, on the contrary, he always listens to loud music.
words.ex_cn: 他说他喜欢安静，相反，他总是听大声的音乐。
words.en: You use 'on the contrary' when you are contradicting what has just been said or implied, or making a contrast between two things.

words.tr: phrase. 尚未决定的；保持中立的；骑墙的
words.ex: She's been on the fence about whether to take the job or not.
words.ex_cn: 她一直在犹豫是否接受这份工作。
words.en: If you are on the fence, you are unable to decide about something.

words.tr: phrase. 在整点；每小时整点时刻
words.ex: The buses run on the hour.
words.ex_cn: 公交车在整点发车。
words.en: used to say that something happens at exactly one o'clock, two o'clock, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 悄悄; 秘密地; 暗地
words.ex: He did it on the quiet, without anyone knowing.
words.ex_cn: 他悄悄地做了这件事，没有人知道。
words.en: If you do something on the quiet, you do it secretly or without other people knowing about it.

words.tr: phrase. 在架子上；搁置的；被弃置的；无人过问的（尤指因过时或不再流行）
words.ex: She's been on the shelf since her last relationship ended.
words.ex_cn: 自从上次恋情结束后，她就一直单身。
words.en: If something is on the shelf, it is not being used or is not available for use at the present time.

words.tr: phrase. 当场；在现场
words.ex: He answered the question on the spot.
words.ex_cn: 他当场回答了问题。
words.en: If you do something on the spot, you do it immediately without any delay.

words.w: on the spur of the moment
words.tr: phrase. 一时冲动之下；心血来潮；当场立即
words.uk: ɒn ðə spɜː(r) əv ðə ˈməʊmənt
words.us: ɑːn ðə spɜːr əv ðə ˈmoʊmənt
words.ex: She decided to travel on the spur of the moment.
words.ex_cn: 她一时冲动决定去旅行。
words.en: If you do something on the spur of the moment, you do it suddenly, without planning it beforehand.

words.tr: phrase. 处于危险境地；如履薄冰；处境岌岌可危
words.ex: After missing three deadlines, he's on thin ice with his boss.
words.ex_cn: 错过了三个截止日期后，他与老板的关系岌岌可危。
words.en: In a precarious or risky situation.

words.tr: phrase. 只有…才；除非
words.ex: You can enter the room only if you have a pass.
words.ex_cn: 只有当你有通行证时，你才能进入房间。
words.en: Used to say that something will happen or be true just in one particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 畅所欲言；打开；开放
words.ex: Please open up and tell me how you really feel.
words.ex_cn: 请畅所欲言，告诉我你真正的感受。
words.en: To make something available or accessible; to start or begin something.

words.tr: phrase. 否则
words.ex: Hurry up, or else you'll miss the bus.
words.ex_cn: 快点，否则你会错过公交车。
words.en: Used to introduce the alternative that is likely or certain to happen if something does not happen or is not done.

words.tr: phrase. 大约
words.ex: He is ten years old, or so.
words.ex_cn: 他十岁左右。
words.en: Approximately; used to indicate an estimate or rough quantity.

words.tr: phrase. 或诸如此类的东西；或类似的；表示不确定或列举未尽
words.ex: He bought a book, or something, to learn math.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一本书，或者类似的东西，来学习数学。
words.en: used when you are not very sure about what you have just said

words.tr: phrase. 起源；由…引起
words.ex: This tradition originates from ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统起源于古代。
words.en: To come from a particular place or start in a particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 除了…以外；不包括；绝不是
words.ex: He eats vegetables other than potatoes.
words.ex_cn: 他吃蔬菜，但不吃土豆。
words.en: You use 'other than' after a negative statement to say that the person, item, or thing that follows is the only exception to the statement.

words.tr: phrase. /adv. 脱臼的；脱节的；紊乱的；失常的；不协调的
words.ex: His shoulder was out of joint after the fall.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒后肩膀脱臼了。
words.en: If something is out of joint, it is not working or happening as it should.

words.tr: phrase. 步调不一致的；不合拍的；落伍的；与…不一致
words.ex: He felt out of step with the rest of the group.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得自己与小组的其他成员步调不一致。
words.en: Not in agreement or harmony with others.

words.tr: phrase. 不时髦的；过时的
words.ex: This kind of clothing is out of style now.
words.ex_cn: 这种衣服现在过时了。
words.en: No longer in fashion or popular.

words.tr: phrase. 出乎意料地；突然地；晴天霹雳般地
words.ex: She called me out of the blue yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 她昨天突然给我打了电话。
words.en: If something happens out of the blue, it happens unexpectedly.

words.tr: phrase. 在偏僻处；不碍事；罕见
words.ex: The old shed is out of the way, behind the hill.
words.ex_cn: 那个旧棚子在山后面，很偏僻。
words.en: If something is out of the way, it is not blocking a path or is in a remote or isolated location.

words.tr: phrase. /adv. 走调的；不协调的；不一致的
words.ex: She sang out of tune during the choir practice.
words.ex_cn: 她在合唱练习中唱走了调。
words.en: If a musical instrument is out of tune, it means that it does not produce the correct pitch or sound, making it discordant or not harmonious with other instruments or voices.

words.tr: phrase. 归因于；归功于；由于
words.ex: He owes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把成功归功于努力工作。
words.en: If you owe something to someone or something, it is because of them that you have it or experience it.

words.tr: phrase. 由于；因...之缘故
words.ex: He was late owing to the bus delay.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为公交车晚点了。
words.en: You use owing to when you are introducing the reason for something.

words.tr: phrase. v. 停止；放弃；吸引大量观众；塞进；挤满
words.ex: She decided to pack in her job and travel the world.
words.ex_cn: 她决定辞掉工作去环游世界。
words.en: If you pack in a job or activity, you stop doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 把…打发走；匆匆送走；遣送
words.ex: She decided to pack off the children to their grandparents for the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 她决定周末把孩子们送到祖父母那里去。
words.en: To send someone away, typically in a quick or abrupt manner.

words.tr: phrase. 打包； 收拾；停止工作； 出故障
words.ex: He will pack up his clothes tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会收拾好他的衣服。
words.en: To put things into cases or boxes so that they can be transported or stored; to stop working or operating.

words.tr: phrase. 配对；使成双；使成对；把…分成一对对
words.ex: The students were asked to pair off for the group activity.
words.ex_cn: 学生们被要求结成一对参加小组活动。
words.en: To form pairs or to match one person or thing with another.

words.tr: phrase. 把…分成若干部分；分配；分发
words.ex: They parcel out the land to farmers every year.
words.ex_cn: 他们每年把土地分给农民。
words.en: To divide something into parts and give those parts to different people.

words.tr: phrase. 参与；参加
words.ex: He wants to participate in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他想参加学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To take part in an activity or event.

words.tr: phrase. 冒充；把…冒充为；顺利举行；逐渐消失
words.ex: He tried to pass off as a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他试图冒充医生。
words.en: To happen or occur; to represent something falsely; to gradually disappear.

words.tr: phrase. 修补；弥合（关系）；草草修理；包扎（伤口）
words.ex: They managed to patch up their differences and work together.
words.ex_cn: 他们设法解决了分歧，一起工作。
words.en: To mend or repair something; to resolve a disagreement or dispute.

words.tr: phrase. 还清；得到回报；取得成功
words.ex: He worked hard and finally paid off his debt.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，终于还清了债务。
words.en: If something you have done pays off, it is successful or brings a good result.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持；固执于
words.ex: He will persist in trying to learn English every day.
words.ex_cn: 他会坚持每天努力学习英语。
words.en: To continue to do something despite difficulties or opposition, in a way that can seem unreasonable.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持某事；固执地继续做某事
words.ex: Despite the difficulties, she persisted in her efforts to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 尽管困难重重，她仍然坚持学习英语。
words.en: To continue firmly or obstinately in an opinion or a course of action in spite of difficulty, opposition, or failure.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持做某事；执意继续做某事
words.ex: He persists in exercising every morning to keep fit.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持每天早上锻炼以保持健康。
words.en: To continue firmly or obstinately in an opinion or a course of action in spite of difficulty, opposition, or failure.

words.tr: phrase. 挑出；辨别出
words.ex: He can pick out his toy from the box.
words.ex_cn: 他能从盒子里挑出他的玩具。
words.en: To choose someone or something from a group.

words.tr: phrase. 捡起；获得；接人；恢复精神；偶然学到；加速；逮住
words.ex: He picked up the pen from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起了钢笔。
words.en: If you pick something up, you lift it up from a surface. If you pick someone up, you go to the place where they are and take them away, often in a car. If you pick up a skill or an idea, you acquire it without formal teaching or training. If something picks up, it improves or increases after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.tr: phrase. 投入；协力
words.ex: Everyone can pitch in to help clean the park.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都可以帮忙打扫公园。
words.en: If people pitch in, they join in and help with an activity.

words.tr: phrase. 插上插头
words.ex: Please plug in the charger.
words.ex_cn: 请把充电器插上。
words.en: To connect an electrical device to a power supply by inserting a plug into a socket.

words.tr: phrase. 指出
words.ex: He will point out the mistake in the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他将指出这道数学题中的错误。
words.en: To direct someone's attention to a particular fact or detail.

words.tr: phrase. 迅速吃完；快速完成；击败；干掉
words.ex: He can polish off a whole pizza in one meal.
words.ex_cn: 他一顿饭就能吃完一整块披萨。
words.en: To finish something quickly and easily, especially food or work.

words.tr: phrase. 把…分成若干份；分配；分发
words.ex: He portions out the food so everyone gets the same amount.
words.ex_cn: 他把食物分好，让每个人得到相同的量。
words.en: To distribute or allocate something in portions or shares.

words.tr: phrase. 倒出；倾泻；倾诉；涌出
words.ex: He poured out the water from the bottle.
