words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子里的水倒了出来。
words.en: To pour out means to cause a liquid or other substance to flow out of a container, or to express your feelings or thoughts freely.

words.tr: phrase. 说服；劝说；敦促
words.ex: He tried to prevail on his friend to help with the project.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服他的朋友帮忙做这个项目。
words.en: To persuade someone to do something, especially after repeated attempts.

words.tr: phrase. 说服；劝说；促使（某人做某事）
words.ex: She managed to prevail upon him to attend the party.
words.ex_cn: 她成功地说服了他参加聚会。
words.en: to persuade someone to do something, especially after trying very hard

words.tr: phrase. 战胜；压倒；胜过；占上风
words.ex: Justice will eventually prevail over evil.
words.ex_cn: 正义终将战胜邪恶。
words.en: To be greater in strength or influence; to triumph.

words.tr: v. 防止；阻止；预防；
words.ex: Wearing a helmet can prevent head injuries.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔可以防止头部受伤。
words.en: To prevent something means to stop it from happening or to stop someone from doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 在…之前；先于
words.ex: Previous to the meeting, I had a brief conversation with the manager.
words.ex_cn: 在会议之前，我和经理进行了一次简短的谈话。
words.en: If something is previous to a particular time or event, it happened or existed before that time or event.

words.tr: phrase. 在…之前；先于
words.ex: He left home prior to sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 他在日出前离开了家。
words.en: Before a particular time or event.

words.tr: phrase. 得益于；得到好处
words.ex: They profit by selling handmade crafts online.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过在网上出售手工工艺品获利。
words.en: To gain an advantage or benefit from something.

words.tr: phrase. 得益于；得到好处
words.ex: Many people profit from selling things online.
words.ex_cn: 许多人通过在网上卖东西获利。
words.en: To gain an advantage or benefit from something.

words.tr: phrase. 为…提供生活所需；供养；为…做准备；考虑到
words.ex: He works hard to provide for his family.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作来养家。
words.en: To supply what is needed for someone or something; to make preparations for something; to support or sustain someone financially.

words.tr: phrase. 拆开；撕碎；使分离；严厉批评
words.ex: The children were excited to pull apart the new toy to see how it worked.
words.ex_cn: v. 孩子们兴奋地拆开新玩具，想看看它是如何工作的。
words.en: To separate something into pieces by pulling; to analyze something in detail.

words.tr: phrase. 拔出；驶离路边；退出
words.ex: He pulled out a coin from his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他从口袋里掏出了一枚硬币。
words.en: To remove something or someone from a place or situation.

words.tr: phrase. （把车）靠边停下；靠边停车
words.ex: The police told him to pull over.
words.ex_cn: 警察让他靠边停车。
words.en: To move a vehicle to the side of the road and stop, especially when instructed by the police.

words.tr: phrase. 渡过难关；恢复健康；使脱离险境
words.ex: With the support of his family, he managed to pull through the difficult times.
words.ex_cn: 在家人的支持下，他成功渡过了难关。
words.en: To survive a difficult or dangerous situation; to recover from an illness.

words.tr: phrase. （使）齐心协力
words.ex: They pull together to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他们齐心协力按时完成项目。
words.en: To work together as a team or group in order to achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 拔起；停下；提高
words.ex: He pulled up the weed from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他把杂草从花园里拔了出来。
words.en: To pull up means to bring something to a higher position or to stop moving.

words.tr: phrase. 把…推入；迫使进入；促使做某事；逼迫某人做某事
words.ex: He push into the room without knocking.
words.ex_cn: 他没敲门就闯进房间。
words.en: To force something or someone into a particular place or position.

words.tr: phrase. 把…放在一边；搁置；储蓄；忽视；抛开
words.ex: He put his phone aside to focus on homework.
words.ex_cn: 他把手机放到一边，专心做作业。
words.en: To temporarily stop thinking about or dealing with something.

words.tr: phrase. 收起来；杀死；关进监狱；放弃
words.ex: He put away his toys after playing.
words.ex_cn: 他玩完后把玩具收起来了。
words.en: To put something away means to place it in its proper storage location, to save or store it, to consume it, or to confine someone in prison.

words.tr: phrase. 实施；使生效；付诸实行
words.ex: The new rules will be put into effect next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 新规则将于下周一实施。
words.en: To cause something to start to apply or operate.

words.tr: phrase. 延期；推迟
words.ex: He put off his homework until tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他把作业推迟到明天。
words.en: To delay something or to cause someone to feel dislike or lack of interest.

words.tr: phrase. 扑灭；熄掉；伸出；发表；恼怒
words.ex: He put out the fire with a blanket.
words.ex_cn: 他用毯子扑灭了火。
words.en: To extinguish a fire or light; to publish or produce something; to extend or stretch out something.

words.tr: phrase. 使经受；接通（电话）
words.ex: He was put through a tough training program.
words.ex_cn: 他经受了一项严格的训练计划。
words.en: To cause someone to experience something, especially something difficult or unpleasant, or to connect a telephone call.

words.tr: phrase. 处死；处决；施以死刑
words.ex: The criminal was put to death for his heinous crimes.
words.ex_cn: 那个罪犯因他的滔天罪行被处死。
words.en: To kill someone as a punishment or as a result of a legal decision.

words.tr: phrase. 举起；张贴；建造；进行；提供；推举；提供食宿
words.ex: He put up his hand to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他举起了手来提问。
words.en: To provide someone with a place to stay temporarily; to build or erect something; to raise or lift something; to propose or suggest something; to display or post something; to increase the price of something.

words.tr: phrase. 忍受；容忍
words.ex: I can't put up with his loud noise every night.
words.ex_cn: 我无法忍受他每晚的噪音。
words.en: To tolerate or endure something unpleasant or annoying.

words.tr: phrase. 琢磨出；推敲出；通过思考解决（难题、谜题等）
words.ex: It took us hours to puzzle out the meaning of the cryptic message.
words.ex_cn: 我们花了几个小时才推测出这个神秘信息的意思。
words.en: To solve or understand something complicated or puzzling.

words.tr: phrase. 相当多的；大量的
words.ex: There are quite a number of books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有相当多的书。
words.en: A considerable quantity or amount of something.

words.tr: phrase. 猛烈指责；痛骂；怒斥
words.ex: He often rails at the bad weather.
words.ex_cn: 他经常抱怨糟糕的天气。
words.en: To complain bitterly or vehemently about someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 猛烈抨击；强烈反对；愤怒谴责
words.ex: He rails against the rules at school.
words.ex_cn: 他强烈反对学校的规章制度。
words.en: To rail against something means to complain or protest very strongly about it.

words.tr: phrase. 漫游；涉及；覆盖；在…范围内变动
words.ex: The discussion will range over many topics, like weather and food.
words.ex_cn: 讨论将涉及许多话题，比如天气和食物。
words.en: To range over something means to cover or include a variety of different things or areas.

words.tr: phrase. 宁可 ... 也不愿；与其 ... 倒不如；而不是
words.ex: He chose to walk rather than take the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他宁愿走路也不愿坐公交车。
words.en: used to say that one thing is preferred to another or happens instead of another

words.tr: phrase. 反抗
words.ex: Teenagers often react against rules set by parents.
words.ex_cn: 青少年经常反抗父母设定的规矩。
words.en: To act in opposition to a force, influence, or movement.

words.tr: phrase. 对…作出反应；作用于…
words.ex: He reacts on every comment he sees.
words.ex_cn: 他对每一个看到的评论都做出反应。
words.en: To respond to a stimulus or event.

words.tr: phrase. 对…产生反应；对…起作用；反作用于
words.ex: The news reacts upon his mood.
words.ex_cn: 这则新闻影响了他的情绪。
words.en: To have an effect or influence on someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 对…的反抗；对…的反对反应；抵制
words.ex: There was a strong reaction against the new rule.
words.ex_cn: 人们对新规定产生了强烈的反对。
words.en: A response or resistance to something, often a change or a policy, that is seen as negative or undesirable.

words.tr: phrase. 指望；依赖；期望
words.ex: I reckon on your help to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 我指望你的帮助来完成这个项目。
words.en: If you reckon on something, you expect it to happen and include it in your plans.

words.tr: phrase. 考虑；处理；正视；对付
words.ex: We need to reckon with the possibility of delays.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要考虑到可能的延迟。
words.en: To consider or deal with something or someone as an important factor in a situation.

words.tr: phrase. 查阅；提到；涉及；指的是
words.ex: Please refer to the dictionary for the meaning.
words.ex_cn: 请查阅字典以了解这个词的意思。
words.en: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them.

words.tr: phrase. 不管；不顾
words.ex: He went for a walk regardless of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去散步了。
words.en: Without taking into account; without being affected by.

words.tr: phrase. 依赖；依靠
words.ex: He relies on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠弟弟帮忙。
words.en: To depend on with full trust or confidence.

words.tr: phrase. 依赖；取决于
words.ex: He relies upon his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依赖他的兄弟帮忙。
words.en: To depend on with full trust or confidence.

words.tr: phrase. 评论；谈论；就…发表意见
words.ex: He did not remark on the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他没有对这个错误发表意见。
words.en: To make a comment or observation about something.

words.tr: phrase. 评论；谈论；就…发表意见
words.ex: He did not remark upon the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他没有提到那个错误。
words.en: To mention or comment on something.

words.tr: phrase. 提醒某人想起……；使某人回忆起……
words.ex: This photo reminds me of our trip to Paris.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片让我想起了我们去巴黎的旅行。
words.en: To cause someone to remember someone or something.

words.tr: adj. 有抵抗力的；
words.ex: This plant is resistant to drought.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物对干旱有抵抗力。
words.en: If someone is resistant to something, they are opposed to it and want to prevent it.

words.tr: phrase. 分解为；归结为；使转化为
words.ex: We can resolve the force into two parts: up and sideways.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以把力分解成两个部分：向上和向侧面。
words.en: To resolve into means to break down or separate something into its constituent parts or elements, or to change something into a different form or state.

words.tr: phrase. 依靠，求助于；诉诸
words.ex: He had to resort to asking for help.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不求助于别人。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because other methods have failed.

words.tr: v. 回答；回应；
words.ex: He responded to the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: If you respond to something that is done or said, you react to it by doing or saying something yourself.

words.tr:
n. 结果；
v. 导致；
words.ex: The result of the test was good.
words.ex_cn: 这次测试的结果很好。
words.en: A consequence, outcome, or effect of an action or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 导致
words.ex: Too much sugar can result in health problems.
words.ex_cn: 过多的糖会导致健康问题。
words.en: If something results in a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人摆脱某物
words.ex: The doctor managed to rid him of his chronic pain.
words.ex_cn: 医生设法解除了他的慢性疼痛。
words.en: To free someone from something unwanted or unpleasant.

words.tr: phrase. 超越；克服；不受…影响；凌驾于…之上
words.ex: He rose above his fears and spoke in public.
words.ex_cn: 他克服了恐惧，当众发言。
words.en: To rise above something means to not allow yourself to be affected or limited by it, and to deal with it in a successful way.

words.tr: v. 抢劫；掠夺；
words.ex: The thieves robbed the bank last night.
words.ex_cn: 小偷昨晚抢劫了银行。
words.en: To rob someone or somewhere means to take money or property illegally from them, often using force.

words.tr: phrase. v. 说服（某人）参与；拉（某人）入伙；使卷入
words.ex: He roped in his friend to help with the project.
words.ex_cn: 他拉了他的朋友来帮忙做这个项目。
words.en: To persuade someone to participate in something, often something they might not initially want to do.

words.tr: phrase. 全天候地；昼夜不停地；24小时不间断地
words.ex: The hospital works round the clock to help patients.
words.ex_cn: 医院全天候工作以帮助病人。
words.en: If something is done round the clock, it is done all day and all night without stopping.

words.tr: phrase. 划去；排除
words.ex: He ruled out the wrong answer on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中划去了错误的答案。
words.en: To decide that something is not possible or not worth considering.

words.tr: phrase. 撞倒；耗尽；贬低；追捕到；浏览；削弱；逐渐恶化
words.ex: The car ran down a pedestrian at the crossing.
words.ex_cn: 那辆车在十字路口撞倒了一名行人。
words.en: To criticize someone or something in a way that makes them seem less good or important; to hit someone with a vehicle and injure or kill them; to reduce the size or effectiveness of something gradually; to find someone or something after searching.

words.tr: phrase. 跑进；撞上；偶遇；陷入；达到
words.ex: The dog ran into the house.
words.ex_cn: 狗跑进了房子。
words.en: To meet someone or find something by chance; to experience something unexpectedly; to collide with something.

words.tr: phrase. 用完；耗尽；跑出去；到期
words.ex: We run out of milk every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们每星期天都把牛奶喝光了。
words.en: If you run out of something, you have no more of it left.

words.tr: phrase. 碾过；溢出；匆匆浏览；超过（时间、数量等）
words.ex: The car ran over a small stone on the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车碾过了路上的一块小石头。
words.en: To hit someone or something with a vehicle and drive over them; to quickly look through or read something; to overflow.

words.tr: phrase. 跑着穿过；刺、戳；贯穿；匆匆处理；排练；划掉；挥霍
words.ex: The dog ran through the park quickly.
words.ex_cn: 狗迅速跑过了公园。
words.en: To go over or examine something quickly; to be present in every part of something; to rehearse a play, piece of music, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 按比例缩小；缩减规模
words.ex: He decided to scale down his business to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他决定缩减业务以节省开支。
words.en: To reduce the size, amount, or extent of something.

words.tr: phrase. 勉强维持；勉强通过；勉强过活
words.ex: He scrapes by on a small salary.
words.ex_cn: 他靠微薄的薪水勉强维持生活。
words.en: To manage to live or do something with difficulty, especially by using very little money.

words.tr: phrase. 勉强通过
words.ex: He worked hard and managed to scrape through the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，勉强通过了考试。
words.en: To manage to barely succeed in passing an examination or overcoming a difficulty.

words.tr: phrase. 勉强凑集；费力地收集（尤指金钱或资源）
words.ex: They managed to scrape together enough money for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们设法凑够了旅行的钱。
words.en: To gather or collect something, especially money or information, with difficulty.

words.tr: phrase. 勉强凑集；费力搜集（尤指金钱或资源）
words.ex: He scraped up enough money for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他凑够了吃午饭的钱。
words.en: To gather or collect something, especially with difficulty or effort.

words.tr: phrase. 搞砸：犯错误，导致事情失败或出现问题。
words.ex: He might screw up the presentation if he doesn't practice.
words.ex_cn: 如果他不练习，他可能会搞砸演讲。
words.en: To make a mistake or to fail at something.

words.tr: phrase. v. 处理；安排；照料（某事）
words.ex: I will see about the meeting time.
words.ex_cn: 我会去确认一下会议时间。
words.en: To attend to or deal with something.

words.tr: phrase. v. 送某人到门口；陪伴某人至结束；完成（某事）
words.ex: I will see you out after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 晚饭后我会送你到门口。
words.en: To continue with a task or project until it is completed, despite difficulties or the time it takes; to accompany someone to the door when they are leaving.

words.tr: phrase. 暴怒；勃然大怒（形容因愤怒而失去理智）
words.ex: He sees red when someone takes his things without asking.
words.ex_cn: 当有人未经允许拿他的东西时，他就会非常生气。
words.en: To become very angry suddenly.

words.tr: phrase. 一定注意到；务必使
words.ex: I see that you're trying to cheat again, and I won't let it happen.
words.ex_cn: 我注意到你又在试图作弊，我不会让它发生的。
words.en: To ensure or verify that something is the case.

words.tr: phrase. 务必确保；负责使…发生（或完成）
words.ex: See to it that the door is locked.
words.ex_cn: 确保门锁好了。
words.en: To make sure that something is done or happens.

words.tr: phrase. 负责；注意；照料
words.ex: I will see to the children while you are away.
words.ex_cn: 你不在的时候，我会照看孩子们。
words.en: To attend to or take care of something.

words.tr: phrase. 抓住（机会等）；利用；突然注意到并加以利用
words.ex: He seized on the chance to speak.
words.ex_cn: 他抓住了发言的机会。
words.en: To take advantage of an opportunity or situation with enthusiasm.

words.tr: phrase. 抓住（机会等）；突然利用；敏锐地注意到并加以利用
words.ex: He always seizes upon small mistakes to criticize others.
words.ex_cn: 他总是抓住小错误来批评别人。
words.en: To take advantage of something eagerly and decisively.

words.tr: phrase. 廉价卖清
words.ex: The company had to sell off all its old inventory at low prices.
words.ex_cn: 公司不得不廉价卖清所有旧库存。
words.en: To sell something, especially quickly and at a low price, in order to get rid of it or to make money quickly.

words.tr: phrase. 卖完；背叛；出卖
words.ex: The concert tickets sold out in one hour.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会的票在一小时内就卖光了。
words.en: To sell all of the available items or tickets for an event, so that there are no more left for people to buy.

words.tr: phrase. 出售全部财产或业务；变卖家产
words.ex: They decided to sell up and move to the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定卖掉一切，搬到乡下。
words.en: To sell all of one's possessions, especially one's home or business, often in order to move or retire.

words.tr: phrase. 派遣离开；打发走；寄出
words.ex: He sent away the noisy guests.
words.ex_cn: 他把那些吵闹的客人送走了。
words.en: To cause something to go or be taken to a place, especially by post or by a messenger.

words.tr: phrase. 派人去叫；派人去请；派人去取
words.ex: He will send for a doctor tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会请医生过来。
words.en: To ask or order that someone or something be brought to you, especially by sending a message.

words.tr: phrase. 派遣；提交；呈送（如文件、申请等）
words.ex: The army will send in troops to help.
words.ex_cn: 军队将派遣部队去帮忙。
words.en: To submit or deliver something, typically a document or application, to a particular place or person.

words.tr: phrase. 树立一个好榜样；以身作则
words.ex: He sets a good example by arriving on time every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天准时到达，树立了良好的榜样。
words.en: To behave in a way that others should copy.

words.tr: phrase. 开始；着手
words.ex: He set about cleaning the room after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完早餐后开始打扫房间。
words.en: To start doing something, especially something that needs a lot of effort or time.

words.tr: phrase. 区分；留出；使与众不同
words.ex: His kindness sets him apart from others.
words.ex_cn: 他的善良使他与众不同。
words.en: To distinguish someone or something as different from others; to reserve or allocate something for a specific purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 放置一旁；留出；不理会；取消
words.ex: He sets aside $50 each week for savings.
words.ex_cn: 他每周存下50美元作为储蓄。
words.en: To reserve or keep something for a particular purpose or person.

words.tr: phrase. 阻碍；延缓；使受挫折；回拨（钟表）
words.ex: The storm set back the construction by two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴把施工推迟了两周。
words.en: To delay or hinder the progress of something.

words.tr: phrase. 制定；（使）放下；（叫…）下车；记下
words.ex: The government set down new rules for safety.
words.ex_cn: 政府制定了新的安全规则。
words.en: To place something on a surface or to write or record something officially.

words.tr: phrase. 释放；使获得自由
words.ex: They set free the bird from the cage.
words.ex_cn: 他们把鸟从笼子里放了。
words.en: To release someone or something from confinement or restraint.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；踏入（某地）
words.ex: He has never set foot in that building.
words.ex_cn: 他从未踏入过那栋大楼。
words.en: To enter or go into a place.

words.tr: phrase. 开始；到来；嵌入
words.ex: The rain set in after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 午饭后雨开始下了。
words.en: If something sets in, especially something unpleasant, it begins and seems likely to continue or develop.

words.tr: 短语动词。一心想要；决心要得到（某物或达成某事）
words.ex: He has set his heart on becoming a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他一心想要成为一名医生。
words.en: To have a strong desire or determination to achieve or obtain something.

words.tr: phrase. 动身； 出发；着手；陈述
words.ex: They set out early to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他们早早出发去赶公交车。
words.en: To begin a journey or to start doing something with a particular aim.

words.tr: phrase. 设定步调；带头引领节奏
words.ex: He runs fast to set the pace for the team.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，为团队设定节奏。
words.en: To establish a speed or standard that others follow.

words.tr: phrase. 定居；平静下来；专心于
words.ex: He wants to settle down with a family.
words.ex_cn: 他想安定下来组建家庭。
words.en: To settle down means to start living in a place where you intend to stay for a long time, usually after moving around a lot.

words.tr: phrase. v. 勉强接受；将就
words.ex: He didn't win the game, but he was happy to settle for second place.
words.ex_cn: 他没有赢得比赛，但对获得第二名感到满意。
words.en: To accept something that is less than what you originally wanted or hoped for.

words.tr: phrase. 安顿下来；适应新环境（如新家、新工作或新国家）
words.ex: They settled in a small town after moving.
words.ex_cn: 搬家后，他们在一个小镇安顿下来。
words.en: To begin to feel comfortable in a new place or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 适应（新环境、新状况）；安顿下来；习惯于
words.ex: He quickly settle into his new job.
words.ex_cn: 他很快适应了他的新工作。
words.en: If you settle into a new situation or settle in, you become used to it or feel comfortable with it.

words.tr: phrase. 选择；选定
words.ex: We need to settle on a date for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要选定一个旅行的日期。
words.en: To decide on something after considering it carefully.

words.tr: phrase. 决定；选定；达成一致（尤指经过讨论或思考后）
words.ex: They settle upon a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定选在公园附近的一所小房子。
words.en: To decide on or choose something after considering it carefully.

words.tr: phrase. 结清（账目）；付清欠款
words.ex: They settled up after the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对后他们结清了账。
words.en: To settle up means to pay what is owed, especially to pay a bill or debt.

words.tr: phrase. 缝合；包办；确保成功
words.ex: He will sew up the torn shirt tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会缝好这件破了的衬衫。
words.en: To sew up means to mend or close by sewing, or to ensure the success of something.

words.tr: phrase. 用阴影填充；在轮廓内涂上阴影
words.ex: Please shade in the circle next to the correct answer.
words.ex_cn: 请把正确答案旁边的圆圈涂上阴影。
words.en: To shade in means to add shading to a drawing or picture to give it depth or to make it look more realistic.

words.tr: phrase. 渐渐变为
words.ex: The blue sky begins to shade into purple as the sun sets.
words.ex_cn: 太阳落山时，蓝色的天空开始渐渐变成紫色。
words.en: If something shades into something else, it gradually becomes that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 彻底搜查；敲诈勒索；使适应新环境；（尤指临时）安顿下来
words.ex: The police shook down the house to find the stolen money.
words.ex_cn: 警察彻底搜查了这所房子，寻找被盗的钱。
words.en: To search a place thoroughly; to adapt to a new environment; to extort money from someone by threats.

words.tr: phrase. 抖落；摆脱
words.ex: He managed to shake off his pursuers in the crowded market.
words.ex_cn: v. 他在拥挤的市场里成功摆脱了追捕者。
words.en: To get rid of something or someone that is bothering you or that you do not want.

words.tr: phrase. 阐明某事；使某事更清楚易懂
words.ex: The new data sheds light on the cause of the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这些新数据揭示了问题的原因。
words.en: To make something less confusing and easier to understand by explaining it or providing new information.

words.tr: phrase. 炫耀；卖弄
words.ex: He likes to show off his new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢炫耀他的新自行车。
words.en: If someone shows off, they behave in a way that is intended to attract attention and impress people, often by displaying their abilities or possessions.

words.tr: phrase. 被困在室内；被禁闭
words.ex: He was shut in the house by the snowstorm.
words.ex_cn: 他被暴风雪困在了房子里。
words.en: To confine or enclose someone or something within a space, often implying a sense of restriction or limitation.

words.tr: phrase. 关掉；切断；使隔绝
words.ex: He shut off the lights before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前关掉了灯。
words.en: To stop the operation or flow of something by turning a switch, valve, or other control.

words.tr: phrase. 关在外面；遮住；障蔽；使不能得分
words.ex: The storm shut out the light from the windows.
words.ex_cn: 风暴把光挡在了窗外。
words.en: To prevent someone or something from entering a place or to exclude someone from participating in something.

words.tr: phrase. 关闭；住口；关严；监禁；封藏
words.ex: Shut up, please, I'm trying to sleep.
words.ex_cn: 闭嘴，求你了，我在睡觉。
words.en: If you tell someone to shut up, you are rudely telling them to stop talking.

words.tr: phrase. 并排；并肩；一起
words.ex: The two boys sat side by side on the bench.
words.ex_cn: 两个男孩并排坐在长凳上。
words.en: If two or more things are side by side, they are next to each other.

words.tr: phrase. 签到；登记
words.ex: He signs in to his account every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上登录他的账户。
words.en: To sign in means to record your arrival at a workplace, hotel, etc., by writing your name on a list or by entering your name and password into a computer.

words.tr: phrase. 签约受雇；签约雇佣；开始广播
words.ex: He signs on to the new job next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周正式加入新工作。
words.en: To agree to become an employee; to start broadcasting.

words.tr: phrase. 签约参加工作；签约雇用；报名
words.ex: He signed up for a job at the local factory.
words.ex_cn: 他签约参加了当地工厂的工作。
words.en: To agree to become involved in an organized activity or to join a group or organization.

words.tr: phrase. 挑选
words.ex: The teacher singled out one student for praise.
words.ex_cn: 老师挑出一名学生进行表扬。
words.en: To choose someone or something from a group for special attention or treatment.

words.tr: phrase. 被了解
words.ex: It took time for the news to sink in.
words.ex_cn: 这则消息花了点时间才让他明白。
words.en: If a fact or idea sinks in, you gradually start to believe it, understand it, or realize the effect it will have on you.

words.tr: phrase. 闲坐着；无所事事地坐着
words.ex: They sit around and talk every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚上都坐着聊天。
words.en: If you sit around or sit about, you spend time doing nothing useful or interesting.

words.tr: phrase. 坐下休息；袖手旁观；放松不动手
words.ex: He sits back and watches the game.
words.ex_cn: 他坐下来观看比赛。
words.en: To relax and not take an active part in something.

words.tr: phrase. 坐着不动直到结束；不参与（活动、比赛等）
words.ex: She decided to sit out the dance and just watch.
words.ex_cn: 她决定不参加舞蹈，只是观看。
words.en: To choose not to participate in an activity or event, often to rest or avoid something.

words.tr: phrase. 忍耐着坐到（会议、电影、演出等）结束
words.ex: I had to sit through a two-hour lecture on the history of paperclips.
words.ex_cn: 我不得不坚持听完一个关于回形针历史的两个小时的讲座。
words.en: To sit through something means to stay until the end of an event, performance, meeting, etc., especially if it is long or boring.

words.tr: phrase. 坐起来；熬夜；注意听（或看）
words.ex: The child sits up straight in his chair.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在椅子上坐得笔直。
words.en: To move into a sitting position after lying down or to stay awake and active, especially late at night.

words.tr: phrase. 估量；估计；打量
words.ex: He likes to size up the situation before making a decision.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在做决定前先评估一下情况。
words.en: To size up means to assess or evaluate something or someone, often in terms of their potential, ability, or size.

words.tr: phrase. 简要勾勒；草拟；粗略规划
words.ex: He sketches out his ideas before writing the story.
words.ex_cn: 他在写故事之前先把想法画出来。
words.en: To describe something in a general way, giving the main points but not the details.

words.tr: phrase. 睡过（某段时间或事件），指在某个时间段或事件发生时持续睡觉而未被惊醒
words.ex: He slept through the alarm.
words.ex_cn: 他睡过了闹钟。
words.en: To continue sleeping without being disturbed by noise or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 犯错；失策；疏忽
words.ex: He might slip up if he speaks too fast.
words.ex_cn: 如果他说话太快，可能会出错。
words.en: If you slip up, you make a small or unimportant mistake.

words.tr: phrase. 减速；（使）慢下来
words.ex: The car will slow down at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红灯处会减速。
words.en: To reduce one's speed or the speed of a vehicle or process.

words.tr: phrase. 减慢；放慢速度（尤指因障碍或困难）
words.ex: The car slowed up when it saw the red light.
words.ex_cn: 当车看到红灯时，它慢了下来。
words.en: To reduce speed or to cause something to reduce speed.

words.tr: phrase. 掩饰；缓和（矛盾或困难）；使（关系等）平顺
words.ex: He tried to smooth over the conflict between the two parties.
words.ex_cn: 他试图平息双方之间的冲突。
words.en: To make a problem or disagreement seem less serious or easier to deal with.

words.tr: phrase. 急躁地责骂；怒气冲冲地对…说话；猛咬；迅速抓住
words.ex: He might snap at you if you bother him while he is working.
words.ex_cn: 如果你在他工作时打扰他，他可能会对你发脾气。
words.en: To speak to someone in a sharp, angry way; to try to bite someone or something suddenly.

words.tr: phrase. v. 摆脱（尤指负面情绪或状态）；突然从…中清醒过来
words.ex: He needs to snap out of his sadness and move on.
words.ex_cn: 他需要从悲伤中振作起来，继续前进。
words.en: To quickly recover from a particular state or mood, especially a negative one.

words.tr: phrase. 抢购； 匆匆吃下； 抢先弄到手
words.ex: People snapped up the discounted shoes quickly.
words.ex_cn: 人们迅速抢购了打折的鞋子。
words.en: To buy something quickly and eagerly, often because it is cheap or in limited supply.

words.tr: phrase. 迄今为止
words.ex: So far, he has finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 到目前为止，他已经完成了作业。
words.en: Up to the present moment; until now.

words.tr: phrase. 吸收；吸取
words.ex: The sponge soaks up water quickly.
words.ex_cn: 海绵很快吸水。
words.en: To absorb or take in (a liquid, knowledge, or experience) fully.

words.tr: 短语. 有点儿；在某种程度上是
words.ex: He has something of a talent for singing.
words.ex_cn: 他有点唱歌的天赋。
words.en: To some degree; somewhat.

words.tr: phrase. 迟早
words.ex: Sooner or later, he will finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 迟早他会完成他的作业。
words.en: If you say that something will happen sooner or later, you mean that it will happen at some time in the future, even though it might take a long time.

words.tr: phrase. 试探；探询（某人的意见或态度）；逐字拼读
words.ex: He tried to sound out his friend about the party.
words.ex_cn: 他试图向朋友探探口风，关于那个派对。
words.en: to try to find out someone's opinions, feelings, or intentions, especially in an indirect way

words.tr: phrase. 引起；激发
words.ex: His words sparked off a big argument.
words.ex_cn: 他的话引起了一场激烈的争吵。
words.en: To cause something to start or happen, especially suddenly.

words.tr: phrase. 代表…说话；要求得到；订购
words.ex: He cannot speak for me.
words.ex_cn: 他不能代表我说话。
words.en: To speak on behalf of someone or something; to represent or defend someone or something in speech.

words.tr: phrase. 高度赞扬；对……评价很高
words.ex: They speak highly of the new teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他们对这位新老师评价很高。
words.en: To express a very favorable opinion of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 大声说；毫无顾虑地说出
words.ex: She decided to speak out about the unfair rule.
words.ex_cn: 她决定大声说出这个不公平的规定。
words.en: To express one's opinions openly and without fear, especially in a situation where it might be difficult or dangerous to do so.

words.tr: phrase. 大声讲；畅所欲言
words.ex: He didn't speak up when the teacher asked a question.
words.ex_cn: 老师问问题时，他没有开口。
words.en: to express one's opinions or feelings openly and without fear, especially in a situation where it might be difficult to do so

words.tr: phrase. 擅长于；专攻
words.ex: He specializes in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他专攻计算机科学。
words.en: To concentrate on and become expert in a particular subject or skill.

words.tr: phrase. 加速
words.ex: He pressed the button to speed up the video.
words.ex_cn: 他按了按钮来加快视频速度。
words.en: To increase the speed or rate of something.

words.tr: phrase. 清楚地说明
words.ex: Can you spell out your name?
words.ex_cn: 你能把你的名字拼出来吗？
words.en: To spell out means to explain something in a very clear way with details or to say or write the letters of a word in the correct order.

words.tr: phrase. 拖延；挥霍；（车辆）打滑失控；（赛车）冲出赛道
words.ex: He spun out his car on the icy road.
words.ex_cn: 他在结冰的路面上把车开失控了。
words.en: To make something last longer than necessary.

words.tr: phrase. 吐出；说出（尤指不情愿地）；迅速说出
words.ex: He had to spit out the bad apple.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不把那个坏苹果吐出来。
words.en: To expel something from the mouth, often because it is unpleasant or unwanted.

words.tr: phrase. 分手；分裂；解散；分摊
words.ex: They split up after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他们在争吵后分开了。
words.en: To end a relationship or partnership; to divide or separate into parts.

words.tr: phrase. 展开；摊开
words.ex: The children spread out on the grass to play.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在草地上铺开玩耍。
words.en: To extend over a large or increasing area.

words.tr: phrase. 代表；象征；支持；容忍
words.ex: The letter A stands for apple.
words.ex_cn: 字母A代表苹果。
words.en: If you say that a letter stands for a particular word, you mean that it is an abbreviation for that word.

words.tr: phrase. 代替；代理（某人）
words.ex: He will stand in for the teacher today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天代替老师上课。
words.en: To take the place of someone or something temporarily.

words.tr: phrase. 引人注目；突出；出色
words.ex: Her red hat makes her stand out in the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 她的红帽子让她在人群中很显眼。
words.en: To be very noticeable or obvious, especially in comparison to others.

words.tr: phrase. 支持；捍卫；为…挺身而出
words.ex: He will stand up for his friend when others are mean.
words.ex_cn: 当别人对他的朋友刻薄时，他会为朋友挺身而出。
words.en: To support or defend someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. v. 抵抗；勇敢面对；经得起（考验或压力）
words.ex: He stood up to the bully and helped his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他勇敢地对抗欺负人的孩子，帮助了他的朋友。
words.en: To confront someone or something in a brave or determined way.

words.tr: phrase. 出发；开始
words.ex: We start off early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我们早早出发以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey, activity, or process.

words.tr: phrase. v. 开始做（某事）；着手处理；对…发起攻击或责备
words.ex: He will start on his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后会开始做作业。
words.en: To begin to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 开始；出发；起初从事（某事）
words.ex: He starts out as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始是一名老师。
words.en: To begin a journey or a process.

words.tr: phrase. 原位不动
words.ex: Stay put until I come back.
words.ex_cn: 我回来之前原地待着。
words.en: To remain in one place and not move.

words.tr: phrase. （使）布满水汽；（使）起雾；（使）情绪激动
words.ex: The windows steam up when we take a hot shower.
words.ex_cn: 当我们洗热水澡时，窗户会起雾。
words.en: To become covered with steam, making it difficult to see through; or to cause something to become covered with steam.

words.tr: phrase. 避开；远离（某人或某事物）
words.ex: He tries to steer clear of trouble.
words.ex_cn: 他尽量避开麻烦。
words.en: If you steer clear of someone or something, you deliberately avoid them.

words.tr: phrase. 来自；起源于
words.ex: His love of music stems from his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他对音乐的热爱源于他的童年。
words.en: If a condition or problem stems from something, it was caused originally by that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 粘附；坚持；紧跟；忠于
words.ex: The glue will stick the paper to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水会把纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: If you stick to a promise, agreement, decision, or principle, you do what you said you would do, or do not change your mind.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持做；紧跟；紧随
words.ex: I will stick with this plan.
words.ex_cn: 我会坚持这个计划。
words.en: To continue to support or use something, even though it may be difficult or you may want to change to something else.

words.tr: phrase. 立即；马上
words.ex: He left straight away after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议结束后他立刻离开了。
words.en: If you do something straight away, you do it immediately and without delay.

words.tr: 立即，马上; 痛痛快快
words.ex: He left straight off after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议一结束他就直接离开了。
words.en: Immediately, without delay.

words.tr: phrase. 整理；解决；使恢复正常；矫正
words.ex: He tried to straighten out the tangled wires.
words.ex_cn: 他试图把缠在一起的电线弄直。
words.en: To make something straight or to resolve a problem or misunderstanding.

words.tr: phrase. 涌入；大量进入（某地）
words.ex: People stream into the stadium before the concert starts.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会在开始前，人们涌进体育场。
words.en: To flow or move continuously in a current or mass, especially into a place.

words.tr: phrase. 屈服于；服从于
words.ex: She decided to submit to the committee's decision.
words.ex_cn: 她决定服从委员会的决定。
words.en: To accept or yield to the authority or control of someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 代用品；代替物；
v. 替代；
words.ex: Honey is a good substitute for sugar.
words.ex_cn: 蜂蜜是糖的良好代用品。
words.en: A substitute is something or someone that takes the place or function of another.

words.tr:
n. 东西；原料；
v. 塞；填充；
words.ex: I need to clean up all this stuff.
words.ex_cn: 我需要清理这些东西。
words.en: If you stuff something somewhere, you push it there quickly and roughly. If you stuff a container or space with something, you fill it completely with that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 坚信；极为信赖；发誓效忠于
words.ex: I swear by this brand of toothpaste.
words.ex_cn: 我坚信这个品牌的牙膏。
words.en: If you swear by something, you believe that it is very effective and you always use it or recommend it to others.

words.tr: phrase. 使宣誓就职；主持宣誓仪式
words.ex: The judge will swear in the new witness tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 法官明天将让新证人宣誓。
words.en: To formally induct someone into a position or office by administering an oath.

words.tr: phrase. 关掉；不再想…；不考虑
words.ex: Please switch off the light before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 你离开前请关掉灯。
words.en: To turn off an electrical device by using a switch.

words.tr: phrase. 接通；开启
words.ex: He switches on the light when it gets dark.
words.ex_cn: 天黑时，他打开灯。
words.en: To turn on an electrical device by operating a switch.

words.tr: phrase. 冒险
words.ex: He decided to take a chance and apply for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他决定冒险申请这份工作。
words.en: To do something that involves risk or uncertainty, often with the hope of success.

words.tr: 看中; 看上; 对…喜欢起来; 结缘
words.ex: He takes a fancy to her because she is kind.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢上了她，因为她很善良。
words.en: To develop a liking or affection for someone or something, often suddenly.

words.tr: phrase. 表明立场；明确立场
words.ex: He decided to take a stand on the controversial issue.
words.ex_cn: 他决定在这个有争议的问题上表明立场。
words.en: To take a stand means to adopt a firm position on a particular issue, often in a public or formal manner.

words.tr: phrase. 考虑
words.ex: The teacher must take account of each student's speed.
words.ex_cn: 老师必须考虑每个学生的进度。
words.en: To consider or pay attention to something when making a decision or judgment.

words.tr: phrase. 利用；欺骗；占便宜
words.ex: He took advantage of the free tickets.
words.ex_cn: 他利用了免费的票。
words.en: To use a particular situation to do or get what you want.

words.tr: phrase. 与 ... 相像；效仿
words.ex: He takes after his father in looks.
words.ex_cn: 他在长相上像他父亲。
words.en: If you take after a member of your family, you resemble them in your appearance, your behaviour, or your character.

words.tr: phrase. 隐蔽；躲藏
words.ex: The children took cover when the storm started.
words.ex_cn: 风暴开始时，孩子们躲了起来。
words.en: To protect oneself from danger by hiding or sheltering.

words.tr: phrase. 生效；开始起作用
words.ex: The new rule will take effect next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 新规则将在下周一生效。
words.en: If something takes effect, it begins to produce results or to work.

words.tr: phrase. 对……表示反对；对……反感；对……提出异议
words.ex: He takes exception to people who are late.
words.ex_cn: 他看不惯迟到的人。
words.en: To object strongly to something; to be offended by something.

words.tr: phrase. 对...感兴趣
words.ex: He takes an interest in birds.
words.ex_cn: 他对鸟类感兴趣。
words.en: To become interested in something or someone.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对…感兴趣；对…有兴趣
words.ex: He has an interest in playing football.
words.ex_cn: 他对踢足球有兴趣。
words.en: If you have an interest in something, you want to learn or hear more about it.

words.tr: phrase. 对……感兴趣；对……有好奇心
words.ex: He feels an interest in science.
words.ex_cn: 他对科学感兴趣。
words.en: to have a feeling of interest in someone or something

words.tr: phrase. 对……不感兴趣；对……漠不关心
words.ex: He takes no interest in playing video games.
words.ex_cn: 他对玩电子游戏不感兴趣。
words.en: To have no interest or concern in something.

words.tr: phrase. 对……不感兴趣；对……毫无兴趣
words.ex: He has no interest in playing video games.
words.ex_cn: 他对玩电子游戏没有兴趣。
words.en: To not be interested in something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 对……毫无兴趣；不感兴趣于……
words.ex: He feels no interest in playing video games.
words.ex_cn: 他对玩电子游戏不感兴趣。
words.en: To have no interest in something means to not be interested in it at all.

words.tr: phrase. 把…列入考虑中
words.ex: We must take the weather into account when planning the picnic.
words.ex_cn: 计划野餐时，我们必须把天气考虑进去。
words.en: If you take something into account, you consider it when you are thinking about a situation or deciding what to do.

words.tr: phrase. 考虑到
words.ex: Please take into consideration the weather before we go out.
words.ex_cn: 在我们出去之前，请考虑一下天气。
words.en: To think about and include a particular thing or fact when you are forming an opinion or making a decision.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 向某人吐露秘密；信任某人并让其参与机密事务
words.ex: He took his best friend into his confidence about the surprise party.
words.ex_cn: 他向最好的朋友透露了惊喜派对的秘密。
words.en: To tell someone a secret or private matter.

words.tr: phrase. 放轻松；别紧张；悠着点
words.ex: Take it easy, the test is not hard.
words.ex_cn: 别紧张，考试不难。
words.en: To relax and not do anything too energetic or stressful.

words.tr: phrase. 呈现；承担；接受；较量；雇用
words.ex: The sky takes on a pink color at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时，天空呈现出粉红色。
words.en: To undertake or begin to deal with a task or responsibility; to hire someone; to acquire a particular appearance or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 激动得说不出话来；使某人大为惊讶
words.ex: The view from the mountain takes my breath away.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色让我惊叹不已。
words.en: If something takes your breath away, it is so beautiful, amazing, or surprising that you feel unable to breathe for a moment.

words.tr: phrase. 接管；接任；取代
words.ex: He will take over the business next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将接管这家企业。
words.en: To take control of something, especially a company, by buying a majority of its shares or by getting a position of power within it.

words.tr: phrase. 承担责任；接受责备
words.ex: He will take the blame for breaking the window.
words.ex_cn: 他将为打破窗户承担责任。
words.en: To accept responsibility for a fault or wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 把……放在心上；认真对待；因……而难过
words.ex: He takes criticism to heart and feels sad.
words.ex_cn: 他把批评放在心上，感到难过。
words.en: To take something to heart means to take something seriously or to be deeply affected by it.

words.tr: phrase. 拿起；开始从事；接受（提议）；占用
words.ex: He took up the book from the table.
words.ex_cn: 他从桌子上拿起了书。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something; to occupy or fill a particular amount of time or space; to accept an offer or challenge.

words.tr: phrase. 扯下；拆卸
words.ex: He tore down the poster from the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把海报从墙上扯了下来。
words.en: To tear down something means to destroy or remove it completely, especially a building or other structure.

words.tr: phrase. 撕碎；撕毁；使情绪激动（尤指哭泣）
words.ex: He tore up the letter in anger.
words.ex_cn: 他生气地把信撕碎了。
words.en: To destroy something, especially paper or cloth, by pulling it into pieces.

words.tr: phrase. 区分某物；辨别某物（尤指相似事物）
words.ex: I can't tell the twins apart.
words.ex_cn: 我分不出这对双胞胎。
words.en: To be able to see, hear, or recognize the difference between two or more things or people.

words.tr: phrase. 区分某人；分辨出某人（尤指外貌或特征相似者）
words.ex: I can't tell the twins apart.
words.ex_cn: 我分不出这对双胞胎。
words.en: To be able to see or understand the difference between two people or things.

words.tr: phrase. （正式）投标；竞标（某项工程或合同）
words.ex: He will tender for the building contract next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将竞标这个建筑合同。
words.en: If a company tenders for something, it makes a formal offer to do work or supply goods at a stated price.

words.tr: phrase. 幸亏；由于；因为
words.ex: Thanks to his help, I passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 多亏了他的帮助，我通过了考试。
words.en: used to say that something good has happened because of someone or something

words.tr: phrase. 回忆起；回想（某事或某时）
words.ex: I often think back to my childhood with great fondness.
words.ex_cn: 我经常怀着极大的喜爱回忆起我的童年。
words.en: To remember or recall something from the past.

words.tr: phrase. 改变主意；重新考虑后决定不做某事
words.ex: He thought better of leaving his job and stayed.
words.ex_cn: 他 reconsidered 辞职的事，决定留下来。
words.en: To reconsider a decision and decide not to do something; to change one's mind about doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细考虑；彻底思考；想透
words.ex: He thinks through the problem before answering.
words.ex_cn: 他在回答前仔细思考这个问题。
words.en: To consider something carefully and thoroughly in order to understand it fully or to make a decision.

words.tr: phrase. 扔掉；丢弃
words.ex: He threw away the old book.
words.ex_cn: 他扔掉了那本旧书。
words.en: To dispose of something that is no longer useful or wanted; to waste an opportunity or advantage.

words.tr: phrase. 阐明；使…清楚明白；提供线索或解释
words.ex: The new evidence throws light on the mystery.
words.ex_cn: 新证据揭示了这个谜团的真相。
words.en: To provide information or explanation that makes something easier to understand.

words.tr: phrase. 阐明；使…清楚明白；揭示
words.ex: The new evidence will throw light upon the mystery.
words.ex_cn: 新的证据将有助于解开这个谜团。
words.en: To provide information or explanation that makes something clearer or easier to understand.

words.tr: phrase. 阐明；使…清楚明白；提供线索或解释
words.ex: The new evidence will throw a light on the mystery.
words.ex_cn: 新证据将有助于解开这个谜团。
words.en: To provide information or insight that makes something clearer or easier to understand.

words.tr: phrase. 扔开；去掉；摆脱
words.ex: He threw off his coat and started working.
words.ex_cn: 他脱下外套，开始工作。
words.en: To get rid of something or someone that is bothering you or that you do not want.

words.tr: phrase. 呕吐；恶心；匆匆建造；产生；放弃
words.ex: He eats too fast and sometimes throws up.
words.ex_cn: 他吃得很快，有时会呕吐。
words.en: To vomit; to eject the contents of the stomach through the mouth.

words.tr: phrase. 匆匆翻阅；浏览（书页、文件等）
words.ex: He likes to thumb through magazines at the doctor's office.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在医生办公室翻阅杂志。
words.en: To look through a book, magazine, etc. quickly.

words.tr: phrase. 使极度劳累
words.ex: The long walk makes me tire out.
words.ex_cn: 长时间的步行让我筋疲力尽。
words.en: To make someone extremely tired.

words.tr: phrase. 在一定程度上
words.ex: To a certain extent, his absence was felt by the team.
words.ex_cn: 在某种程度上，他的缺席让团队感到了影响。
words.en: To some degree; partly.

words.tr: phrase. 首先；起初
words.ex: To begin with, we need to clean the room.
words.ex_cn: 首先，我们需要打扫房间。
words.en: As a first point or reason; initially.

words.tr: phrase. 到此为止；至今
words.ex: To date, no one has solved the problem.
words.ex_cn: 到此为止，还没有人解决这个问题。
words.en: Up to the present time.

words.tr: phrase. 到死；极其，非常（用于加强语气）
words.ex: She was bored to death during the long lecture.
words.ex_cn: 她在漫长的讲座中感到极度无聊。
words.en: To an extreme degree; excessively.

words.tr: phrase. 过度地；过分地
words.ex: He drinks to excess.
words.ex_cn: 他饮酒过度。
words.en: If you do something to excess, you do it too much.

words.tr: phrase. 作为开始；首先
words.ex: To start with, we need some water.
words.ex_cn: 首先，我们需要一些水。
words.en: You use 'to start with' when you are mentioning the first or most basic thing in a series of things, or when you are giving the first or most basic reason for something.

words.w: to the best of one's ability
words.tr: 短语. 尽某人最大能力；竭尽全力
words.uk: tə ðə best əv wʌnz əˈbɪləti
words.us: tu ðə best əv wʌnz əˈbɪləti
words.ex: He did the job to the best of his ability.
words.ex_cn: 他尽自己最大的能力完成了工作。
words.en: As well as one can; using all one's skills and resources.

words.tr: phrase. 相反
words.ex: He said it was easy, but to the contrary, it was very hard.
words.ex_cn: 他说这很容易，但恰恰相反，它非常难。
words.en: If you say 'to the contrary', you are indicating that the opposite of what has been said is true.

words.tr: phrase. 使更健壮；使肌肉更紧实；增强（身体或声音的）状态
words.ex: He runs every morning to tone up his legs.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步来紧实腿部肌肉。
words.en: To make your body or a part of your body stronger, firmer, or healthier, especially by doing physical exercise.

words.tr: phrase. 略微提及；涉及；谈到
words.ex: He touched on the topic of climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他简要提到了气候变化的话题。
words.en: To mention or deal with a subject briefly or casually.

words.tr: phrase. 略微提及；涉及；谈到
words.ex: The teacher will touch upon fractions in today's math class.
words.ex_cn: 老师将在今天的数学课上简单提到分数。
words.en: To mention or deal with a subject briefly or in passing.

words.tr: phrase. 追溯到；回溯至（某时间、地点或源头）
words.ex: The origins of this tradition trace back to the 12th century.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统的起源可以追溯到12世纪。
words.en: To find the origin or cause of something by examining the way it has developed or the events that have happened.

words.tr: phrase. 逐渐减弱
words.ex: He started to speak but then his voice trailed away.
words.ex_cn: 他开始说话，但随后声音逐渐变小，消失了。
words.en: To gradually become quieter or weaker and then disappear.

words.tr: phrase. 变小；减弱
words.ex: He started to speak, but then his voice trailed off.
words.ex_cn: 他开始说话，但后来声音逐渐变小了。
words.en: If someone's voice trails off, it gradually becomes quieter and then stops.

words.tr: phrase. 对…充耳不闻；故意不理睬
words.ex: He turned a deaf ear to his friend's warning.
words.ex_cn: 他无视了朋友的警告。
words.en: If someone turns a deaf ear to something, they ignore it or refuse to listen to it.

words.tr: phrase. 转身离开；拒绝进入；把脸转开
words.ex: The guard will turn away anyone without a ticket.
words.ex_cn: 没有票的人，警卫都会拒之门外。
words.en: If you turn someone away, you do not allow them to enter a place or join an organization, often because there is no room for them or because they are not suitable.

words.tr: phrase. 调低；关小；拒绝
words.ex: Please turn down the volume, it's too loud.
words.ex_cn: 请把音量调低，太大声了。
words.en: To refuse or reject an offer or request; to reduce the volume, temperature, or intensity of something.

words.tr: phrase. 背弃；拒绝帮助；不理睬
words.ex: He turned his back on his friend when he needed help.
words.ex_cn: 当他的朋友需要帮助时，他却背弃了他。
words.en: To refuse to help or support someone or something; to abandon or reject.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；生产；结果是；关闭；朝外
words.ex: The weather turned out to be sunny.
words.ex_cn: 天气结果是晴朗的。
words.en: If something turns out a particular way, it happens in that way or has the result or degree of success indicated. If you turn out something, you produce or create it. If you turn out a light, you switch it off.

words.tr: phrase. 翻转；移交；换台；营业额达到；反复考虑
words.ex: He turned over the pancake with a spatula.
words.ex_cn: 他用铲子把煎饼翻了个面。
words.en: To cause something to move so that a different side is facing upwards; to transfer or hand over something to someone else; to achieve a certain amount of business.

words.tr: phrase. 好转；渡过难关；转危为安（常用于描述病情、经济或局势等）
words.ex: After months of hard work, the business finally turned the corner.
words.ex_cn: 经过几个月的努力，这家企业终于有了起色。
words.en: To pass a critical point in a process or situation and begin to improve.

words.tr: phrase. 回到；返回到
words.ex: He will return to school next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将返回学校。
words.en: To go back to a previous state, place, or topic.

words.tr: phrase. 在任何情况下；无论如何
words.ex: You must not lie under any circumstances.
words.ex_cn: 在任何情况下你都不能撒谎。
words.en: In any possible situation; no matter what happens.

words.tr: phrase. 在任何情况下都不；决不
words.ex: Under no circumstances will I lie to you.
words.ex_cn: 我绝不会对你撒谎。
words.en: In no situation or for no reason.

words.tr: phrase. 多达；直到；在于…；能胜任
words.ex: The box can hold up to ten books.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子最多能放十本书。
words.en: used to say that something is the responsibility of someone or that someone has the ability to decide something

words.tr: phrase. 不同
words.ex: Prices vary from one store to another.
words.ex_cn: 价格因商店而异。
words.en: To be different from something else in some way.

words.tr: phrase. 服侍；招待；焦急地等待
words.ex: The waitress waits on customers at dinner.
words.ex_cn: 女服务员在晚餐时服侍顾客。
words.en: To serve food and drink, especially to customers in a restaurant or at a table; to wait for something to happen or for someone to arrive.

words.tr: phrase. 用坏；穿破；（使）筋疲力尽；耗尽
words.ex: He wore out his shoes after running every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天跑步，把鞋子磨坏了。
words.en: To wear out means to make something old and damaged because it has been used a lot, or to make someone extremely tired.

words.tr: phrase. 压低；使沉重；使疲惫不堪
words.ex: The heavy bag will weigh you down.
words.ex_cn: 这个重袋子会让你行动不便。
words.en: To cause someone to feel worried or burdened.

words.tr: phrase. 要是……怎么办；倘若……会怎样
words.ex: What if it rains tomorrow?
words.ex_cn: 如果明天下雨怎么办？
words.en: You use what if at the beginning of a question when you ask about the consequences of something happening, especially something undesirable.

words.tr: phrase. 给（钟表等）上发条；使紧张；结束；最终导致
words.ex: He will wind up the clock every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都会给钟上发条。
words.en: To bring something to an end; to coil or twist something; to make someone nervous or excited.

words.tr: phrase. 关于；至于；就……而言
words.ex: He spoke with regard to the new rules.
words.ex_cn: 他谈到了新规定。
words.en: Used to introduce the subject that one is going to talk or write about.

words.tr: phrase. 关于
words.ex: He spoke in regard to the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 他谈到了新的校规。
words.en: Concerning or about something.

words.tr: phrase. 考虑到；关于；至于
words.ex: We need to decide with respect to the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要考虑到天气来做出决定。
words.en: Regarding or concerning something.

words.tr: phrase. 不损害权益地；不构成权利放弃地（常用于法律语境，表示某行为或声明不影响未来主张权利）
words.ex: He spoke without prejudice.
words.ex_cn: 他毫无偏见地讲话。
words.en: Without prejudice means without affecting any legal right or claim. It is often used in legal contexts to indicate that an action or agreement does not waive any rights or claims that the parties may have.

words.tr: phrase. 不损害；不影响（某人权利、主张等）
words.ex: He can complain without prejudice to his contract.
words.ex_cn: 他可以投诉，而不影响他的合同。
words.en: Without affecting or harming something; used especially in legal contexts to indicate that a decision or action is made without affecting any rights, claims, or future actions.

words.tr: phrase. 逐字地；一字不差地
words.ex: He repeated the poem word for word.
words.ex_cn: 他一字不差地重复了那首诗。
words.en: If you repeat something word for word, you repeat it exactly as it was originally said or written.

words.tr: phrase. 通过工作或运动消耗（热量、债务、情绪等）；摆脱（尤指通过努力）
words.ex: He decided to work off his frustration by running.
words.ex_cn: 他决定通过跑步来消除他的沮丧。
words.en: To get rid of something, especially a debt or a feeling, by working or by doing something energetic.

words.tr: phrase. 包裹；圆满完成；（使）穿得暖和
words.ex: She will wrap up the gift with colorful paper.
words.ex_cn: 她会用彩纸把礼物包起来。
words.en: To finish or complete something; to cover or enclose something in paper or soft material.

words.tr: phrase. 一系列；一套
words.ex: He has a range of hobbies, like swimming and painting.
words.ex_cn: 他有很多爱好，比如游泳和画画。
words.en: A variety or assortment of things.

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.tr: 短语动词. 指责某人做某事，控告某人做了某事
words.ex: He accused her of stealing his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他指控她偷了他的手机。
words.en: If you accuse someone of doing something wrong or dishonest, you say or tell them that you believe that they did it.

words.tr: phrase. 使自己适应于
words.ex: He can adapt himself to new situations easily.
words.ex_cn: 他能很容易地适应新情况。
words.en: To adjust one's behavior or thinking to suit a new situation or environment.

words.tr: phrase. 整夜；通宵
words.ex: He worked all night long to finish his project.
words.ex_cn: 他整夜工作来完成他的项目。
words.en: For the entire duration of the night.

words.tr: phrase. 到处；四处；完了
words.ex: He is all over the place today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天到处跑。
words.en: In every part of a place; everywhere.

words.tr: v. 娱乐；
words.ex: The clown amuses the children with funny tricks.
words.ex_cn: 小丑用滑稽的把戏娱乐孩子们。
words.en: If something amuses you, it makes you want to laugh or smile.

words.tr: phrase. 适用于；运用
words.ex: This rule applies to all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则适用于所有学生。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 与……争论；与……争吵
words.ex: He likes to argue with his brother about football.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢和他哥哥争论足球。
words.en: If one person argues with another, they speak angrily to each other about something that they disagree about.

words.tr: phrase. 安排；为……做准备；促成
words.ex: He will arrange for a taxi to pick him up.
words.ex_cn: 他将安排一辆出租车来接他。
words.en: To make plans or preparations for something to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 依附于；连接到； attaching oneself or something to a person, object, or place
words.ex: The child attaches to his mother when he is scared.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子害怕时，他会依附于母亲。
words.en: To fasten, join, or connect something to something else.

words.tr: phrase. 对…的态度；对…的看法
words.ex: Her attitude toward the new policy was skeptical.
words.ex_cn: 她对新政策持怀疑态度。
words.en: A manner of thinking, feeling, or behaving that reflects a state of mind or disposition towards someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 态度；看法
words.ex: His attitude towards homework is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对待作业的态度非常积极。
words.en: A person's feelings, opinions, or way of thinking about something.

words.tr: phrase. 吸引注意；引起关注
words.ex: The bright sign attracts attention from drivers.
words.ex_cn: 醒目的标志吸引了司机的注意。
words.en: To draw the interest or attention of someone or something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 吸引某人的注意力
words.ex: The bright colors attract her attention.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的颜色吸引了她的注意。
words.en: To cause someone to notice or focus on something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. a 和 b 之间的平衡；指在两个因素、力量或选项之间保持均势或协调的状态
words.ex: It is important to have a balance between work and rest.
words.ex_cn: 在工作和休息之间保持平衡很重要。
words.en: A state of equilibrium or parity between two contrasting or opposing elements.

words.tr: phrase. 全神贯注于；专心于
words.ex: He is absorbed in reading a book.
words.ex_cn: 他正专心致志地读书。
words.en: To be so interested in something that you do not notice anything else.

words.tr: phrase. 被指控
words.ex: He is accused of stealing the money.
words.ex_cn: 他被指控偷了钱。
words.en: If you are accused of a crime, someone says that you have committed it.

words.tr: adj. 明智的；可取的；
words.ex: It is advisable to wear a helmet when riding a bike.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔是明智的。
words.en: If something is advisable, it will avoid problems if you do it.

words.tr: phrase. 对某人生气的；对某人感到恼火的
words.ex: I am annoyed with my brother for making noise.
words.ex_cn: 我因为弟弟制造噪音而感到生气。
words.en: To feel slightly angry or irritated with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 适用的
words.ex: This rule is applicable to all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则适用于所有学生。
words.en: To be relevant or appropriate to a particular situation or case.

words.tr: phrase. v. 离开；不在某地；远离
words.ex: He is away from school today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天不在学校。
words.en: To be in a place that is not near or close to a particular location or person.

words.tr: phrase. 意识到；察觉到；知道
words.ex: Be aware of the danger near the river.
words.ex_cn: 注意河边的危险。
words.en: To have knowledge or understanding of something.

words.tr: phrase. 对···有益
words.ex: Eating vegetables is beneficial to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜对你的健康有益。
words.en: To be beneficial to something means to have a good effect or influence on it.

words.tr: phrase. 一定；注定
words.ex: He is tired, so he is bound to fall asleep soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很累，所以很快就会睡着。
words.en: Certain or destined to happen; inevitably going to occur.

words.tr: phrase. 确信
words.ex: He is certain of his answer.
words.ex_cn: 他确信自己的答案。
words.en: To be sure or confident about something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 以…为特征；具有…的特点
words.ex: The city is characterized by narrow streets and old buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市以狭窄的街道和古老的建筑为特征。
words.en: To be characterized by something means to have it as a typical or noticeable feature.

words.tr: phrase. 意识到……的；察觉到……的
words.ex_cn: 他意识到自己的错误。
words.en: To be aware of or sensitive to something.

words.tr: phrase. 满足于； 对 ... 感到满足
words.ex: He is content with his small house.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的小房子感到满足。
words.en: To be satisfied with what one has or is, without desiring more or something else.

words.tr: 用于表示某事物被设计或计划来做某事，具有特定目的或功能
words.ex: The machine is designed to help old people.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的设计是为了帮助老年人。
words.en: If something is designed to do a particular thing, it is made or planned with the intention of doing that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 对…感到怀疑的；对…没有把握的
words.ex: He is doubtful about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个答案感到怀疑。
words.en: To feel uncertain or skeptical about something.

words.tr: phrase. 对……充满热情的；热衷于……的
words.ex_cn: 他热衷于打篮球。
words.en: To show a lot of excitement and interest in something.

words.tr: phrase. 嫉妒的；羡慕的（指对他人拥有的东西感到羡慕或嫉妒）
words.ex_cn: 他羡慕他朋友的新自行车。
words.en: To feel or show envy of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 对...必要的；非常重要的
words.ex: Water is essential to life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you say that something is essential to a particular thing, you mean that it is absolutely necessary for that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 对…来说是重要的
words.ex: Water is essential for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: To be absolutely necessary or extremely important for something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 次于； 不如；在....之下
words.ex: This phone is inferior to that one.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机不如那部。
words.en: To be lower in quality, rank, or importance than someone or something else.

words.tr: 短语. 有心情做某事；处于某种情绪状态
words.ex: I am not in the mood to eat today.
words.ex_cn: 我今天不想吃东西。
words.en: To feel like doing something or to be in the right state of mind for something.

words.tr: phrase. 没有心情；不想做某事
words.ex: He is not in the mood to talk today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天不想说话。
words.en: If you are not in the mood to do something, you do not feel like doing it or you are not interested in doing it.

words.w: be in the mood for sth.
words.tr: 短语. 想要某物；有心情做某事
words.uk: bi ɪn ðə mʊd fər ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: bi ɪn ðə mʊd fɔr ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: I am not in the mood for pizza today.
words.ex_cn: 我今天不想吃披萨。
words.en: If you are in the mood for something, you feel like doing it or having it.

words.w: be not in the mood for sth.
words.tr: phrase. 不想做某事的；没有心情做某事的
words.uk: /biː nɒt ɪn ðə mjuːd fɔːr ˈsʌmθɪŋ/
words.us: /bi nɑːt ɪn ðə muːd fɔːr ˈsʌmθɪŋ/
words.ex: He is not in the mood for talking now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在不想说话。
words.en: If you are not in the mood for something, you do not feel like doing it or having it at a particular time, often because you are feeling tired, upset, or uninterested.

words.w: be in the mood to do sth.
words.tr: phrase. 有心情做某事；想做某事
words.uk: bi ɪn ðə muːd tə duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: bi ɪn ðə muːd tə duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: I am not in the mood to clean the house today.
words.ex_cn: 我今天不想打扫房子。
words.en: To feel like doing something; to have the desire or inclination to do something.

words.w: be not in the mood to do sth.
words.tr: phrase. 不想做某事；没有心情做某事
words.uk: /biː nɒt ɪn ðə mjuːd tə duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/
words.us: /biː nɑːt ɪn ðə muːd tə duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/
words.ex: He is not in the mood to clean his room.
words.ex_cn: 他不想打扫房间。
words.en: To not feel like doing something because of one's emotional state.

words.tr: phrase. 涉及；专心； 卷入
words.ex: He is involved in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他参与了学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To be included or participate in something, especially something that requires a lot of time or effort.

words.tr: phrase. 渴望做某事；非常乐意做某事
words.ex: He is keen to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他很想学英语。
words.en: To have a strong desire or eagerness to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 忠于
words.ex: He is loyal to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友忠诚。
words.en: To be faithful and committed to someone or something.

words.tr: 表示应该做某事或注定要做某事，相当于 ought to 或 is/are supposed to
words.ex: He is meant to finish his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他本应晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: To be intended or designed to do something, or to be supposed to do something.

words.tr: adj. 反对的；敌对的； v. 反对；反抗；“oppose”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was opposed to the new rule.
words.ex_cn: 他反对这个新规定。
words.en: If you are opposed to something, you disagree with it or disapprove of it.

words.tr: 短语. 受某人欢迎；受某人喜爱
words.ex: This song is popular with teenagers.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在青少年中很受欢迎。
words.en: If someone or something is popular with a particular group of people, they are liked or admired by those people.

words.tr: phrase. 与…有关
words.ex: This topic is relevant to our project.
words.ex_cn: 这个话题与我们的项目相关。
words.en: To be connected with what is happening or being discussed.

words.tr: phrase. 不情愿做某事的；勉强的；不愿的
words.ex: He is reluctant to speak in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他不愿意在全班面前说话。
words.en: If you are reluctant to do something, you are unwilling to do it and hesitate before doing it, or do it slowly and without enthusiasm.

words.tr: phrase. 以…著称
words.ex: This painting is remarkable for its bright colors.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画因其鲜艳的色彩而引人注目。
words.en: To be notable or famous for a particular quality or feature.

words.tr: phrase. 对...负责
words.ex: He is responsible for cleaning the room.
words.ex_cn: 他负责打扫房间。
words.en: To have the duty of taking care of something or someone, so that you may be blamed if something goes wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 对…持怀疑态度的；对…表示怀疑
words.ex: He is skeptical about the new diet plan.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个新饮食计划持怀疑态度。
words.en: To have doubts or reservations about something; to question the truth or validity of something.

words.tr: phrase. 被迫接受（某人或某事）；无法摆脱
words.ex: I am stuck with this old car because I have no money to buy a new one.
words.ex_cn: 我没有钱买新车，只好留着这辆旧车。
words.en: To be unable to avoid dealing with someone or something, especially because you have no choice.

words.tr: adj. 合适的；适宜的；
words.ex: This shirt is suitable for the party.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫适合这场派对。
words.en: Something that is suitable for a particular person or thing is right or acceptable for them.

words.tr: phrase. 应该；被期望
words.ex: He is supposed to finish his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他本该在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: If you are supposed to do something, it means that you are expected or required to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 确信
words.ex: He is sure of his answer.
words.ex_cn: 他确信自己的答案。
words.en: If you are sure of something, you are confident that it is true or correct.

words.tr: phrase. 该受责备；应承担责任
words.ex: He is to blame for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误该怪他。
words.en: If someone is to blame for something bad that has happened, they are responsible for causing it.

words.tr: phrase. 以…为起点；首先
words.ex: The lesson begins with a simple question.
words.ex_cn: 这节课以一个简单的问题开始。
words.en: To start with something, especially as a first step or part of a process.

words.tr: phrase. 受益于
words.ex: He benefits from eating healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 他从吃健康食品中获益。
words.en: To gain an advantage or profit from something.

words.tr: phrase. 无法言表的；难以形容的
words.ex: Her joy was beyond expression.
words.ex_cn: 她的喜悦无法形容。
words.en: If something is beyond expression, it is impossible to describe or express in words.

words.tr: phrase. 故意地；有意为之地
words.ex: The mistake was by design.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误是故意的。
words.en: If something happens by design, someone makes it happen on purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 追赶；追求；追逐
words.ex: The dog runs to chase after the ball every time.
words.ex_cn: 每次狗都跑着去追球。
words.en: If you chase after someone or something, you run after them or follow them quickly in order to catch or reach them.

words.tr: phrase. 要求；索取（赔偿、权利等）
words.ex: He claimed for compensation after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他要求赔偿。
words.en: To ask for something because you think it belongs to you or because you think you have a right to it.

words.tr: phrase. 与…结合；兼具
words.ex: Mix the flour combine with water to make dough.
words.ex_cn: 将面粉与水混合做成面团。
words.en: To join or merge two or more things together to form a single entity.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 对…表示好感；向…献殷勤；试图引诱
words.ex: He came on to her at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在聚会上对她表示好感。
words.en: To make a sexual advance towards someone; to attempt to initiate a romantic or sexual relationship with someone.

words.tr:
n. 指挥；命令；
v. 掌握；
words.ex: The general has command of the army.
words.ex_cn: 将军指挥着军队。
words.en: If someone in authority commands you to do something, they tell you that you must do it.

words.tr: phrase. 自杀；结束自己的生命
words.ex: He decided to commit suicide because he felt hopeless.
words.ex_cn: 他感到绝望，决定自杀。
words.en: To kill oneself intentionally.

words.tr: phrase. 交流；沟通
words.ex: He communicates with his friends every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天和朋友交流。
words.en: To share or exchange information, news, or ideas with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 与……竞争；与……对抗
words.ex: He competes against his brother in swimming.
words.ex_cn: 他和哥哥在游泳比赛中竞争。
words.en: To strive against another or others to attain a goal, such as winning a game or achieving a superior position.

words.tr: phrase. 与…竞争
words.ex: He competes with his brother for the best grades.
words.ex_cn: 他和弟弟竞争最好的成绩。
words.en: If one company or country competes with another, it tries to get people to buy its goods or services rather than those of the other company or country.

words.tr: phrase. 参加…比赛；在…领域中竞争
words.ex: He will compete in the race tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天将参加比赛。
words.en: To take part in a competition or event.

words.tr: phrase. 使自己镇定下来去做某事；从容应对以做某事
words.ex: He composed himself to speak in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他让自己平静下来，以便在全班面前讲话。
words.en: To calm or prepare oneself mentally to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 集中于； 专心于
words.ex: He must concentrate on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他必须专心做作业。
words.en: To direct all your attention and effort towards a particular activity, subject, or problem.

words.tr: phrase. 专注于做某事
words.ex: You should concentrate on doing your homework.
words.ex_cn: 你应该专心做你的作业。
words.en: To focus one's attention or effort on performing a specific activity.

words.tr: phrase. v. 从……得出结论；推断出
words.ex: He concluded from the data that the plan will fail.
words.ex_cn: 他从数据中得出结论，这个计划会失败。
words.en: To decide that something is true after considering all the information you have.

words.tr: v. 得出结论；
words.ex: He concluded that the experiment failed.
words.ex_cn: 他得出结论说实验失败了。
words.en: If you conclude that something is true, you decide that it is true using the facts you know as a basis.

words.tr: phrase. 承认某事；坦白某事
words.ex: He confessed to stealing the money.
words.ex_cn: 他承认偷了钱。
words.en: To admit that you have done something wrong or something that you feel guilty or bad about.

words.tr: phrase. 承认做了某事
words.ex: He confessed to stealing the money.
words.ex_cn: 他承认偷了钱。
words.en: If you confess to doing something, you admit that you did it.

words.tr: phrase. 转换至
words.ex: He can convert liters to gallons easily.
words.ex_cn: 他能轻松地将升转换为加仑。
words.en: To change the form, function, or units of something.

words.tr: v. 说服；使确信；
words.ex: He tried to convince her to stay.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服她留下。
words.en: If someone or something convinces you of something, they make you believe that it is true or that it exists.

words.tr: phrase. 与某人合作；与某人协作
words.ex: He cooperates with his friend to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友合作完成这个项目。
words.en: To work jointly with another person or group.

words.w: cooperate with sb. in doing sth.
words.tr: phrase. 与某人合作做某事
words.uk: kəʊˈɒpəreɪt wɪð səmˈbɒdi ɪn ˈduːɪŋ səmθɪŋ
words.us: koʊˈɑːpəreɪt wɪð səmˈbɑːdi ɪn ˈduːɪŋ səmθɪŋ
words.ex: They cooperate with each other in cleaning the room.
words.ex_cn: 他们合作一起打扫房间。
words.en: To work jointly with another person or group on a particular activity.

words.tr: phrase. 信用卡
words.ex: He uses a credit card to buy food.
words.ex_cn: 他用信用卡买食物。
words.en: A credit card is a small plastic card that you use to buy things on credit or to borrow money.

words.tr: phrase. 切；去掉；逃走
words.ex: The surgeon carefully cut away the tumor.
words.ex_cn: 外科医生小心地切除了肿瘤。
words.en: To remove something by cutting it off.

words.tr: phrase. 致力于；献身于；全身心投入于
words.ex: He devotes himself to helping poor people.
words.ex_cn: 他致力于帮助贫困人群。
words.en: To give all or a large part of one's time or resources to (a person, activity, or cause).

words.tr: v. 阻止；劝阻；
words.ex: Don't discourage him from trying.
words.ex_cn: 不要阻止他尝试。
words.en: If someone or something discourages you, they cause you to lose your enthusiasm about your actions.

words.tr: v. 使有别于；区分；
words.ex: The two colors distinguish the two teams.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色使两个队伍有所不同。
words.en: If you can distinguish one thing from another, you can see or understand how they are different.

words.tr: phrase. 转移对……的注意力；使分心，使偏离
words.ex: Don't let noise distract from your homework.
words.ex_cn: 不要让噪音分散你做作业的注意力。
words.en: To distract someone from something means to take their attention away from it.

words.tr: phrase. 许多的；数十个
words.ex: There are dozens of apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有很多苹果。
words.en: If you refer to dozens of things or people, you are emphasizing that there are very many of them.

words.tr: phrase. 拉开；使离开；逐渐远离
words.ex: He drew away the curtain to let in the light.
words.ex_cn: 他拉开窗帘让阳光照进来。
words.en: To move something or someone away from a particular place or to distract someone's attention from something.

words.tr: phrase. v. 驱赶出去；赶走；驱逐
words.ex: The loud noise will drive out the birds.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音会把鸟吓跑。
words.en: To force someone or something to leave a place or to eliminate something.

words.tr: phrase. 经济衰退；指一个国家的经济活动显著下降，通常表现为GDP连续两个季度负增长
words.ex: The country faced an economic recession last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个国家经历了经济衰退。
words.en: A period of temporary economic decline during which trade and industrial activity are reduced, generally identified by a fall in GDP in two successive quarters.

words.tr: phrase. v. 详细说明；详尽阐述
words.ex: He will elaborate on the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会详细说明这个计划。
words.en: To provide more details or information about a subject.

words.tr: adj. 反对的；敌对的； v. 反对；反抗；“oppose”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was opposed to the new rule.
words.ex_cn: 他反对这个新规定。
words.en: If you are opposed to something, you disagree with it or disapprove of it.

words.tr: phrase. 装备；使具备
words.ex: The soldiers were equipped with new rifles.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们配备了新步枪。
words.en: To provide someone or something with the necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 即便如此；尽管如此
words.ex: It rained all day, even so, we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 下了一整天的雨，尽管如此，我们还是去散步了。
words.en: You use 'even so' to introduce a surprising fact which relates to what you have just said.

words.tr: v. 存在；生存；活着；
words.ex: Dinosaurs existed millions of years ago.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙存在于数百万年前。
words.en: If something exists, it is present in the world as a real thing.

words.tr: phrase. 未能...
words.ex: He fail to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他未能完成家庭作业。
words.en: If you fail to do something that you were trying to do, you are unable to do it or you do not succeed in doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 落入；陷入；属于
words.ex: He fell into the river by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心掉进了河里。
words.en: To fall into something means to be classified or divided into it, or to start to be in a particular state or condition.

words.tr: phrase. 为...而战
words.ex: People must fight for their rights.
words.ex_cn: 人们必须为自己的权利而斗争。
words.en: To engage in a struggle or campaign to achieve or secure something.

words.tr: phrase. 适合
words.ex: The new shelf does not fit into the corner.
words.ex_cn: 这个新架子放不进角落里。
words.en: If you fit into a group or situation, you seem to belong there because you are similar to the other people involved.

words.tr: 短语. 瞬间；片刻；一瞬间
words.ex: She hesitated for an instant before answering.
words.ex_cn: 她在回答之前犹豫了片刻。
words.en: For a very brief period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 为了…
words.ex: He woke up early for the purpose of catching the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早起是为了赶公交车。
words.en: If you do something for the purpose of achieving a particular result, you do it in order to achieve that result.

words.tr: phrase. 免费；不收费
words.ex: The library gives books free of charge.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆免费提供书籍。
words.en: If something is free of charge, it does not cost anything.

words.tr: phrase. 吓跑；使害怕而离开
words.ex: Loud noises can frighten away small animals.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的声音会吓跑小动物。
words.en: To cause someone or something to go away or stay away because they are frightened.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 收集起来；拾起；收拾
words.ex: He gather up the papers from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地板上捡起那些纸。
words.en: To collect or bring things together in one place.

words.tr: phrase. 养成…的习惯
words.ex: He gets into the habit of brushing his teeth every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他养成了每天早上刷牙的习惯。
words.en: To start doing something regularly or often, so that it becomes a habit.

words.tr: phrase. 摆脱；逃避；从…出去
words.ex: He wants to get out of debt.
words.ex_cn: 他想摆脱债务。
words.en: To leave a place or situation; to avoid doing something that you do not want to do.

words.tr: 短语. 一瞥；匆匆看一下
words.ex: He gave me a glimpse at his new phone.
words.ex_cn: 他让我看了一眼他的新手机。
words.en: A quick look or a brief view of something.

words.tr: phrase. 回去；追溯到
words.ex: He will go back to his hometown next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会回他的家乡。
words.en: To return to a previous place, time, or subject.

words.tr: phrase. 进行罢工
words.ex: The workers go on strike to ask for higher pay.
words.ex_cn: 工人们罢工以要求加薪。
words.en: To stop work as a form of protest, typically in an attempt to gain a particular concession or concessions from their employer.

words.tr: phrase. v. 递送，分发（通常指物品或信息）
words.ex: He will hand round the snacks at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他会在聚会上分发小吃。
words.en: To pass something around a group of people.

words.tr: phrase. 使用；接近；可以利用
words.ex: Students have access to the library after school.
words.ex_cn: 学生放学后可以使用图书馆。
words.en: To have the right or opportunity to use or see something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 与某人相识；与某人有交情
words.ex: I have an acquaintance with my neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 我认识我的邻居。
words.en: to know someone slightly

words.tr: phrase. 胜过；优于
words.ex: He has an advantage over others because he speaks English well.
words.ex_cn: 他因为英语说得很好而比别人有优势。
words.en: To be in a better position or have a better chance than someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 对…有影响
words.ex: Smoking has an effect on your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对健康有影响。
words.en: To cause a change or influence something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对……有深刻的理解；洞察……
words.ex: He has an insight into how plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 他对植物的生长有深刻的理解。
words.en: to gain a deep understanding of a subject or situation

words.tr: 短语动词. 深入了解某事；使洞察某事
words.ex: This book gives an insight into ancient Chinese life.
words.ex_cn: 这本书提供了对古代中国生活的深入了解。
words.en: To provide a deep understanding or clear perception of something.

words.tr: phrase. 对……有信心；信任
words.ex: I have confidence in my brother.
words.ex_cn: 我信任我的兄弟。
words.en: To believe in someone's or something's abilities or qualities.

words.tr: phrase. 相信；信任
words.ex: I have faith in you to do the right thing.
words.ex_cn: 我相信你会做正确的事。
words.en: To believe in the reliability, truth, or ability of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 不知道；不清楚；不了解
words.ex: I have no idea where the bus stop is.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道公交车站在哪里。
words.en: If you have no idea about something, you do not know anything about it or you have no understanding of it.

words.tr: phrase. 在...方面有麻烦
words.ex: He has trouble with reading English books.
words.ex_cn: 他在阅读英语书籍方面有困难。
words.en: If you have trouble with something or someone, you have difficulty dealing with them.

words.tr: phrase. 紧握；坚持
words.ex: He holds to his promise no matter what.
words.ex_cn: 无论发生什么，他都会遵守自己的承诺。
words.en: To continue to believe in or adhere to an idea, principle, or plan, despite difficulties or opposition.

words.tr: 保持真实；仍然适用
words.ex: This rule hold true for all simple cases.
words.ex_cn: 这个规则适用于所有简单的情况。
words.en: If something holds true, it is or remains true, valid, or applicable.

words.tr: phrase. 使对…留下深刻印象；因…而钦佩
words.ex: He tries to impress with his singing.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用他的歌声给人留下印象。
words.en: To make someone feel admiration or respect because of something you have done or said.

words.tr: phrase. 用…给某人留下深刻印象；以…使某人钦佩
words.ex: He impressed his teacher with his math skills.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的数学能力给老师留下了深刻印象。
words.en: To make someone feel admiration and respect because of something that you have done or said.

words.tr: phrase. 瞬间；立刻；一眨眼工夫
words.ex: He disappeared in an instant.
words.ex_cn: 他立即消失了。
words.en: If something happens in an instant, it happens very quickly.

words.tr: phrase. 陷入困境；惹上麻烦
words.ex: He is in hot water for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因为违反规则而陷入麻烦。
words.en: In trouble or difficulty.

words.tr: phrase. 通知某人
words.ex: Please inform the staff of the change in schedule.
words.ex_cn: 请通知员工日程安排的变更。
words.en: To tell someone about something, especially in an official way.

words.tr: phrase. 通知某人关于……；告知某人有关……
words.ex: Please inform me about the meeting time.
words.ex_cn: 请告诉我会议的时间。
words.en: To tell someone about something, especially in an official or formal way.

words.tr: phrase. 因为；由于
words.ex: He is late in that he missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为他没赶上公交车。
words.en: Used to introduce a reason or explanation for something.

words.tr: phrase. 以……的形式；呈……形状；以……方式
words.ex: The answer is in the form of a number.
words.ex_cn: 答案是以数字的形式给出的。
words.en: used to indicate the way in which something is done or presented

words.tr:
n. 工序；过程；
v. 处理；加工；
words.ex: The factory improved the production process.
words.ex_cn: 工厂改进了生产工序。
words.en: A process is a series of actions which are carried out in order to achieve a particular result.

words.tr: phrase. 呈…形状；以…的形式
words.ex: The clouds were in the shape of a dragon.
words.ex_cn: prep. 云朵呈龙的形状。
words.en: Having the form or appearance of something.

words.tr: phrase. 这样；用这种方式
words.ex: She solved the problem in this way.
words.ex_cn: 她这样解决了问题。
words.en: By means of this method or manner.

words.tr: phrase. 从…推断；由…得出结论
words.ex: We can infer from the data that the trend is increasing.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以从数据中推导出趋势正在上升。
