words.en: To conclude or deduce something from evidence and reasoning rather than from explicit statements.

words.tr: phrase. 对...有影响
words.ex: His words have a big influence on her choices.
words.ex_cn: 他的话对她的选择有很大影响。
words.en: The effect that somebody/something has on the way a person thinks or behaves or on the way that something works or develops.

words.tr:
n. 影响（力）；
v. 影响；
words.ex: The teacher had a big influence on her students.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生们有很大的影响。
words.en: The power to affect, control, or manipulate someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 对…的影响；作用于…
words.ex: His words influence upon her decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他的话影响着她的决定。
words.en: To have an effect on the character, development, or behavior of someone or something, or the effect itself.

words.tr: phrase. 用某事激励某人；以某事鼓舞某人
words.ex: The teacher inspired the students with her passion for science.
words.ex_cn: 老师用她对科学的热情激励了学生们。
words.en: To fill someone with the urge or ability to do or feel something, especially to do something creative, by giving them an idea or example.

words.tr: phrase. 在某人心中激起某种情感或想法；使某人产生某种感觉或灵感
words.ex: Her story inspires courage in me.
words.ex_cn: 她的故事给了我勇气。
words.en: To fill someone with the urge or ability to do or feel something, especially to do something creative.

words.tr: v. 解释；把…理解为；
words.ex: He interprets the poem as a love story.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首诗解释为一个爱情故事。
words.en: If you interpret something in a particular way, you decide that this is its meaning or significance.

words.tr: v. 使隔离；分离出；
words.ex: The hospital will isolate the patient to stop the spread.
words.ex_cn: 医院将隔离这名病人以防止传播。
words.en: To isolate someone or something means to separate them from other people or things, often in order to protect them or to prevent the spread of something harmful.

words.tr: adj. 偏远的；隔离的；孤独的； v. 使隔离；“isolate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The village is isolated, far from any city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄很偏远，远离任何城市。
words.en: If something is isolated, it is far away from other places, buildings, or people.

words.tr: phrase. 就像；正如
words.ex: He runs just as fast as his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得和他哥哥一样快。
words.en: in the same way that; at the same time as

words.tr: phrase. 记录
words.ex: He keeps a record of every book he reads.
words.ex_cn: 他记录下自己读过的每一本书。
words.en: To maintain a written account or documentation of something.

words.tr: phrase. 保持距离；疏远；不亲近
words.ex: He keeps his distance from the dog because he is scared.
words.ex_cn: 他远离那只狗，因为他害怕。
words.en: To maintain a physical or emotional distance from someone or something, often to avoid getting too involved or to stay safe.

words.w: Kill two birds with one stone
words.tr: phrase. 一石二鸟；一举两得
words.ex: By going to the grocery store, I can kill two birds with one stone and pick up dinner ingredients and some office supplies.
words.ex_cn: 去杂货店我可以一举两得，既买了晚餐的食材，又买了一些办公用品。
words.en: To achieve two things at the same time with a single action.

words.tr: phrase. 落后；滞后；跟不上
words.ex: Tom often lags behind in class because he doesn't study.
words.ex_cn: 汤姆因为不学习，经常在课堂上落后。
words.en: To fail to keep up with others or to fall behind in progress, development, or achievement.

words.tr: phrase. 为……奠定基础；为……打下根基
words.ex: Good teachers help lay the foundation for students' future success.
words.ex_cn: 好老师帮助为学生的未来成功奠定基础。
words.en: To establish the basic principles or groundwork for something.

words.tr: phrase. 把…锁起来；把…关起来；把…妥善保管
words.ex: He likes to lock away his phone when he works.
words.ex_cn: 他工作时喜欢把手机收起来。
words.en: To lock away means to put something in a place and lock it so that it is safe, or to put someone in a prison or a secure psychiatric hospital.

words.tr: phrase. 失去勇气；胆怯；临阵退缩
words.ex: He loses his nerve when he sees a big dog.
words.ex_cn: 他看到大狗时就吓得失去了勇气。
words.en: If you lose your nerve, you suddenly become too frightened to do something you had planned to do.

words.tr: phrase. 与……讨价还价；与……达成协议；与……做交易
words.ex: He made a bargain with his brother to share the cake.
words.ex_cn: 他和弟弟达成协议，平分蛋糕。
words.en: To make an agreement or deal with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 发大财；赚大钱；积累巨额财富
words.ex: He made a fortune by selling his small business.
words.ex_cn: 他通过卖掉自己的小生意发了一笔财。
words.en: To earn a large amount of money, often in a short period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 把…弄得一团糟；搞砸；弄乱
words.ex: He made a mess of his homework and had to start again.
words.ex_cn: 他把作业搞得一团糟，不得不重新开始。
words.en: To handle something in a way that results in a disordered or chaotic state.

words.tr: phrase. 盈利；获得利润；赚钱
words.ex: He makes a profit by selling old books.
words.ex_cn: 他通过卖旧书赚钱。
words.en: To earn money from a business or investment.

words.tr: phrase. 预约；约会
words.ex: I will make an appointment with the doctor tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天要预约医生。
words.en: To arrange a meeting or consultation at a specific time.

words.tr: phrase. 提及；提到
words.ex: He did not make mention of the problem during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议期间没有提到这个问题。
words.en: To refer to someone or something briefly or casually.

words.tr: phrase. 结识某人；与某人初次见面
words.ex: I made his acquaintance at the party.
words.ex_cn: 我在聚会上认识了他。
words.en: To meet and get to know someone for the first time.

words.tr: phrase. 理解；弄懂；明白；领会
words.ex: I can't make sense of this math problem.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂这个数学题。
words.en: To understand something that is complicated or unusual.

words.tr: phrase. 达到（标准）；符合（期望）；比得上
words.ex: He cannot measure up to his brother's standards.
words.ex_cn: 他达不到他哥哥的标准。
words.en: To reach the standard that is needed or expected.

words.tr: phrase. 把某人误认作某人；把某人错当成某人
words.ex: He mistook the teacher for the principal.
words.ex_cn: 他把老师误认为是校长。
words.en: to wrongly think that one person is another person because they are similar in some way

words.tr: phrase. 只不过；仅仅；无非
words.ex: You can eat no more than three cookies.
words.ex_cn: 你最多只能吃三块饼干。
words.en: used to emphasize that something is not more than a particular amount, number, or level

words.tr: phrase. 记下；写下
words.ex: Please note down the homework in your notebook.
words.ex_cn: 请把作业记在你的笔记本上。
words.en: To write something down so that you will remember it.

words.tr: phrase. 代表自己；为自己；以自己的名义
words.ex: He spoke on his own behalf at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上为自己发言。
words.en: Acting or speaking for oneself rather than being represented by someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 濒于；在…边缘
words.ex: The house is on the edge of the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子位于森林的边缘。
words.en: If someone or something is on the edge of a particular state or condition, they are about to enter that state or condition.

words.tr: phrase. 立即；马上；当场
words.ex: He responded on the instant when I called for help.
words.ex_cn: 当我呼救时，他立即做出了回应。
words.en: Immediately; without any delay.

words.tr: phrase. 选修课
words.ex: She took an optional course in photography.
words.ex_cn: 她选了一门摄影的选修课。
words.en: An optional course is a class that students can choose to take as part of their studies, but it is not required for their degree.

words.tr: phrase. 往下传；遗传；传承
words.ex: My grandfather passed down his old watch to me.
words.ex_cn: 我祖父把他的旧手表传给了我。
words.en: To transmit or hand down from one generation to another.

words.tr: phrase. 付账；付出代价
words.ex: He will pay for the coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他将为这杯咖啡付款。
words.en: To give money in exchange for goods or services; to suffer the consequences of one's actions.

words.tr:
n. 同辈；同等的人；
v. 凝视；
words.ex: He feels comfortable talking to his peers.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得和同辈交谈很自在。
words.en: A peer is someone who is equal to another in abilities, qualifications, age, background, or social status. As a verb, to peer means to look keenly or with difficulty at someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 持续（一段时间）；坚持（多久）
words.ex: The rain will persist for three days.
words.ex_cn: 这场雨将持续三天。
words.en: To continue for a period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 堆积；积累
words.ex: Books are piling up on the table.
words.ex_cn: 书正堆在桌子上。
words.en: If things pile up, they gradually increase in number or amount until there is a large quantity of them.

words.tr: phrase. 使突然陷入；投身于；跳入；投入（某活动或状态）
words.ex: He likes to plunge into cold water in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在冬天跳进冷水里。
words.en: To start to do something suddenly and with a lot of energy, often without thinking about it first.

words.tr: phrase. 润色；改进；使更完善；擦亮
words.ex: He will polish up his English before the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他将在旅行前把英语提高一下。
words.en: To improve or refine something, especially a skill or piece of work, by making small changes.

words.tr: phrase. , n.突然出现：指突然从隐藏的位置迅速出现或活动。; 弹出式：指在打开页面时形成一个立体结构的设备或插图。...
words.ex: A message will pop up when you open the app.
words.ex_cn: 当你打开应用程序时，会弹出一条消息。
words.en: If something such as a message or window pops up on a computer screen, it appears there suddenly.

words.tr: phrase. 倾盆而下；大量倾泻；（雨）下得很大
words.ex: It started to pour down just as we left the house.
words.ex_cn: 我们刚离开家，天就开始下大雨了。
words.en: If rain pours down, it rains very heavily.

words.tr: phrase. 大量涌入；不断注入；把……倒进
words.ex: People pour into the stadium for the concert.
words.ex_cn: 人们涌入体育场参加音乐会。
words.en: To invest a large amount of time, money, or energy into something.

words.tr: n. 赞美；赞扬；
words.ex: His hard work received much praise from the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他的努力工作得到了老师的许多赞美。
words.en: If you praise someone or something, you express approval for their achievements or qualities.

words.tr: phrase. 禁止
words.ex: The school prohibits students from using phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If a law or someone in authority prohibits something, they forbid it or make it illegal.

words.tr: phrase. 打算做；计划做；提议去做
words.ex: He wants to propose to do a new project next week.
words.ex_cn: 他想在下周提议做一个新项目。
words.en: To suggest or put forward a plan or idea for consideration.

words.tr: v. 提议；计划；
words.ex: He propose to go to the park after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提议午饭后去公园。
words.en: If you propose something, you suggest it as a plan or course of action.

words.tr: phrase. 保护…免受；防御；防止
words.ex: We need to protect against cyber attacks.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要防范网络攻击。
words.en: To take measures to prevent something harmful or undesirable from happening.

words.tr: v. 提供；
words.ex: The school provides free lunch for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: If you provide something that someone needs or wants, or if you provide them with it, you give it to them or make it available to them.

words.tr: n. 俯卧撑
words.ex: He does ten push-ups every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上做十个俯卧撑。
words.en: A push-up is a physical exercise performed in a prone position by raising and lowering the body using the arms.

words.tr: phrase. 放下；记下；镇压；贬低；削减；杀死
words.ex: He put down his pen and smiled.
words.ex_cn: 他放下笔，笑了。
words.en: To place something on a surface or in a particular position; to write something down; to suppress or end something by force; to criticize someone in a way that makes them seem stupid or unimportant.

words.tr: phrase. 提出
words.ex: He put forward a new idea in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个新想法。
words.en: To suggest or propose something for consideration.

words.tr: phrase. 纠正；修理；恢复正常；使恢复正常秩序
words.ex: He will put right the mistake tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会纠正这个错误。
words.en: To correct or amend something that is wrong or inaccurate.

words.tr: phrase. 使有资格；使具备…的资格；取得…的资格
words.ex: He can qualify for the job with more experience.
words.ex_cn: 他如果有更多经验就能有资格获得这份工作。
words.en: to have the right to have or do something because of the qualities or actions that you have

words.tr: 排队等候：在某个地方或场合中按照先后顺序排队等待。
words.ex: They queue for the bus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天早上排队等公交车。
words.en: To wait in a line of people, often to buy something or to enter a place.

words.tr: phrasal verb排队等候
words.ex: People queue up for tickets at the cinema.
words.ex_cn: 人们在电影院排队买票。
words.en: If people queue up for something, they stand in a line waiting to obtain it.

words.tr: phrase. 通读；从头到尾仔细阅读；审阅
words.ex: Please read through the instructions before you start.
words.ex_cn: 在开始之前，请仔细阅读说明。
words.en: To read something from beginning to end, especially in order to find mistakes or check details.

words.tr: phrase. 向...登记；对...有印象
words.ex: He must register with the office before Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他必须在周一之前到办公室登记。
words.en: To officially record your name or the details of an event on a list.

words.tr: phrase. 与…产生共鸣；与…建立联系；与…相关
words.ex: He can easily relate with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他很容易与朋友产生共鸣。
words.en: To establish a connection or association with someone or something, often through shared experiences, understanding, or empathy.

words.tr: phrase. 要求；期望；对…有要求
words.ex: The job requires of you to work hard.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作要求你努力工作。
words.en: To demand something from someone as necessary.

words.tr:
n. 根；根源；
v. 生根；
words.ex: The root of 9 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 9的平方根是3。
words.en: The root of a plant is the part that grows underground and absorbs water and minerals. It can also refer to the origin or cause of something.

words.tr: phrase. 发烧；发热
words.ex: He runs a fever when he gets sick.
words.ex_cn: 他生病时会发烧。
words.en: To have a higher body temperature than normal, often as a symptom of illness.

words.tr: phrase. 冲出；匆匆离开
words.ex: He has to rush off to work now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在得赶紧去上班。
words.en: To leave quickly or in a hurry, often because you need to be somewhere else.

words.tr: phrase. 节省；减少（开支、时间等）
words.ex: You can save on fuel by driving more slowly.
words.ex_cn: 你可以通过开慢点来节省燃料。
words.en: To spend less money on something by reducing the amount you use or by choosing a cheaper alternative.

words.tr: phrase. （两人）看法一致；意见相同
words.ex: We don't always see eye to eye, but we respect each other's opinions.
words.ex_cn: 我们并不总是看法一致，但我们尊重彼此的意见。
words.en: If two people see eye to eye, they agree with each other.

words.tr: phrase. 责任感；责任心
words.ex: He shows a strong sense of responsibility at work.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中表现出强烈的责任感。
words.en: A sense of responsibility is a feeling that it is your duty to deal with something or to care for someone.

words.tr: phrase. 动摇某人的信念；使某人对自己的信仰或看法产生怀疑
words.ex: The false report shakes his belief in the news.
words.ex_cn: 这个虚假报道动摇了他对新闻的信任。
words.en: To cause someone to doubt or question their beliefs, convictions, or faith.

words.tr: phrase. 表现出对……的尊重；尊敬
words.ex: Children should show respect for their teachers.
words.ex_cn: 孩子应该尊重他们的老师。
words.en: To treat someone with admiration and consideration.

words.tr: phrase. 称赞；说……的好话
words.ex: He always speaks well of his teachers.
words.ex_cn: 他总是称赞他的老师。
words.en: To express a favorable opinion of someone or something.

words.tr: n. 股份；赌注；桩；
words.ex: He bought a stake in the new company.
words.ex_cn: 他购买了这家新公司的股份。
words.en: A stake is a pointed stick or post that is pushed into the ground, for example to support a young tree. It can also refer to a share or interest in a business, situation, or system.

words.tr: phrase. 熬夜；不睡觉
words.ex: He stays up late to watch movies.
words.ex_cn: 他熬夜看电影。
words.en: To remain awake and not go to bed.

words.tr: phrase. 走出；暂时离开；外出（尤指短暂地）
words.ex: She decided to step out for a quick breath of fresh air.
words.ex_cn: 她决定出去呼吸一下新鲜空气。
words.en: To walk out of a place, especially briefly or suddenly.

words.tr: phrase. 奋斗；争取；谋求
words.ex: He strives for success every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在努力追求成功。
words.en: To try very hard to achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 遭受；患病
words.ex: He suffers from a bad cold.
words.ex_cn: 他患了重感冒。
words.en: If you suffer from an illness or from a medical condition, you are badly affected by it.

words.tr: phrase. 吸收；领会；接待；接受
words.ex: Plants take in sunlight to make food.
words.ex_cn: 植物吸收阳光来制造食物。
words.en: To take something in means to understand it or to absorb it. It can also mean to deceive someone or to make clothes smaller.

words.tr: phrase. 趁机，借机做某事
words.ex: He took occasion to thank everyone after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议结束后，他借此机会感谢了每个人。
words.en: To use a particular opportunity to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 趋向；易于；往往
words.ex: He tends to arrive late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他总是迟到上课。
words.en: If someone or something tends to do a particular thing, they usually do it or they often do it.

words.tr: phrase. 做某事的能力；对某事的胜任力
words.ex: The ability for water to boil changes with altitude.
words.ex_cn: 水沸腾的能力随海拔而变化。
words.en: The capacity or skill to do something.

words.tr: n. 能力；才能；
words.ex: He has the ability to solve math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力快速解决数学问题。
words.en: The capacity to do something or the possession of the means or skill to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 整理；收拾干净；使整洁
words.ex: He will tidy up the room after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐后会收拾房间。
words.en: To make a place neat and orderly by removing clutter and arranging things properly.

words.tr: phrase. 某种程度上
words.ex: To some extent, he likes the new job.
words.ex_cn: 在某种程度上，他喜欢这份新工作。
words.en: To some extent means to a certain degree or in a certain measure, but not completely.

words.tr: phrase. 扭伤某人的脚踝
words.ex: He twist one's ankle while running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步时扭伤了脚踝。
words.en: To injure one's ankle by turning it suddenly and awkwardly.

words.tr: 短语. 正在讨论中；正在审议中
words.ex: The new policy is still under discussion.
words.ex_cn: 新政策仍在讨论中。
words.en: If something is under discussion, it is still being talked about and a final decision or agreement has not yet been reached.

words.tr: phrase. 警告某人某事；提醒某人注意（潜在危险或问题）
words.ex: The weather forecast warned us of an impending storm.
words.ex_cn: 天气预报警告我们即将有暴风雨。
words.en: To inform someone in advance of an impending or possible danger, problem, or other unpleasant situation.

words.tr: phrase. 除...以外
words.ex: Everyone passed the test, with the exception of Tom.
words.ex_cn: 除了汤姆，所有人都通过了考试。
words.en: You use 'with the exception of' to introduce a thing or person that is not included in a general statement that you are making.

words.tr: phrase. 大量
words.ex: There is a multitude of birds in the park.
words.ex_cn: 公园里有大量鸟类。
words.en: A multitude of things or people is a very large number of them.

words.tr: phrase. 是…的原因；解释；负责；（数量或比例上）占
words.ex: The rain can account for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 下雨是延误的原因。
words.en: If a particular thing accounts for a part or proportion of something, that part or proportion consists of that thing, or is used or produced by it.

words.tr: phrase. v. 使熟悉；使了解；使认识（某人或某事）
words.ex: Let me acquaint you with the new rules.
words.ex_cn: 让我让你熟悉新规则。
words.en: To make someone familiar with or knowledgeable about something.

words.tr: phrase. 对…起作用；按...行动
words.ex: He acted on the advice and got better.
words.ex_cn: 他按照建议做了，结果好多了。
words.en: To do something as a result of information or advice received.

words.tr: phrase. 粘附；遵循；坚持
words.ex: The sticker adheres to the wall.
words.ex_cn: 贴纸粘在墙上。
words.en: If you adhere to a rule or agreement, you act in the way that it says you should.

words.tr: phrase. 突然；同时；一下子
words.ex: The lights went out all at once.
words.ex_cn: 灯一下子全灭了。
words.en: Suddenly; at the same time.

words.tr: phrase. 总计
words.ex: The savings amount to $500.
words.ex_cn: 这些储蓄加起来是500美元。
words.en: If something amounts to a particular total, all the parts of it add up to that total. If an idea, feeling, or action amounts to something, it has the same effect or importance as that thing.

words.tr: 短语动词. 向……请求……；为……向……呼吁
words.ex: They appeal to the government for help.
words.ex_cn: 他们向政府请求帮助。
words.en: to make a serious or urgent request to someone for something

words.tr: phrase. 请求；申请
words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the library.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请图书馆的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.tr: phrase. 反对…进行辩论；提出反对的理由
words.ex: He argue against the new rule at school.
words.ex_cn: 他反对学校的新规定。
words.en: To present reasons against something; to oppose or contend against in argument.

words.tr: phrase. 归因于；把……归咎于；认为……是由于
words.ex_cn: 他们相信努力工作会有回报。
words.en: If you ascribe an event or condition to a particular cause, you say or consider that it was caused by that thing.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 四处打听；向多人询问
words.ex: He asked around to find the best repair shop.
words.ex_cn: 他四处打听，想找最好的修理店。
words.en: To ask a number of people for information or help.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持自己的权利或意见；表现自信；维护自我
words.ex: He finally decided to assert himself at work.
words.ex_cn: 他终于决定在工作中表现自己。
words.en: To behave or speak in a confident and forceful way, especially in order to make sure that one's own rights or opinions are respected.

words.tr:
v. 把…联系在一起；
adj. 副的；
n. 同事；伙伴；
words.ex: He associates happiness with family time.
words.ex_cn: 他把幸福与家庭时光联系在一起。
words.en: If you associate someone or something with a particular quality or idea, or if they are associated with it, you connect them in your mind with that quality or idea.

words.tr: 短语. 价格昂贵的；备受重视的；供不应求的
words.ex: Fresh water is at a premium in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 在沙漠中，淡水非常珍贵。
words.en: If something is at a premium, it is very valuable or in short supply.

words.tr: phrase. 每时每刻；处处；在每一个转折点上
words.ex: He faced problems at every turn.
words.ex_cn: 他每时每刻都遇到问题。
words.en: If you say that something happens at every turn, you are emphasizing that it happens frequently or all the time, usually so that it prevents you from achieving what you want.

words.tr: phrase. 最后；详尽地
words.ex: He talked at length about his trip finally.
words.ex_cn: 他最后详细谈到了他的旅行。
words.en: If someone does something at length, they do it for a long time or in great detail.

words.tr: phrase. 处境危险；遭受危险
words.ex: The children are at risk without proper care.
words.ex_cn: 这些孩子如果没有适当的照顾就会有危险。
words.en: In a situation where there is a possibility of something bad happening.

words.tr: phrase. 专心；注意；照顾
words.ex: Please attend to your homework now.
words.ex_cn: 现在请专心做你的作业。
words.en: To deal with or take care of something; to give attention to someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 在……的时候；在某事发生时
words.ex: He was happy at the time of the party.
words.ex_cn: 在派对的时候，他很开心。
words.en: prep. used to indicate the specific time when something happens

words.tr: phrase. 在……的时候；当……之时
words.ex: I was cooking dinner at the time that the phone rang.
words.ex_cn: 电话响的时候，我正在做晚饭。
words.en: Used to indicate the specific time when something happened.

words.tr: phrase. 随心所欲地；随意地
words.ex: He can leave at will.
words.ex_cn: 他可以随时离开。
words.en: If you can do something at will, you can do it when you want and in the way that you want.

words.tr: phrase. 在开头时；从一开始
words.ex: At the outset, he said he would help.
words.ex_cn: 一开始，他说他会帮忙。
words.en: At the beginning of something.

words.tr: phrase. 从一开始
words.ex: He knew from the outset that it would be hard.
words.ex_cn: 他从一开始就知道这会很难。
words.en: From the very beginning; from the start.

words.tr: phrase. 重视
words.ex: He attaches importance to homework.
words.ex_cn: 他重视家庭作业。
words.en: To consider something as important or to give special attention to it.

words.tr: phrase. 吸引注意；引起关注
words.ex: The bright sign attracts attention from drivers.
words.ex_cn: 醒目的标志吸引了司机的注意。
words.en: To draw the interest or attention of someone or something.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.tr: phrase. 来回地；一来一往
words.ex: He moves back and forth between two chairs.
words.ex_cn: 他在两把椅子之间来回移动。
words.en: Moving in one direction and then in the opposite direction repeatedly.

words.tr: phrase. 不履行；食言；后退
words.ex: He decided to back out of the deal.
words.ex_cn: 他决定退出这笔交易。
words.en: If someone backs out of an agreement or a deal, they decide not to continue with it.

words.tr: phrase. 支持；经得住；打起精神；驶向下风
words.ex: She bore up during the hard times.
words.ex_cn: 她在艰难时期坚持了下来。
words.en: To bear up means to endure or withstand something difficult or painful without giving in or collapsing.

words.tr: phrase. 富于；有丰富的…
words.ex: This forest is abundant in birds and trees.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林里鸟和树很多。
words.en: To exist in large quantities or be plentiful within a specific place or context.

words.tr: phrase. 适应…的；适合…的
words.ex: The fish adapted to the cold water.
words.ex_cn: 这种鱼适应了冷水。
words.en: If something is adapted to a particular situation or purpose, it is especially suitable for it.

words.tr: phrase. 沉迷于；对…上瘾
words.ex: He is addicted to playing video games.
words.ex_cn: 他沉迷于玩电子游戏。
words.en: If someone is addicted to something, they are unable to stop doing it or using it, even though it may be harmful to them.

words.tr: adj. 足够的；
words.ex: The water supply is adequate for the village.
words.ex_cn: 供水对这个村庄来说是足够的。
words.en: If something is adequate, there is enough of it or it is good enough to be used or accepted.

words.tr: 短语. 有争议的；成为争论焦点的
words.ex: What he said is at issue.
words.ex_cn: 他说的话是争议的焦点。
words.en: To be the subject of debate or dispute.

words.tr: phrase. 毫无疑问地；确实地
words.ex: He is the best player, beyond question.
words.ex_cn: 他是最棒的球员，毫无疑问。
words.en: If something is beyond question, it is completely certain and everyone accepts it.

words.tr: phrase. 毫无疑问地；确实地
words.ex: He is beyond all question the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他无疑是队里最好的球员。
words.en: Without any doubt; certainly.

words.tr: phrase. 对…视而不见；忽视；无视（某事物）
words.ex: He is blind to his own mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他看不到自己的错误。
words.en: If you are blind to something, you are unaware of it or you ignore it.

words.tr: phrase. 一定；注定
words.ex: He is tired, so he is bound to fall asleep soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很累，所以很快就会睡着。
words.en: Certain or destined to happen; inevitably going to occur.

words.tr: phrase. 谨慎对待
words.ex: Be cautious about crossing the street without looking.
words.ex_cn: 过马路时不要不看就横穿。
words.en: To be careful or wary about something, often because it might be dangerous or risky.

words.tr: adj. 可比较的；比得上的；类似的；
words.ex: The prices of these two phones are comparable.
words.ex_cn: 这两部手机的价格是可比较的。
words.en: Something that is comparable to something else is similar in size, amount, or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 由...组成
words.ex: The team is composed of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名队员组成。
words.en: If something is composed of particular things, people, or elements, it is made from those things, people, or elements.

words.tr: phrase. 对…持批评态度的；对…苛求的
words.ex: He is critical of the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 他批评新的校规。
words.en: To express disapproval of someone or something based on perceived faults or mistakes.

words.tr: phrase. 缺乏；不足
words.ex: He is deficient in vitamin D.
words.ex_cn: 他缺乏维生素D。
words.en: to lack something that is needed or essential

words.tr: phrase. 对……不满意的；对……感到不满的
words.ex_cn: 他对他的工作不满意。
words.en: To be unhappy or not pleased with something because it is not as good as you expected or need.

words.tr: adj. 命中注定的； v. 注定；“doom”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The doomed ship sank in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 那艘命中注定的船在风暴中沉没了。
words.en: If something is doomed, it is certain to fail or be destroyed.

words.tr: phrase. 排除……的；不包括……在内
words.ex: The price quoted is exclusive of tax.
words.ex_cn: v. 报价不包括税。
words.en: To not include something; to exclude something.

words.tr: phrase. 被某人熟悉
words.ex: This song is familiar to him.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌对他来说很熟悉。
words.en: If something is familiar to you, you recognize it or know it well.

words.tr: phrase. 适合做某事的；有资格的；能够胜任的
words.ex: He is not fit to drive after drinking.
words.ex_cn: 他喝酒后不适合开车。
words.en: To be suitable or qualified for a particular role or task.

words.tr: phrase. 对…有免疫力的；不受…影响的
words.ex: She seems to be immune to any form of flattery.
words.ex_cn: 她似乎对任何形式的奉承都免疫。
words.en: To be immune to something means to be protected against it and not affected by it.

words.tr: 短语动词. 含蓄地存在于……中；暗含于……中
words.ex: His anger is implicit in his silence.
words.ex_cn: 他的愤怒隐含在他的沉默中。
words.en: To be suggested or understood without being stated directly.

words.tr: phrase. 处于危险之中
words.ex: The child is in danger near the busy road.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在繁忙的马路旁很危险。
words.en: To be in a situation where harm or loss is possible.

words.tr: 处于……的危险中；有……的危险
words.ex: If you continue to drive recklessly, you are in danger of causing an accident.
words.ex_cn: 如果你继续鲁莽驾驶，你就有可能造成事故。
words.en: To be in a situation where something bad might happen.

words.tr: phrase. 在胚胎阶段；在萌芽状态；尚未成熟的
words.ex: The project is still in embryo, but it shows great potential.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目还处于初期阶段，但显示出巨大的潜力。
words.en: In the early stages of development; not yet fully formed or realized.

words.tr: 短语. 被安置妥当；就位；准备就绪
words.ex: Make sure all the tools are in place before starting the project.
words.ex_cn: 在开始项目之前，确保所有工具都已就位。
words.en: If something is in place, it is in its correct or usual position. If it is not in place, it is not in its correct or usual position.

words.tr: phrase. 处于某人的境地；设身处地为某人着想
words.ex: If I were in your shoes, I would handle the situation differently.
words.ex_cn: v. 如果我是你，我会以不同的方式处理这种情况。
words.en: To be in someone else's position or situation, especially to understand their feelings or difficulties.

words.tr: phrase. 倾向于
words.ex: He is inclined to wake up early.
words.ex_cn: 他倾向于早起。
words.en: If you are inclined to do something, you want to do it or you are likely to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 表明……的；是……的征兆；显示……的
words.ex: Her behavior is often indicative of her true feelings.
words.ex_cn: 她的行为常常表明她的真实感受。
words.en: To be a sign of something; to suggest or show that something is likely to be true.

words.tr: phrase. 在……中起重要作用的；对……有帮助的
words.ex: His research was instrumental in the development of new medical treatments.
words.ex_cn: 他的研究在新医疗方法的开发中起到了重要作用。
words.en: To be a key factor in achieving something.

words.tr: phrase. 专心致志于……的；决心要做……的
words.ex_cn: 他决心通过考试。
words.en: To be determined or eager to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 不论；不管；不顾
words.ex: We will proceed irrespective of the cost.
words.ex_cn: 我们将继续进行，无论成本如何。
words.en: without considering; regardless of

words.tr: adj. 偏远的；隔离的；孤独的； v. 使隔离；“isolate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The village is isolated, far from any city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄很偏远，远离任何城市。
words.en: If something is isolated, it is far away from other places, buildings, or people.

words.tr: phrase. 对……感到紧张的；对……感到焦虑的
words.ex_cn: 他对于数学考试感到紧张。
words.en: To feel anxious or worried about something that is going to happen or might happen.

words.tr: phrase. 偏离轨道；离题；误入歧途；出错
words.ex: His comments quickly went off the track during the interview.
words.ex_cn: 他在采访中很快就开始离题了。
words.en: Deviating from the correct or expected course or topic.

words.tr: 短语动词. 保持警惕；随时注意（危险或机会）
words.ex: We should always be on the alert for potential dangers.
words.ex_cn: 我们应时刻警惕潜在的危险。
words.en: To be vigilant or ready to deal with possible danger or difficulty.

words.tr: phrase. 开放；易受到；易遭受
words.ex_cn: 他愿意接受新想法。
words.en: To be willing to consider or accept something.

words.tr: adj. 乐观的
words.ex: He is optimistic about the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来持乐观态度。
words.en: Someone who is optimistic is hopeful about the future or the success of something in particular.

words.tr: phrase. 倾向于；易于
words.ex: He is prone to making small mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他容易犯小错误。
words.en: If someone is prone to something, they are likely to do it or experience it.

words.tr: phrase. 不情愿做某事的；勉强的；不愿的
words.ex: He is reluctant to speak in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他不愿意在全班面前说话。
words.en: If you are reluctant to do something, you are unwilling to do it and hesitate before doing it, or do it slowly and without enthusiasm.

words.tr: phrase. 对…敏感
words.ex: He is sensitive to loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 他对大声响很敏感。
words.en: To be easily affected or influenced by something, especially in a way that is not desired.

words.tr: phrase. 被困在……中；陷于（某种情况）
words.ex: He is stuck in traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他被困在交通堵塞中。
words.en: To be unable to move or to be fixed in a particular position or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 易受影响的；易受感染的；易受诱惑的
words.ex_cn: 孩子在冬天容易感冒。
words.en: Easily influenced, affected, or harmed by something; vulnerable.

words.tr: phrase. 对…持怀疑态度的；怀疑…有问题的
words.ex_cn: 他怀疑那个陌生人的微笑。
words.en: To think that someone might be guilty of doing something wrong or dishonest.

words.tr: phrase. 对…宽容的；容忍的
words.ex: She had to be tolerant of his bad temper.
words.ex_cn: 她不得不忍受他的坏脾气。
words.en: To accept the existence of opinions or behavior that one does not like.

words.tr: phrase. 不知道……的；未意识到……的
words.ex_cn: 他不知道这个错误。
words.en: If you are unaware of something, you do not know about it.

words.tr: adj. 不熟悉的；陌生的；
words.ex: The town looked unfamiliar to him.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇对他来说很陌生。
words.en: If something is unfamiliar to you, you know nothing or very little about it, because you have not seen or experienced it before.

words.tr: phrase. 对……感到厌倦的；提防……的；对……失去耐心的
words.ex: After hours of walking, I began to be weary of the journey.
words.ex_cn: v. 走了几个小时后，我开始对这次旅行感到厌倦。
words.en: To be tired of or lose interest in something because you have experienced too much of it.

words.tr: phrase. 值得……的；应得某种待遇或评价的
words.ex_cn: 这幅画配得上博物馆。
words.en: To be deserving of something, often due to merit or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 行为规矩
words.ex: The teacher asked the children to behave themselves during the trip.
words.ex_cn: 老师要求孩子们在旅行期间要守规矩。
words.en: To conduct oneself in a specified way, especially in a way that is socially acceptable.

words.tr: phrase. 难以形容的；无法描述的；超出言语表达的
words.ex: The beauty of the sunset was beyond description.
words.ex_cn: 日落的美景难以形容。
words.en: If you say that something is beyond description, you mean that it is very difficult to describe because it is so extreme or so unusual.

words.tr: phrase. 因某事责备某人
words.ex: He blames his brother for breaking the vase.
words.ex_cn: 他责怪他弟弟打碎了花瓶。
words.en: To hold someone responsible for a fault or wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 脱离；摆脱
words.ex: He tried to break away from his old habits.
words.ex_cn: 他试图摆脱旧习惯。
words.en: To leave or escape from a group, place, or situation, especially in order to start something new or different.

words.tr: phrase. 打碎；分裂；解体；结束；期终放假
words.ex: He broke up the ice with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子把冰打碎了。
words.en: To end a relationship or to disintegrate into pieces.

words.tr: phrase. 溢出；充满到溢出；感情等洋溢
words.ex: The cup will brim over if you add more water.
words.ex_cn: 如果你再加点水，杯子就会溢出来。
words.en: To overflow or to be filled to the point of overflowing.

words.tr: 短语动词。充满，溢出（常用于情感或液体）；形容感情或内容非常充沛，达到满溢的程度
words.ex: The cup will brim over with water if you add more.
words.ex_cn: 如果你再加水，杯子就会溢出来。
words.en: To be so full of something that it begins to spill over the edge.

words.tr: v. 沉思；闷闷不乐地想；n. 一窝幼崽；沉思的状态
words.ex: He sits by the window and broods over his failures.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在窗边，为自己的失败而忧思。
words.en: If someone broods over something, they think about it a lot, seriously and often unhappily. A brood is a group of young birds all born at the same time to the same mother.

words.tr: phrase. 担心地思考；忧郁地沉思（某事）
words.ex: He likes to brood over his problems instead of solving them.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢为自己的问题烦恼，而不是解决它们。
words.en: If someone broods over something, they think about it a lot, seriously and often unhappily.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；逐步增长；加强
words.ex: He builds up his strength by running every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天跑步来增强体力。
words.en: To increase or develop something gradually; to accumulate or amass something over time.

words.tr:
conj. 但是；然而；
prep. 除…以外；
adv. 只能；仅仅；
words.ex: I like apples, but I don't like oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果，但是我不喜欢橙子。
words.en: used to introduce a phrase or clause contrasting with what has already been mentioned

words.tr: phrase. v. 忙碌奔波；四处走动；嗡嗡地飞来飞去
words.ex: The kids buzz around the park all afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们整个下午都在公园里忙碌地跑来跑去。
words.en: If there is a buzz around something, there is a lot of excitement or discussion about it.

words.tr: phrase. 四处谈论；议论纷纷；忙于奔波
words.ex: People are buzzing about the new movie.
words.ex_cn: 人们在热议这部新电影。
words.en: To move or act quickly and energetically; to be filled with a lot of activity or excitement.

words.tr: phrase. 名叫…的
words.ex: She introduced herself by the name of Lily.
words.ex_cn: 她以莉莉的名义介绍了自己。
words.en: used to indicate the name of a person or thing

words.tr: phrase. 通过类比；类推地
words.ex: We can understand this concept by analogy with something familiar.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以通过类比熟悉的事物来理解这个概念。
words.en: Used to introduce an explanation or comparison that is based on a similarity between two things.

words.tr: phrase. 熟记
words.ex: He knows the poem by heart.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首诗背得滚瓜烂熟。
words.en: If you know something by heart, you have learned it so well that you can remember it perfectly.

words.tr: phrase. 用…的方法；借助…
words.ex: He cleaned the floor by means of a mop.
words.ex_cn: 他用拖把打扫了地板。
words.en: If you do something by means of a particular method, instrument, or process, you do it using that method, instrument, or process.

words.tr: phrase. 就其本质而言；天生地
words.ex: He is by nature a quiet person.
words.ex_cn: 他天性安静。
words.en: If someone has a particular quality by nature, they have it as a natural part of their character.

words.tr: phrase. 由于；因为
words.ex: He was excused by reason of his illness.
words.ex_cn: 他因病被原谅了。
words.en: Because of; due to.

words.tr: phrase. 同样地；同样道理；由于同样的原因
words.ex: He likes coffee; by the same token, he also likes tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡；同样地，他也喜欢茶。
words.en: used to mean that something you are about to say is also true, for the same reasons as what has just been said

words.tr: phrase. 凭借…的力量；由于
words.ex: He passed the test by virtue of his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他凭借努力学习通过了考试。
words.en: Because of or as a result of something.

words.tr: 短语动词，指打电话询问或讨论某事；因某事而打电话联系
words.ex: He will call about the job tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会打电话询问工作的事。
words.en: To contact someone by phone regarding a specific matter.

words.tr: phrase. 雕刻；开凿；开拓；用辛勤的劳动创造出…
words.ex: He carved out a bird from wood.
words.ex_cn: 他从木头上雕刻出一只鸟。
words.en: to create or obtain something that helps you by skillful activities

words.tr: phrasal verb. 分割；瓜分；分配（通常指将某物分成几部分，尤指领土、市场或财产）
words.ex: They carve up the cake for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他们把蛋糕切开用于派对。
words.en: To divide something into parts, especially in a way that is considered unfair or selfish.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 阐明；使（问题等）较容易理解；揭示
words.ex: The new study helps to cast light on why birds migrate in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这项新研究有助于阐明鸟类为什么在冬天迁徙。
words.en: To provide information that helps to explain or make something clear.

words.tr: phrase. v. 阐明；使（问题或情况）更清楚
words.ex: The new evidence cast light upon the mystery.
words.ex_cn: 新证据揭示了这个谜团。
words.en: To make something clearer or easier to understand by providing more information or explanation.

words.tr: phrase. 与……核实；向……确认
words.ex: I will check with my teacher about the homework.
words.ex_cn: 我会向老师确认一下作业。
words.en: To consult someone or something in order to confirm or verify information.

words.tr: phrase. 取缔；施加压力
words.ex: The government clamped down on illegal street markets.
words.ex_cn: 政府取缔了非法街头市场。
words.en: To take strong action to stop or limit a particular type of activity, especially one that is illegal or harmful.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 对…进行严厉压制；遏制；加强管制
words.ex: The government decided to clamp down on illegal activities.
words.ex_cn: 政府决定打击非法活动。
words.en: Suppress or restrict something firmly, especially in a harsh or decisive way.

words.tr: phrase. 打扫干净；收拾整洁
words.ex: They clean up the room every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每星期六打扫房间。
words.en: To make a place or thing clean and tidy by removing dirt, rubbish, or unwanted items.

words.tr: phrase. 紧附；紧抓；坚持
words.ex: He still clings to his old beliefs.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然坚持自己的旧信念。
words.en: To hold on tightly to something or someone, either physically or emotionally, often because of fear, love, or a strong desire.

words.tr: phrase. 符合；与...一致
words.ex: His opinion coincides with mine.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点与我的一致。
words.en: To happen at the same time as something else or to be the same or very similar.

words.tr: phrase. 与…相撞；相碰
words.ex: The car collided with a tree.
words.ex_cn: 汽车撞上了一棵树。
words.en: To collide with something means to crash into it or come into conflict with it.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 分离；散架；崩溃；瓦解
words.ex: The toy car came apart when I dropped it.
words.ex_cn: 我的玩具车掉下来的时候散架了。
words.en: If something comes apart, it breaks into pieces or parts.

words.tr: phrase. 离开；脱落；走开
words.ex: They come away from the meeting early.
words.ex_cn: 他们早早地离开了会议。
words.en: To leave a place or situation, or to become detached or separated from something.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 离开，脱离（某人或某物）
words.ex: He came away from the meeting with new ideas.
words.ex_cn: 他从会议中获得了一些新想法。
words.en: To leave or separate from a place or situation.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 介入…之间；离间；妨碍（关系或进程）
words.ex: He tried to come between them, but failed.
words.ex_cn: 他试图离间他们，但失败了。
words.en: To prevent people from having a good relationship with each other.

words.tr: phrase. v. 获得；设法得到；顺道来访
words.ex: I came by some old books at the flea market.
words.ex_cn: 我在跳蚤市场弄到了一些旧书。
words.en: To obtain or acquire something, especially something that is not easily available.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 下来；下降；流传；病倒
words.ex: The price of apples came down last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周苹果的价格降了。
words.en: To move or travel from a higher to a lower level or position; to descend.

words.tr: phrase. 接触
words.ex: He came in contact with the virus last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周接触到了病毒。
words.en: To meet or communicate with someone or something, especially for the first time.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 受到（批评、赞扬等）；招致
words.ex: He came in for criticism after the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他因这个错误而受到了批评。
words.en: If someone or something comes in for criticism, blame, or praise, they receive it.

words.tr: phrase. 开始存在；成立
words.ex: The universe came into existence billions of years ago.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙在数十亿年前开始存在。
words.en: To begin to exist; to be created or formed.

words.tr: phrase. 离开；举行；实现；成功；从…掉下
words.ex: He will come off the train at the next station.
words.ex_cn: 他将在下一站下车。
words.en: To happen or occur, especially in a particular way; to be successful or effective.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 推出（新产品）；发表（言论）；说出（想法）
words.ex: The company is expected to come out with a new product next month.
words.ex_cn: v. 公司预计下个月将发布一款新产品。
words.en: To introduce or make known to the public, especially a new product or idea.

words.tr: phrase. 过来；顺便来访；改变立场；突然感觉；显得
words.ex: Come over to my house after school.
words.ex_cn: 放学后到我家来。
words.en: To move or travel towards someone or something, especially in order to visit them.

words.tr: phrase. 遭难；吃亏；出事；失败
words.ex: He didn't study for the exam and came to grief.
words.ex_cn: 他没有为考试学习，结果失败了。
words.en: To experience failure, misfortune, or an accident.

words.tr: phrase. 恢复理智；清醒过来；醒悟
words.ex: After the argument, he came to his senses and said sorry.
words.ex_cn: 争吵之后，他醒悟过来并道了歉。
words.en: To start to think clearly and behave sensibly again after a period of confusion or irrationality.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 面对；遭遇（困难、反对等）
words.ex: He came up against a big problem while solving the math question.
words.ex_cn: 他在解这道数学题时遇到了一个大问题。
words.en: To encounter or face difficulties or opposition.

words.tr: phrase. 赶上；提出；想出
words.ex: He ran fast to come up with the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: If you come up with a plan, idea, or solution, you think of it and suggest it.

words.tr: phrase. 遵守；照做；依从
words.ex: You must comply with the rules.
words.ex_cn: 你必须遵守规则。
words.en: To act in accordance with a wish, command, or rule.

words.tr: phrase. 想像；设想
words.ex: It's difficult to conceive of a world without music.
words.ex_cn: 很难想象一个没有音乐的世界。
words.en: To form a mental representation or idea of something.

words.tr: v. 授予；赋予；
words.ex: The university conferred an honorary degree on him.
words.ex_cn: 大学授予他一个荣誉学位。
words.en: To confer something such as a degree or an honor on someone means to give it to them in a formal way. To confer with someone means to discuss something with them in order to make a decision.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 向……吐露（秘密、心事等）；信任某人并与其分享私事
words.ex: She could always confide in her best friend.
words.ex_cn: 她总是可以信赖她最好的朋友。
words.en: If you confide in someone, you tell them a secret.

words.tr: phrase. 符合；遵守
words.ex: He must conform to the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 他必须遵守校规。
words.en: To comply with rules, standards, or laws; to behave according to socially acceptable conventions or standards.

words.tr: phrase. 符合，与……一致；遵守（规定、标准等）
words.ex: He must conform with the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 他必须遵守校规。
words.en: To comply with rules, standards, or laws; to be similar in form or type.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 策划；编造；临时凑成
words.ex: She decided to cook up a story to explain her absence.
words.ex_cn: 她决定编造一个故事来解释她的缺席。
words.en: If someone cooks up a story or excuse, they invent it, often to deceive someone.

words.tr: phrase. v. 冷静下来；使冷却；（使）平息怒气
words.ex: He needs to cool off after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争吵后需要冷静一下。
words.en: To become less hot, or to make something less hot; to become calmer or less excited.

words.tr: phrase. 应付；处理
words.ex: He tries to cope with stress by walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天散步来应对压力。
words.en: To deal effectively with something difficult.

words.tr: v. （使）相互关联
words.ex: The data points correlate with each other.
words.ex_cn: 这些数据点相互关联。
words.en: If one thing correlates with another, there is a close similarity or connection between them, often because one thing causes the other.

words.tr: phrase. 与……相关联；与……相互关联
words.ex: Sleep quality often correlates with how well a student does in school.
words.ex_cn: 睡眠质量通常与学生在学校的表现相关。
words.en: If one thing correlates with another, there is a close similarity or connection between them, often because one thing causes the other.

words.tr: phrase. 掩盖
words.ex: He tried to cover up his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他试图掩盖自己的错误。
words.en: To conceal something, especially a mistake or a crime, by hiding it or by pretending that it does not exist.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （物体）倒塌，崩塌；（声音）突然响起
words.ex: The tree will crash down in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 那棵树会在暴风雨中轰然倒下。
words.en: To fall or collapse suddenly and noisily, often with destructive consequences.

words.tr: phrase. 闯入；撞上
words.ex: The car crashed into the tree.
words.ex_cn: 汽车撞上了树。
words.en: To collide with something forcefully.

words.tr: phrase. 贡献；促成；导致；有助于
words.ex: Volunteers contribute to the clean-up of the park.
words.ex_cn: 志愿者们为公园的清洁做出了贡献。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.tr: phrase. 依靠；指望
words.ex: I can count on my brother to help me.
words.ex_cn: 我可以依靠我哥哥帮我。
words.en: If you count on someone or something, you rely on them to support you or help you.

words.tr: phrase. 打断；侵入；削减
words.ex: He cut into the conversation to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他打断了对话来问一个问题。
words.en: To interrupt or penetrate something, often abruptly or forcefully.

words.tr: phrase. 中途打断；突然终止
words.ex: He cut short his trip because of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他因为风暴而缩短了旅行。
words.en: To terminate or abbreviate something before it is completed or fully developed.

words.tr: phrase. 匆忙完成；匆忙离开
words.ex: He can dash off a quick message before the meeting starts.
words.ex_cn: 他可以在会议开始前匆匆写个消息。
words.en: To write or draw something quickly or carelessly; to leave quickly.

words.tr: phrase. 追溯到
words.ex: This castle dates back to the 12th century.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡可以追溯到12世纪。
words.en: If something dates back to a particular time, it started or was made at that time.

words.tr: phrase.  献（身）于…；把（时间、精力等）用于…
words.ex: He dedicates to helping poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他献身于帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: To give a lot of your time and effort to a particular activity or purpose because you think it is important.

words.tr: v. 防御；辩护；
words.ex: The soldiers defend their country from enemies.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们保卫自己的国家免受敌人入侵。
words.en: To defend means to protect someone or something from attack, harm, or criticism. It can also involve arguing in support of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 剥夺，使丧失（某物）
words.ex: The storm deprived him of his power.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴使他失去了电力。
words.en: To take something away from someone or something; to prevent someone from having something.

words.tr: phrase. 起源于...； 由...传下来
words.ex: This village descends from a small fishing town.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄起源于一个小型渔村。
words.en: To have a particular person or group as your ancestors.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 突然造访；大批涌入；降临于
words.ex: The tourists will descend on the small town during the festival.
words.ex_cn: 节日期间，游客们将蜂拥而至这个小镇。
words.en: If a group of people descend on a place or person, they arrive, often unexpectedly or in large numbers.

words.tr: phrase. descend to 意为‘下降到；堕落到’，常指地位、道德水平或行为方式上的降低
words.ex: The plane will descend to 10,000 feet.
words.ex_cn: 飞机将下降到一万英尺。
words.en: To move or be reduced to a lower level or state, often morally or socially.

words.tr: phrase. 从…分离；拆卸
words.ex: He wants to detach from his phone and enjoy the moment.
words.ex_cn: 他想放下手机，享受当下。
words.en: To separate something from the thing it is attached to.

words.tr: phrase. 偏离；背离（通常指偏离常规、计划或标准）
words.ex: He did not deviate from the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他没有偏离计划。
words.en: To deviate from something means to start doing something different from what is expected or from what has been agreed.

words.tr: phrase. 因某事（病以外）而死
words.ex: He died from a car accident.
words.ex_cn: 他因车祸去世。
words.en: If someone dies from a particular cause, that cause is the reason for their death.

words.tr: phrase.  灭绝；逐渐消失
words.ex: Many old traditions die out over time.
words.ex_cn: 许多古老的传统随着时间推移而消失。
words.en: If something dies out, it becomes less and less common and eventually disappears completely.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 向下挖；深入探究
words.ex: They dig down to find the old coins.
words.ex_cn: 他们向下挖以找到旧硬币。
words.en: To make a thorough investigation or to search deeply for something.

words.tr: phrase. 区分，辨别……之间的差异
words.ex: Can you differentiate between a cat and a dog?
words.ex_cn: 你能区分猫和狗吗？
words.en: To recognize or ascertain what makes (someone or something) different.

words.tr: phrase. 不赞成；反对
words.ex: My parents disapprove of me staying out late.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母不赞成我熬夜到很晚。
words.en: If you disapprove of something or someone, you feel or show that you do not like them or do not approve of them.

words.tr: phrase. 歧视；不公平地对待
words.ex: They should not discriminate against people because of their skin color.
words.ex_cn: 他们不应该因为肤色而歧视他人。
words.en: If someone discriminates against a person or group, they treat them unfairly because of their race, sex, or some other characteristic.

words.tr: phrase. 区分，辨别；区别对待
words.ex: It's important to discriminate between right and wrong.
words.ex_cn: 能够区分对错是很重要的。
words.en: To recognize or perceive the difference between things.

words.tr: phrase. 免除；省掉；没有也行
words.ex: He decided to dispense with the formal dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他决定取消正式的晚宴。
words.en: If you dispense with something, you stop using it or get rid of it, usually because you no longer need it.

words.tr: phrase. 处理好；处置掉；除掉
words.ex: Please dispose of the trash before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在离开前处理好垃圾。
words.en: To get rid of something that you no longer want or need.

words.tr: phrase. v. 逃跑；溜走；突然离开（尤指为逃避责任或债务）
words.ex: He did a bunk from school yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天逃学了。
words.en: If someone does a bunk, they leave a place suddenly and secretly, often to avoid trouble or to escape from a situation.

words.tr: phrase. 打瞌睡；打盹儿
words.ex: He started to doze off during the boring meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在无聊的会议上开始打瞌睡了。
words.en: To fall into a light sleep, especially unintentionally.

words.tr: phrase. v. 拖延；冗长持续
words.ex: The meeting will drag on if we don't stop talking.
words.ex_cn: 如果我们不停止讲话，会议会拖很久。
words.en: If an event or situation drags on, it continues for longer than necessary or longer than you want.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 拖延；费力地拉出；使（事件、过程）冗长
words.ex: Don't drag out the meeting; we all want to go home.
words.ex_cn: 不要把会议拖得太久；我们都想回家。
words.en: To make something last longer than necessary.

words.tr: 短语动词. 引起对某事物的注意；使关注某事
words.ex: The campaign is designed to draw attention to the plight of the homeless.
words.ex_cn: 这个活动的目的是引起人们对无家可归者困境的关注。
words.en: To make people notice something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 将某人的注意力引向某事；使某人注意到某物
words.ex: The teacher drew the students' attention to the blackboard.
words.ex_cn: 老师让学生们注意黑板。
words.en: To make someone notice or be aware of something.

words.tr: phrase. 赶走；驱散
words.ex: The loud noise will drive away the birds.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音会把鸟吓跑。
words.en: To force someone or something to leave a place.

words.tr: phrase. 顺便走访
words.ex: I might drop in at your house this evening.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚可能会顺便去你家。
words.en: To visit someone informally and often without notice.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 掩盖，盖过（声音）；使…听不见
words.ex: The music was so loud it could drown out the talking.
words.ex_cn: 音乐声太大了，能把说话声盖住。
words.en: to be louder than another sound so that it cannot be heard

words.tr: phrase. 干透； 戒酒
words.ex: The clothes will dry out in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 衣服在阳光下会晾干。
words.en: To remove the moisture from something or to stop drinking alcohol after a period of heavy drinking.

words.tr: phrase. v. 老是想着；过分关注（某事）； dwelling on 指反复思考或谈论不愉快的事
words.ex: He doesn't dwell on his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他不会纠结于自己的错误。
words.en: If you dwell on something, especially something unpleasant, you think, speak, or write about it a lot or for quite a long time.

words.tr: phrase. v. 仔细思考；详述；耽搁于
words.ex: He won't dwell upon the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他不会一直纠结于那个错误。
words.en: If you dwell on something, especially something unpleasant, you think, speak, or write about it a lot or for quite a long time.

words.tr: phrase. 谋生；维持生计
words.ex: He earns a living by driving a taxi.
words.ex_cn: 他靠开出租车谋生。
words.en: To earn a living means to make enough money to support oneself, typically through employment or business.

words.tr: phrase. 吃光
words.ex: The dog ate up all the food.
words.ex_cn: 狗把所有的食物都吃光了。
words.en: To consume all of something, especially food.

words.tr: phrase. 涨落；兴衰；起伏（指事物像潮水一样有规律地变化）
words.ex: The ebb and flow of the tide changes every day.
words.ex_cn: 潮水的涨落每天都在变化。
words.en: The alternating movement or fluctuation between two states, levels, or conditions, often used metaphorically to describe the rise and fall of fortunes, feelings, or the natural cycle of things.

words.tr: phrase. 赋予，赐予（某人或某物以特质、能力、财产等）
words.ex: The teacher endowed the student with great confidence.
words.ex_cn: 老师赋予了这名学生极大的信心。
words.en: To provide with a quality, ability, or asset.

words.tr: 短语动词. 注册参加；登记入学；加入（课程、学校等）
words.ex: He will enroll in English class next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将报名参加英语课。
words.en: To officially register or join a course, program, or institution.

words.tr: v. 注册；
words.ex: He will enroll in the English course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将注册英语课程。
words.en: To officially register or enlist oneself or someone else in a course, institution, or organization.

words.tr: 短语动词. 宁可……也不愿冒险；倾向于某一方面（通常指安全、谨慎或宽容等）
words.ex: It's better to err on the side of caution.
words.ex_cn: 宁可多加小心，也不要冒险。
words.en: If you err on the side of a particular quality, you show more of it than is necessary, in order to avoid showing too little.

words.tr: phrase. 被免除的，豁免的（指被免除某种义务、责任或费用等）
words.ex: Students under 18 are exempt from paying the fee.
words.ex_cn: 18岁以下的学生免于支付费用。
words.en: If someone or something is exempt from a particular rule, duty, or obligation, they do not have to follow it or do it.

words.tr: phrase. 跌落；下降
words.ex: The book fell off the table.
words.ex_cn: 书从桌子上掉了下来。
words.en: If something falls off, it becomes detached from something to which it was attached.

words.tr: phrase. 成为...的牺牲品；受...的侵害；屈服于...
words.ex: Many businesses fall prey to fraudulent schemes.
words.ex_cn: 许多企业成为欺诈计划的受害者。
words.en: To become a victim of something harmful or undesirable.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 未能达到；不足；不够
words.ex: He fell short of the target score.
words.ex_cn: 他没能达到目标分数。
words.en: To not reach the standard or level that is expected or required.

words.tr: phrase. 袭击；由…承担
words.ex: The robbers fell on the old man at night.
words.ex_cn: 抢劫者在夜里袭击了那位老人。
words.en: If a duty, responsibility, or opportunity falls on someone, it is their duty, responsibility, or opportunity to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 袭击；由…承担
words.ex: The robbers fell upon the old man at night.
words.ex_cn: 抢劫者在夜里袭击了那位老人。
words.en: To happen to someone or something, especially something unpleasant, or to attack someone or something suddenly.

words.tr: n. 反馈
words.ex: The teacher gave me feedback on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我关于我作文的反馈。
words.en: Feedback is comments in the form of opinions about and reactions to something, intended to provide useful information for future decisions and development.

words.tr: phrase. 感受到经济压力；感到拮据
words.ex: Many families are beginning to feel the pinch due to the rising cost of living.
words.ex_cn: 许多家庭由于生活成本的上升开始感到经济压力。
words.en: To experience financial difficulties or hardship, often due to a lack of money.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （某人或某物）最终到达（某处）；突然出现；被冲上岸
words.ex: He fetched up the old book from the basement.
words.ex_cn: 他从地下室取出了那本旧书。
words.en: To arrive or end up somewhere, often unexpectedly or after a journey.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 抑制，压下（情绪或冲动）
words.ex: She had to fight down her anger to speak calmly.
words.ex_cn: 她不得不压抑住自己的愤怒，以便平静地说话。
words.en: to struggle to suppress or control something, such as an emotion or impulse

words.tr: phrase. v. 击退；抵御；摆脱（疾病、攻击等）
words.ex: He tried to fight off the cold with hot soup.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用热汤抵御感冒。
words.en: To fight off means to resist or repel someone or something in a physical or metaphorical sense.

words.tr: n. 档案；
words.ex: He stored the documents in a metal file.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件存放在一个金属档案盒里。
words.en: A file is a box or folded piece of heavy paper or plastic in which letters or documents are kept. As a verb, to file means to put documents in a file or to officially record something.

words.tr: phrase. 结束；完成；干掉
words.ex: He will finish off the homework tonight.
words.ex_cn: 他今晚会完成作业。
words.en: To complete the last part of something; to kill someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 结束；完成；用光
words.ex: We need to finish up our homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们得在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: to complete something or come to the end of an activity

words.tr: phrase. 非常健康的；身体极佳的
words.ex: After a month of regular exercise, she was fit as a fiddle.
words.ex_cn: 经过一个月的定期锻炼，她非常健康。
words.en: In very good health.

words.tr: phrase. 自鸣得意；自以为是；自欺地认为
words.ex: He likes to flatter himself by saying he is the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢自夸说他是队里最棒的球员。
words.en: If you flatter yourself that something good is true about you, you believe it about yourself, perhaps wrongly.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 快速翻阅；浏览（书籍、杂志等）
words.ex: He flicked through the book while waiting.
words.ex_cn: 他等待时快速翻阅了这本书。
words.en: To flick through something means to look quickly at the pages of a book, magazine, etc., without reading everything.

words.tr: phrase. 弄糟；搞砸；使混乱
words.ex: He will foul up the exam if he doesn't study.
words.ex_cn: 如果他不学习，他会把考试搞砸。
words.en: To make a mistake or to cause something to go wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 从…释放出来；使摆脱；免于；不受影响
words.ex: The water is free from pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这种水没有污染。
words.en: To release or liberate someone or something from a particular constraint or problem.

words.tr: phrase. 从头开始；从零开始
words.ex: He built the website from scratch.
words.ex_cn: 他从零开始搭建了这个网站。
words.en: If you do something from scratch, you do it without making use of anything that has been done before.

words.tr: phrase. 获得动力
words.ex: The car starts to gain momentum going down the hill.
words.ex_cn: 汽车下山时开始加速。
words.en: To gain momentum means to start to happen or develop more quickly, or to become more popular or successful.

words.tr: phrase. 聚集力量
words.ex: The campaign began to gather momentum after the first debate.
words.ex_cn: v. 第一次辩论后，竞选活动开始积聚动力。
words.en: To gather momentum means to gradually increase in speed, strength, or importance.

words.tr: phrase. 赌博输掉；挥霍掉（金钱、机会等）
words.ex: He gambled away all his money at the casino.
words.ex_cn: 他在赌场把所有的钱都赌光了。
words.en: To lose something valuable, especially money, by gambling.

words.tr: phrase. 领会；贿赂；查明；够到
words.ex: I don't know what you are getting at.
words.ex_cn: 我不明白你到底想表达什么。
words.en: If you ask someone what they are getting at, you are asking them to explain what they mean, usually because you think they are being unpleasant or are suggesting something that is untrue.

words.tr: phrase. 逃脱；离开；度假
words.ex: The thief tried to get away from the police.
words.ex_cn: 小偷试图逃脱警察。
words.en: If you get away, you succeed in leaving a place or a person's company. If you get away with something, you succeed in doing it without being caught or punished.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；陷入；染上（坏习惯）
words.ex: He wants to get into a good university.
words.ex_cn: 他想进入一所好大学。
words.en: To enter or become involved in a particular activity, situation, or state.

words.tr: phrase. 胜过，击败，占上风
words.ex: He always manages to get the best of any argument.
words.ex_cn: 他总是能在任何争论中占上风。
words.en: To gain an advantage over someone or something, often after a struggle or competition.

words.tr: 短语动词. 占上风；处于有利地位；过得比别人好
words.ex: They have the best of both worlds: a good job and a happy family.
words.ex_cn: 他们两全其美：有一份好工作和一个幸福的家庭。
words.en: To gain the advantage or victory in a contest or argument.

words.tr: phrase. v. 给予自由发挥的空间；放任，纵容（某人或某种情感）
words.ex: She decided to give rein to her emotions and let herself cry.
words.ex_cn: 她决定放纵自己的情感，让自己哭出来。
words.en: To allow someone to do what they want or to behave as they wish, without trying to control them.

words.tr: phrase. 对…听之任之，放手让…自由发挥（通常指情感或行为）
words.ex: The manager decided to give free rein to the team's creativity.
words.ex_cn: 经理决定放手让团队的创造力自由发展。
words.en: To allow someone complete freedom to act as they wish.

words.tr: phrase. 赠送；分发；背叛；泄露
words.ex: He will give away his old books to the library.
words.ex_cn: 他将把他的旧书捐给图书馆。
words.en: To give something to someone without asking for payment, or to reveal something secret or private.

words.tr: phrase. 认为…优先
words.ex: The school gives priority to students who need extra help.
words.ex_cn: 学校优先照顾需要额外帮助的学生。
words.en: To treat something as more important than others.

words.tr: phrase. 赋予……形状；使成形；使具体化
words.ex: He tried to give shape to his ideas.
words.ex_cn: 他试图使他的想法成形。
words.en: To give a clear, definite form or structure to an idea or plan.

words.tr: phrase. v. 发泄，表达（情绪、感情等）
words.ex: He gave vent to his anger by shouting loudly.
words.ex_cn: 他通过大声喊叫来发泄愤怒。
words.en: To express or release (a strong emotion, such as anger) in a forceful way.

words.tr: phrase. 怒视；瞪眼看着
words.ex: He glares at the boy because the boy took his pencil.
words.ex_cn: 他怒视那个男孩，因为男孩拿了他的铅笔。
words.en: To look at someone or something in an angry way.

words.tr: phrase. 闪耀着……；充满……（光或情感）
words.ex: Her eyes gleam with excitement when she sees the gift.
words.ex_cn: 当她看到礼物时，眼睛里闪烁着兴奋的光芒。
words.en: To shine with a soft, steady light or to show a quality such as happiness or excitement.

words.tr: phrase. 前进；继续；进行
words.ex: Go ahead, the path is clear.
words.ex_cn: 前进吧，路是畅通的。
words.en: To proceed or continue with something without hesitation.

words.tr: 动词短语. 走下坡路；情况恶化；衰退
words.ex: After he stopped exercising, his health began to go downhill.
words.ex_cn: 他停止锻炼后，健康状况开始恶化。
words.en: To deteriorate or become worse in condition, quality, or performance.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 进入；参加；参与
words.ex: He wants to go in the room.
words.ex_cn: 他想进房间。
words.en: To enter or participate in something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 开始行动；投入行动；开始发挥作用
words.ex: The army will go into action at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 军队将在黎明时分投入战斗。
words.en: To begin to act or operate; to start doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 爆炸；离去；响起
words.ex: The firework went off at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 烟花在午夜爆炸了。
words.en: If a device or alarm goes off, it starts to ring loudly or make a loud noise. To leave a place, especially in order to do something. To happen in a particular way. To stop liking someone or something. To explode or fire. To decay or become rotten.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 坚持完成；贯彻到底；把…进行到底（尤指困难或不愉快的事）
words.ex: He decided to go through with the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他决定坚持执行这个计划。
words.en: To complete or carry out something, especially something that is difficult or unpleasant.

words.tr: 短语动词. 走极端；采取极端措施
words.ex: She tends to go to extremes when dieting, either eating too much or not at all.
words.ex_cn: 她在节食时往往走极端，要么吃得太多，要么一点也不吃。
words.en: To act or be forced to act in a way that is far from moderate or normal, often to achieve a goal or express an opinion.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 情绪崩溃；失去控制；瓦解
words.ex: He goes to pieces when he sees a spider.
words.ex_cn: 他一看到蜘蛛就崩溃了。
words.en: To become so upset or nervous that you cannot control yourself or think clearly.

words.tr: phrase. 伴随；与...相配；同…一致
words.ex: I will go with you to the market.
words.ex_cn: 我会和你一起去市场。
words.en: To be suitable or appropriate with something; to accompany something; to exist or occur together with something.

words.tr: phrase. 哀悼；缅怀；感到悲痛
words.ex: He grieves for his lost dog every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在为他失去的狗而悲伤。
words.en: To feel or express deep sorrow or distress, especially because of someone's death or a great loss.

words.tr: phrase. 为……而悲痛；为……感到伤心
words.ex: He grieves over his lost pet every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在为失去的宠物悲伤。
words.en: To feel deep sorrow or distress over a loss or misfortune.

words.tr: phrase. 摸索；费力地寻找；试图找到（答案、措辞等）
words.ex: He is grope for the right words to say.
words.ex_cn: 他正摸索着想说合适的话。
words.en: To search blindly or uncertainly for something.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 摸索前进；四处摸索；在黑暗中或不确定的情况下尝试寻找某物或方向
words.ex: He is grope around in the dark for the light switch.
words.ex_cn: 他在黑暗中摸索着找电灯开关。
words.en: To search for something by feeling with your hands, especially because you cannot see.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 闲逛；逗留；在附近徘徊
words.ex: He hangs around the park after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后在公园闲逛。
words.en: To spend time somewhere without any particular purpose or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 与……协调；与……和谐相处；使与……协调一致
words.ex: The colors of the room harmonize with the furniture.
words.ex_cn: 房间的颜色与家具协调一致。
words.en: To harmonize with something means to be in agreement or to match it well.

words.tr: phrase. 非常讨厌某人，恨某人入骨
words.ex: He hates my guts because I got the job he wanted.
words.ex_cn: 他非常讨厌我，因为我得到了他想要的工作。
words.en: To dislike someone very intensely.

words.tr: phrase. 对……有影响；与……有关联
words.ex: The weather has a bearing on our travel plans.
words.ex_cn: 天气对我们的旅行计划有影响。
words.en: To have a bearing on something means to be relevant or important to it.

words.tr: phrase. 忙得不可开交；应接不暇
words.ex: She has her hands full with three kids and a full-time job.
words.ex_cn: 她有三个孩子和一份全职工作，忙得不可开交。
words.en: If you have your hands full, you are extremely busy with something.

words.tr: phrase. 到处； 处处
words.ex: He looks here and there for his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他到处找他的钥匙。
words.en: in various places; scattered around

words.tr: phrase. 取决于…；以…为转移
words.ex: His decision hinges on the weather tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他的决定取决于明天的天气。
words.en: to depend on something completely for success or continued existence

words.tr: phrase. 由...决定
words.ex: The decision hinges upon the weather tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 这个决定取决于明天的天气。
words.en: To depend completely on something; to be determined by something.

words.tr: phrase. 控制；抑制；遏制
words.ex: The teacher holds the noise in check.
words.ex_cn: 老师控制住了噪音。
words.en: To restrain, control, or limit something, often to prevent it from becoming excessive or harmful.

words.tr: 短语动词. 控制某物；抑制某物；使某物处于受控状态
words.ex: The doctor advised him to hold his emotions in check during the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议他在手术期间控制自己的情绪。
words.en: To control or restrain something.

words.tr: phrase. 藐视；对…表示轻蔑
words.ex: He holds the corrupt official in contempt.
words.ex_cn: 他鄙视那个腐败的官员。
words.en: To consider someone or something as unworthy of respect or attention.

words.tr: phrase. 要挟某人；以人质相要挟以达到目的
words.ex: The kidnappers held the child to ransom, demanding a large sum of money for his release.
words.ex_cn: 绑架者将孩子扣为人质索要赎金，要求支付一大笔钱才释放他。
words.en: To hold someone to ransom means to demand money or some other benefit from them in exchange for not harming them or not revealing something damaging about them.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 追捕并找到；彻底搜寻以抓获或发现
words.ex: The police will hunt down the thief.
words.ex_cn: 警察将追捕那个小偷。
words.en: To search for someone or something persistently until they are found.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 平息；掩盖（真相）；压制（消息）
words.ex: The company tried to hush up the scandal.
words.ex_cn: 公司试图掩盖丑闻。
words.en: To prevent something from becoming known; to keep something secret.

words.tr: phrase. 我敢说；我想；大概，恐怕
words.ex: I dare say it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我敢说明天会下雨。
words.en: I think it is likely or true; I suppose.

words.tr: phrase. 闲逛；无所事事地消磨时间；游手好闲
words.ex: He likes to idle around after school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢放学后闲逛。
words.en: To spend time doing nothing in particular; to be idle.

words.tr: phrase. 妨碍…；打搅…
words.ex: Don't interfere with my work.
words.ex_cn: 不要干涉我的工作。
words.en: To interfere with something means to prevent it from happening or developing as it should, often by causing a problem or difficulty.

words.tr: phrase. 使沉浸于；使专心于；使深陷于
words.ex: He immersed himself in the book and forgot the time.
words.ex_cn: 他沉浸在书中，忘记了时间。
words.en: To involve oneself deeply in a particular activity or interest.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种意义上
words.ex: In a sense, he is right.
words.ex_cn: 在某种意义上，他是对的。
words.en: You say in a sense to indicate that a statement is true in one way, but not in others.

words.tr: phrase. 大量地；充裕地；丰富地
words.ex: There are apples in abundance in the orchard.
words.ex_cn: 果园里苹果很多。
words.en: In large quantities; plentifully.

words.tr: phrase. 与…一致；符合；依照
words.ex: His actions are in accord with his beliefs.
words.ex_cn: 他的行动与他的信仰一致。
words.en: in agreement with; in harmony with

words.tr: phrase. 与...一致；按照
words.ex: He acted in accordance with the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他按照规则行事。
words.en: If something is done in accordance with a particular rule or system, it is done in the way that the rule or system says that it should be done.

words.tr: phrase. 与……一致；同意；符合
words.ex: He is in agreement with his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他和老师意见一致。
words.en: In accordance with; consistent with.

words.tr: phrase. 极有可能；十有八九；几乎可以肯定
words.ex: In all probability, the meeting will be postponed.
words.ex_cn: 很可能，会议将会被推迟。
words.en: used to say that something is very likely to happen or be true

words.tr: phrase. 进进出出；弯弯曲曲
words.ex: He moved in and out of the shadows.
words.ex_cn: 他在阴影中进进出出。
words.en: Frequently entering and leaving a place; moving in and out repeatedly.

words.tr: phrase. 以任何方式
words.ex: Can I help you in any way?
words.ex_cn: 我能在任何方面帮助你吗？
words.en: used to emphasize that something is true or possible in any manner or method

words.tr: phrase. 白纸黑字；书面形式；黑白分明；非彩色
words.ex: The contract was written in black and white, clearly stating the terms and conditions.
words.ex_cn: 合同白纸黑字地写明了条款和条件。
words.en: If something is in black and white, it means it is in writing or printed, and therefore official or cannot be changed.

words.tr: phrase. 大量地；散装地；成批地
words.ex: He buys apples in bulk to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他批量购买苹果以节省金钱。
words.en: In large quantities or amounts, not divided into separate units.

words.tr: phrase. 与……合作；与……协作
words.ex: The project was completed in collaboration with a team of experts.
words.ex_cn: 该项目是由一个专家团队合作完成的。
words.en: Working jointly with someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 私下地；秘密地；作为机密地
words.ex: She told me about her plans in confidence.
words.ex_cn: 她私下里告诉我她的计划。
words.en: If you tell someone something in confidence, you tell them something secret or private and you trust them not to tell anyone else.

words.tr: phrase. 在缺乏…的情况下；若无…时；因没有…而
words.ex: In default of specific instructions, we will proceed as usual.
words.ex_cn: 在缺少具体指示的情况下，我们将按常规进行。
words.en: In default of means in the absence of something or because it is not available.

words.tr: phrase. 本质上；大体上
words.ex: In essence, he is a kind person.
words.ex_cn: 本质上，他是一个善良的人。
words.en: You use in essence to emphasize that you are talking about the most important or central aspect of an idea, situation, or event.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 紧追不舍；穷追猛赶
words.ex: The police were in hot pursuit of the escaped convict.
words.ex_cn: 警察紧追不舍地追赶逃犯。
words.en: If you are in hot pursuit of someone or something, you are chasing them and trying to catch them immediately.

words.tr: phrase. 需要
words.ex: He is in need of help with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要帮助做作业。
words.en: If someone or something is in need of something, they need it.

words.tr: phrase. 在运转中的；在实施中的；生效的；运行中的
words.ex: The machine is in operation.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器正在运转。
words.en: If a machine or system is in operation, it is working or being used.

words.tr: phrase. 在实践中；实际上
words.ex: He knows the rules, but in practice, he forgets them.
words.ex_cn: 他知道这些规则，但在实践中却忘了。
words.en: Used to say what actually happens or is done, especially when this is different from what is expected or supposed to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 追求；寻求；追赶
words.ex: She moved to New York in pursuit of her acting career.
words.ex_cn: 她搬到纽约去追求她的演艺事业。
words.en: If you are in pursuit of something, you are trying to achieve it or obtain it.

words.tr: phrase. 寻求；探求
words.ex: He set out in quest of adventure.
words.ex_cn: 他出发去寻找冒险。
words.en: In search of; seeking to find something.

words.tr: phrase. 对…做出反应
words.ex: He smiled in response to her question.
words.ex_cn: 他针对她的问题笑了。
words.en: as a reply or reaction to something

words.tr: phrase. 有库存；有现货
words.ex: The apples are in stock.
words.ex_cn: 苹果有货。
words.en: Available for sale or use; in the store or warehouse.

words.tr: phrase. 在短期内；从短期来看
words.ex: In the short term, we need more money to fix the car.
words.ex_cn: 短期内，我们需要更多钱来修车。
words.en: In the short term means for a brief period of time, not considering the distant future.

words.tr: phrase. 至于；就…来说；在...的情况
words.ex: In the case of rain, we will stay inside.
words.ex_cn: 如果下雨，我们就待在室内。
words.en: used to describe a particular situation or instance

words.tr: phrase. 在黑暗中；秘密地；不知道地
words.ex: The children played in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在黑暗中玩耍。
words.en: If you are in the dark about something, you do not know anything about it.

words.tr: phrase. 受…控制；深陷于…之中；被…牢牢掌控
words.ex: The city was in the grip of a severe winter storm.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市正遭受一场严重的冬季风暴。
words.en: If someone or something is in the grip of a particular feeling or situation, they are being controlled or affected very strongly by it.

words.tr: phrase. 大体上
words.ex: In the main, people like simple food.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，人们喜欢简单的食物。
words.en: For the most part; generally or mainly.

words.tr: n. 与此同时；
words.ex: He cooked dinner; meantime, the kids did their homework.
words.ex_cn: 他做晚饭；与此同时，孩子们在做作业。
words.en: The time between one event and another; meanwhile.

words.tr: phrase. 在……之中；在……当中；正当……的时候
words.ex: He is running in the midst of the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他在人群中奔跑。
words.en: If you are in the midst of doing something, you are doing it at the moment.

words.tr: phrase. 在…附近；在…周围；在邻近地区
words.ex: The park is in the vicinity of the school.
words.ex_cn: 公园在学校附近。
words.en: in the area near a particular place

words.tr: phrase. 在…附近；大约；接近
words.ex: The park is in the vicinity of the school.
words.ex_cn: 公园在学校附近。
words.en: In the area near a particular place.

words.tr: phrase. 关于...方面；就…而言
words.ex: His social life got in the way of his studies.
words.ex_cn: 他的社交生活妨碍了他的学习。
words.en: Concerning or in the matter of; with regard to.

words.tr: phrase. 理论上
words.ex: In theory, the plan works well.
words.ex_cn: 理论上，这个计划效果很好。
words.en: If you say that something is true in theory, you mean that it is supposed to be true according to a set of ideas or principles, but in practice it may not be true.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 拖着；带着；紧随其后；被牵引着
words.ex: The car was pulling a broken bike in tow.
words.ex_cn: 那辆车拖着一辆坏掉的自行车。
words.en: If you have someone in tow, they are following you closely because you are looking after them or you are responsible for them.

words.tr: phrase. 在运输中；在途中；在转运过程中
words.ex: The package is in transit.
words.ex_cn: 这个包裹正在运输途中。
words.en: If someone or something is in transit, they are travelling or being taken from one place to another.

words.tr: phrase. 正在流行
words.ex: This style of clothing is in vogue this season.
words.ex_cn: 这种服装风格在这个季节很流行。
words.en: If something is in vogue, it is very popular and fashionable.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 在这种情况下；既然如此；就当时的情形而言
words.ex: In the circumstances, it is better to postpone the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 在这种情况下，最好推迟会议。
words.en: Given the situation; considering the conditions.

words.tr: phrase. 在这种情况下；鉴于当前情势
words.ex: He stayed home under the circumstances.
words.ex_cn: 在这种情况之下，他待在家里。
words.en: Given the particular situation or conditions.

words.tr: phrase. 沉湎于；耽于；放任
words.ex: He likes to indulge in chocolate after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢晚饭后吃巧克力。
words.en: To allow oneself to enjoy the pleasure of something, often something that is considered bad for you.

words.tr: phrase. 强加于；使遭受；使承受（痛苦、惩罚等）
words.ex: He should not inflict pain on others.
words.ex_cn: 他不应该把痛苦强加给别人。
words.en: To cause something unpleasant or harmful to be suffered by someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 使遭受（痛苦、损失等）；把…强加于
words.ex: He will inflict pain upon his enemy.
words.ex_cn: 他将把痛苦强加给他的敌人。
words.en: To cause something unpleasant or painful to be suffered by someone or something.

words.tr: adj. 固有的；内在的；
words.ex: Honesty is an inherent quality of a good leader.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是好领导固有的品质。
words.en: Existing in something as a permanent, essential, or characteristic attribute.

words.tr: phrase. 在…上投资
words.ex: He wants to invest in a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他想投资一家小企业。
words.en: To put money, effort, time, etc. into something to make a profit or achieve a result.

words.tr: phrase. 邮寄广告宣传品
words.ex: I receive a lot of junk mail every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天收到很多邮寄宣传品。
words.en: Unsolicited mail, typically of a commercial nature, sent in large quantities.

words.tr: phrase. 让开；不接近
words.ex: Keep off the grass.
words.ex_cn: 别踩草坪。
words.en: To avoid touching, stepping on, or coming into contact with something; to prevent someone or something from coming near or touching something.

words.tr: phrase. 信守诺言；履行承诺
words.ex: He keeps his promise to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他遵守了帮助朋友的承诺。
words.en: To do what one said one would do; to fulfill one's commitment.

words.tr: phrase. 跟上...的进展；记录
words.ex: I keep track of my expenses every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天记录我的开支。
words.en: To keep track of something means to stay informed about it or to record it, especially in order to notice any changes or developments.

words.tr: phrase. 保持最新；使跟上最新发展；及时更新
words.ex: You need to keep up to date with the latest technology trends.
words.ex_cn: 你需要跟上最新的科技趋势。
words.en: To keep up to date means to make sure that you know about or are informed about the latest information or developments in a particular subject or area.

words.tr: phrase. 谨记，牢记
words.ex: Keep this rule in mind when you write essays.
words.ex_cn: 当你写文章时，要记住这个规则。
words.en: If you keep something in mind, you remember it and take it into account in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 知道；了解；听说
words.ex: I know about cats and dogs.
words.ex_cn: 我知道关于猫和狗的事情。
words.en: To have information or understanding about something.

words.tr: phrase. 猛烈抨击；突然怒斥；突然用力击打
words.ex: He tends to lash out when he is angry.
words.ex_cn: 他生气时往往会发脾气。
words.en: To suddenly speak angrily to someone or criticize someone strongly; to suddenly attack someone or something physically.

words.tr: phrase. 猛烈抨击；突然猛烈地攻击；痛斥
words.ex: He tends to lash out at others when he is stressed.
words.ex_cn: 当他感到压力时，往往会向别人发脾气。
