words.en: If you lash out at someone or something, you speak to them or about them very angrily or critically.

words.tr: phrase. 用笑来掩饰；对…一笑置之；把…当作玩笑而不认真对待
words.ex: She tried to laugh off her nervousness.
words.ex_cn: 她试图用笑声来掩饰自己的紧张。
words.en: To dismiss something as unimportant or not serious by laughing about it.

words.tr: phrase. 声称对…拥有权利；宣称对…有所有权
words.ex: He lay claim to the old treasure map he found in the attic.
words.ex_cn: 他声称在阁楼找到的旧藏宝图归他所有。
words.en: To assert one's right to something; to state that one owns or has a right to something.

words.tr: phrase. 摆开；展示；布置；安排；投资
words.ex: He will lay out the books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他将把书摆在桌子上。
words.en: To arrange or spread something out in a particular way, especially so that it can be seen or used easily.

words.tr: phrase. 强调；着重于；把重点放在……上
words.ex: Teachers lay stress on the importance of reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调每天阅读的重要性。
words.en: To emphasize the importance of something.

words.tr: phrase. 匆匆翻阅；快速浏览（书页、文件等）
words.ex: He likes to leaf through magazines at the doctor's office.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在医生办公室翻阅杂志。
words.en: To quickly turn the pages of a book, magazine, etc., and look at them without reading them in detail.

words.tr: phrase. 发出；放走；泄露
words.ex: He let out a loud scream.
words.ex_cn: 他大喊了一声。
words.en: To allow something to escape or be released; to reveal something that was supposed to be kept secret; to rent out property.

words.tr: phrase. 使失望；辜负；放下；降低
words.ex: He let down his team by missing the game.
words.ex_cn: 他因为没参加比赛而让队友失望了。
words.en: To fail to support or help someone as they had hoped or expected.

words.tr: phrase. 寿命；使用期限
words.ex: The life span of a dog is about 10 to 15 years.
words.ex_cn: 狗的寿命大约是10到15年。
words.en: The length of time for which a person or animal lives or a thing functions.

words.tr: phrase. 继续逗留；迟迟不消失；持续存留；拖延
words.ex: Don't linger on the past. Move forward.
words.ex_cn: 不要沉湎于过去。继续前进。
words.en: If something such as a feeling, idea, or smell lingers on, it continues to exist for a long time, often much longer than expected.

words.tr: phrase. 不住在工作地点；实践（梦想、幻想等）；度过（某段时间）
words.ex: He lives out in the city, not at the factory.
words.ex_cn: 他住在城里，而不是在工厂里。
words.en: If you live out your life in a particular way, you live in that way for the whole of your life.

words.tr: phrase. 不辜负；做到；实践（诺言等）
words.ex: He tried hard to live up to his father's expectations.
words.ex_cn: 他努力不辜负父亲的期望。
words.en: To perform as well as or achieve what is expected or promised.

words.tr: phrase. 登录
words.ex: He logs on to his computer every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上登录电脑。
words.en: To log on is to access a computer system or network by entering your username and password.

words.w: look for a needle in a haystack
words.tr: phrase. 大海捞针；做几乎不可能成功的事
words.uk: lʊk fɔː(r) ə ˈniːdl ɪn ə ˈheɪstæk
words.us: lʊk fɔːr ə ˈniːdl ɪn ə ˈheɪstæk
words.ex: Finding my lost pen in the room was like looking for a needle in a haystack.
words.ex_cn: 在房间里找到我丢的笔就像大海捞针一样。
words.en: To search for something extremely difficult to find due to its rarity or the vastness of the search area.

words.tr: phrase. 调查；研究；观察；检查
words.ex: The police will look into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警察将调查这起事故。
words.en: If you look into a problem or matter, you investigate it or examine it.

words.tr: phrase. 把...看作；看待
words.ex: People look upon him as a hero.
words.ex_cn: 人们把他看作英雄。
words.en: To consider or regard someone or something in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 失去对…的控制；无法掌控
words.ex: He loses control of his temper when he is angry.
words.ex_cn: 他生气时会控制不住自己的脾气。
words.en: If you lose control of something, you are no longer able to control it.

words.tr: phrase. 失去对……的线索；与……失去联系；忘记；未能跟踪
words.ex: He lost track of time while playing games.
words.ex_cn: 他玩游戏时忘记了时间。
words.en: To fail to keep oneself informed about someone or something; to lose contact with someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 为…做出贡献；对…有所贡献；向…捐款
words.ex: He wants to make a contribution to the school library.
words.ex_cn: 他想为学校图书馆做点贡献。
words.en: To give or provide something that helps to improve a situation or to achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 愚弄；使出丑；把…当傻瓜
words.ex: He likes to make a fool of his friends at parties.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在派对上捉弄他的朋友。
words.en: To make someone appear foolish or to deceive someone in a way that makes them seem silly.

words.tr: n. 错误；
words.ex: He made a mistake in his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you make a mistake, you do something which you did not intend to do, or which produces a result that you do not want.

words.tr: phrase. 努力；尽力；作出努力
words.ex: He makes an effort to wake up early every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力早起。
words.en: To attempt to do something, especially when it requires a significant amount of work or determination.

words.tr: phrase. 提出报价；出价；提出提议
words.ex: He decided to make an offer on the house.
words.ex_cn: 他决定对这栋房子出价。
words.en: To propose a price for something, especially in the context of buying or selling.

words.tr: phrase. 与…取得联系；与…接触；与…建立联系
words.ex: He tried to make contact with his friend by phone.
words.ex_cn: 他试图通过电话与朋友取得联系。
words.en: To establish communication or connection with someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 设法应付
words.ex: We don't have enough food, so we will make do with what we have.
words.ex_cn: 我们没有足够的食物，所以只能将就着用现有的。
words.en: If you make do with something, you use or have it instead of something else that you do not have, although it is not as good.

words.tr: phrase. 前往；费力前进；取得成功；闯出一条路
words.ex: The boy makes his way to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩每天早上步行去上学。
words.en: To move or travel towards a destination, especially when this is difficult or takes a long time.

words.tr: phrase. 翻新；改造；转让；移交
words.ex: He decided to make over his property to his children.
words.ex_cn: 他决定将他的财产转让给他的孩子们。
words.en: To change something completely, often so that it is better, or to transfer the legal possession of property to someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 与…讲和；与…和解；接受并适应（无法改变的事实）
words.ex: He decided to make peace with his brother after the fight.
words.ex_cn: 他在争吵后决定与哥哥和好。
words.en: To reconcile with someone or something, to end a conflict or disagreement.

words.tr: phrase. 让路给；为…腾出空间；给…让位
words.ex: The old building was torn down to make way for a new park.
words.ex_cn: 旧建筑被拆除了，为新公园让路。
words.en: If you make way for someone or something, you move aside so that they can pass or so that there is space for them.

words.tr: n. 标低价，[物价] 减价
words.ex: The store gave a markdown on all summer clothes.
words.ex_cn: 商店对所有夏季服装进行了减价。
words.en: A reduction in the price of something, especially in a retail context.

words.tr: n. 加价；毛利；涨价幅度
words.ex: The store adds a 20% markup to the cost of goods.
words.ex_cn: 商店在商品成本上加了20%的利润。
words.en: The amount added to the cost price of goods to cover overhead and profit.

words.tr: v. 调停；斡旋
words.ex: He tries to mediate between the two friends.
words.ex_cn: 他试图在两个朋友之间调解。
words.en: To intervene between people or parties in order to bring about an agreement or reconciliation.

words.tr: phrase. 在……之间调停；斡旋于……之间
words.ex: The UN envoy tried to mediate between the warring factions.
words.ex_cn: 联合国特使试图在交战各方之间进行调解。
words.en: To intervene in a dispute to help opposing parties reach an agreement.

words.tr: phrase. 错过；遗漏；错失机会；未参与
words.ex: Don't miss out on the free lunch.
words.ex_cn: 别错过免费的午餐。
words.en: To fail to experience or take advantage of something.

words.tr: phrase. 收拾；结束；肃清；扫荡
words.ex: She used a cloth to mop up the spilled juice.
words.ex_cn: 她用一块布擦掉了洒出来的果汁。
words.en: To clean or dry something by wiping it with a mop or cloth; to complete the final tasks or details of something; to eliminate or deal with the last remnants of resistance or opposition.

words.tr: phrase. 上移；挪动；提升；上升
words.ex: He move up to the next grade because he did well in school.
words.ex_cn: 他因为学习成绩好而升到了下一个年级。
words.en: To change position or place, especially to a higher one.

words.tr: phrase. v. （用车辆或枪炮）撞倒；扫射；大量杀伤；压倒
words.ex: The farmer uses a machine to mow down the grass.
words.ex_cn: 农民用机器割草。
words.en: To cut down (grass or grain) with a scythe or a machine; to kill or destroy in large numbers, especially in a violent or sudden manner.

words.tr: phrase. 紧邻；在…近旁
words.ex: The book is next to the pen.
words.ex_cn: 书在笔旁边。
words.en: Adjacent to; at the side of.

words.tr: phrase. 不可轻视的；值得认真对待的；不容小觑的
words.ex: A salary of $50,000 a year is not to be sneezed at.
words.ex_cn: 年薪5万美元是不容忽视的。
words.en: If you say that something is not to be sneezed at, you mean that it is worth having or considering.

words.tr: phrase. 不时地；偶尔
words.ex: He visits his grandparents now and then.
words.ex_cn: 他时不时去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: Occasionally; from time to time.

words.tr: phrase. 难怪； 怪不得
words.ex: No wonder he is tired, he worked all night.
words.ex_cn: 难怪他累了，他整晚都在工作。
words.en: It is not surprising that something is the case.

words.tr: phrase. /adj. 即兴地（的）；未经准备地（的）；随口地（的）
words.ex: He gave an off the cuff speech at the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他在婚礼上做了一个即兴演讲。
words.en: If you say something off the cuff, you say it without having prepared or thought about your words first.

words.tr: phrase. 大规模地；大范围地
words.ex: They built houses on a large scale after the earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 地震后，他们大规模地建造房屋。
words.en: Involving a large number of people or things, or covering a large area.

words.tr: phrase. 存档的；已归档的；记录在案的
words.ex: The document is on file.
words.ex_cn: 这份文件已存档。
words.en: Recorded or stored in a file for future reference.

words.tr: phrase. 凭一时冲动
words.ex: He bought the toy on impulse.
words.ex_cn: 他一时冲动买了这个玩具。
words.en: Done suddenly, without careful thought.

words.tr: phrase. 绝不；无论如何都不；在任何情况下都不
words.ex: On no account should you leave the house without your keys.
words.ex_cn: 绝对不可以不带钥匙就离开家。
words.en: Under no circumstances; never.

words.tr: phrase. 罢工中
words.ex: The workers are on strike for higher pay.
words.ex_cn: 工人们因加薪而罢工。
words.en: Engaged in a work stoppage as a form of protest.

words.tr: phrase. 以...为基础；根据；按照
words.ex: He made a decision on the basis of the facts.
words.ex_cn: 他基于事实做出了决定。
words.en: On the basis of means using something as the foundation or starting point for something else.

words.tr: phrase. 在逃；匆忙地；奔波；不停地移动
words.ex: He has been on the run since the bank heist.
words.ex_cn: 自从银行抢劫案以来，他一直在逃亡。
words.en: If someone is on the run, they are trying to avoid being captured by the police, often by moving from place to place.

words.tr: phrase. 在快车道上；处于迅速晋升或成功的轨道上；快速推进的
words.ex: She is on the fast track to becoming a manager.
words.ex_cn: 她正迅速成为经理的路上。
words.en: Moving or progressing quickly towards success or a goal.

words.tr: phrase. 在…的开端；即将进入；濒临
words.ex: The company is on the threshold of a new era of innovation.
words.ex_cn: 公司正处在一个创新新时代的门槛上。
words.en: At the beginning of a new and important event or development.

words.tr: phrase. 接近于；濒临于；在···边缘
words.ex: He is on the verge of crying.
words.ex_cn: 他快要哭了。
words.en: If you are on the verge of something, you are very close to experiencing it.

words.tr: phrase. 在宣誓的约束下；经宣誓（指证人在法庭上已宣誓说实话）
words.ex: He swore on oath that he would tell the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他发誓要讲真话。
words.en: If someone is on oath, they have made a formal promise to tell the truth, especially in a court of law.

words.tr: phrase. 在宣誓下；发过誓地
words.ex: He testified under oath that he had not seen the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在法庭上宣誓作证说他没有看到事故。
words.en: If someone is under oath, they have formally promised to tell the truth, especially in a court of law.

words.tr: phrase. 再一次
words.ex: He forgot his keys once again.
words.ex_cn: 他又一次忘了带钥匙。
words.en: used to say that something happens again or is repeated

words.tr: phrase. 偶尔；有时；间或
words.ex: I eat ice cream once in a while.
words.ex_cn: 我偶尔吃冰淇淋。
words.en: Occasionally; from time to time.

words.tr: phrase. 使适应
words.ex: The new students orient to the school quickly.
words.ex_cn: 新生很快就适应了学校。
words.en: To adjust or adapt to a new situation or environment.

words.tr: phrase. 面向，朝向，以……为方向，针对，适应于：指朝向某个方向或以某个方向为基准；指针对某个目标或对象；指适...
words.ex: The company will orient its goals toward customer satisfaction.
words.ex_cn: 公司将把目标定位于客户满意度。
words.en: To direct someone or something towards a particular purpose or goal.

words.tr: phrase. 起源；由…引起
words.ex: The problem originates in a lack of communication.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题源于缺乏沟通。
words.en: To have a specified beginning or source.

words.tr: phrase. 起源；由…引起
words.ex: This tradition originates from ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统起源于古代。
words.en: To come from a particular place or start in a particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 起源于；由…首创；始于
words.ex: The idea originated with a student from Brazil.
words.ex_cn: 这个想法起源于一位来自巴西的学生。
words.en: To begin or arise from a particular source or person.

words.tr: phrase. 在...外；从里面；出于；在...范围外；离开
words.ex: The ball rolled out of the box.
words.ex_cn: 球滚到了盒子外面。
words.en: used to indicate movement or direction from the inside to the outside of a place or thing; used to indicate the cause or reason for something; used to indicate a lack or absence of something

words.tr: phrase. 在偏僻处；不碍事；罕见
words.ex: The old shed is out of the way, behind the hill.
words.ex_cn: 那个旧棚子在山后面，很偏僻。
words.en: If something is out of the way, it is not blocking a path or is in a remote or isolated location.

words.tr:
n. 溢出；
v. 泛滥；
words.ex: The rain caused an overflow of the river.
words.ex_cn: 雨水导致河水溢出。
words.en: If a liquid or a river overflows, it flows over the edges of the container or place it is in.

words.tr: phrase. 承认；坦白；供认（过错、罪行等）
words.ex: He did not want to own up to his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他不想承认自己的错误。
words.en: To admit or confess to something, especially something that one might be ashamed of or embarrassed about.

words.tr: phrase. 用欺骗手段推销；把（假货、次品等）冒充真货卖掉；把（责任等）推给别人
words.ex: He tried to palm off the defective product on an unsuspecting customer.
words.ex_cn: 他试图把有缺陷的产品骗卖给不知情的顾客。
words.en: To palm off means to get rid of something unwanted, especially by selling it or giving it to someone else in a dishonest way.

words.tr: phrase. 去世；逝世；消亡
words.ex: My grandfather passed away last year.
words.ex_cn: 我祖父去年去世了。
words.en: If someone passes away, they die.

words.tr: phrase. 经过
words.ex: I saw a car pass by my house.
words.ex_cn: 我看到一辆车从我家旁边开过。
words.en: To move past or go past something or someone without stopping or without paying attention to them.

words.tr: phrase. 跨过；忽视；不予理会
words.ex: He passed over the small stream on the log.
words.ex_cn: 他从木头上跨过了那条小溪。
words.en: To ignore or disregard someone or something; to move across or beyond something.

words.tr: phrase. 当场支付（部分款项）；预付（定金）；偿还（债务）以减少欠款
words.ex: He pays down his debt every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月都偿还一部分债务。
words.en: To reduce the amount of money that you owe by paying some of it.

words.tr: phrase. 剥落；脱掉；脱离；离队
words.ex: The paint is starting to peel off the walls.
words.ex_cn: 墙上的油漆开始剥落了。
words.en: If you peel off a surface layer or covering from something, you remove it by pulling it away.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持不懈地做；努力从事
words.ex: He continues to peg away at his homework every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都在坚持做作业。
words.en: To continue working hard at something, especially something that is difficult or takes a lot of time.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持；固执于
words.ex: He will persist in trying to learn English every day.
words.ex_cn: 他会坚持每天努力学习英语。
words.en: To continue to do something despite difficulties or opposition, in a way that can seem unreasonable.

words.tr: phrase. 逐步引入；分阶段实施；逐步采用
words.ex: The company plans to phase in new technology over the next three years.
words.ex_cn: 公司计划在未来三年内逐步采用新技术。
words.en: To introduce or implement something gradually over a period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 使逐步淘汰；逐渐停止
words.ex: The company will phase out old machines next year.
words.ex_cn: 公司明年将逐步淘汰旧机器。
words.en: To gradually stop using or providing something, especially over a period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 把…批评得体无完肤；对…吹毛求疵；彻底剖析并挑剔
words.ex: He picked my idea to pieces in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上把我的想法批得体无完肤。
words.en: To criticize someone or something severely and in detail.

words.tr: phrase. 撕成碎片；严厉批评；把…驳得体无完肤
words.ex: The teacher pulled his essay to pieces.
words.ex_cn: 老师把他的文章批得体无完肤。
words.en: To criticize someone or something very severely.

words.tr: phrase. 空头支票；渺茫的希望；不切实际的美好承诺
words.ex: His promise to solve all our problems was just pie in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺解决我们所有的问题，但那只是空想。
words.en: If you describe an idea, plan, or promise of something good as pie in the sky, you mean that you think that it is very unlikely to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 淡化；轻描淡写；降低…的重要性
words.ex: He tried to play down his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他试图淡化自己的错误。
words.en: To make something seem less important or serious than it really is.

words.tr: phrase. 对…造成严重破坏；扰乱；使陷入混乱
words.ex: The storm played havoc with the power lines.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨破坏了电线。
words.en: To cause a lot of damage or confusion to something.

words.tr: phrase. 屈居次要地位；给…当副手；充当配角
words.ex: In the team, he has to play second fiddle to the more experienced player.
words.ex_cn: 在团队中，他不得不给更有经验的球员扮演次要角色。
words.en: To play second fiddle to someone means to be in a subordinate position to them or to be less important than they are.

words.tr: phrase. 取笑；拿……开玩笑；嘲弄
words.ex: They often poke fun at his accent.
words.ex_cn: 他们经常嘲笑他的口音。
words.en: To make jokes or humorous remarks about someone or something in a way that is intended to be amusing rather than hurtful.

words.tr: phrase. 管闲事；插手；干涉（他人的私事）
words.ex: He likes to poke his nose into other people's business.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢干涉别人的私事。
words.en: To interfere in or be nosy about someone else's business or affairs.

words.tr: phrase. 主持（会议、仪式等）；担任主席
words.ex: The mayor will preside at the opening ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 市长将主持开幕仪式。
words.en: To be in charge of a formal event, meeting, or ceremony, especially as the person who introduces speakers or performers.

words.tr: phrase. 负责；主持；管理
words.ex: The judge will preside over the trial tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 法官明天将主持审判。
words.en: To preside over a meeting or event means to be in charge of it and to ensure that it is conducted in an orderly and efficient manner.

words.tr: phrase. 滥用；不正当地利用（他人的好意、耐心等）
words.ex: Don't presume on his kindness—he might say no.
words.ex_cn: 不要依赖他的好心——他可能会拒绝。
words.en: To take unwarranted advantage of something, especially someone's kindness or trust.

words.tr: phrase. 捕食；折磨；掠夺
words.ex: The lion preys on weak deer.
words.ex_cn: 狮子捕食虚弱的鹿。
words.en: To hunt and kill another animal for food; to exploit or harm someone who is weaker.

words.tr: phrase. （人或动物因好奇或警觉而）竖起耳朵；突然开始注意听
words.ex: The dog pricks up its ears when it hears a loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 狗一听到大声响就竖起耳朵。
words.en: To suddenly start paying attention because you have heard something interesting or important.

words.tr: phrase. 支撑；撑住；扶持；维持（不稳定的局面或体系）
words.ex: They use a stick to prop up the broken tree.
words.ex_cn: 他们用一根棍子撑起那棵断了的树。
words.en: To prop up something means to support it or keep it in position by placing something underneath or against it.

words.tr: phrase. 驶离；离开；脱身；拉开距离
words.ex: The car started to pull away from the bus stop.
words.ex_cn: 汽车开始从公交站开走了。
words.en: To move away or depart, especially in a vehicle; to create distance between oneself and someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 拆毁（建筑物）；拉下；降低（价格、水平等）
words.ex: They pull down the old house to build a new school.
words.ex_cn: 他们拆掉旧房子来建一所新学校。
words.en: To pull down something means to destroy it or remove it from its position.

words.tr: phrase. 进站；靠岸；赚取
words.ex: The bus pulls in at the station every ten minutes.
words.ex_cn: 公交车每十分钟进站一次。
words.en: To attract or earn money; to arrest someone; (of a vehicle) to move into a particular place or to stop at a station.

words.tr: phrase. 成功完成（困难的事）；脱下；扯掉；把车驶离（道路）
words.ex: She managed to pull off a surprise party for her husband.
words.ex_cn: 她成功地为丈夫举办了一个惊喜派对。
words.en: To succeed in doing something difficult or tricky.

words.tr: phrase. （使）齐心协力
words.ex: They pull together to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他们齐心协力按时完成项目。
words.en: To work together as a team or group in order to achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 使被理解；把…讲清楚；成功地表达（想法、观点等）
words.ex: He tried to put across his idea clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他试图清楚地表达他的想法。
words.en: To communicate something clearly and effectively to someone.

words.tr: phrase. v. 使被理解；成功传达（想法、信息等）；推迟；延期
words.ex: He put over the message clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他清楚地传达了那个信息。
words.en: To successfully communicate an idea or message to someone, or to postpone something to a later time.

words.tr: phrase. 结束；终止
words.ex: The new law will put an end to pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律将结束污染。
words.en: To cause something to stop or to finish something.

words.tr: phrase. 使经受；接通（电话）
words.ex: He was put through a tough training program.
words.ex_cn: 他经受了一项严格的训练计划。
words.en: To cause someone to experience something, especially something difficult or unpleasant, or to connect a telephone call.

words.tr: phrase. 高度重视；给予…高评价；使…显得珍贵
words.ex: The school puts a premium on good behavior.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校高度重视良好行为。
words.en: To consider something to be very important or valuable.

words.tr: phrase. 高度重视；极力推崇；给予…额外价值
words.ex: They place a premium on honesty in their family.
words.ex_cn: 他们在家庭中非常重视诚实。
words.en: To consider something to be very important and valuable.

words.tr: phrase. 下倾盆大雨
words.ex: It is raining cats and dogs outside.
words.ex_cn: 外面下着倾盆大雨。
words.en: To rain very heavily.

words.tr: phrase. 筹钱
words.ex: They are trying to raise money for the school.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在努力为学校筹钱。
words.en: To collect money for a particular purpose, especially for a charity or for a political campaign.

words.tr: phrase. 从a到b不等；范围介于a与b之间
words.ex: The prices range from 10 to 20 dollars.
words.ex_cn: 价格从10美元到20美元不等。
words.en: To vary or extend across a specified spectrum or scale.

words.tr: phrase. 不假思索地快速说出；一口气背出；滔滔不绝地列举
words.ex: He can rattle off the names of all the countries in the world.
words.ex_cn: 他能迅速说出世界上所有国家的名字。
words.en: To say or recite something quickly and without much thought or effort.

words.tr: phrase. 喋喋不休；絮絮叨叨地说个不停
words.ex: He keeps rattle on about his vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他不停地唠叨他的假期。
words.en: If someone rattles on, they talk continuously about things that are not very interesting or important.

words.tr: phrase. 达成协议；取得一致意见
words.ex: They reach an agreement after talking for one hour.
words.ex_cn: 他们谈了一个小时后达成了协议。
words.en: To come to a mutual understanding or arrangement between parties.

words.tr: phrase. 恢复；复原
words.ex: He will recover from the flu next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会从流感中康复。
words.en: To recover from something means to return to a normal state of health, mind, or strength after experiencing an illness, injury, or emotional distress.

words.tr: phrase. v. 一口气说出；滔滔不绝地讲；流畅地背诵
words.ex: He can reel off the names of all the planets.
words.ex_cn: 他能一口气报出所有行星的名字。
words.en: To say or recite something quickly and easily, often from memory.

words.tr: phrase. 忍住；制止；戒除
words.ex: He refrains from eating sugar to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他戒糖以保持健康。
words.en: If you refrain from doing something, you deliberately do not do it.

words.tr: phrase. 注册；登记；报名参加（课程、活动等）
words.ex: Students need to register for their courses before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要在截止日期前注册他们的课程。
words.en: To officially sign up or enroll in a course, event, or activity.

words.tr:
n. 缰绳；驾驭；控制
v. 控制；驾驭
words.ex: He uses a leather rein to control the horse.
words.ex_cn: 他用皮缰绳来控制马。
words.en: A rein is a long, narrow strap attached at one end to a horse's bit, typically used in pairs to guide or check a horse while riding or driving.

words.tr: phrase. 提醒某人；使某人想起
words.ex: This song reminds me of my childhood.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌让我想起了我的童年。
words.en: To cause someone to remember someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 居住于；存在于
words.ex: He resides in a small village near the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他住在山附近的一个小村庄里。
words.en: If someone or something resides in a particular place, they are in that place; if a quality resides in something, it is present in that thing.

words.tr:
n. 结果；
v. 导致；
words.ex: The result of the test was good.
words.ex_cn: 这次测试的结果很好。
words.en: A consequence, outcome, or effect of an action or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 环绕；旋转
words.ex: The story revolves around a boy who finds a magic stone.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事围绕一个发现魔法石的男孩展开。
words.en: To revolve around something means to have it as the main subject or purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 成熟的；时机成熟的；已准备好迎接（某事发生）的
words.ex: The fruit is ripe for picking.
words.ex_cn: 这水果已经成熟，可以采摘了。
words.en: Ready or suitable for a particular purpose or action; fully prepared or developed.

words.tr: phrase. 偶然碰见；撞见
words.ex: I run across my old friend at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场遇到了我的老朋友。
words.en: To meet or find someone or something by chance.

words.tr: phrase. 与…私奔；轻易赢得；失去控制；携…逃跑
words.ex: He wants to run away with his friend to the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他想和朋友一起逃跑到海滩。
words.en: To leave a place or person secretly and suddenly, especially to get married without the permission of one's parents; to win something easily; to lose control of something.

words.tr: phrase. 与…背道而驰；与…相抵触；违背
words.ex: His opinion runs counter to the teacher's.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点与老师的相反。
words.en: If one thing runs counter to another, it is very different from it and seems to conflict with it.

words.tr: phrase. （供应、资源等）减少；即将耗尽；快要用完
words.ex: The car runs low on fuel during the trip.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在旅途中燃料快用完了。
words.en: If something is running low, there is not much of it left.

words.tr: phrase. 逃跑； 流掉；迅速离开
words.ex: The boy ran off with his brother's bike.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩骑着他哥哥的自行车跑掉了。
words.en: To leave a place or situation quickly and secretly, often to avoid a problem or responsibility; to produce copies of a document quickly; to discharge or release a liquid.

words.tr: phrase. 失控；肆虐；放纵；任意滋长
words.ex: The children run riot in the playground every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们每天下午都在操场上乱跑乱闹。
words.en: If someone runs riot, they behave in a wild and uncontrolled way. If something runs riot, it spreads or develops in an uncontrolled way.

words.tr: phrase. 达到（某数量或程度）；求助于；有能力支付；匆匆前往
words.ex: The children run to the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们每天早上都跑向公园。
words.en: To move quickly on foot so that both feet leave the ground during each stride; to go to someone for help or support.

words.tr: phrase. v. 迅速累积（债务、账单等）；匆匆赶制；升起（旗帜等）；助跑
words.ex: He ran up a big bill at the store.
words.ex_cn: 他在商店里赊账欠下了一大笔钱。
words.en: To accumulate or increase something, especially debts or costs, quickly.

words.tr: phrase. 出发；动身；使爆炸；引起
words.ex: He set off early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他早早出发以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey or to cause something to start or happen.

words.tr: v. 尖叫；
words.ex: The child screamed when she saw the dog.
words.ex_cn: 当那个孩子看到狗时，她尖叫了起来。
words.en: If you scream, you shout or cry in a loud high-pitched voice, usually because you are in pain or are very frightened.

words.tr: phrase. 看穿；识破
words.ex: I can see through his lie.
words.ex_cn: 我看穿了他的谎言。
words.en: To perceive the true nature of someone or something, especially their deceitfulness or the real situation. Also, to support someone or something until the end of a difficult situation.

words.tr: phrase. 找出；搜寻出；挑出
words.ex: He seeks out new friends at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校里主动结交新朋友。
words.en: To seek out means to look for and find someone or something, especially when this is difficult or takes a lot of effort.

words.tr: phrase. 区分；留出；使与众不同
words.ex: His kindness sets him apart from others.
words.ex_cn: 他的善良使他与众不同。
words.en: To distinguish someone or something as different from others; to reserve or allocate something for a specific purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 开船，离开
words.ex: He told the man to shove off.
words.ex_cn: 他让那个人走开。
words.en: To leave a place, especially in a boat.

words.tr: phrase. 露面；到场；显现
words.ex: He did not show up for class yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天没有来上课。
words.en: If someone shows up, they arrive somewhere, especially unexpectedly or after they have been waiting a long time.

words.tr: phrase. 对…不予理睬；轻易摆脱；漠然置之
words.ex: She managed to shrug off her troubles and continue with her work.
words.ex_cn: 她设法摆脱了烦恼，继续工作。
words.en: If you shrug something off, you ignore it or treat it as if it is not really important or serious.

words.tr: phrase. 报名参加；注册（某项活动、课程或服务）
words.ex: He wants to sign up for the English class.
words.ex_cn: 他想报名参加英语课。
words.en: To agree to become involved in an organized activity.

words.tr: phrase. 使平顺；抚平；使缓和
words.ex: He tried to smooth down the wrinkles on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他试图把纸上的褶皱抚平。
words.en: To make something flat or even; to calm someone or something down.

words.tr: phrase. 迅速抓起；急忙抢购；匆忙拿起
words.ex: He quickly snatch up the candy from the table.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速从桌子上抢走了糖果。
words.en: To take something quickly or eagerly.

words.tr: phrase. 嗅出；察觉出；发现（尤指隐藏的事物）
words.ex: Dogs can sniff out drugs at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 狗能在机场嗅出毒品。
words.en: To detect or discover something by or as if by smelling.

words.tr: phrase. 醒酒；清醒过来
words.ex: He drank too much and needs to sober up.
words.ex_cn: 他喝得太多了，需要清醒一下。
words.en: To become sober after drinking alcohol.

words.tr: phrase. 分类；整理；选出
words.ex: He will sort out his books tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会整理好他的书。
words.en: To sort something out means to organize or arrange it, or to solve a problem or difficulty.

words.tr: phrase. 溢出；涌出；倾泻而出（常指液体或人群等不受控制地大量流出）
words.ex: The children spill out of the school when the bell rings.
words.ex_cn: 铃响时，孩子们从学校里涌出来。
words.en: If a liquid spills out or if you spill it out, it flows out of a container because the container is too full or because it is knocked over.

words.tr: phrase. 吐出；说出（尤指不情愿地）；迅速说出
words.ex: He had to spit out the bad apple.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不把那个坏苹果吐出来。
words.en: To expel something from the mouth, often because it is unpleasant or unwanted.

words.tr: phrase. 向某人要钱或利用某人的财物而不偿还或不付出相应的代价：指向某人索要金钱或利用某人的财物，但不偿还或不...
words.ex: He is sponging off his brother for food and rent.
words.ex_cn: 他靠哥哥提供食物和房租生活。
words.en: To live off someone else's generosity or resources without offering anything in return.

words.tr: phrase. 监视；暗中观察；窥探
words.ex: He tries to spy on his neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 他试图监视他的邻居。
words.en: To secretly watch and gather information about someone or something, often without their knowledge or consent.

words.tr: phrase. 背后捅刀；背信弃义的行为
words.ex: He felt a stab in the back when his friend lied to him.
words.ex_cn: 当他的朋友对他撒谎时，他感到被背叛了。
words.en: An act of betrayal, especially by a supposed friend or ally.

words.tr: phrase. 开始；启动；发动
words.ex: He wants to start up a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他想开一家小咖啡店。
words.en: To start up means to begin or initiate something, such as a business or a project.

words.tr: phrase. 远离；避开；不接近
words.ex: Stay away from the dog; it is angry.
words.ex_cn: 离那只狗远点，它很生气。
words.en: To avoid going near someone or something, especially because it is dangerous or could cause problems.

words.tr: phrase. 留在外面；不进入；避免参与
words.ex: The children must stay out until the rain stops.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们必须留在外面，直到雨停。
words.en: To remain away from home or a particular place, especially at night.

words.tr: phrase. 留在原地；逗留不走
words.ex: He decided to stick around until the meeting was over.
words.ex_cn: 他决定留下来直到会议结束。
words.en: To remain in a place or situation, especially while waiting for something to happen or someone to arrive.

words.tr: phrase. 偶然发现；意外碰到
words.ex: I stumble across a small shop when I walk in the street.
words.ex_cn: 我在街上走时偶然发现了一家小店。
words.en: If you stumble across something or someone, you discover them unexpectedly.

words.tr: phrase. 无意中发现
words.ex: He stumble on a rock and fall down.
words.ex_cn: 他被一块石头绊倒了。
words.en: To find or discover something by chance and unexpectedly.

words.tr: phrase. 服从；容易遭受；受制于
words.ex: All students are subject to the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 所有学生都必须服从校规。
words.en: Likely to be affected by or to experience something.

words.tr: phrase. 屈服于；服从于
words.ex: She decided to submit to the committee's decision.
words.ex_cn: 她决定服从委员会的决定。
words.en: To accept or yield to the authority or control of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 从属于；隶属于；次于
words.ex: He is subordinate to his manager.
words.ex_cn: 他服从于他的经理。
words.en: If someone is subordinate to you, they have a less important position than you in the organization that you both work for.

words.tr: phrase. 订阅；同意；支持（某种观点或理论）
words.ex: He wants to subscribe to the news channel.
words.ex_cn: 他想订阅这个新闻频道。
words.en: to agree to receive and pay for a service or publication regularly, or to support an idea or theory

words.tr: phrase. 诉请；请求（尤指通过法律途径要求赔偿、离婚等）
words.ex: He will sue for damages after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他将起诉要求赔偿。
words.en: To make a formal request or demand in a court of law for something, especially as a right or for damages.

words.tr: phrase. 只需说…就够了；不必多说
words.ex: Suffice it to say, we were all very surprised by the outcome.
words.ex_cn: 只需说，我们所有人都对结果感到非常惊讶。
words.en: used to indicate that what you are saying is enough to explain or prove something, without needing to say anything more

words.tr: v. 足够；足以；
words.ex: One apple will suffice for now.
words.ex_cn: 一个苹果现在就足够了。
words.en: If something suffices, it is enough to achieve a purpose or to fulfill a need.

words.tr: phrase. 合计；总计；概括
words.ex: Can you sum up the total cost?
words.ex_cn: 你能合计一下总费用吗？
words.en: If you sum something up, you briefly describe the main features or ideas of it.

words.tr: phrase. 鼓起（勇气、力量等）；唤起（记忆、情感等）
words.ex: She tried to summon up the courage to speak in front of the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 她试图鼓起勇气在众人面前讲话。
words.en: To call upon or bring forth a particular quality or resource within oneself, especially courage or strength.

words.tr: 短语。指在尾部或末端进行测试；常用于工程、软件或质量控制语境中，表示对系统末端环节的检测
words.ex: The doctor is testing in the tail for rare side effects.
words.ex_cn: 医生正在尾部测试罕见的副作用。
words.en: A statistical term for examining the extreme ends of a data distribution, often to identify outliers or rare events.

words.tr: phrase. 冒险一试；孤注一掷
words.ex: He decided to take a gamble and invest in the startup.
words.ex_cn: 他决定冒险一试，投资这家初创公司。
words.en: To take a risk in the hope of gaining an advantage or a benefit.

words.tr: phrase. 使吃惊；使意外；使措手不及
words.ex: The sudden noise took her aback.
words.ex_cn: 突然的响声让她大吃一惊。
words.en: To surprise or shock someone so much that they do not know how to react.

words.tr: phrase. 拆卸； 拆开
words.ex: He took apart the clock to see how it works.
words.ex_cn: 他把钟表拆开来看它是如何工作的。
words.en: To separate something into its different parts, especially in order to repair it or to understand how it works.

words.tr: phrase. 拿走；取走；扣除
words.ex: He takes away the toys after playtime.
words.ex_cn: 他玩完后把玩具拿走。
words.en: To remove something from a place or to subtract a number or amount from another.

words.tr: phrase. 拿回；收回；取消；使回忆起
words.ex: I will take back my book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我会从图书馆拿回我的书。
words.en: To take something back means to return something to the place it came from, or to admit that something you said was wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 负责；看管
words.ex: He will take charge of the project next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将负责这个项目。
words.en: To assume control or responsibility over something.

words.tr: phrase. 拆卸；拆毁；记录；记下；笔录；取下
words.ex: He took down the old photo from the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把墙上的旧照片取了下来。
words.en: To write something down, especially in order to remember or record it; to remove something from a high position; to dismantle or disassemble something.

words.tr: phrase. 从容应对；泰然处之（指面对困难或意外情况时不慌不忙，轻松处理）
words.ex: She took the bad news in stride and kept smiling.
words.ex_cn: 她泰然处之地接受了坏消息，并继续微笑。
words.en: To deal with something difficult or unpleasant in a calm and accepting way.

words.tr: phrase. 轻松应对；泰然处之（指对困难或意外情况不以为意，从容处理）
words.ex: He takes new challenges in his stride.
words.ex_cn: 他从容应对新的挑战。
words.en: To deal with something difficult or unpleasant in a calm and accepting way, without letting it affect you too much.

words.tr: phrase. 注意；理会；留心
words.ex: He did not take notice of the warning sign.
words.ex_cn: 他没有注意到那个警告标志。
words.en: To become aware of something or someone, especially by seeing or hearing them.

words.tr: phrase. 就职；上任；开始担任公职
words.ex: He took office last January.
words.ex_cn: 他去年一月上任。
words.en: To assume a position of authority or responsibility, especially in a formal or official capacity.

words.tr: phrase. 拿出；取出；去掉；取得；领到
words.ex: He took out his keys to open the door.
words.ex_cn: 他拿出钥匙开门。
words.en: To remove something from a place or to take something with you when you go somewhere.

words.tr: phrase. 优先于；比…更重要
words.ex: Healthcare issues take priority over economic concerns.
words.ex_cn: 医疗问题比经济问题更优先。
words.en: If one thing takes priority over another, it is considered more important than the other thing and is dealt with first.

words.tr: phrase. 开始从事；喜欢；形成...的习惯
words.ex: He took to swimming every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他开始每天早上游泳来保持健康。
words.en: To begin to like someone or something; to start doing something as a habit or regular activity.

words.tr: phrase. 轮流；更替
words.ex: The children take turns to play with the toy.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们轮流玩这个玩具。
words.en: If people take turns doing something, they do it one after the other to ensure that each person has an equal opportunity to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 参与；插手；介入（某事）
words.ex: He took a hand in fixing the car.
words.ex_cn: 他参与了修车。
words.en: To become involved in something, especially in order to influence its outcome.

words.tr: phrase. v. 参与；插手；在……中起作用
words.ex: He has a hand in organizing the school party.
words.ex_cn: 他参与了学校派对的组织工作。
words.en: To be involved in or have influence over something.

words.tr: phrase. 说服某人做某事
words.ex: He talked his sister into joining the club.
words.ex_cn: 他说服了他妹妹加入这个俱乐部。
words.en: To persuade someone to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 为首；带头
words.ex: Tom takes the lead in the race.
words.ex_cn: 汤姆在比赛中领先。
words.en: To be in the leading position in a competition, race, or any activity.

words.tr: phrase. 说有道理的话；讲得通；言之有理
words.ex: She tried to talk sense into him before he made a big mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他在犯大错之前，她试图跟他讲道理。
words.en: To speak in a reasonable and logical way.

words.tr: phrase. 争吵；与...厮混
words.ex: He tangle with a bully at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校和一个欺凌者发生了冲突。
words.en: To become involved in a conflict or fight with someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 证明；证实；作证说明
words.ex: He testified to the truth of what happened.
words.ex_cn: 他证明了所发生事情的真实性。
words.en: To testify to something means to provide evidence or proof of it, especially in a legal context.

words.tr: 那种事情；诸如此类的事物（用于泛指类似的情况或事物）
words.ex: He likes apples, bananas, and that sort of thing.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果、香蕉之类的东西。
words.en: Things of a similar nature or kind.

words.tr: phrase. 使分秒在滴答声中溜走
words.ex: The seconds tick away on the clock.
words.ex_cn: 秒针在钟上一秒一秒地走着。
words.en: If you say that time ticks away, you mean that it passes, especially when you are waiting for something to happen or worrying about something.

words.tr: phrase. 使分秒在滴答声中溜走
words.ex: Time ticks by slowly when you are waiting.
words.ex_cn: 当你等待时，时间过得很慢。
words.en: If you say that time ticks by, you mean that it passes, especially when you are waiting for something to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 整理；收拾干净；使整洁
words.ex: He will tidy up the room after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐后会收拾房间。
words.en: To make a place neat and orderly by removing clutter and arranging things properly.

words.tr: phrase. 扎牢；妥善解决；密切联系；占用；合伙；停泊
words.ex: He will tie up the loose rope.
words.ex_cn: 他会把松开的绳子系好。
words.en: To tie up means to fasten or secure something with a cord, rope, or the like. It can also mean to occupy or engage someone or something completely, leaving no time or resources for other activities.

words.tr: phrase. 一次又一次地；屡次；反复地
words.ex: He makes the same mistake time and again.
words.ex_cn: 他一次又一次地犯同样的错误。
words.en: If something happens time and again, it happens repeatedly.

words.tr: phrase. 向…密告；预先通知；泄露消息
words.ex: He gave a tip off to the police about the robbery.
words.ex_cn: 他向警察举报了那起抢劫案。
words.en: To give someone secret or private information, especially about illegal activities.

words.tr: phrase. 实际上；就所有实际目的而言（常与 and purposes 连用，构成短语 to all intents and purposes）
words.ex: To all intents, the project is finished.
words.ex_cn: 从所有实际目的来看，这个项目已经完成了。
words.en: In all important respects; virtually.

words.tr: phrase. 实际上；事实上；在所有实际意义上
words.ex: To all intents and purposes, the project is finished.
words.ex_cn: 在所有实际目的上，这个项目已经完成了。
words.en: In all important respects; practically.

words.tr: phrase. 来回地
words.ex: The pendulum moves to and fro.
words.ex_cn: 钟摆来回摆动。
words.en: Moving repeatedly from one place to another and back again.

words.tr: phrase. 尽情地；心满意足地
words.ex: The children ate candy to their heart's content.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们尽情地吃糖果。
words.en: As much as one desires; to the full extent of one's wishes.

words.tr: phrase. 达到最高点；停止增长或上升
words.ex: The car top out at 200 miles per hour.
words.ex_cn: 这辆汽车的最高速度达到每小时200英里。
words.en: To reach the highest point or level; to complete the highest part of something.

words.tr: phrase. 视同儿戏；玩忽
words.ex: He likes to trifle with small problems instead of focusing on important work.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢敷衍小问题，而不专注于重要的工作。
words.en: to treat someone or something in a way that shows a lack of respect or seriousness

words.tr: phrase. 把…收起来；藏起；偷偷吃掉（尤指食物）
words.ex: He likes to tuck away his money in a small box under the bed.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢把钱藏在床下的一个小盒子里。
words.en: To put something in a safe or hidden place, or to eat a lot of food.

words.tr: phrase. 塞入；把… tucked 进（如衣服、被子）；（口语）大吃一顿
words.ex: He tuck in his shirt before the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议前把衬衫塞进去。
words.en: To push, fold, or turn the ends or edges of something so that it is held in place or looks neat; to eat food with enthusiasm.

words.tr: phrase. （非正式）突然明白；恍然大悟（某事）
words.ex: He finally tumbled to the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他最终意识到了真相。
words.en: To suddenly understand or realize something, often after a period of confusion or misunderstanding.

words.tr: phrase. 对...熟视无睹
words.ex: He saw the mistake but decided to turn a blind eye to it.
words.ex_cn: 他看到了那个错误，但决定视而不见。
words.en: If you say that someone is turning a blind eye to something bad or illegal that is happening, you mean that you think they are pretending not to notice that it is happening so that they will not have to do anything about it.

words.tr: phrase. （使）变成；成为
words.ex: The caterpillar turns into a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫变成了一只蝴蝶。
words.en: To change or develop into something different.

words.tr: phrase. 上上下下；前前后后
words.ex: The ball goes up and down when he throws it.
words.ex_cn: 当他扔球时，球上下弹跳。
words.en: Moving alternately upwards and downwards or back and forth.

words.tr: phrase. 投票支持；选举（某人）
words.ex: I will vote for her in the election.
words.ex_cn: 我将在选举中投她一票。
words.en: To express one's choice or preference in a decision-making process, especially in an election.

words.tr: phrase. 避开；挡住；抵挡
words.ex: Wear a hat to ward off the sun.
words.ex_cn: 戴帽子以遮挡阳光。
words.en: If you ward off a danger or illness, you prevent it from affecting you or harming you.

words.tr: phrase. 热身；变暖；使活跃起来
words.ex: He warms up before running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步前热身。
words.en: To prepare for physical exertion or a performance by exercising or practicing gently beforehand.

words.tr: phrase. v. 挥手示意忽略；不予理会；拒绝考虑
words.ex: He waved aside the offer politely.
words.ex_cn: 他礼貌地拒绝了那个提议。
words.en: If you wave aside something such as a suggestion or question, you dismiss it without giving it proper consideration or attention.

words.tr: phrase. 逐渐变弱；逐渐失效；逐渐令人厌烦
words.ex: His patience is wearing thin.
words.ex_cn: 他的耐心正在耗尽。
words.en: To gradually lose effectiveness or patience.

words.tr: phrase. （衣物、材料等）经久耐穿；（人或事物）保持良好状态，经得起时间考验
words.ex: This jacket wears well and still looks new after a year.
words.ex_cn: 这件夹克很耐穿，一年后看起来还是新的。
words.en: To remain in good condition over a long period of time or to continue to be acceptable or satisfactory.

words.tr: phrase. 清除；淘汰
words.ex: The school will weed out students who fail the exam.
words.ex_cn: 学校将清除考试不及格的学生。
words.en: To remove unwanted or less desirable elements from a group or collection.

words.tr: phrase. 权衡；估量；仔细考虑（利弊、可能性等）
words.ex: He can weigh up the options before making a decision.
words.ex_cn: 他可以在做决定前权衡各种选择。
words.en: To consider something carefully before making a decision.

words.tr: phrase. 权衡；把……放在天平另一边以衡量；考虑不利因素
words.ex: Weigh against the cost and the benefit before you decide.
words.ex_cn: 在做决定之前，权衡一下成本和收益。
words.en: To consider or compare carefully the advantages and disadvantages of something.

words.tr: phrase. 给（钟表等）上发条；使紧张；结束；最终导致
words.ex: He will wind up the clock every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都会给钟上发条。
words.en: To bring something to an end; to coil or twist something; to make someone nervous or excited.

words.tr: phrase. 眨眼示意；默许，纵容（尤指不当行为）
words.ex: He winked at her during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议期间朝她眨了眨眼。
words.en: To pretend not to see something that you should disapprove of or take action about.

words.tr: phrase. 擦掉；清除；灭掉
words.ex: He wiped out the board with a cloth.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块布把板擦掉了。
words.en: To completely destroy, remove, or eliminate something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 猛烈地；使劲地
words.ex: He missed the bus, and he was late with a vengeance.
words.ex_cn: 他错过了公交车，结果迟到了很多。
words.en: If you do something with a vengeance, you do it with great intensity or force, often more than expected or usual.

words.tr: phrase. 为了
words.ex: She is studying hard with a view to getting a promotion.
words.ex_cn: 她努力学习，以期获得晋升。
words.en: If you do something with a view to doing something else, you do it because you hope it will result in that other thing being done.

words.tr: phrase. 与...共事；与...合作； 对...起作用
words.ex: He works with numbers every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天和数字打交道。
words.en: To collaborate or deal with someone or something in a shared task or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 屈服；让步
words.ex: He yields to his brother when they argue.
words.ex_cn: 当他们争吵时，他让着弟弟。
words.en: To give way to arguments, demands, or pressure.

chapters.name: 附录一 四级简单词组表

words.tr: phrase. 有点；稍微
words.ex: I am a bit tired today.
words.ex_cn: 我今天有点累。
words.en: A bit means to a small extent or degree.

words.tr: phrase. 大量的；许多的
words.ex: He spends a great deal of time on homework.
words.ex_cn: 他花大量时间做作业。
words.en: A large amount or quantity of something.

words.tr: phrase. 大量的，许多的（用于修饰可数名词复数）
words.ex: A great many students like to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 非常多的学生喜欢放学后踢足球。
words.en: A large number of; very many.

words.tr: phrase. 加起来； 总计
words.ex: The numbers don't add up.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字对不上。
words.en: If facts or events do not add up, they make you confused about a situation because they do not seem to be consistent. If small amounts of something add up, they gradually increase.

words.tr: phrase. 毕竟；终究
words.ex: He didn't win, but after all, he tried his best.
words.ex_cn: 他没有赢，但毕竟他尽了最大努力。
words.en: You use after all when you are saying that something that you thought might not be the case is in fact the case.

words.tr: phrase. 对...达成协议；对...取得一致意见
words.ex: They agree on the plan for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们对旅行的计划达成一致。
words.en: To reach a mutual understanding or consensus about something.

words.tr: phrase. v. 旨在；针对；以…为目标
words.ex: This program aims at helping poor children.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目旨在帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: If you aim at something, you direct your efforts or actions towards achieving it.

words.tr: phrase. 各种各样的；各种类型的
words.ex: He collects all kinds of stamps.
words.ex_cn: 他收集各种各样的邮票。
words.en: A phrase used to indicate a variety of different types or kinds of something.

words.tr: phrase. 等等
words.ex: He bought apples, bananas, and so on.
words.ex_cn: 他买了苹果、香蕉等等。
words.en: Used at the end of a list to indicate that there are other items that could also be mentioned.

words.tr:
v. 回答；回应；
n. 回答；答案；
words.ex: He answered the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: An answer is something that you say or write when you reply to a question or remark.

words.tr: phrase. 结果
words.ex: He didn't study hard, as a result, he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他没有努力学习，结果考试不及格。
words.en: used to introduce the consequence or effect of a particular situation or event

words.tr: phrase. 由于…的结果；起因；经；因
words.ex: He was late as a result of the bus breaking down.
words.ex_cn: 由于公交车坏了，他迟到了。
words.en: Because of something that has happened.

words.tr: phrase. 一…就…；尽快
words.ex: He will call me as soon as he arrives.
words.ex_cn: 他一到就会给我打电话。
words.en: At the moment that; immediately after.

words.tr: phrase. 要；要求；请求
words.ex: He asks for help when he is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当他遇到困难时，他会寻求帮助。
words.en: To request something; to express a desire for something.

words.tr: phrase. 至多；充其量；顶多
words.ex: He is at best a beginner in cooking.
words.ex_cn: 他在烹饪方面最多是个初学者。
words.en: At best is used to indicate the most positive or optimistic scenario or outcome, often implying that the actual situation may be worse.

words.tr: phrase. 首先；起先
words.ex: At first, he did not like math.
words.ex_cn: 起初，他不喜欢数学。
words.en: At the beginning; initially.

words.tr: phrase. 至少；不少于；起码
words.ex: I need at least three apples to make a pie.
words.ex_cn: 我至少需要三个苹果来做派。
words.en: You use at least to say that a number or amount is the smallest that is possible or likely and that the actual number or amount may be greater. The forms at the least and at the very least are also used.

words.tr: phrase. 马上
words.ex: He stopped talking at once.
words.ex_cn: 他立刻停止了说话。
words.en: Immediately; without delay; at the same time.

words.tr: phrase. 同时；但是；在相同的时间
words.ex: He sings and dances at the same time.
words.ex_cn: 他一边唱歌一边跳舞。
words.en: If two or more things exist, happen, or are true at the same time, they exist, happen, or are true together although they seem to contradict each other.

words.tr: phrase. 将要；正打算
words.ex: He is about to leave the house.
words.ex_cn: 他马上就要离开家了。
words.en: If you are about to do something, you are going to do it very soon.

words.tr: phrase. 与生俱来
words.ex: He was born with a talent for music.
words.ex_cn: 他生来就有音乐天赋。
words.en: To have a particular quality or ability from birth.

words.tr: phrase. 关心；挂念
words.ex: She is concerned about her son's health.
words.ex_cn: 她担心她儿子的健康。
words.en: To be worried or anxious about something or someone.

words.tr: phrase.  涉及；关切；与…有关
words.ex_cn: 他关心他的成绩。
words.en: If you are concerned with something, you are giving it your attention because you think it is important or because you are worried about it.

words.tr: phrase. 和 ... 不同
words.ex: This book is different from that one.
words.ex_cn: 这本书和那本书不一样。
words.en: To not be the same as something or someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 渴望做某事的；急切想要做某事的
words.ex_cn: 他渴望学习英语。
words.en: If you are eager to do or have something, you want to do or have it very much.

words.tr: phrase. 熟悉
words.ex: He is familiar with basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他熟悉基础数学。
words.en: If you are familiar with something, you know or understand it well.

words.tr: phrase. 充满着
words.ex: The room is filled with laughter.
words.ex_cn: 房间里充满了笑声。
words.en: To have a lot of a particular quality or thing.

words.tr: phrase. 喜爱；喜欢
words.ex: He is fond of playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢踢足球。
words.en: To have a liking or affection for someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 住院
words.ex: He is in hospital after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他出事故后住院了。
words.en: To be admitted to a hospital for medical treatment or observation.

words.tr: phrase. 对…感兴趣
words.ex: He is interested in math.
words.ex_cn: 他对数学感兴趣。
words.en: To have a feeling of curiosity or concern about something, wanting to learn or know more about it.

words.tr: phrase. 迟到
words.ex: He is late for school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都上学迟到。
words.en: To arrive somewhere after the expected or usual time.

words.tr: phrase. 仅限
words.ex: His knowledge is limited to basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他的知识仅限于基础数学。
words.en: To be restricted or confined within certain limits.

words.tr: phrase. 由……构成
words.ex: The team is made up of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something is made up of particular things or people, it consists of those things or people.

words.tr: phrase. 对……有耐心；容忍……
words.ex_cn: 对你弟弟要有耐心。
words.en: To remain calm and not become annoyed when dealing with problems or with difficult people or situations.

words.tr: phrase. 准备好应对；为……做好准备
words.ex: He is prepared for the test.
words.ex_cn: 他为考试做好了准备。
words.en: To make ready or able to deal with something that is expected to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 自豪
words.ex: My mom is proud of me because I passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈为我通过考试而感到骄傲。
words.en: To feel a sense of pride or satisfaction in something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 准备好做某事；愿意做某事
words.ex_cn: 他准备帮助他的朋友。
words.en: To be prepared or willing to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 类似于； 与 ... 相似
words.ex: This apple is similar to that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果和那个很相似。
words.en: If one thing is similar to another, or if two things are similar, they have features that are the same.

words.tr: phrase. 对…严格
words.ex: My mom is strict with me about homework.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈对我的作业很严格。
words.en: To demand or enforce rules and standards rigorously.

words.tr: phrase. 对…厌烦
words.ex: He is tired of eating the same food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他厌倦了每天吃同样的食物。
words.en: To feel that you have had enough of someone or something and do not want to have to deal with them or it any more.

words.tr: phrase. 愿意做某事；乐意去做
words.ex_cn: 他愿意帮助他的朋友。
words.en: If someone is willing to do something, they are ready and eager to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 值得做的；值得花时间或精力去做的
words.ex_cn: 再试一次是值得的。
words.en: If something is worth doing, it is enjoyable, useful, or important enough to spend time, effort, or money on it.

words.tr: phrase. 因为
words.ex: He was late because of the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他因为公交车而迟到了。
words.en: You use 'because of' to introduce the reason or explanation for something.

words.tr: phrase. 不久以后
words.ex: Before long, he will finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 不久之后，他就会完成作业。
words.en: If you say that something will happen or is true before long, you mean that it will happen or is true soon.

words.tr: phrase. 属于
words.ex: This book belongs to me.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于我。
words.en: If something belongs to you, you own it or it is yours.

words.tr: phrase. 闯入；打断；（使）逐渐适用
words.ex: Thieves broke in through the back door.
words.ex_cn: 小偷从后门闯入。
words.en: To enter a building by force, especially in order to steal something; to interrupt a conversation or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 提出；教育；养育；呕出
words.ex: He brought up an important point in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个重要的观点。
words.en: To mention a subject or start to talk about it; to care for a child until they are an adult, often giving them particular beliefs; to educate someone; to vomit.

words.tr: phrase. 到…末期
words.ex: By the end of the week, he finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 到周末结束时，他完成了作业。
words.en: Indicates the point in time when something concludes or is expected to conclude.

words.tr: phrase. 顺便说说；顺便提起
words.ex: By the way, I saw your brother yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 对了，我昨天看到你弟弟了。
words.en: used to introduce a comment or question that is not directly related to the main subject of conversation

words.tr: phrase. 经由；作为；为了
words.ex: He sent the letter by way of his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他通过朋友寄了这封信。
words.en: If you do something by way of a particular method, you use that method to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 情不自禁做某事；忍不住做某事
words.ex: I cannot help laughing when I see that funny cat.
words.ex_cn: 当我看到那只搞笑的猫时，忍不住笑了。
words.en: If you say that you cannot help doing something, you mean that you cannot prevent yourself from doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 给…打电话；使想起；召集
words.ex: He called up his friend to say hello.
words.ex_cn: 他给朋友打电话问好。
words.en: To telephone someone; to summon someone to military service; to bring something back to one's mind.

words.tr: phrase. 照料；关怀；喜欢；想要
words.ex: She cares for her sick mother every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天照顾她生病的母亲。
words.en: To like or love someone or something; to look after someone or something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 恢复呼吸；歇一口气；（因惊讶或激动）屏住呼吸
words.ex: He stopped to catch his breath after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑完后停下来喘口气。
words.en: To pause and rest after physical exertion in order to regain normal breathing.

words.tr: phrase. 赶上；逮捕并处罚；（麻烦事）缠上
words.ex: He needs to catch up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他需要赶上他的同学。
words.en: To reach the same standard or level as someone or something else, especially after a period of lagging behind.

words.tr: phrase. 登记；报到
words.ex: He checks in at the hotel at 3 PM.
words.ex_cn: 他在下午三点办理入住。
words.en: To announce your arrival, especially at a hotel or an airport, by signing your name or showing your ticket.

words.tr: phrase. 付账后离开；核实
words.ex: We checked out of the hotel after paying the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我们付完账后离开了酒店。
words.en: To check out means to leave a hotel after paying your bill, or to examine something or someone in order to be certain that everything is correct, safe, or satisfactory.

words.tr: phrase. 清扫；打扫干净
words.ex: She decided to clean out the garage this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 她决定这个周末打扫车库。
words.en: To clean out means to remove everything from a place and clean it thoroughly.

words.tr: phrase. 跟着…之后来；取走
words.ex: He will come after you if you take his toy.
words.ex_cn: 如果你拿走他的玩具，他会来找你。
words.en: To follow someone or something in order or sequence.

words.tr: phrase. 回来；记起；复原；恢复；重新流行
words.ex: He promised to come back soon.
words.ex_cn: 他答应很快就会回来。
words.en: To return to a place or to a previous activity or condition.

words.tr: phrase. 评论
words.ex: He will comment on the game after it ends.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束后，他会对此发表评论。
words.en: To express an opinion or reaction about something.

words.tr: phrase. 抱怨
words.ex: He complain of headache every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都抱怨头痛。
words.en: To express dissatisfaction or annoyance about something.

words.tr: phrase. 抱怨
words.ex: He complains about the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 他抱怨那噪音太大。
words.en: If you complain about a situation, you say that you are not satisfied with it.

words.tr: phrase. 对…作出决定
words.ex: They decide on the color for the room.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定房间的颜色。
words.en: To choose something or someone after thinking carefully.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 就…作出决定；选定
words.ex: The committee will decide upon the new policy next week.
words.ex_cn: 委员会将在下周对新政策作出决定。
words.en: To choose something or someone after thinking carefully about it.

words.tr: phrase. 依靠；取决于
words.ex: He depends on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠他哥哥帮忙。
words.en: To rely on someone or something for support, help, or supply; to be determined or influenced by something.

words.tr: phrase. 因…而死
words.ex: Many people die of cold in winter.
words.ex_cn: 许多人在冬天死于寒冷。
words.en: To die of something means to die because of a particular cause, such as an illness or an accident.

words.tr: phrase. 因某事（病以外）而死
words.ex: He died from a car accident.
words.ex_cn: 他因车祸去世。
words.en: If someone dies from a particular cause, that cause is the reason for their death.

words.tr: phrase. 互相；彼此
words.ex: They help each other with homework.
words.ex_cn: 他们互相帮助做作业。
words.en: You use each other when you are saying that each member of a group does something to or for the other members.

words.tr: phrase. 赚钱；挣得金钱
words.ex: He works at a store to earn money.
words.ex_cn: 他在商店工作赚钱。
words.en: To receive money as payment for work or services performed.

words.tr: phrase. 享受；过得快乐
words.ex: They enjoy themselves at the park every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每个星期天在公园里玩得很开心。
words.en: To have a good time; to experience pleasure or satisfaction in what one is doing.

words.tr: phrase. 入睡
words.ex: He falls asleep quickly after turning off the light.
words.ex_cn: 他关灯后很快就睡着了。
words.en: To begin to sleep.

words.tr: phrase. 查明；弄清
words.ex: I want to find out why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想弄清楚他为什么迟到。
words.en: To discover a fact or piece of information, often by making an effort to do so.

words.tr: phrase. 首先
words.ex: First of all, we need to clean the room.
words.ex_cn: 首先，我们需要打扫房间。
words.en: Before anything else; initially.

words.tr: 短语. 片刻；一会儿
words.ex: He stopped for a moment to catch his breath.
words.ex_cn: 他停了一下，喘口气。
words.en: For a brief period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 例如；比如
words.ex: I like fruits, for instance, apples and bananas.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，例如苹果和香蕉。
words.en: Used to introduce an example that illustrates or supports a point being made.

words.tr: phrase. 例如
words.ex: He likes apples, for example.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果，例如。
words.en: Used when you want to give a specific instance or illustration of what you are talking about.

words.tr: phrase. 发烧
words.ex: He gets a fever when he is very tired.
words.ex_cn: 他非常累的时候会发烧。
words.en: To develop a fever, an elevated body temperature often due to illness.

words.tr: phrase. 相处融洽
words.ex: I get on with my brother very well.
words.ex_cn: 我和我哥哥相处得很好。
words.en: To continue doing something, especially after an interruption, or to have a good relationship with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 摆脱； 除去
words.ex: He wants to get rid of the old chair.
words.ex_cn: 他想扔掉那把旧椅子。
words.en: To dispose of or remove something unwanted or undesirable.

words.tr: phrase. 帮忙；鼓掌
words.ex: Can you give a hand with the heavy box?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮忙搬一下这个重箱子吗？
words.en: To help someone, especially by doing a particular task.

words.tr: phrase. 投降；屈服；让步
words.ex: He will not give in to the bully.
words.ex_cn: 他不会向欺凌者屈服。
words.en: To agree to something that you had been opposing, especially because someone has forced or persuaded you to.

words.tr: phrase. 出国；去国外
words.ex: He wants to go abroad next year.
words.ex_cn: 他想明年出国。
words.en: To travel to a foreign country.

words.tr: 短语动词. 去打猎；去搜寻
words.ex: He goes hunting every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末去打猎。
words.en: To engage in the activity of hunting animals for sport or food.

words.tr: phrase. 去观光
words.ex: They go sightseeing on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他们在周末去观光。
words.en: To visit places of interest as a tourist.

words.tr: phrase. 长大；成熟；成长
words.ex: He wants to grow up and be a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他想长大后当一名医生。
words.en: To grow up means to gradually change from being a child to being an adult. This process involves physical, emotional, and intellectual development.

words.tr: phrase. 交上；提交；呈递
words.ex: He will hand in his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天交作业。
words.en: To give something to someone in authority, especially a piece of work or a document.

words.tr: phrase. 分发；给予
words.ex: The teacher will hand out the papers now.
words.ex_cn: 老师现在会分发试卷。
words.en: To distribute something to a group of people.

words.tr: phrase. 穿着；戴着；计划要做
words.ex: She has on a red dress.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着一件红裙子。
words.en: To wear something; to be wearing something. Also, to deceive someone or to have something arranged.

words.tr: phrase. 屏气；屏息
words.ex: He holds his breath when he waits for the result.
words.ex_cn: 他等待结果时屏住呼吸。
words.en: If you hold your breath, you make yourself stop breathing for a moment, usually because you are waiting for something to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 赶紧；快点
words.ex: Hurry up, or we will miss the bus.
words.ex_cn: 快点，否则我们会错过公交车。
words.en: If you tell someone to hurry up, you are telling them to do something more quickly than they were doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 在国内和国外；海内外
words.ex: The company sells products at home and abroad.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司在国内和国外都销售产品。
words.en: both domestically and internationally

words.tr: phrase. 匆忙；乐意地
words.ex: He is in a hurry to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他赶着去赶公交车。
words.en: If you are in a hurry, you are doing something quickly because you do not have much time.

words.tr: phrase. 马上；立刻
words.ex: I will do it in a minute.
words.ex_cn: 我马上做。
words.en: Used to indicate that something will happen very soon.

words.tr: phrase. 立刻；一会儿
words.ex: I'll be with you in a moment.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 我马上就来。
words.en: If you say that something will happen in a moment, you mean that it will happen very soon.

words.tr: phrase.  一共；总计
words.ex: He has ten apples in all.
words.ex_cn: 他一共有十个苹果。
words.en: You use in all to emphasize that something is the total amount or number involved.

words.tr: phrase. 事实上；实际上
words.ex: He says he likes sports, but in fact, he hates them.
words.ex_cn: 他说他喜欢运动，但事实上，他讨厌它们。
words.en: You use in fact to emphasize that something is true, especially when it contradicts what has just been said or might be expected.

words.tr: phrase. 在...前面
words.ex: The cat is sitting in front of the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在房子前面。
words.en: If someone or something is in front of a particular thing, they are facing it, ahead of it, or close to the front part of it.

words.tr: phrase. 为了…
words.ex: He wakes up early in order to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早起是为了赶上公交车。
words.en: with the purpose of achieving something

words.tr: phrase. 在远处；在远方
words.ex: We saw a castle in the distance.
words.ex_cn: 我们在远处看到了一座城堡。
words.en: At a point that is far away.

words.tr: phrase. 最后；终于
words.ex: In the end, he chose to go home.
words.ex_cn: 最后，他选择回家。
words.en: finally, after everything has been considered or done

words.tr: phrase. 及时
words.ex: He arrived in time for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他赶上了公交车。
words.en: If you say that something will happen in time or given time, you mean that it will happen eventually, after a lot of time has passed.

words.tr: phrase. 写日记
words.ex: She keeps a diary every night before bed.
words.ex_cn: 她每天晚上睡觉前都写日记。
words.en: To regularly record personal experiences, thoughts, or feelings in a diary.

words.tr: phrase. 跟上
words.ex: He tries to keep up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力跟上他的同学。
words.en: To keep up with something means to manage to do or have as much of it as is necessary or desirable, or to move at the same speed as someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 与…保持联系
words.ex: I keep in touch with my friend by texting.
words.ex_cn: 我通过发短信和朋友保持联系。
words.en: To maintain communication or contact with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 和...取得联系
words.ex: Please get in touch with me if you have questions.
words.ex_cn: 如果你有问题，请与我联系。
words.en: To make contact or communicate with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 消磨时间；打发时间
words.ex: He reads comics to kill time.
words.ex_cn: 他看漫画来打发时间。
words.en: To spend time doing something that is not particularly useful or interesting, especially while waiting for something else to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 缺乏
words.ex: He failed the test because of lack of sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他因为缺乏睡眠而考试不及格。
words.en: The state of being without or not having enough of something.

words.tr: phrase. 因…而发笑；嘲笑
words.ex: They laugh at his funny hat.
words.ex_cn: 他们因他的滑稽帽子而发笑。
words.en: To laugh at someone or something means to mock or ridicule them, often in a way that is not kind.

words.tr: phrase. 把…带到；导致；通向
words.ex: The path will lead to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路会把人带到公园。
words.en: If an action or event leads to a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 很久以前
words.ex: He left home long before the sun rose.
words.ex_cn: 太阳升起之前很久，他就离开了家。
words.en: At a time earlier than a specified event or period.

words.tr: phrase. 展望；期待
words.ex: I look forward to the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我期待着周末。
words.en: If you look forward to something that is going to happen, you want it to happen because you think you will enjoy it.

words.tr: phrase. 往外看；注意；留神
words.ex: Look out the window to see the birds.
words.ex_cn: 往窗外看，看看那些鸟。
words.en: To be vigilant or cautious.

words.tr: phrase. 体重减轻；减肥
words.ex: He wants to lose weight by eating less and walking more.
words.ex_cn: 他想通过少吃多走来减肥。
words.en: To reduce one's body weight intentionally.

words.tr: phrase. 做决定；下决心
words.ex: He makes a decision quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快做出决定。
words.en: To choose between options after consideration; to make up one's mind.

words.tr: phrase. 交朋友；建立友谊；与人结交
words.ex: He wants to make friends at school.
words.ex_cn: 他想在学校交朋友。
words.en: To establish a relationship of mutual affection with someone, typically one that is not a romantic or family relationship.

words.tr: phrase. 与…交朋友
words.ex: He wants to make friends with the new student.
words.ex_cn: 他想和新同学交朋友。
words.en: To become friendly with someone, or to start a friendship with them.

words.tr: phrase. 取笑
words.ex: They make fun of him for wearing old shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为他穿旧鞋子而取笑他。
words.en: To tease, laugh at, or joke about someone in a way that is either playful or mocking.

words.tr: phrase. 挣钱
words.ex: He makes money by selling cakes.
words.ex_cn: 他通过卖蛋糕赚钱。
words.en: To earn or obtain money through work, investment, or other means.

words.tr: phrase. 让路；让开；让位
words.ex: The crowd made way for the ambulance.
words.ex_cn: 人群为救护车让路。
words.en: To move aside or to allow someone or something to pass by.

words.tr: phrase. 或多或少
words.ex: He is more or less ready for the test.
words.ex_cn: 他差不多准备好考试了。
words.en: To a certain extent; approximately.

words.tr: phrase. 既不……也不……；两者都不
words.ex: Neither Tom nor Anna likes coffee.
words.ex_cn: 汤姆和安娜都不喜欢咖啡。
words.en: Used before the first of two (or occasionally more) alternatives that are being specified to indicate that they are each untrue or do not happen.

words.tr: phrase. 不再
words.ex: He no longer plays soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他不再踢足球了。
words.en: If something is no longer the case, it is not the case now, although it was the case in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 一点也不； 不必客气
words.ex: I don't like spicy food, not at all.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢辣的食物，一点也不。
words.en: Used as a polite response to thanks or to express that something is not a problem or does not matter.

words.tr: phrase. 不仅…而且…
words.ex: Not only does he play soccer, but he also runs every day.
words.ex_cn: 他不仅踢足球，而且还每天跑步。
words.en: Used to emphasize that in addition to the first thing mentioned, the second thing is also true and often even more significant.

words.tr: phrase. 在世上；究竟
words.ex: What on earth are you doing?
words.ex_cn: 你到底在干什么？
words.en: Used for emphasis in questions to express surprise or confusion.

words.tr: phrase. 另一方面
words.ex: I like coffee, on the other hand, my brother prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡，另一方面，我弟弟更喜欢茶。
words.en: used to introduce a statement that contrasts with or seems to contradict something that has been said previously

words.tr: phrase. 按时；准时
words.ex: He arrives on time every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都准时到达。
words.en: If something happens on time, it happens at the time that was planned.

words.tr: phrase在度假中
words.ex: They are on vacation in Spain.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在西班牙度假。
words.en: If someone is on vacation, they are spending a period of time away from home or work for relaxation or travel.

words.tr: phrase. 陆续地；一个接一个地
words.ex: The children left the room one after another.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们一个接一个地离开了房间。
words.en: If things happen one after another, they happen in sequence, with little or no time in between.

words.tr: phrase. 另外一个人；彼此；相互
words.ex: The students helped one another with their homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们互相帮助做作业。
words.en: used to indicate that each of two or more people or things does something to or with the other(s)

words.tr: phrase. 注意； 留意
words.ex: Please pay attention to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 请专心听老师讲课。
words.en: To focus one's mind or efforts on something or someone, especially in order to understand or learn.

words.tr: phrase. 在...扮演一个角色；起作用
words.ex: Exercise plays a role in staying healthy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼在保持健康方面起作用。
words.en: To have a part or influence in something.

words.tr: phrase. 许多
words.ex: There is plenty of food on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌上有很多食物。
words.en: A large quantity or number; more than enough.

words.tr: phrase. 更喜欢；宁愿；宁可
words.ex: I prefer to walk to school.
words.ex_cn: 我更喜欢走路去学校。
words.en: If you prefer to do something, you like it more than another thing and would choose it if you could.

words.tr: phrase. 阻止；制止
words.ex: Wearing a helmet can prevent you from getting hurt.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔可以防止你受伤。
words.en: If you prevent someone from doing something, you stop them from doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 穿戴；上演；增加（体重）
words.ex: He puts on his coat before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上外套。
words.en: To put on something means to dress oneself in it, or to start wearing it. It can also mean to produce a play, show, or other performance. Additionally, it can refer to gaining weight or to pretend to have a particular feeling or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 相当多
words.ex: Quite a few students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 相当多的学生通过了考试。
words.en: You use quite a few to emphasize that you are referring to a considerable number of things or people.

words.tr: phrase. 把...视为
words.ex: They regard him as a hero.
words.ex_cn: 他们把他视为英雄。
words.en: To consider or think of someone or something in a specified way.

words.tr: phrase. 马上；立即
words.ex: He left right away when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 他一听到消息就离开了。
words.en: If you do something right away, you do it immediately.

words.tr: phrase. 逃跑；出走；逃避
words.ex: The boy ran away from home.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩从家里跑走了。
words.en: To leave a place or person secretly and suddenly in order to escape from them or to avoid a difficult or unpleasant situation.

words.tr: phrase. 搜寻；寻找
words.ex: He is searching for his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他正在找他的钥匙。
words.en: To look for something carefully and thoroughly.

words.tr: phrase. 送行；告别
words.ex: We went to the station to see off our friend.
words.ex_cn: 我们去车站为朋友送行。
words.en: To accompany someone to the point of departure, such as an airport, train station, etc., as a gesture of farewell.

words.tr: phrase. 发送；派遣；长出
words.ex: He sends out emails every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上发送邮件。
words.en: To cause something to go or be taken to a place, especially by post or by email.

words.tr: phrase. 幽默感
words.ex: He has a good sense of humor.
words.ex_cn: 他有很好的幽默感。
words.en: The ability to perceive and express or appreciate humor.

words.tr: phrase. 出发；动身；使爆炸；引起
words.ex: He set off early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他早早出发以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey or to cause something to start or happen.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；创立；设立；架起；提出
words.ex: He set up a small shop last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年开了一家小商店。
words.en: To set up something means to establish it or arrange it.

words.tr: phrase. 以便；为了
words.ex: He woke up early so as to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早早起床，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: with the purpose of; in order to

words.tr: phrase. 如此……以致于（用于表示结果或目的）
words.ex: He was so tired as to fall asleep at his desk.
words.ex_cn: 他太累了，以至于在书桌旁睡着了。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is done to such an extent that a particular result happens.

words.tr: phrase. 就…而言；到…程度；只要
words.ex: So far as I know, he is still at work.
words.ex_cn: 据我所知，他还在工作。
words.en: to the extent that; with regard to

words.tr: phrase. 只要
words.ex: You can go out so long as you finish your homework.
words.ex_cn: 只要你做完作业，就可以出去。
words.en: provided that; on condition that

words.tr: phrase. 如此……以至于……（引导结果状语从句）
words.ex: He was so tired that he fell asleep quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他太累了，很快就睡着了。
words.en: Used to indicate the result or consequence of something being extremely the case.

words.tr: phrase. 与…交谈；向…说话；涉及，关乎
words.ex: I will speak to my teacher tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天要和我的老师谈谈。
words.en: To address someone directly in speech; to communicate with someone verbally.

words.tr: phrase. 站起来
words.ex: The students stand up when the teacher enters the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 当老师走进教室时，学生们站起来。
words.en: If you stand up, you rise to your feet from a sitting or lying position.

words.tr: phrase. 在...方面成功
words.ex: He will succeed in passing the test.
words.ex_cn: 他会成功通过考试。
words.en: To achieve something that you have been aiming for.

words.tr: phrase. 例如；像…这样的
words.ex: He likes fruits such as apples and bananas.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果和香蕉这样的水果。
words.en: Used to introduce examples of something that has been mentioned.

words.tr: phrase. 采取行动；提出诉讼
words.ex: He must take action now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在必须采取行动。
words.en: To do something in order to deal with a situation or problem.

words.tr: phrase. 照顾；照料；处理；应付
words.ex: She takes care of her little brother after school.
words.ex_cn: 她放学后照顾她的弟弟。
words.en: To look after someone or something; to deal with something.

words.tr: phrase. 当心
words.ex: Take care when you cross the street.
words.ex_cn: 过马路时要小心。
words.en: To be cautious or attentive; to look after someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 记笔记；作记录
words.ex: He takes notes during the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在上课时做笔记。
words.en: To write down information, especially during a lecture or meeting, in order to remember it later.

words.tr: phrase. 拿掉；离开；起飞；脱下；突然成功
words.ex: Please take off your hat before entering.
words.ex_cn: 进入前请把帽子拿掉。
words.en: If an aircraft, bird, or insect takes off, it leaves the ground and begins to fly.

words.tr: phrase. 发生
words.ex: The meeting will take place tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在明天举行。
words.en: When something takes place, it happens, especially in a controlled or organized way.

words.tr: phrase. 想当然认为···
words.ex: He takes his health for granted.
words.ex_cn: 他把健康视为理所当然。
words.en: If you take something for granted, you believe it to be true or accept it as normal or without questioning it.

words.tr: phrase. 把……当作；视为；认为
words.ex: I take him as my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 我把他当作我最好的朋友。
words.en: To regard or consider something in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 误认为；把…当作
words.ex: Don't take him for a fool; he's very smart.
words.ex_cn: 不要把他当成傻瓜；他非常聪明。
words.en: To consider someone or something to be a particular type of person or thing, especially when this is wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 说谎
words.ex: He tells a lie to avoid trouble.
words.ex_cn: 他撒谎以避免麻烦。
words.en: To say something that is not true in order to deceive someone.

words.tr: phrase. 与...同样的
words.ex: This book is the same as that one.
words.ex_cn: 这本书和那本书一样。
words.en: Identical or equivalent to something else.

words.tr: phrase. 想到；想起；有...的看法
words.ex: I think of my mom when I eat cookies.
words.ex_cn: 当我吃饼干时，我想起我的妈妈。
words.en: To have a particular idea or opinion about something or someone; to consider something or someone in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细考虑；重新考虑
words.ex: I need time to think over your offer.
words.ex_cn: 我需要时间考虑你的提议。
words.en: To consider carefully before making a decision.

words.tr: phrase. 交通堵塞
words.ex: He was late because of a traffic jam.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: A traffic jam is a long line of vehicles that cannot move forward because there is too much traffic, or because the road is blocked by something.

words.tr: phrase. 参加…选拔；测试；试验
words.ex: He wants to try out for the school soccer team.
words.ex_cn: 他想参加校足球队的选拔。
words.en: To test something to see if it is suitable or effective.

words.tr: phrase. 使停止往前；往回走
words.ex: He turned back when he saw the dog.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到狗时，他往回走了。
words.en: To go back in the direction you have come from, or to make someone or something do this.

words.tr: phrase. 调低；关小；拒绝
words.ex: Please turn down the volume, it's too loud.
words.ex_cn: 请把音量调低，太大声了。
words.en: To refuse or reject an offer or request; to reduce the volume, temperature, or intensity of something.

words.tr: phrase. 上床睡觉；上交；告发；交还
words.ex: It's late, so I'll turn in now.
words.ex_cn: 很晚了，我现在上床睡觉。
words.en: To give something to someone in authority, especially a piece of work or something that is lost.

words.tr: phrase. 关掉
words.ex: Please turn off the light before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前请关灯。
words.en: If you turn off a device or machine, you stop it from operating by pressing a button or moving a switch.

words.tr: phrase. 开启；接通；发动；突击
words.ex: He turns on the light in the room.
words.ex_cn: 他打开了房间的灯。
words.en: To cause something to start operating, especially by pressing a switch or button.

words.tr: phrase. 突然出现；重新露面；调大
words.ex: He didn't turn up to the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他没有出席会议。
